📜  資訊

  • 入住價格：$4,670 (兩晚，週一&週二)
  • 地址：22-1-1 Otemachi, Hakodate, Hokkaido 040-0064日本
  • 電話：+66888674777
  • 官方網站：https://www.tokyustay.co.jp/hotel/HAA/
  • 訂房網站：https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/tokyu-stay-hakodate-asaichi-akarinoyu.zh-tw.html

📍 地點位置


飯店位於函館市中心，從函館 JR 站再步行約 5 分鐘內、穿過函館朝市就可以抵達，交通十分便利，地點很不錯。雖然這次我們沒有開車，不過飯店周邊有多個停車場，也很方便自駕旅客。

 

大眾交通

  • 距離JR函館本線「函館」站約4分鐘步行路程
  • 從函館機場乘坐前往函館站方向的巴士約20分鐘

合作停車場

飯店有與飯店左側的「函館朝市停車場」合作，停車時間為下午3點至隔日早上11點前，總共的費用只需含稅 1,000 JPY per day。

🏢 飯店環境與設施

飯店一樓的大廳，有著對外營業的冰淇淋店

飯店櫃檯大一樓大廳，在這裡辦理入住或是任何需要的服務。一樓大廳並不大，除了櫃檯之外，還有一小間對外營業的冰淇淋店 - 「MÚCCARUS」冰淇淋專賣店。

飯店大廳櫃檯

到房間前記得自取需要的備品

也有提供每日的報紙

燈之湯

在18樓頂樓有著露天溫泉，可以體驗一邊泡湯一邊欣賞，一邊是函館灣，一邊是整座城市的夜景。入浴時間：※ 男女湯交替使用

  • 下午 3:00 ～ 凌晨 1:00
  • 早上 5:00 ～ 上午 11:00

照片取自官網：https://www.tokyustay.co.jp/chn_tc/hotel/HAA/#facility

休息室與酒吧

泡完湯後，樓下就有一個休息室，讓住客可以在泡完湯後，到休息室來休息，並且也可以在吧台點一杯清涼的啤酒來喝。這裡可以遠眺海港夜景，景色十分優美。


休息室「Kagayaki」，有提供各式酒類，如啤酒、威士忌或是一些特殊酒類(ex:  草莓、芒果的果實酒)，或是喝一杯無酒精的飲料，配上北海道的冰淇淋。


靜岡戀愛白草莓利口酒搭配氣泡水 ¥ 800

白天的時候，雖然吧台沒有營業，但住客還是可以自由到這個休息室來，這裡有提供咖啡機的咖啡，配上早晨的海景。







🛏  房間環境

這次入住的是雙人床房型，面向函館朝市的方向，一早從窗戶就可以看到現在朝市的人潮。房間內空間大小算蠻不錯的，不會像一般日本住宿來說那麼的擁擠，隔音也還算不錯。

房間內的設備蠻齊全的，該有的都有，像是日本飯店幾乎標配的加濕器也沒缺席。比較特別的是，竟然還有一台可以烘鞋子的機器（不知道是不是因為函館天氣比較容易濕濘？）。冰桶也有附一個，可以自己拿去走廊的製冰機裝冰塊，半夜想喝個冰涼的飲料很方便。

床的軟硬度剛剛好，是那種不會腰痠背痛的舒服硬度。



提供一組玻璃杯與一組馬克杯

這間飯店最不錯的地方，就是房間內就備有洗衣機！且連洗衣精都準備好，讓入住的客人可以直接在房內就洗衣服，不需要到共用區跟大家排隊使用。


拖鞋也不是不好穿的紙拖鞋

兩件式的浴衣，當睡衣蠻好穿的

浴室的部分空間雖然沒有很大，不過是有浴缸的，整體使用算寬敞舒適。


使用日本的 POLA 品牌

早餐的部分是跟函館朝市的店家合作，我們就沒加購了，直接去函館朝市看想吃什麼。

這次在函館入住東急STAY函館朝市 燈之湯的體驗蠻不錯，除了地點方便之外，房間的空間與景色都不錯，如果想找 JR 函館車站附近住宿的話，可以考慮這間。

title.$t: Hakodate Accommodation | Tokyu Stay Hakodate Asaichi Akarinoyu | Near JR Hakodate Station and Hakodate Morning Market | Convenient Location | Affordable Hotel

content.$t:
The first stop on this Hokkaido trip was Hakodate. Since we would be taking the JR onward to Lake Toya, we wanted accommodation with convenient transport that wasn't too far from the attractions. In the end we narrowed it down to a few options near the JR station and Hakodate Morning Market. Not only did we find the transport very convenient, but accommodation in Hakodate is also quite cheap compared to other cities!

We had previously stayed at a Tokyu-brand hotel in Osaka and had a good experience, so this time we chose another Tokyu property—Tokyu Stay Hakodate Asaichi Akarinoyu.

Further reading：Kansai Free-and-Easy Trip | Osaka Accommodation | Osaka Excel Hotel Tokyu | Near Hommachi and Shinsaibashi Stations | New Hotel with Spacious Rooms

📜  Information

  • Room Price: $4,670 (two nights, Mon & Tue)
  • Address: 22-1-1 Otemachi, Hakodate, Hokkaido 040-0064, Japan
  • Phone: +66888674777
  • Official Website：https://www.tokyustay.co.jp/hotel/HAA/
  • Booking Website：https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/tokyu-stay-hakodate-asaichi-akarinoyu.zh-tw.html

📍 Location


The hotel is located in the center of Hakodate. From Hakodate JR Station it's about a 5-minute walk—just cut through the Hakodate Morning Market and you're there. Transport is extremely convenient and the location is excellent. Although we didn't drive this time, there are several parking lots around the hotel, which is also very convenient for self-drive travelers.

 

Public Transport

  • About a 4-minute walk from "Hakodate" Station on the JR Hakodate Main Line
  • About 20 minutes by bus heading toward Hakodate Station from Hakodate Airport

Partner Parking

The hotel partners with the "Hakodate Morning Market Parking Lot" on its left side. Parking hours are from 3:00 PM until 11:00 AM the next morning, and the total fee is just 1,000 JPY per day including tax.

🏢 Hotel Environment & Facilities

The lobby on the ground floor, with an ice cream shop open to the public

The front desk is in the ground-floor lobby, where you check in or get any assistance you need. The ground-floor lobby isn't large; besides the front desk, there's a small ice cream shop open to the public—the "MÚCCARUS" ice cream specialty store.

The hotel lobby front desk

Remember to grab the amenities you need before heading to your room

Daily newspapers are also provided

Akarinoyu (Bath)

On the 18th-floor rooftop there is an open-air hot spring where you can soak while enjoying the view—Hakodate Bay on one side and the city's night view on the other. Bathing hours:※ Men's and women's baths alternate

  • 3:00 PM – 1:00 AM
  • 5:00 AM – 11:00 AM

Photo from the official website：https://www.tokyustay.co.jp/chn_tc/hotel/HAA/#facility

Lounge & Bar

After soaking, there's a lounge one floor below where guests can relax post-bath and order a refreshing beer at the bar. You can gaze out over the harbor's night view from here—the scenery is beautiful.


The lounge "Kagayaki" offers various drinks such as beer, whiskey, and some special liquors (e.g., strawberry and mango fruit liqueurs), or a non-alcoholic drink paired with Hokkaido ice cream.


Shizuoka Koi White Strawberry Liqueur with sparkling water ¥ 800

During the day, although the bar isn't open, guests can still come to this lounge freely. Here you can enjoy coffee from the coffee machine along with the morning sea view.







🛏  Room Environment

This time we stayed in a double-bed room facing the direction of the Hakodate Morning Market—first thing in the morning you can see the crowds at the market from the window. The room was quite spacious, not as cramped as typical Japanese accommodation, and the soundproofing was fairly good too.

The room is quite well-equipped—everything you'd need is there, including the humidifier that's almost standard in Japanese hotels. What's special is that there's even a machine for drying shoes (maybe because Hakodate's weather tends to be damp?). An ice bucket is also provided, so you can go to the ice machine in the hallway to fill it—very handy when you want a cold drink in the middle of the night.

The bed's firmness was just right—a comfortable firmness that won't leave you with a sore back.



A set of glasses and a set of mugs are provided

The best thing about this hotel is that the room comes with its own washing machine! Laundry detergent is even provided, so guests can wash their clothes right in the room without queuing to use the shared area.


The slippers aren't the uncomfortable paper kind either

The two-piece yukata is quite comfortable to wear as pajamas

Although the bathroom isn't very large, it does have a bathtub, and overall it's spacious and comfortable to use.


They use Japan's POLA brand

For breakfast, they partner with shops at the Hakodate Morning Market, so we didn't add it on—we just went straight to the market to see what we wanted to eat.

Our stay at Tokyu Stay Hakodate Asaichi Akarinoyu was quite good. Besides the convenient location, the room's spaciousness and views were great. If you're looking for accommodation near JR Hakodate Station, this is worth considering.

title.$t: 台南住宿 | 友愛街旅館 U.I.J Hotel & Hostel | 結合設計旅店與青年旅舍的混合型旅館 | 復古與文青風

content.$t:
台南，是一座融合歷史與創新的城市，這次選擇入住位於市中心的「友愛街旅館 U.I.J Hotel & Hostel」，這間結合設計旅店與青年旅舍的混合型旅館，不僅提供舒適的住宿空間，更營造出濃厚的文青氛圍。

📜  資訊

  • 入住房型：友緻客房
  • 地址：台南市中西區友愛街115巷5號
  • 電話：06-221-8188
  • 官方網站：https://uij.com.tw/

📍 地點位置

友愛街旅館座落於台南市中西區友愛街115巷5號，地理位置蠻好的，旁邊就是台南美術館二館。周邊有許多知名景點，步行都可以抵達，無論是文化探索如赤崁樓、孔廟、神農街等，還是美食之旅，永樂市場、國華街，或是海安路也都不遠。

自行開車

停車場入口在旅館正門旁邊，雖然旅館外空間蠻大的，還有一個小公園，但因為位於巷弄內，對外的路都很小，必須要從「友愛街115巷」或是「永福路二段35巷」，才能夠進來。

台南火車站轉乘公車

從台南公車站轉乘公車，可搭乘紅幹線公車：1號/5號/10號/11號/18號/19號

  • 西門友愛街口站下車→順行西門路→左轉友愛街→右轉友愛街115巷(友愛市場旁)→U.I.J位於左手邊

高鐵接駁車

高鐵2號出口→高鐵接駁車H31市政府線→建興國中(孔廟)站下車→順行府前路→右轉永福路→左轉友愛街→左轉友愛街115巷(友愛市場旁)→U.I.J位於左手邊 （建興國中站下車後，步行約8-9分鐘抵達）

🏢 飯店環境與設施

一樓大廳的接待櫃檯

走進友愛街旅館的一樓大廳，彷彿穿越回大航海時代。整體空間以「船艦堡壘」為設計概念，運用了大量鉚釘、黑鐵、鉛版等工業風材質，營造出堅實沉穩的氣場。挑高空間結合復古燈具與木質地板，懷舊與現代的元素巧妙交織。

牆面上可見黑膠唱片牆與老件展示櫃，不僅充滿懷舊感，也展現旅館對細節的堅持與品味。沙發區寬敞舒適，是旅人們歇腳、閱讀或短暫工作的理想角落，搭配大片玻璃窗引進自然光，整體氛圍溫暖、寧靜又有設計感。


友愛街旅館是結合設計旅店與青年旅舍的混合型旅館，因此飯店設施有著許多的共享空間，除了一樓的休息空間之外，三樓還有一個很大的共享空間、開放式共享廚房，以及戶外的休憩露臺。


共享空間「你好沙龍 Hello Salon」

來到住房客人才能使用的三樓，這裡有一個空間很大，且採光非常好的共享空間。由於也有許多青年旅舍房型的入住客，蠻多人會在這裡使用共享空間，用電腦、滑手機休息。


停下腳步，來共享空間下一盤棋吧


共享廚房 Open Kitchen

在共享空間內也有一個開放式的廚房，這裡備有烤箱、冰箱、基本餐具與調味料，適合簡單料理或加熱外帶美食，也還有提供咖啡豆跟手沖器具，讓入住旅客可以自己沖一杯咖啡來品嚐。

免費租借桌遊 / 手沖咖啡區

戶外空間的「恣意露臺 Free Terrace」

戶外空間很舒適也很寬敞，天氣好的時候很適合在外面與朋友們聚會、小酌一杯，或是在這裡靜靜享受都市中的寧靜。

夜晚會打燈，會更有氣氛

🛏  房間環境


這次入住的是位於8樓的客房，房內空間算蠻大的，有著 Queen Size 的加大雙人床，房內採光也蠻好的。房內設計延續旅館整體風格，床頭是整面的復古紅磚牆，搭配復古風格的家具，與偏黃色系的燈光，整體氛圍輕鬆舒適。部分房型房內還會有黑膠唱片機，可以到櫃檯借黑膠唱片來播放。

不過整體隔音不是很好，當天比較早入住，隔壁房間還在打掃的聲音都聽得蠻清楚。

室內拖鞋還與林果良品合作，是林果良品的手工鞋

電視尺寸偏小

房內有準備好微礦水與氣泡水，喝完可以再請櫃檯補


友愛街旅館使用的是玻璃瓶裝的微礦水與微礦氣泡水，房內有一瓶微礦水、冰箱裡兩瓶微礦氣泡水，如果喝完了都可以再請櫃檯來補。

窗外可以直接看到台南美術館二館

衛浴的空間與房間在空間上也有所區隔，是乾濕分離設計，而風格與房間一樣，有著紅磚與霧面玻璃的復古風。



空間寬敞，配有 TOTO 的免治馬桶


淋浴空間與廁所空間寬敞，沐浴的備品都是使用 Aesop，一樓也有展示櫃，如果覺得用起來不錯，都可以直接到一樓大廳的 Aesop 櫃檯選購。

🍽️ 早餐


早餐的用餐地點，位於一樓的餐廳，空間挑高寬敞。早餐採用的是一人一客套餐的形式，需使用入住時拿到的早餐兌換卷來兌換，早餐份量適中，口味蠻好吃的。

早餐 Menu




經典暖胃虱目魚飯湯

本地現沖溫體牛肉湯

🍪 手作椪餅

入住的時候還可以報名手作課程，我們報名了手作椪餅的課程 ($100/人)，會在三樓的共享空間，有著旅館員工介紹與教學如何實作椪餅。

「椪餅」是台南特有的傳統糕餅，又被稱為「月子餅」，起源可追溯至十九世紀初。最初是為產後婦女補身所製，隨著時間演變，已成為台南府城具代表性的在地古早味點心。





整體來說，這次入住友愛街旅館的體驗是不錯的，最印象深刻的，是共享空間，不論是閱讀區、共享廚房，還是露台，都充滿設計感與生活氛圍，讓人可以真正放慢節奏。館內整體風格偏向復古工業風中帶有濃濃的文青氣息，對設計與生活品味有要求的旅人應該都會喜歡這裡。

若要挑一點小缺點，大概是隔音表現稍嫌普通。不過這次剛好是平日入住，整層樓房客不多，除了剛開始的打掃聲音之外，也沒有受到其他聲音干擾。

如果計畫來台南玩幾天、想找一間氣氛不錯又可以放鬆放空的旅宿，友愛街旅館會是一個值得考慮的選擇。

title.$t: Tainan Accommodation | U.I.J Hotel & Hostel | A Hybrid of Design Hotel and Youth Hostel | Retro and Hipster Vibes

content.$t:
Tainan is a city where history and innovation come together. This time we chose to stay at "U.I.J Hotel & Hostel" in the city center, a hybrid property that blends a design hotel with a youth hostel. It not only offers comfortable places to stay, but also creates a strong artsy, hipster atmosphere.

📜  Information

  • Room type: U Room
  • Address: No. 5, Lane 115, Youai Street, West Central District, Tainan City
  • Phone: 06-221-8188
  • Official website: https://uij.com.tw/

📍 Location

U.I.J Hotel & Hostel sits at No. 5, Lane 115, Youai Street, West Central District, Tainan — a great location, right next to Tainan Art Museum Building 2. There are many famous attractions nearby, all within walking distance, whether you're after culture such as Chihkan Tower, the Confucius Temple and Shennong Street, or a food tour — Yongle Market, Guohua Street and Hai'an Road are all close by, too.

Driving yourself

The parking entrance is right beside the hotel's main door. Although there's quite a bit of open space outside the hotel, plus a small park, it sits inside a lane, and the access roads are all narrow — you have to come in via "Lane 115, Youai Street" or "Lane 35, Section 2, Yongfu Road."

Bus transfer from Tainan Railway Station

From the Tainan bus station, take the Red Trunk Line buses: No. 1 / 5 / 10 / 11 / 18 / 19

  • Get off at Ximen Youai Street Intersection stop → walk along Ximen Road → turn left onto Youai Street → turn right into Lane 115, Youai Street (next to Youai Market) → U.I.J is on your left

HSR shuttle bus

HSR Exit 2 → HSR shuttle bus H31 City Hall Line → get off at Jianxing Junior High School (Confucius Temple) stop → walk along Fuqian Road → turn right onto Yongfu Road → turn left onto Youai Street → turn left into Lane 115, Youai Street (next to Youai Market) → U.I.J is on your left (about an 8–9 minute walk from the Jianxing Junior High School stop)

🏢 Hotel Environment and Facilities

The reception desk in the ground-floor lobby

Walking into the hotel's ground-floor lobby feels like stepping back into the Age of Exploration. The whole space is designed around the concept of a "ship fortress," using plenty of industrial materials such as rivets, black iron and lead panels to create a solid, grounded presence. The high ceilings, retro light fixtures and wooden floors weave nostalgic and modern elements together beautifully.

On the walls you'll find a vinyl record display and cabinets of vintage objects — full of nostalgia, and a sign of the hotel's insistence on detail and taste. The sofa area is spacious and comfortable, an ideal corner for travelers to rest, read or get a little work done, while large glass windows let in natural light, making the whole atmosphere warm, quiet and design-conscious.


Because U.I.J is a hybrid of design hotel and youth hostel, it has plenty of shared spaces. Besides the lounge on the ground floor, the third floor has a large shared area, an open shared kitchen, and an outdoor terrace for relaxing.


The shared space, "Hello Salon"

Up on the third floor, accessible only to hotel guests, there's a very large shared space with excellent natural light. Since many guests stay in the hostel-style rooms, quite a few people use this area to work on their laptops, scroll on their phones, or simply relax.


Take a break and play a round of chess in the shared space


Open Kitchen

Inside the shared space there's also an open kitchen, equipped with an oven, refrigerator, basic tableware and seasonings — perfect for simple cooking or reheating takeout. Coffee beans and pour-over equipment are provided too, so guests can brew themselves a cup of coffee.

Free board game rental / pour-over coffee corner

The outdoor "Free Terrace"

The outdoor area is comfortable and spacious. When the weather is nice it's a great spot to gather with friends for a drink, or just to quietly enjoy a moment of calm in the middle of the city.

At night the lights come on for even more atmosphere

🛏  The Room


This time we stayed in a room on the 8th floor. The room is quite spacious, with a queen-size bed and plenty of natural light. The design continues the hotel's overall style: the headboard wall is entirely retro red brick, paired with vintage-style furniture and warm yellow lighting for a relaxed, comfortable feel. Some room types even come with a vinyl record player, and you can borrow records from the front desk to play.

That said, overall the soundproofing isn't great — we checked in fairly early that day and could clearly hear housekeeping cleaning the room next door.

The in-room slippers are a collaboration with Oriental Traditions (Lin Guo Liang Pin) — handmade shoes

The TV is on the small side

Mineral water and sparkling water are provided in the room; ask the front desk for refills


The hotel uses glass-bottled Weikuang mineral water and sparkling water. There's one bottle of still water in the room and two bottles of sparkling water in the fridge — if you finish them, just ask the front desk for more.

You can see Tainan Art Museum Building 2 right out the window

The bathroom is separated from the bedroom and features a wet/dry separation design. The style matches the room, with retro red brick and frosted glass.



Spacious, with a TOTO washlet toilet


The shower and toilet areas are roomy, and the bath amenities are all Aesop. There's a display counter on the ground floor as well, so if you like the products you can buy them directly at the Aesop counter in the lobby.

🍽️ Breakfast


Breakfast is served in the ground-floor restaurant, a high-ceilinged, spacious room. It's a set meal, one per person, redeemed with the breakfast voucher you receive at check-in. The portions are just right and the food tastes great.

Breakfast menu




Classic comforting milkfish rice soup

Local freshly-poured warm beef soup

🍪 Handmade Pong-piah

During your stay you can also sign up for hands-on workshops. We signed up for the handmade pong-piah (puffed pastry) class (NT$100 per person), held in the shared space on the third floor, where a staff member introduces the pastry and teaches you how to make it.

"Pong-piah" is a traditional pastry unique to Tainan, also known as "confinement cake," with origins traceable to the early 19th century. It was originally made to nourish women after childbirth, and over time it has become one of the most representative old-school local snacks of Tainan's old city.





Overall, our stay at U.I.J Hotel & Hostel was a good one. What left the deepest impression were the shared spaces — the reading area, the shared kitchen, and the terrace are all full of design sense and a lived-in warmth that really lets you slow down. The overall style leans retro-industrial with a strong artsy touch, and travelers who care about design and lifestyle should love it here.

If I had to pick a small flaw, it would be the merely average soundproofing. That said, we happened to stay on a weekday when the floor wasn't crowded, so apart from the cleaning noise at the start, nothing else disturbed us.

If you're planning a few days in Tainan and want a stay with great atmosphere where you can truly unwind, U.I.J Hotel & Hostel is well worth considering.

title.$t: 台北酒吧 | 枝枒．氣氛轉換所/気分転換所 New Leaf 餐酒館 | 位於信義安和的新餐酒館

content.$t:
這次剛好有機會來到這間位於信義安和，新開幕還正在試營運的餐酒館「枝枒．氣氛轉換所/気分転換所 New Leaf 」，這裡前身是「宜窩 EQUAL by TKLAB」，新的團隊在原址重新開始，想主打提供一個舒適的空間，讓大家能在踏入的瞬間，開始在心情上有所轉換，好好放鬆體驗。

📜 資訊

  • 地址：110台北市信義區嘉興街8號
  • 營業時間：18:00 - 01:00 (週二公休)
  • 聯絡電話：0287869006
  • 官方粉專：https://www.instagram.com/bar_new_leaf/
  • 訂位：inline 訂位

📍 地點與店內環境

枝枒‧気分転換所 New Leaf ，位於信義區嘉興街，離 101 捷運站稍微比較近一點，步行約 5 分鐘就可以抵達了，地點交通方便，處於台北酒吧的一級戰區內。

店門口的拍貼機

店門口外還有一台韓式拍貼機，在試營運期間只要拍貼 (印象中好像 $200~$250 不等)，就免費送一杯特調 ($350)。


室內採用的光線舒適，採用許多有弧形的間接照明，且空間蠻寬敞的，不像一些酒吧或是餐酒館般的擁擠。

除了吧台之外，前面的區塊有許多的四人桌，後面的部分則是有沙發區，可以接待更多人數的客人。


低調有質感的裝潢設計

主要的吧台

入座時桌上的小卡

接著會有四款香氛，解憂、放空、回憶、沉浸，需要從其中挑一個喜歡的味道，噴在小卡上，說讓這個味道陪你度過這一個夜晚，概念雖簡單但還蠻有趣的。

四款香氛：解憂、放空、回憶、沉浸

📜 Menu 

線上 Menu: 枝枒．氣氛轉換所 New Leaf Menu 

Menu 的部分分為活動酒單、生日套餐、獨家調酒，與其他食物的部分。

🍸 調酒

迎賓的無酒精飲品

迎賓的無酒精飲品是其中一杯特調「春露」的無酒精版本，四季春、青蘋果與白豆蔻，酸甜帶有微微茶香。

註：風味與口感很主觀，以下為自己嘗試的心得，建議大家還是可以自己嘗試看看

如煙

這杯「如煙」，一上桌就有儀式感也好拍照(?)，會點燃一張玫瑰香氛紙，淡淡的煙霧帶點花香，讓人瞬間進入放鬆的狀態。基底是用台灣的紅玉紅茶去舒肥蘭姆酒，香氣溫潤順口，喝起來有黑醋栗的果酸，還帶著蜜桃的甜香（雖然其實沒加桃子，但聞起來很像）。整體是想走清爽酸甜的妹酒風格，尾段會慢慢浮出茶香，整體表現中規中矩，不過最後收尾的酒精感有衝出來比較可惜。

與過去說再見/ Turn over a new leaf


這杯酒的操作概念蠻有趣的，增加了蠻多互動感。首先會要我們先寫上想要說再見的一件事，再來點燃燒掉，象徵與這件事情說再見，最後才飲用這杯酒。



與過去不成熟的自己說再見

效果十足，好拍也蠻有趣

這杯酒從名字開始就很有故事感，像是在告別，也像是在整理心情，準備迎接下一段旅程。

整杯使用櫻桃木煙燻，是很明確、甚至有點強勢的開場，酒體本身的組合使用了六琴酒 infused 肖楠木，加上澄清番茄汁，以及自製的洛神雪莉酒。風味像是帶點清淡的木質香調，酒感偏明顯，入口時會有一點淡淡不是很討喜的香精感。

剛開始喝的時候覺得煙燻有點太搶戲，跟酒體的風味稍微有點分離，我們嘗試將這杯放一下、讓煙氣散掉一些之後，整體的味道變得好一點點。

小時候我都這樣喝飲料/ The drink from old time


像古早味的冬瓜茶一樣用袋子裝，你要再把它倒出來

這杯用了金賓威士忌作為基底，搭配梅子、烏醋和冬瓜茶，最上面還放了一朵糖漬的洛神花當作小點綴，視覺上有種在喝「升級版童年飲料」的感覺。

一靠近先聞到冬瓜茶的香氣，混著洛神的微酸；喝下去則是明顯的烏梅風味，帶著一點點冬瓜茶的甜，清爽又不膩。整體順口，酒感不會突兀地衝出來，可以說是我們當晚最喜歡的一杯。

田野市集

這杯田野市集在酒單上使用的元素是「豆芽菜、山葵、蘆筍」搭配琴酒基底，我們看到的時候就覺得蠻新奇的，第一次看到有人使用豆芽菜入酒，因此就點來試試看。聞的時候的確就是豆芽菜的味道，入口袋有蘆筍，與尾韻山葵微微的味道，整體像是有一點點山葵味道的波蜜果菜汁，以嚐鮮來說蠻有趣的。

Sidecar

最後點了杯經典試試，可惜並不在我們預期中的風味。

🍽️ 餐點

餐點的部分整體來說，覺得口味都還蠻不錯的，適合點來下酒。

炸物拼盤

漢堡排

玉子燒

招牌炸雞

屋台炒麵



    店家招待：使用烏醋的澄清版血腥瑪莉 shot

    整體來說，枝枒．氣氛轉換所的空間舒適，氛圍輕鬆，很適合下班後來這裡放空一下。而且地點位在信義安和一帶的酒吧密集區，當作 bar hopping 的起點也非常合適。餐點表現不錯，當天點的幾道菜都沒踩雷，服務人員也很親切，對於菜單的介紹詳細又有耐心。

    最後調酒的部分，呈現方式有記憶點，視覺上也蠻適合拍照打卡。風味上比較主觀，幾杯喝下來有新鮮感，也有趣味性，但是否合口味就見仁見智了。整體來說，是屬於偏大眾口味、入門友善的餐酒館風格。

    酒吧清單 | Bar surfing around the world | 世界酒吧巡禮紀錄

      • 台灣旅遊 | 台灣景點清單

      如果喜歡我的分享，也可以追蹤以下旅遊的帳號，會定期分享自己覺得美麗的景點與實用的旅遊資訊，也歡迎推薦好玩的地點！

title.$t: Taipei Bars | New Leaf Bistro (枝枒．気分転換所) | A New Bistro-Bar in Xinyi Anhe

content.$t:
This time I had the chance to visit this newly opened bistro-bar in Xinyi Anhe, still in its soft-opening phase — "New Leaf (枝枒．氣氛轉換所/気分転換所)". The space was previously home to "EQUAL by TKLAB", and a new team has made a fresh start at the same address. Their aim is to offer a comfortable space where, the moment you step inside, your mood begins to shift and you can truly relax and unwind.

📜 Information

  • Address: No. 8, Jiaxing St., Xinyi District, Taipei 110
  • Hours: 18:00 - 01:00 (closed Tuesdays)
  • Phone: 0287869006
  • Official page: https://www.instagram.com/bar_new_leaf/
  • Reservations: Book on inline

📍 Location & Interior

New Leaf (枝枒‧気分転換所) sits on Jiaxing Street in Xinyi District, slightly closer to Taipei 101 MRT Station — about a 5-minute walk. It's easy to reach and right in the heart of Taipei's most competitive bar district.

The photo sticker booth at the entrance

There's a Korean-style photo sticker booth right outside the door. During the soft-opening period, taking photos (around $200–$250 as I recall) got you a free signature cocktail ($350).


The interior lighting is soft and comfortable, with plenty of curved indirect lighting, and the space is quite roomy — not cramped like some bars and bistros.

Besides the bar counter, the front section has plenty of four-person tables, while the back has a sofa area that can accommodate larger groups.


Understated, tasteful interior design

The main bar counter

The little card waiting on the table

Then you're offered four fragrances — Worry-Free, Blank Mind, Memory, and Immersion — and you pick the scent you like best and spray it onto the card, so that the aroma keeps you company through the night. A simple concept, but a fun one.

Four fragrances: Worry-Free, Blank Mind, Memory, Immersion

📜 Menu 

Online menu: New Leaf Menu 

The menu is divided into event drinks, birthday sets, signature cocktails, and food.

🍸 Cocktails

The non-alcoholic welcome drink

The welcome drink is a non-alcoholic version of one of their signature cocktails, "Spring Dew" — Four Seasons oolong, green apple and white cardamom, sweet-tart with a faint tea aroma.

Note: flavour and texture are very subjective — the following are just my own impressions, so do go and try them for yourself.

Like Smoke

"Like Smoke" arrives with a real sense of ceremony (and it's very photogenic): a rose-scented paper is lit, and the faint smoke carries a floral note that instantly puts you in a relaxed state. The base is rum sous-vide infused with Taiwanese Ruby black tea, giving a warm, smooth aroma, with blackcurrant tartness and a honeyed peach sweetness (there's no peach in it, but it certainly smells like it). Overall it aims for a light, sweet-and-sour crowd-pleasing style, with tea notes gradually emerging on the finish. A solid if unremarkable performance — though it's a shame the alcohol pushes through a bit on the finish.

Turn Over a New Leaf


The concept behind this drink is quite fun and adds a lot of interaction. First you write down one thing you'd like to say goodbye to, then it's set alight and burned — symbolising your farewell to it — and only then do you drink.



Saying goodbye to my younger, less mature self

Great effect — photogenic and good fun

This drink has a story in it right from the name — it feels like a farewell, and also like sorting out your feelings before moving on to the next chapter.

The whole drink is smoked with cherry wood, a clear, even somewhat forceful opening. The liquid itself combines Roku gin infused with Taiwan incense cedar, clarified tomato juice, and house-made roselle sherry. The flavour has a light woody profile, with fairly pronounced alcohol and a slightly artificial-perfume note on the palate that isn't the most appealing.

At first the smoke felt like it was stealing the show and sat a little apart from the drink itself; after letting it rest a while for the smoke to disperse, the overall flavour improved a little.

The Drink from Old Times


Served in a bag like old-school winter melon tea — you pour it out yourself

This one uses Jim Beam as its base, paired with plum, black vinegar and winter melon tea, topped with a candied roselle flower as a garnish — visually it really feels like drinking an "upgraded childhood beverage".

The first thing you smell is winter melon tea mixed with the gentle tartness of roselle; on the palate there's a clear smoked-plum flavour with a touch of winter melon sweetness — refreshing without being cloying. It goes down easily and the alcohol never jumps out awkwardly. This was our favourite drink of the night.

Farmers' Market

On the menu, Farmers' Market lists "bean sprouts, wasabi and asparagus" over a gin base. It struck us as novel — the first time we'd seen bean sprouts used in a cocktail — so we had to try it. On the nose it really is bean sprouts; on the palate there's asparagus, with a faint wasabi note on the finish. Overall it tastes rather like a mixed vegetable juice with a hint of wasabi — a fun one to try for novelty's sake.

Sidecar

We finished with a classic, though sadly it wasn't quite the flavour we expected.

🍽️ Food

On the whole, we thought the food was pretty tasty — great for pairing with drinks.

Fried Snack Platter

Hamburg Steak

Tamagoyaki

Signature Fried Chicken

Yatai Fried Noodles



    On the house: a clarified Bloody Mary shot made with black vinegar

    Overall, New Leaf offers a comfortable space with a relaxed atmosphere — perfect for switching off after work. And since it sits in the dense bar cluster around Xinyi Anhe, it also makes an excellent starting point for a night of bar hopping. The food performs well; none of the dishes we ordered that night were a letdown, and the staff were friendly, explaining the menu in detail and with plenty of patience.

    As for the cocktails, the presentations are memorable and very photo-friendly. Flavour is more subjective — the drinks we tried had novelty and playfulness, but whether they suit your palate is another matter. All in all, it's a fairly mainstream, beginner-friendly bistro-bar.

title.$t: 台南酒吧 | Bar Home | 日系復古風格老宅 | 台南指標性酒吧之一

content.$t:
Bar Home，是 TCRC 主理人阿翔在台南開設的第二間酒吧，如果聽過 TCRC，Bar Home 肯定也是不陌生的台南酒吧。而在 Bar Home 主打的是「開放」與「日常」，想讓每一個來到這裡的人，都能感受到像家一樣的自在與溫暖。

這次來台南沒有特別先訂位，因為剛好住在 Bar Home 不遠，就來試試運氣看能不能成功 Walk-in，很幸運地在週日晚上還有些位置。

📜 資訊

  • 地址：700台南市中西區中山路23巷1號 No
  • 電話：062232869
  • 營業時間：19:00 - 01:00
  • 官方粉絲頁：https://www.instagram.com/barhome1201/
  • 訂位方式：線上訂位 or 直接撥打電話


🏢  店內環境

進門前沒有招牌，僅在門口看到一個寫著「home」的小鐵牌，搭配木質大門與些許植栽，簡單卻很有個性。前身為耳鼻喉科診所老洋房的 Bar Home，一進門內的店內空間，是一個日系復古風格，暖色燈光、木質桌椅、適合聊天的音樂音量，給人很舒適的感覺。

店內空間其實蠻大的，除了寬敞呈現 L 字型的吧台之外，還有許多兩人座，與許多舒適的沙發區域，後面更還有另一區空間。這裡的客群組成非常多元，當天有遇到蠻多組家庭客帶著孩子來吃飯，呼應前面提到想要打造像是家一樣的自在與溫暖感。


🍸 調酒

森 Woods

蘇格蘭威士忌與琴酒為基底，結合柚子、紫蘇與檜木香氣。一開始聞的時候，紫蘇風味非常明顯，入口的酸甜剛好，酒感偏重但不刺激，尾韻則緩緩帶出柚子柑橘的清爽餘味。 

紅酒起司 Wine & Cheese

以葡萄、檸檬、鳳梨為基底，覆蓋上煙燻 cheese foam 與鹹奶蓋，撒上一點黑胡椒，聽說整體靈感來自 sangria，酒體輕盈。上面的烤麵包與起司很好吃，喝的時候鹹奶蓋與底下的酒搭配，酸甜與鹹香交錯，整體是輕鬆順口的一杯。

🍸 無酒精特調

Bar Home 也有提供無酒精調酒選項，不同於有些酒吧的無酒精只能喝果汁，Bar Home 的無酒精調飲是真的有層次也印象深刻的，調酒師會先詢問你有沒有什麼不喜歡的水果，然後根據當天有的水果或是材料，來準備無酒精特調。

葡萄・蔓越莓・烏龍茶

這杯口感帶有淡淡茶香與果酸，酸甜比例拿捏得恰到好處，尾段芭樂泡沫讓整體收尾帶一點滑順與熱帶感，搭配烏龍茶的尾韻，好喝有層次且印象深刻。

香蘭・檸檬・鳳梨

這杯入口先是鳳梨的甜與檸檬的酸，隨後出現一點類似米香、芋頭的淡淡香氣，來自香蘭葉的風味。其中這裡的香蘭葉糖漿，調酒師說是使用自家種植的香蘭葉，然後自製成糖漿，像是一杯隱藏版的東南亞甜點，輕盈又特別。

Bar Home 雖然目前還未進榜 Asia’s 50 Best Bars 的正式名單，但已經入選「Discovery」推薦酒吧，在台南也是一家不好訂位的酒吧，常常一位難求。除了調酒做得很不錯之外，這次印象特別深刻的則是無酒精的調飲，因為做出有趣、又有層次的無酒精調飲是十分困難的。來到台南，很值得來 Bar Home 試試！

title.$t: Tainan Bars | Bar Home | A Japanese-Style Retro Old House | One of Tainan's Landmark Bars

content.$t:
Bar Home is the second bar opened in Tainan by A-Xiang, the man behind TCRC. If you've heard of TCRC, then Bar Home is surely a familiar name among Tainan's bars too. What Bar Home focuses on is "openness" and "everyday life" — the hope is that everyone who walks in feels the same ease and warmth they would at home.

This time in Tainan I didn't book ahead, but since I happened to be staying not far from Bar Home, I decided to try my luck with a walk-in. Luckily there were still a few seats free on a Sunday night.

📜 Information

  • Address: No. 1, Lane 23, Zhongshan Rd., West Central District, Tainan 700
  • Phone: 06-223-2869
  • Opening hours: 19:00 - 01:00
  • Official page: https://www.instagram.com/barhome1201/
  • Reservations: book online or call directly


🏢  The Space

There's no signboard out front — just a small iron plate reading "home" by the entrance, paired with a wooden door and a few plants: simple, but full of character. Bar Home occupies a former ENT clinic housed in an old Western-style building, and the interior is decked out in a Japanese retro style, with warm lighting, wooden tables and chairs, and music kept at a volume that's perfect for conversation. It all feels very comfortable.

The space is actually quite large. Besides the spacious L-shaped bar counter, there are plenty of two-seater tables and comfortable sofa areas, plus another section further back. The crowd here is very diverse — that night I saw quite a few families with children coming in for dinner, which echoes the idea mentioned earlier of creating the ease and warmth of a home.


🍸 Cocktails

Woods (森)

Built on a base of Scotch whisky and gin, combined with yuzu, shiso and hinoki cypress aromas. On the first sniff the shiso comes through very clearly; on the palate the sweet-tart balance is just right, and the alcohol is fairly assertive but never harsh, with the finish gradually unfolding into a refreshing yuzu-citrus aftertaste. 

Wine & Cheese

Based on grape, lemon and pineapple, topped with a smoked cheese foam and a salted cream cap, finished with a sprinkle of black pepper. Apparently the whole thing was inspired by sangria, and the body is light. The toasted bread and cheese on top are delicious, and as you drink, the salted cream cap plays off the liquid beneath, weaving sweet-tart and savoury notes together. All in all, an easy-drinking, breezy glass.

🍸 Non-Alcoholic Creations

Bar Home also offers non-alcoholic cocktails, and unlike some bars where "no alcohol" just means fruit juice, the mocktails here genuinely have depth and leave an impression. The bartender first asks whether there's any fruit you dislike, then builds a bespoke non-alcoholic drink from whatever fruit and ingredients are on hand that day.

Grape · Cranberry · Oolong Tea

This one carries a gentle tea fragrance and fruity acidity, with the sweet-tart ratio judged just right. The guava foam at the end lends a silky, tropical touch to the finish, and paired with the lingering oolong notes it's delicious, layered and memorable.

Pandan · Lemon · Pineapple

The first sip brings pineapple sweetness and lemon acidity, followed by a faint aroma reminiscent of rice or taro — that's the pandan leaf coming through. The bartender told me the pandan syrup here is made in-house from pandan leaves they grow themselves. It's like a secret-menu Southeast Asian dessert in a glass: light and distinctive.

Although Bar Home hasn't yet cracked the official Asia's 50 Best Bars list, it has already been named to the "Discovery" recommended bars, and in Tainan it's a notoriously hard place to book, with seats often in short supply. Beyond the very well-made cocktails, what left the deepest impression this time were the non-alcoholic drinks — because creating mocktails that are both interesting and layered is genuinely difficult. If you're in Tainan, Bar Home is well worth a visit!

title.$t: 曼谷住宿 |  曼谷沙通雅詩閣大使酒店 Ascott Embassy Sathorn Bangkok | 五星級公寓式酒店 | 無邊際高空泳池

content.$t:
這次在曼谷的行程，選擇了兩個不同的住宿，除了前半行程住宿的 卡拉羅姆酒店 Karaarom Hotel 之外，行程的後半段，我們入住了 Ascott Embassy Sathorn Bangkok。

這間酒店於 2022 年開幕，隸屬於新加坡雅詩閣集團（The Ascott Limited），整體設施相當新穎，融合了公寓的居家感與五星級飯店的高端服務，且距離 Sala Daeng BTS Station 與 Chong Nonsi Station 兩站都不遠，交通十分便利。

📜  資訊

  • 入住價格：$8,915 (平日二晚，房型 Deluxe Hotel Room 含早餐)
  • 地址：No. 59 South Sathorn Road, Thungmahamek, Sathorn, Bangkok
  • 電話：+6623431999
  • 官方網站：https://www.discoverasr.com/en/ascott-the-residence/thailand/ascott-embassy-sathorn-bangkok
  • 訂房網站：https://www.booking.com/hotel/th/ascott-embassy-sathorn-bangkok.zh-tw.html

📍 地點位置

Ascott Embassy Sathorn Bangkok 位於車水馬龍的 S Sathon Rd 路上，直線距離約在 Sala Daeng BTS Station 與 Chong Nonsi Station 兩站的中間位置，不論要去哪一站搭 BTS 都還算蠻方便的，步行距離都約 10 分鐘左右。

不過曼谷的交通壅塞真的很可怕，飯店位在的 S Sathon Rd 這條路上，大約早上 10 點左右車流量就很大了，一路會塞到晚上，有一天我們從飯店附近叫 grab，花了半小時才離開這條路...

飯店的門口比較不顯眼一點，且入口區也沒有太大的停車空間，屬於比較低調的類型，一不小心會以為只是一間商辦大樓而錯過。

飯店有提供前往 BTS 站與 Icon Siam (假日限定) 的免費接駁車

🏢 飯店環境與設施

飯店的一樓接待大廳

Ascott Embassy Sathorn Bangkok 的一樓大廳空間並不大，如果在入住或是退房的尖峰時刻，大廳會顯得蠻擁擠的，兩旁讓入住旅客稍作休息的座位區也並不多，我們抵達的時間約是中午12點，大廳的人潮很多，動線會感覺有點混亂。

大廳的座位區

行政酒廊 Residence Lounge

📍 位置：9 樓
⏰ 開放時間：06:00 - 22:00

Ascott Embassy Sathorn Bangkok 的設施大多集中在 9 樓，與夾層 9M 樓，而行政酒廊的位置就位於 9 樓，這裡有著寬敞的空間與高挑的天花板，每日還有著 Buy 2 get 1 free 的 Happy Hour 時段 (5 - 7 PM)。


這裡的座位與空間比樓下大廳舒適許多，在行程空檔可以來這裡休息喝上一杯，而這次入住的時候同時加入飯店會員，每人有贈送任何一杯有酒精/無酒精飲品，點了兩杯無酒精的特調，都還蠻好喝的。

Sweet Lavender - 芋頭牛奶、椰奶與椰果

 Golden Groove - 芒果、檸檬、椰奶

無邊際泳池 Infinity Swimming Pool

📍 位置：9 樓
⏰ 開放時間：06:00 - 22:00

在行政酒廊外面，有一個高空無邊際泳池，視野非常遼闊，成為許多人拍攝網美照的熱點。住客也可以點上一杯行政酒廊的飲品，帶到泳池邊悠閒地享用。

烤箱與置物區隱藏在廁所內

健身房 Gymnasium

📍 位置：9M 樓
⏰ 開放時間：06:00 - 22:00

位在 9M 樓層 有著空間蠻大的健身房，以飯店的健身房來說，器材算是蠻多的，能滿足基本的運動需求。這裡也有飲水機，讓來運動的房客可以直接使用。除了可以搭電梯直達外，從泳池邊的樓梯也能直接走上來，動線還算方便。

面對泳池 view 的跑步機

🛏  房間環境

這次入住的是最基本的 Deluxe Hotel Room 房型，包含早餐，入住時間是下午 14:00 後，隔天退房時間則是中午 12:00 前，住宿時間相較於很多飯店來說比較多一點點。

由於屬於標準客房，沒有配備廚房或洗衣機等公寓式酒店的設施，不過空間適中，要完全攤平兩個大行李箱是完全沒問題的。房間內整體乾淨簡潔，採光明亮。唯一較可惜的是，我們入住在 26 樓，但窗外正對著另一棟大樓，完全沒有景觀可賞。

有一個可以辦公的書桌

電視前還有一個小沙發區域

免費的 mini bar 與咖啡機，種類蠻豐富的

衛浴的空間很大



房卡是很有質感的木質房卡

🍽️ 早餐

早餐是在 37 樓 的「新古」中餐廳享用，這裡的景色相當不錯，用餐區採用大片落地窗，視野開闊。一早來這裡，一邊享用早餐，一邊欣賞曼谷的高空市景，整體氛圍既放鬆又舒適，是個很愉快的用餐體驗。




用餐區域明亮且開闊

食物的部分種類不算多，口味的部分很主觀，但自己是覺得沒有到很好吃，算是一大缺點，可惜這個用餐環境了。



整體來說，這次的住宿體驗還蠻不錯的，床鋪軟硬適中，隔音效果也不錯，能讓人好好休息一晚。房內空間設計簡潔，採光明亮，住起來很舒適。再加上飯店地點便利，無論是搭乘大眾交通工具或步行前往周邊景點都很方便。

此外，因為飯店開幕才幾年，硬體設施都還很新穎，無論是房內設備、健身房，還是無邊際泳池，整體維護得都很好，以五星級酒店來說，確實符合預期。唯一比較可惜的，就是早餐的部分沒有特別令人驚艷，稍微有點可惜。

title.$t: Bangkok Hotels | Ascott Embassy Sathorn Bangkok | Five-Star Serviced Apartment Hotel | Rooftop Infinity Pool

content.$t:
For this trip to Bangkok we chose two different places to stay. Besides the Karaarom Hotel where we stayed during the first half of the trip, for the second half we checked into Ascott Embassy Sathorn Bangkok.

This hotel opened in 2022 and belongs to Singapore's The Ascott Limited. The facilities are all quite new, blending the homey feel of an apartment with high-end five-star hotel service, and it isn't far from either Sala Daeng BTS Station or Chong Nonsi Station, making it very convenient to get around.

📜  Information

  • Price: $8,915 (two weeknights, Deluxe Hotel Room with breakfast)
  • Address: No. 59 South Sathorn Road, Thungmahamek, Sathorn, Bangkok
  • Phone: +6623431999
  • Official website: https://www.discoverasr.com/en/ascott-the-residence/thailand/ascott-embassy-sathorn-bangkok
  • Booking site: https://www.booking.com/hotel/th/ascott-embassy-sathorn-bangkok.zh-tw.html

📍 Location

Ascott Embassy Sathorn Bangkok sits on the busy S Sathon Rd, roughly midway between Sala Daeng BTS Station and Chong Nonsi Station. Either station is fairly convenient for catching the BTS, with both about a 10-minute walk away.

That said, Bangkok traffic is truly terrifying. On S Sathon Rd, where the hotel is located, traffic already gets heavy around 10 in the morning and stays jammed until night. One day we called a Grab near the hotel and it took half an hour just to get off this road...

The hotel entrance is fairly inconspicuous, and there isn't much parking space at the drop-off area — it's quite low key, so if you're not paying attention you might mistake it for an office building and walk right past.

The hotel offers a free shuttle to the BTS station and to Icon Siam (weekends only)

🏢 Hotel Environment & Facilities

The ground-floor reception lobby

The ground-floor lobby of Ascott Embassy Sathorn Bangkok isn't very big, so during peak check-in and check-out times it feels quite crowded, and there aren't many seats on either side for guests to rest. We arrived around noon, when the lobby was packed and the flow of people felt a bit chaotic.

The lobby seating area

Residence Lounge

📍 Location: 9th floor
⏰ Opening hours: 06:00 - 22:00

Most of the facilities at Ascott Embassy Sathorn Bangkok are concentrated on the 9th floor and the 9M mezzanine, and the Residence Lounge is on the 9th floor. It's a spacious room with high ceilings, and there's a daily Buy 2 Get 1 Free Happy Hour (5 - 7 PM).


The seating and space here are far more comfortable than the lobby downstairs — a great spot to rest and grab a drink between outings. We also signed up for hotel membership during this stay, which came with one complimentary drink (alcoholic or non-alcoholic) per person. We ordered two non-alcoholic signature drinks and both were quite tasty.

Sweet Lavender - taro milk, coconut milk and nata de coco

 Golden Groove - mango, lemon and coconut milk

Infinity Swimming Pool

📍 Location: 9th floor
⏰ Opening hours: 06:00 - 22:00

Just outside the Residence Lounge is a rooftop infinity pool with sweeping views — a hotspot for photo-worthy shots. Guests can also order a drink from the lounge and enjoy it poolside at their leisure.

The sauna and lockers are tucked away inside the restrooms

Gymnasium

📍 Location: 9M floor
⏰ Opening hours: 06:00 - 22:00

On the 9M floor there's a fairly large gym. For a hotel gym it has plenty of equipment, enough to cover basic workout needs. There's also a water dispenser for guests to use. Besides taking the elevator straight up, you can also walk up via the stairs beside the pool, which makes getting around quite easy.

Treadmills facing the pool view

🛏  The Room

This time we stayed in the most basic Deluxe Hotel Room, breakfast included. Check-in is after 14:00 and check-out is before noon the next day, giving you a bit more time in the room than at many other hotels.

As a standard room, it doesn't come with a kitchen or washing machine like the serviced-apartment units, but the space is a decent size — laying out two large suitcases fully open was no problem at all. The room is clean and uncluttered overall, with plenty of natural light. The only shame was that although we stayed on the 26th floor, our window faced directly onto another building, so there was no view to speak of.

There's a desk you can work at

There's also a small sofa area in front of the TV

A complimentary mini bar and coffee machine, with a good variety

The bathroom is very spacious



The room key is a nicely crafted wooden card

🍽️ Breakfast

Breakfast is served at the Chinese restaurant "Xin Gu" on the 37th floor, where the views are excellent — the dining area is lined with floor-to-ceiling windows for a wide-open outlook. Coming here in the morning to enjoy breakfast while taking in Bangkok's skyline makes for a relaxed, comfortable and very pleasant dining experience.




The dining area is bright and open

The food selection isn't especially wide, and taste is subjective, but personally I didn't find it particularly delicious — a real drawback, and a shame given such a lovely dining setting.



Overall, this was a pretty good stay. The bed was just the right firmness and the soundproofing was solid, so we slept well. The room design is clean and simple with plenty of natural light, making it very comfortable to stay in. On top of that, the hotel's location is convenient — easy to reach nearby attractions whether by public transport or on foot.

What's more, since the hotel has only been open a few years, the hardware is all still new; the in-room fittings, the gym and the infinity pool are all well maintained, and it certainly lives up to expectations for a five-star hotel. The only letdown was breakfast, which wasn't particularly impressive — a bit of a shame.

title.$t: Bangkok Hotel | Karaarom Hotel | Affordable Design-Led Boutique Stay | 7-Minute Walk from BTS Thong Lor Station | With Glimmer Bar On-Site

content.$t:
Accommodation prices in central Bangkok are far more affordable than in many other major cities around the world. On this, my second trip to Bangkok, I browsed through the stays people had shared online and settled on a hotel with a hip, design-conscious style: Karaarom Hotel.

📜  Information

  • Price: NT$8,924 (three nights, Friday–Monday, Studio room with breakfast)
  • Address: 8 Napasup 2, Sukhumvit 36 Rd., Klongtan, Klongtoey, Bangkok, 10110
  • Phone: +66888674777
  • Official website: https://www.karaarom.com/
  • Booking site: https://www.booking.com/hotel/th/karaarom.zh-tw.html
  • Other: An additional deposit is required, refunded after the check-out inspection

📍 Location

Karaarom Hotel sits in a soi near BTS Thong Lor Station, about a 7-minute walk from the exit — genuinely close. That said, the surrounding lanes have no sidewalks and there's quite a lot of traffic, so the walk isn't the easiest; watch out for passing cars.

On the way from BTS Thong Lor Station to Karaarom Hotel

Our day-tour guide later told us this is one of Bangkok's wealthy neighbourhoods. Along with heavy traffic, the roads are narrow, so it's jammed pretty much all day, from morning until night. This time we took a Grab straight from the airport to the hotel (about NT$375) and experienced Bangkok's notorious traffic first-hand: what should have been a 30-minute ride took 70 minutes.

🏢 Hotel Environment and Facilities

Karaarom Hotel has a plain, understated exterior, with the whole building wrapped in lush greenery. Step inside and you immediately feel the laid-back, artsy atmosphere of a small boutique inn, almost like a hidden resort. Tucked deep in a quiet lane away from the city's noise, it feels all the more relaxed and private.

The reception lobby is on the second floor and there's an elevator, so you never have to worry about hauling luggage. The ground floor is an open indoor car park with a comfortable lounge area, and staff wait here to greet guests and kindly guide them up to the second-floor lobby.

The lounge area on the ground floor
The open indoor car park

Most facilities are on the second floor; floors 3–7 are guest rooms

The entrance to the second-floor reception lobby

The non-alcoholic welcome drink and snacks at check-in

The reception lobby and shared work counter

The hotel's main facilities are all concentrated on the second floor. Besides the wood-toned, artsy reception desk, there's a small retail display area stocked with all sorts of lovely things — handmade goods, clothing, accessories and hipster knick-knacks, and even the high-quality bath amenities and coffee beans the hotel uses are available to take home. Guests can carry away not just memories, but a little of the Karaarom vibe too.

Unlike many hotels where the lobby seating follows a single uniform look, Karaarom Hotel's second-floor communal space is full of clever touches, with leather sofas, bar stools and other design elements scattered around to create a variety of moods. Guests can pick a different spot depending on their preference or their mood that day — every corner has its own distinct comfort.

The beautifully arranged retail display area

The second-floor communal space

The space feels especially cosy at night

Gym

At the end of the second-floor corridor there's a small gym and recreation space with some basic exercise equipment, a treadmill, a pool table, and a little play area for kids.


Sky Garden and Outdoor Pool

On the 9th floor there's a small garden and outdoor pool. Honestly, though, the area is really tiny and the pool is about the size of a big bathtub — at best you can soak in it.

🛏  The Room

We stayed on the fifth floor

This time we stayed in Karaarom Hotel's standard double, which carries on the wood-toned, artsy design of the second floor. The room is dominated by warm wood tones, paired with soft orange-yellow lighting and a large ceiling fan overhead — the overall atmosphere is both comfortable and relaxing. The room isn't especially spacious, but it has everything you need, including a mini kitchen area with a pot, induction cooker, sink and microwave. Whether you fancy cooking instant noodles late at night or reheating a light meal, it's very convenient — perfect for travellers who like to eat light.

The queen-size bed is medium-firm, and if you have a particular pillow preference you can ask the front desk for the type you like. One corner of the room has a small two-seater sofa and a little table — great for a late-night snack, a drink, or reading a good book on the road. It adds a touch of warmth and practicality to the room.

The small two-seater sofa area

The double room's queen-size bed

The small kitchen area in the room


The bathroom follows the same design-led, artsy style


The fridge is stocked with all kinds of drinks, alcohol and water. Note that only the large bottles of water are free — one per day, and they give you enough for the length of your stay up front. I didn't notice this and assumed all the water was free, so at check-out I was charged for the small bottles. Prices aren't expensive though; as I recall a bottle was around 25–30 baht.

The room comes with a plug adapter you can use

🍽️ Breakfast

Breakfast at Karaarom Hotel is buffet-style plus one main dish, with a choice of American or Thai. The main dish isn't huge, but the buffet spread offers a decent range — you can definitely eat your fill, and most of it tastes pretty good.

As for drinks, besides what you can help yourself to at the buffet, your main dish comes with one à la carte drink, and there's a fairly wide selection.

Fresh fruit, juices and some Thai dishes

There's a basic bread station too

Soups, congee and boiled eggs

After three days of breakfast, I thought the Thai mains were tastier

The buffet area is small, but the selection isn't too limited

The dining area is bright and very comfortable

🍸 The On-Site Bar: Glimmer Bar

Karaarom Hotel has its own bar, Glimmer Bar. On our first day in Bangkok we hadn't planned any particular itinerary and got back to the hotel fairly early, so we decided to give the in-house bar a try.

Glimmer Bar's four signature cocktails

The classic cocktails section


CALM


Gin/ Lemon/ Jasmine/ Aloe vera

The lemon aroma is quite pronounced on the nose — it's a bit like a lemon-aloe special, with a few bits of aloe pulp inside. A refreshing sweet-and-sour cocktail, though personally I found it overly sweet, almost cloying; it only reached a balance I liked after the ice had melted a little.

VANISH

Gin/ St.Germain/ Green Tea/ Thai Jasmine Rice

Setting aside how well it was mixed, I really liked the direction of this combination. The Thai jasmine rice ingredient tastes a little like purple sweet potato, and paired with the sweet-and-sour notes the overall flavour and concept are both appealing and distinctive. That said, the green tea character didn't really come through, and there's a fairly strong hit of alcohol that surges up on the finish. The biggest takeaway was that I became very interested in this Thai jasmine rice flavour, and later found and bought a bottle of the Thai jasmine rice syrup at a supermarket.

Glimmer Bar's prices are much more approachable than Bangkok's top-tier bars, so if you happen to have some free time and fancy a drink, it's worth considering having one here.

Bangkok Bars

  • Bangkok Bars | BKK Social Club | Luxurious High-End Bar Inside the Four Seasons | No.7 on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2024
  • Bangkok Bars | Vesper | Understated Luxury with a British Feel | Nine Consecutive Years on Asia's 50 Best | No.13 on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2024

The little welcome gift at check-in

Choosing Karaarom Hotel this time turned out to be a very good experience overall, and the price is more affordable than many other hotels. The staff speak fluent English and are friendly, so communication was completely stress-free. The hotel's artsy design style adds plenty of character and taste to the stay, with every detail radiating warmth and comfort.

Of course, there are a few things that could be improved. First, the room layout is a bit awkward: to reach the sofa area in the corner you actually have to climb over the bed, otherwise you get stuck.

The bigger drawback is the poor soundproofing. For the first two nights the nearby rooms were empty, so it was quite quiet. But on the last night new guests moved in next door, and we could clearly hear their TV, the shower running, even sneezes. If you're particularly sensitive to noise, this is worth bearing in mind.

title.$t: 曼谷住宿 | 卡拉羅姆酒店 Karaarom Hotel | 文青設計風格平價飯店 | BTS Thong Lor Station 步行 7 分鐘 | 附設酒吧 Glimmer Bar

content.$t:
曼谷市區的住宿價格，相較於各國許多一線大城市要來的親民很多，這次第二次來到曼谷，在網路上看了看大家分享的一些住宿之後，找了一間看起來風格屬於文青型，有點設計感的飯店，卡拉羅姆酒店 Karaarom Hotel。

📜  資訊

  • 入住價格：$8,924 (三晚，週五～週一，房型 Studio 含早餐)
  • 地址：8 Napasup 2, Sukhumvit 36 Rd., Klongtan, Klongtoey, Bangkok, 10110
  • 電話：+66888674777
  • 官方網站：https://www.karaarom.com/
  • 訂房網站：https://www.booking.com/hotel/th/karaarom.zh-tw.html
  • 其他：會有額外押金，在退房檢查後才會退還

📍 地點位置

Karaarom Hotel 位於 BTS Thong Lor Station 附近的巷子內，出站後約步行 7 分鐘就可以抵達，實際步行距離相當的近。不過由於附近的巷子沒有人行道，加上車其實蠻多的，所以這條路並不是很好走，要小心往來的車輛。

BTS Thong Lor Station 到 Karaarom Hotel 的路上

這區域後來聽 Day Tour 的導遊說，這裡是所謂的富人區，除了車很多之外，又因為路也不大，所以通常是每天必塞，一路從早上塞到晚上。這次我們是直接從機場叫 Grab 直達飯店 ($375台幣)，體驗到了曼谷市區塞車的可怕，本來約 30分鐘的車程，變成 70 分鐘才抵達。

🏢 飯店環境與設施

Karaarom Hotel 的外觀樸實低調，整棟建築被綠意盎然的植物所環繞，讓人一踏入就感受到小旅館的文青氛圍，彷彿置身於隱世的度假勝地。飯店座落在靜謐的巷弄深處，遠離城市的喧囂，增添了幾分悠閒與私密感。

接待大廳位於二樓，設有電梯，入住時完全不用擔心行李搬運的困擾。一樓則為開放式的室內停車場，還設有舒適的休息區域，且會有接待人員在此迎接旅客，並貼心地協助引導至二樓的接待大廳。

一樓的休息區域
開放式室內的停車場

大部分設施都在二樓，3-7 樓則是客房

二樓接待大廳的入口處

入住的無酒精 Welcome Drink 與小點心

接待大廳與共用的工作台

飯店內的主要設施都集中在二樓，除了木質文青風格的接待櫃檯之外，還有一區小小的販售展示區，這裡陳列著各式各樣的精緻好物，從手作商品、服飾、飾品到文青風小物，甚至連飯店使用的高品質衛浴用品與咖啡豆都能買回家，讓旅客不僅能帶走回憶，還能帶回一點專屬 Karaarom 的氣息。

而與許多飯店統一風格的大廳座位區不同，Karaarom Hotel 的二樓交誼空間充滿巧思，各種皮製沙發、高腳椅等設計元素錯落分布，營造出多樣化的氛圍。讓居住的旅客可以依據自己喜好、今天的心情，坐在不同的空間，每個角落都有獨特的舒適感。

佈置精美的販售展示區

二樓交誼空間

夜晚的時候讓這空間格外舒適

健身房

在二樓走廊盡頭，有一個小小的健身房與育樂空間，這裡有一些簡易的健身器材、跑步機，還有撞球桌，與一個小孩遊玩的空間可以使用。


空中花園與戶外泳池

在飯店 9F 的地方，有一個小小的庭園與戶外泳池可以使用，不過這區域其實真的很小，游泳池也真的就像是一個大浴缸的大小而已，頂多泡泡水。

🛏  房間環境

這次入住五樓的樓層

這次入住的是 Karaarom Hotel 的標準大床房，延續了飯店二樓一貫的木質設計與文青風格。房間以溫暖的木色調為主，搭配柔和的橘黃色燈光，與頭頂的大型吊扇，整體氛圍既舒適又放鬆。雖然房內空間不算寬敞，但該有的設備一應俱全，還設置了一個迷你廚房區域。這裡配有鍋子、電磁爐、水槽和微波爐，無論是深夜想煮碗泡麵還是加熱簡餐，都非常方便，特別適合喜歡輕食的小旅行者。

房內的 Queen Size 大床軟硬適中，如果對枕頭有特別偏好，也可以向櫃檯選擇自己喜歡的款式。房間的一角還設有一張小型雙人沙發和一張小桌子，無論是吃宵夜、喝杯小酒，還是閱讀一本旅途中的好書，這個角落都為房間增添了幾分溫馨與實用的質感。

小型雙人沙發區域

雙人房的 Queen Size 大床

房間內的小型廚房空間


衛浴空間也是走一個文青設計風


冰箱內有著各種飲料、酒類與水，要注意只有大瓶的水才是免費的，一天一瓶，會根據入住天數先給你足夠的份量。這次沒注意到以為水都是免費的，最後退房被收了小瓶水的費用，不過因為物價也不貴，印象中一瓶大概也是 25~30 元上下的價格。

房間內就有附轉接頭可以使用

🍽️ 早餐

Karaarom Hotel 的早餐是採自助式 + 一份主餐的形式，可以選擇美式的早餐，或是泰式的早餐，雖然主餐份量不多，不過自助的部分種類也不算到太少，基本上是可以吃很飽的，且口味大部分也都還算不錯。

飲料的部分，除了在自助區域的可以自由取用之外，跟著主餐會有一杯的單點飲品，選擇也還蠻多元的。

新鮮水果、果汁，一些泰式餐點

基本的麵包區域也有

湯品、粥類與水煮蛋

這次吃了三天，覺得泰式的主餐比較好吃

自助的區域不大，但品項也不至於太少

用餐空間也十分的舒適明亮

🍸 附設酒吧 Glimmer Bar

Karaarom Hotel 有著附設的酒吧 Glimmer Bar，第一天抵達曼谷的時候，由於沒有特別排什麼行程，也比較早回到飯店，就選擇來試試看這間附設的酒吧。

Glimmer Bar 的四杯 signature

經典調酒的部分


CALM


Gin/ Lemon/ Jasmine/ Aloe vera

聞起來檸檬香氣蠻明顯的，有點像一杯檸檬蘆薈的特調，裡面有著些許蘆薈顆粒果肉。是一杯酸甜清爽的調酒，只是整體自己覺得過於偏甜到過於甜膩，要放一下融水後，才會是比較喜歡的平衡。

VANISH

Gin/ St.Germain/ Green Tea/ Thai Jasmine Rice

先不論這杯調得如何，這杯做出來的方向組合自己是喜歡的，由於泰國香米的原料，有點類似紫薯的味道，搭配酸甜，整體的風味與方向都是相當討喜且有特色的路線，只是綠茶茶感可能沒有出來，且後面有個蠻重的酒感在喝的時候會衝出來。不過最大收穫就是，因為對於泰國香米這風味很有興趣，後來有在超市找到這隻泰國香米的糖漿買回來。

Glimmer Bar 的價位相比曼谷一線的酒吧親民許多，如果剛好有空又想要喝一杯的話，可以再考慮看看要不要在這裡喝一杯。

曼谷酒吧

  • 曼谷酒吧 | BKK Social Club | 位於四季酒店內奢華高級酒吧 | 2024 亞洲五十大酒吧 No.7
  • 曼谷酒吧 | Vesper | 低調奢華英倫風 | 連續九年入圍亞洲五十 | 2024 亞洲五十大酒吧 No.13

入住的迎賓小禮物

這次選擇入住 Karaarom Hotel，整體體驗相當不錯，價格也相對於許多飯店要再更親民一點，工作人員的英文流利又親切，溝通起來毫無壓力。飯店內的文青設計風格也為住宿增添了不少趣味與品味，每一個細節都散發著溫暖與舒適的氛圍。

當然，也有一些可以改進的地方，首先是房間的動線設計稍顯不便，想走到角落的沙發區時，竟然需要跨過床才能抵達，不然會被卡住。

另外一個比較大的缺點是隔音效果真的不太理想，入住的前兩個晚上，附近房間都沒有人，因此都還蠻安靜的。但到了最後一晚，隔壁房間住進了新客人，電視聲、洗澡水聲，甚至連打噴嚏的聲音都很清楚，對於特別在意安靜環境的旅客，這點可能需要多加考量。

title.$t: 曼谷酒吧 | Vesper | 低調奢華英倫風 | 連續九年入圍亞洲五十 | 2024 亞洲五十大酒吧 No.13

content.$t:
Vesper 是一家位於 Sala Daeng BTS Station 附近的一家酒吧，於 2014 年創立，連續九年都在亞洲五十大酒吧內入圍，來到曼谷絕對要排時間來這間指標性酒吧嘗試看看。

  • 2016 亞洲五十大酒吧 No.17
  • 2017 亞洲五十大酒吧 No.40
  • 2018 亞洲五十大酒吧 No.27
  • 2019 亞洲五十大酒吧 No.26
  • 2020 亞洲五十大酒吧 No.11
  • 2021 亞洲五十大酒吧 No.46
  • 2022 亞洲五十大酒吧 No.19
  • 2023 亞洲五十大酒吧 No.12
  • 2024 亞洲五十大酒吧 No.13

📜 資訊

  • 地址：10/15 Convent Road, Silom, Bangkok 10500
  • 營業時間：17:30–02:00
  • 價格：平均一杯 400~550 泰銖不等，須再加 10% 服務費與 7% 的稅
  • 官方網站：https://www.vesperbar.co/
  • 訂位：via FB / IG inbox only，平日只開放 8 點前，假日 7 點前的訂位，後續時間都是開放給 walk-in 的顧客。

📍 地點與店內環境


Vesper 位於 Sala Daeng BTS Station 附近，出站後約走3分鐘就會到了，不過外觀蠻低調的，一不小心就會錯過。室內與室外都以綠色、藍色搭配金邊為主要的視覺風格，有種低調奢華、英倫時尚的設計感。


這天是在附近吃完晚餐後，大約 8:30 直接 walk-in 到店裡看看有沒有位置，很幸運的剛好有吧台的位置可以坐。


室內燈光算明亮，店內空間不大，座位不算到太多，主要為吧台區域、靠窗的小桌子，以及後面約可以坐 12~15 人的沙發區，所以假日或是熱門時段都很有機會要等候才會有位置。


📜 Menu


今年是 Vesper 開幕十週年，酒單為第三版的 PEOPLE OF VESPER，手繪風的酒單十分的有設計展與質感，有著 16 杯 signature 的調酒。

酒單線上版 (from 官方網站)：People of Vesper



🍸 調酒

THAIBALL

Hendrick’s Gin / Cocchi Americano / Fino Sherry / Ginger / Lemongrass / Cha Plu Leaf / Soda / Pomelo salad


這杯調酒以琴酒為基底，融合泰式草本的精髓。一開始聞到淡淡的植物香氣，入口清爽順口，帶有柚子的微酸甜味。搭配上方的柚子沙拉一起食用，風味層次豐富，充滿熱帶清新感。

TEABALL 

Johnnie Walker Black Label, Apple / Toasted rice / Hojicha Tea / Soda


這是 HighBall 的變化，除了威士忌基底之外，加入焙茶的濃郁與蘋果的甜香。喝下有著威士忌香氣與尾韻濃郁與焙茶的回甘味，結束時帶有一絲烤米的香氣，整體溫潤且別具特色。

GUAVARITA 

Don Julio Blanco Tequila / Sake / Guava / Melon / Lemon verbena / Lime / Salt


這杯以龍舌蘭為基底，結合紅心芭樂與清酒的風味，一開始聞是紅心芭樂的果香，入口則是稍帶酸的瓜類融合風味與清酒的香氣，搭配不會很衝突的龍舌蘭風味，整體的平衡做的不錯，口感稍微偏酸，順口好喝。 

BANGKOKQUIRI 

Havana Club Rum / Tom Yum spices / Cucumber Coconut / Lime


這杯靈感來自泰式酸辣湯，是這天喝到最驚艷好喝的一杯。以蘭姆酒為基底，融合 Tom Yum 香料，一開始聞的時候有著小黃瓜的氣味，喝的時候很像是有著酸甜的酸辣湯，帶有除了椰奶香氣之外，尾韻有著一點點的辣度，整體平衡好喝而且非常的有趣耐喝。 


在 Vesper 喝到的酒都還蠻對我的喜好，店內的音樂、氣氛也十分舒適。在過程中也有和調酒師聊到，Vesper 其中的一位投資人是台灣人，他也推薦了我們最近新開的另一家店 4th Wall，不過可惜這間已經是曼谷行的最後一天了，未來有機會再到別的店試試看。

離開的時候約十點，已經全部坐滿，且外面很多人在等待

雖然 Vesper 價位也是不低，但每一杯酒都十分的有水準，再加上連續九年的亞洲五十大酒吧上榜加持，Vesper 已經是曼谷的指標酒吧之一了，如果來到曼谷，很值得來嘗試看看。

title.$t: Bangkok Bar | Vesper | Understated Luxury with British Flair | Nine Consecutive Years on Asia's 50 Best | 2024 Asia's 50 Best Bars No.13

content.$t:
Vesper is a bar located near Sala Daeng BTS Station. Founded in 2014, it has been named on Asia's 50 Best Bars list for nine years running — when you're in Bangkok, you absolutely have to make time for this landmark bar.

  • 2016 Asia's 50 Best Bars No.17
  • 2017 Asia's 50 Best Bars No.40
  • 2018 Asia's 50 Best Bars No.27
  • 2019 Asia's 50 Best Bars No.26
  • 2020 Asia's 50 Best Bars No.11
  • 2021 Asia's 50 Best Bars No.46
  • 2022 Asia's 50 Best Bars No.19
  • 2023 Asia's 50 Best Bars No.12
  • 2024 Asia's 50 Best Bars No.13

📜 Information

  • Address: 10/15 Convent Road, Silom, Bangkok 10500
  • Opening hours: 17:30–02:00
  • Prices: around 400–550 THB per drink on average, plus 10% service charge and 7% tax
  • Official website: https://www.vesperbar.co/
  • Reservations: via FB / IG inbox only. On weekdays only slots before 8pm are bookable, and on weekends before 7pm; all later times are kept for walk-in guests.

📍 Location & Interior


Vesper is near Sala Daeng BTS Station — about a 3-minute walk from the exit — though the exterior is quite understated and easy to miss. Both indoors and out, the visual style centers on green and blue paired with gold trim, giving off an understated-luxe, British-fashion design feel.


On this day, after finishing dinner nearby, we walked in around 8:30 to see whether there were any seats — luckily there happened to be spots at the bar counter.


The indoor lighting is fairly bright, the space isn't large and there aren't that many seats — mainly the bar counter, small tables by the window, and a sofa area at the back seating about 12–15 people. So on weekends or at peak hours there's a good chance you'll have to wait for a seat.


📜 Menu


This year marks Vesper's 10th anniversary, and the drinks list is the third edition of PEOPLE OF VESPER. The hand-drawn-style menu is full of design flair and quality, featuring 16 signature cocktails.

Online version of the menu (from the official website): People of Vesper



🍸 Cocktails

THAIBALL

Hendrick’s Gin / Cocchi Americano / Fino Sherry / Ginger / Lemongrass / Cha Plu Leaf / Soda / Pomelo salad


This cocktail is gin-based and captures the essence of Thai herbs. At first you catch a light botanical aroma; on the palate it's refreshing and easy-drinking, with a gently sweet-tart pomelo note. Enjoyed together with the pomelo salad on top, the flavors are wonderfully layered and full of tropical freshness.

TEABALL 

Johnnie Walker Black Label, Apple / Toasted rice / Hojicha Tea / Soda


This is a twist on the highball: besides the whisky base, it adds the richness of hojicha and the sweet aroma of apple. You get whisky aromatics up front, a rich finish with the lingering sweetness of roasted tea, and a hint of toasted rice fragrance at the end — mellow overall and full of character.

GUAVARITA 

Don Julio Blanco Tequila / Sake / Guava / Melon / Lemon verbena / Lime / Salt


Tequila-based and combining pink guava with sake, it opens with the fruity aroma of pink guava; on the palate there's a slightly tart melon blend fused with the fragrance of sake, backed by tequila notes that never clash. The balance is well handled — a touch on the tart side, smooth and delicious. 

BANGKOKQUIRI 

Havana Club Rum / Tom Yum spices / Cucumber Coconut / Lime


Inspired by tom yum soup, this was the most impressive and delicious drink of the night. Rum-based and infused with tom yum spices, it smells of cucumber at first; drinking it feels like a sweet-and-sour tom yum, with coconut milk aromas and a tiny touch of heat on the finish. Well balanced, tasty, and hugely fun and moreish. 


The drinks I had at Vesper really suited my taste, and the music and atmosphere were very comfortable. Chatting with the bartender, I learned that one of Vesper's investors is Taiwanese, and he recommended another recently opened bar, 4th Wall — unfortunately this was already the last day of my Bangkok trip, so I'll have to try their other venues next time.

By the time we left, around 10pm, every seat was taken and plenty of people were waiting outside

Although Vesper isn't cheap, every drink is of a high standard, and with nine consecutive years on Asia's 50 Best Bars behind it, Vesper is already one of Bangkok's landmark bars. If you're in Bangkok, it's well worth a visit.

title.$t: 曼谷酒吧 | BKK Social Club | 位於四季酒店內奢華高級酒吧 | 2024 亞洲五十大酒吧 No.7

content.$t:
BKK Social Club，位於 2020年底開幕的「曼谷湄南河四季酒店」內，短短一年多時間，BKK Social Club 在 2022 年就拿到了亞洲五十大酒吧的第十名，是近年來曼谷酒吧中熱門、且指標性的酒吧之一，這次曼谷行，就計畫想要來體驗看看這間連三年都在前十名的酒吧。

  • 2022 亞洲五十大酒吧 No.10
  • 2023 亞洲五十大酒吧 No.3
  • 2024 亞洲五十大酒吧 No.7
P.S. 建議事前先線上訂位

📜 資訊

  • 地址：300/1 Charoenkrung Road Yannawa, Sathorn, Bangkok 10120 Thailand
  • 營業時間：17:00–00:00
  • 價格：平均一杯 500~600 泰銖不等，須再加 10% 服務費與 7% 的稅
  • 官方粉專：https://www.instagram.com/bkksocialclub/
  • 訂位：https://www.opentable.co.th/restref/client/?restref=120026&lang=en-US

📍 地點與店內環境

BKK Social Club 位於曼谷湄南河四季酒店內，如果要前往曼谷湄南河四季酒店，距離最近的 BTS 站是 Saphan Taksin，且還要步行 15 分鐘，因此這次是直接從市區其他地點，搭乘 Grab 直達飯店門口。

而要前往酒吧，必須從飯店大門口進去，經過一連串的右轉再左轉才會到，因此最好的方式就是直接在飯店門口詢問服務人員，請他們帶領你。

必須穿過飯店大廳的幾個區域後才會抵達


最後要走出飯店室內，到這個半開放式的戶外才會抵達 BKK Social Club

BKK Social Club 室內空間十分的奢華高級，座位數量也不少，當天我們是週一晚上抵達，當要離開的時候是內座位已經都全部客滿了，可見其熱門程度。

吧台後面的酒牆

📜 Menu

這次到訪，剛好是新酒單剛開始不到一個月左右的時間，新酒單的主題是「墨西哥」，內容有許多使用龍舌蘭、蘭姆酒，或是辣椒等大家會聯想到的墨西哥元素來組成，將酒單分成 Places、People、Parties 三大主題來詮釋，酒單上也有寫著這杯酒發想的原因或是故事。

Places

People

Parties

還有一頁是經典調酒的 twist，是將 9 杯經典調酒與墨西哥這個元素做了結合，像是 Highball、Gimlet、Martini 等等，都有做了些有趣的變化。

🍸 調酒

苦甜的迎賓酒與小點

CARLOS


靈感來自 Carlos Santana 的音樂，使用 Domaine Ott Clos Mireille Rosé、Monkey 47 Gin 等材料，看起來有點類似 mojito 的做法，聞的時候比較沒味道，主要是薄荷味。

大量碎冰使口感更加輕盈，酒感低，入口是類似覆盆莓的微酸甜風味，可能來自百香果與雪莉酒的結合，尾韻帶有粉紅葡萄酒的酒體風味。

CHIAPAS

以墨西哥恰帕斯州的咖啡文化為靈感，以 espresso martini 為基礎，使用蘭姆酒取代傳統伏特加，並融入藥草酒的氣息。濃縮咖啡的香氣濃郁，一旁附上的甜爆米花，增添了許多引用上風味的變化，雖然風味中規中矩，但可以試試。

FRIDA KAHLO

這款調酒的靈感來自藝術家 Frida Kahlo 的強烈風格，旨在呈現出層次豐富的風味。一聞是柑橘的清香，但入口時茴香（八角）的香氣立刻衝出來，濃郁而鮮明，如果不喜歡八角味的這杯可能會無法接受這一杯。

不過隨著時間推移，茴香味會慢慢的逐漸退散，酸甜的楓糖風味變得更加突出，柔和的甜度與香氣更加平衡。

CHICHEN ITZA

這杯調酒靈感來自熱帶水果和咖啡的風味交融，試圖捕捉瑪雅文化的異國情調，使用了澄清 Sesame Milk、多種水果、咖啡等等的原料。

一開始聞到的是淡淡的咖啡香氣，入口時酸甜平衡，椰子的柔滑香氣隱約可見，再搭配由鳳梨、草莓和香蕉組合而成的熱帶水果風味，整體層次分明且出色，是這天喝到最驚艷、覺得最喜愛的一杯。

GIMLET PICANTE

這杯以經典 Gimlet 為基礎，融入墨西哥辣椒的辛香元素，創造出酸甜帶辣的全新風味。

聞起來是辣椒香氣，入口時則帶有鹹湯或 dirty martini 的趣味感，整體來說雖然和我想像的 Gimlet 變化差蠻多的，但十分有趣。

最後離開前，由於後來換位置到吧台，調酒師請了一個冰沙的 bye bye shot，由鳳梨(or 百香果，已忘記...)為主體的冰沙 shot，很好喝，但冰沙實在太冰了，沒辦法當 shot 來喝 🤣

    整體來說體驗蠻不錯的，除了調酒之外，服務也是五星級酒店的服務等級，環境舒適。調酒師與服務人員的英文也都很好，溝通完全沒有問題，且在過程中服務人員還會來詢問調酒的體驗如何，希望收集顧客的飲用心得，也分享了他自己喝完的心得。

    如果有來到曼谷，BKK Social Club 肯定是值得可以排進行程來踩點試試看的一家酒吧。

    除了原始價格，還要加上 10% 服務費，再加上 7% 稅，頗貴的...

title.$t: Bangkok Bar | BKK Social Club | Luxurious High-End Bar Inside the Four Seasons | No.7 on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2024

content.$t:
BKK Social Club is located inside the Four Seasons Hotel Bangkok at Chao Phraya River, which opened at the end of 2020. In just over a year, BKK Social Club claimed the No.10 spot on Asia's 50 Best Bars in 2022, making it one of the most popular and landmark bars in Bangkok in recent years. On this Bangkok trip, I planned to come and experience this bar that has made the top ten three years in a row.

  • 2022 Asia's 50 Best Bars No.10
  • 2023 Asia's 50 Best Bars No.3
  • 2024 Asia's 50 Best Bars No.7
P.S. Booking online in advance is recommended

📜 Information

  • Address: 300/1 Charoenkrung Road Yannawa, Sathorn, Bangkok 10120 Thailand
  • Opening hours: 17:00–00:00
  • Price: around 500–600 THB per drink on average, plus a 10% service charge and 7% tax
  • Official page: https://www.instagram.com/bkksocialclub/
  • Reservations: https://www.opentable.co.th/restref/client/?restref=120026&lang=en-US

📍 Location & Interior

BKK Social Club sits inside the Four Seasons Hotel Bangkok at Chao Phraya River. The nearest BTS station is Saphan Taksin, and it's still a 15-minute walk from there, so this time I simply took a Grab from elsewhere in the city straight to the hotel entrance.

To reach the bar you have to enter through the hotel's main entrance and make a series of right and left turns, so the easiest approach is to ask a staff member at the hotel entrance to guide you there.

You have to pass through several areas of the hotel lobby before arriving


Finally you step out of the hotel interior into this semi-open outdoor area to reach BKK Social Club

The interior of BKK Social Club is extremely luxurious and upscale, with plenty of seating. We arrived on a Monday evening, and by the time we left every indoor seat was full — a testament to how popular it is.

The bottle wall behind the bar counter

📜 Menu

During this visit, the new drinks menu had been out for less than a month. Its theme is "Mexico," featuring plenty of Mexican elements you'd associate with the country — tequila, rum, chili and more. The menu is divided into three themes: Places, People and Parties, and each drink comes with a note about the inspiration or story behind it.

Places

People

Parties

There's also a page of twists on classic cocktails — nine classics combined with Mexican elements, such as the Highball, Gimlet and Martini, each given some interesting variation.

🍸 The Cocktails

A bittersweet welcome drink with a small snack

CARLOS


Inspired by the music of Carlos Santana, made with Domaine Ott Clos Mireille Rosé, Monkey 47 Gin and other ingredients. It looks somewhat like a mojito in style; the aroma is fairly subtle, mostly mint.

Plenty of crushed ice makes the texture lighter, with low alcohol presence. On the palate it's a slightly sweet-tart raspberry-like flavour, likely from the combination of passion fruit and sherry, with a rosé wine body on the finish.

CHIAPAS

Inspired by the coffee culture of Mexico's Chiapas state, it's built on an espresso martini base but swaps the traditional vodka for rum, with a herbal liqueur note woven in. The espresso aroma is rich, and the sweet popcorn served alongside adds plenty of variation to the drinking experience. The flavour is fairly by-the-book, but it's worth a try.

FRIDA KAHLO

This cocktail draws on the bold style of artist Frida Kahlo, aiming to deliver layered complexity. The nose is fresh citrus, but on the palate the anise (star anise) aroma bursts out immediately — rich and pronounced. If you don't like star anise, this one may be hard to take.

That said, the anise gradually fades over time, and the sweet-tart maple flavour becomes more prominent, bringing gentle sweetness and aroma into better balance.

CHICHEN ITZA

This drink is inspired by the interplay of tropical fruit and coffee flavours, seeking to capture the exotic feel of Mayan culture, using clarified sesame milk, various fruits, coffee and more.

The first thing you smell is a light coffee aroma; on the palate it's balanced between sweet and tart, with a subtle silky coconut note, paired with tropical fruit flavours of pineapple, strawberry and banana. Well-defined and outstanding overall — the most impressive and my favourite drink of the night.

GIMLET PICANTE

Built on the classic Gimlet with the spicy kick of Mexican chili added, creating a brand-new sweet-tart-spicy flavour.

It smells of chili, and on the palate has an amusing savoury-broth or dirty martini quality. Overall it's quite different from the Gimlet variation I had imagined, but it's very interesting.

Before leaving, since we had moved over to the bar counter, the bartender treated us to a frozen "bye bye shot" — a slushy shot based on pineapple (or passion fruit, I've forgotten...). It was delicious, but the slush was simply too cold to down as a shot 🤣

    Overall it was a very good experience. Beyond the cocktails, the service is at five-star hotel level and the setting is comfortable. The bartenders and staff all speak excellent English, so communication was no problem at all, and during the evening staff even came over to ask how we were finding the drinks, keen to gather guests' impressions while also sharing their own tasting notes.

    If you're in Bangkok, BKK Social Club is definitely a bar worth working into your itinerary.

    On top of the listed prices there's a 10% service charge plus 7% tax — pretty pricey...

title.$t: 東京酒吧 | The SG Club | 澀谷熱門必訪酒吧 | 2024 亞洲五十大酒吧 No.23

content.$t:
來到東京 Bar Hopping，今年 2024 是亞洲 50 最佳酒吧第 23 名的 The SG Club (2024 世界酒吧排名 No.54)，絕對是不能錯過的一站。從 2019 年開始，The SG Club 每年都會入選亞洲 50 最佳酒吧，2020 年還拿過 No.10 的成績，值得來探訪看看。

📜 資訊

  • 地址：1 Chome-7-8 Jinnan, Shibuya City, Tokyo 150-0041日本
  • 營業時間：18:00–01:00
  • 價格：單杯 ¥1,800 ~ ¥2,800 日幣不等
  • 官方粉專：https://www.instagram.com/the_sg_club/
  • 訂位：https://www.tablecheck.com/zh-TW/shops/the-sg-club/reserve

📍 地點與店內環境

The SG Club 位於澀谷地鐵站附近，如果從地鐵站過來步行約要 10 分鐘左右，雖然沒有明顯的招牌，但不至於太難找，因為時時刻刻都有顧客在門口。

不論平日還是假日，亞洲 50 大酒吧的光環還是很厲害的，人潮都非常的多，假如沒有事先訂位，蠻有可能會沒有位置，建議如果要前往 The SG Club 的話，還是先在網路上訂位比較保險  (訂位一次最多五人的位置)。

一樓的「Guzzle」

The SG Club 在空間上區分為一樓的「Guzzle」和地下室的「Sip」，一樓的「 Guzzle 」走的是輕鬆休閒的路線，除了調酒之外也提供咖啡和多款無酒精飲品，據來訪過的同行朋友說，一樓與地下室的酒單是不一樣的，如果想嘗試許多特別的 Signature 調酒，還是要選擇地下室的「Sip」。

地下室的「Sip」

地下室的「Sip」提供許多特別的 Signature 調酒，如果想要體驗味蕾的衝擊與亞洲50大酒吧的調酒體驗，推薦選擇地下室。當天觀察到顧客幾乎都是外國人，調酒師們的英文也都非常的好，基本上點酒、詢問風味，或是溝通都完全沒有問題的。

不過地下室的空間偏小，座位不多且距離放得很近，所以如果都客滿的時候其實會覺得有一點點擁擠。


「Sip」的空間

📜 Menu




🍸 調酒

Tomato Tree or Insane Tomato

這杯以清新的番茄香氣為主打，輕盈微甜，帶有淡淡的酒味，特別的是其中的草本番茄和蒔蘿香氣，會有點蔬果風味的感覺，杯中還裝飾著一顆小番茄，增添視覺的趣味。

Rain & Moss Gin Fizz

這款調酒帶有草本植物的香氣，隱隱透露出藥草和烏梅的微酸甜風味，就像烏梅汁的澄清版本。它的氣泡清新爽口，卻又充滿趣味的風味轉折，是一杯適合慢慢品味的 fizz 調酒。

自然派不自然派ワイン

這款調酒讓人聯想到清新的白酒，散發著青蘋果和葡萄柚皮的香氣，整體風味接近白酒，帶有些許發酵的獨特韻味，酸甜度低，可以想像是一杯有著發酵風味的白酒。

Drunken Grandma’s Apple Pie

這杯聞的時候，就像是肉桂蘋果派的味道，杯口還有海鹽味噌，蘋果風味的酸甜平衡，搭配焦化奶油香氣，尾韻輕輕散發酒香，是當天晚上同行大家覺得最喜歡的一杯，整體很順口大眾可以接受的風味，但又有著有趣的風味元素，值得推薦這一杯。

Less in Wax

聞的時候微微果香風味，口感卻混合了可可、椰奶和芋頭，帶有蛋糕般的奶香。杯壁塗上一層白巧克力，讓飲用時多了層次感。

Charlie Brown Loves Wagyu

一開始聞的時候，這杯有著一點點鹹的食物香氣，喝起來有點像是 old fashion 再帶著淡淡的花生油和牛肉香氣，搭配上面的一塊和牛肉乾，方向是一款美食和調酒的結合，自己認為可能喜好 old fashion 的人會更喜歡這一杯。

Cold Soba Negroni

烤蕎麥的香氣讓人聯想到咖啡，搭配麥茶的烘焙氣息與苦味，讓整體風味相得益彰。即使平時不喜歡 negroni 的人，也可能會喜歡這款苦味平衡的調酒，覺得是表現得很不錯的一杯。

Whisky Nigiri

這杯調酒聞起來有醋、醬油和芥末的香氣，喝起來鹹酸交織，尾韻帶著一絲芥末辣度。風味獨特，喜不喜歡就見仁見智了，但是是一杯很有趣的食物類調酒。

整體來說，調酒的方向與風味都十分的有趣，像是烤蕎麥麵這種許多之前沒有想像過的味道，很值得來試試看，整體酒吧的氛圍也很不錯，調酒師們都很熱情也開朗，體驗上蠻不錯的。

title.$t: Tokyo Bars | The SG Club | Shibuya's Must-Visit Bar | No.23 on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2024

content.$t:
If you're bar hopping in Tokyo, The SG Club — ranked No.23 on Asia's 50 Best Bars in 2024 (and No.54 on The World's 50 Best Bars 2024) — is absolutely a stop you can't miss. Since 2019, The SG Club has made the Asia's 50 Best Bars list every year, and it even reached No.10 in 2020, so it's well worth a visit.

📜 Information

  • Address: 1 Chome-7-8 Jinnan, Shibuya City, Tokyo 150-0041, Japan
  • Opening hours: 18:00–01:00
  • Price: roughly ¥1,800 ~ ¥2,800 per drink
  • Official page: https://www.instagram.com/the_sg_club/
  • Reservations: https://www.tablecheck.com/zh-TW/shops/the-sg-club/reserve

📍 Location & Interior

The SG Club is located near Shibuya Station — about a 10-minute walk from the subway. There's no obvious sign out front, but it isn't too hard to find, since there are always customers gathered by the entrance.

Whether on a weekday or a weekend, the halo of being one of Asia's 50 Best Bars is powerful: the place is packed. If you haven't booked in advance there's a good chance you won't get a seat, so I'd recommend reserving online beforehand to be safe (reservations accept up to five people at a time).

"Guzzle" on the first floor

The SG Club is divided into "Guzzle" on the ground floor and "Sip" in the basement. "Guzzle" upstairs takes a relaxed, casual approach, offering coffee and a range of non-alcoholic drinks alongside cocktails. According to friends who had visited before, the drinks lists upstairs and downstairs are different — so if you want to try lots of special signature cocktails, you should choose "Sip" in the basement.

"Sip" in the basement

"Sip" downstairs serves many special signature cocktails, so if you want a jolt to the taste buds and the full Asia's 50 Best cocktail experience, the basement is the way to go. That night, almost all the guests were foreigners, and the bartenders' English is excellent — ordering drinks, asking about flavors, or just chatting is no problem at all.

That said, the basement space is on the small side, with few seats placed quite close together, so when it's full it can feel a little cramped.


The "Sip" space

📜 Menu




🍸 The Cocktails

Tomato Tree or Insane Tomato

This one leads with a fresh tomato aroma — light, lightly sweet, with just a faint hint of alcohol. What stands out is the herbal tomato and dill aroma, which gives it a vegetal, fruity feel. A cherry tomato garnishes the glass, adding a playful visual touch.

Rain & Moss Gin Fizz

This cocktail carries a herbaceous aroma, with subtle medicinal-herb and smoked plum notes that are gently sweet-and-sour — like a clarified version of smoked plum juice. The bubbles are crisp and refreshing, yet the flavor takes fun turns; it's a fizz meant to be sipped slowly.

Shizenha Fushizenha Wine (自然派不自然派ワイン)

This drink brings to mind a crisp white wine, giving off aromas of green apple and grapefruit peel. The overall profile is close to white wine, with a distinctive fermented character and low acidity and sweetness — imagine a white wine with a fermented twist.

Drunken Grandma's Apple Pie

On the nose it's exactly like cinnamon apple pie, and the rim is dressed with sea salt miso. The apple flavor is nicely balanced between sweet and tart, paired with a browned-butter aroma, with a gentle whisper of spirit on the finish. It was everyone's favorite of the night — very easy-drinking and crowd-pleasing, yet with genuinely interesting flavor elements. Highly recommended.

Less in Wax

The nose is subtly fruity, but the palate blends cacao, coconut milk and taro, with a cake-like creaminess. The inside of the glass is coated with white chocolate, adding another layer as you drink.

Charlie Brown Loves Wagyu

At first sniff there's a slightly savory, food-like aroma. It drinks a bit like an Old Fashioned with faint peanut oil and beef notes, topped with a piece of wagyu jerky — very much a fusion of food and cocktail. I'd say fans of the Old Fashioned will enjoy this one even more.

Cold Soba Negroni

The aroma of roasted buckwheat is reminiscent of coffee, and paired with the roasted character and bitterness of barley tea, the flavors complement each other beautifully. Even people who don't usually like a negroni might enjoy this well-balanced bitter cocktail — I thought it was very well executed.

Whisky Nigiri

This one smells of vinegar, soy sauce and wasabi, and tastes salty and sour at once, finishing with a touch of wasabi heat. The flavor is unique — whether you like it is down to personal taste, but it's a genuinely fun food-inspired cocktail.

Overall, the direction and flavors of the cocktails are fascinating — flavors like roasted soba that I'd never imagined before, well worth trying. The atmosphere of the bar is great too, and the bartenders are warm and cheerful. All in all, a really enjoyable experience.

title.$t: 台北酒吧 | KNOCK KNOCK WHO'S THERE? | 開啟東西方飲食文化的大門 | 大安區酒吧

content.$t:
KNOCK KNOCK WHO'S THERE? (以下簡稱為 Knock Knock) 是2023年底、今年初才開幕的新酒吧，由業界的兩位主理人 Kevin 和 Emma 所創立，整體的氛圍，食物好吃與調酒的口味，完全可以說是自己近期最喜歡的酒吧。

📜 資訊

  • 地址：106台北市大安區信義路四段107-1號1樓
  • 電話：0223252379
  • 營業時間：19:00 - 02:00
  • 官方粉絲頁：https://www.instagram.com/knockknock_tw/
  • 訂位方式：線上訂位

🏢  店內環境與位置

Knock Knock 位於台北的酒吧一級戰區 - 信義安和周邊，離大安站或是信義安和站其實都不遠，隔著敦化南路對面也還有另一家有名的酒吧「The Public House」，地點十分方便。

而 Knock Knock 總共有兩層，想提供的不僅僅是喝酒的場域，而是一個跨越藝術、創意與調酒的多元空間。一樓與二樓的空間是分開的，分別也想呈現兩種不同的氛圍。一樓的空間適合輕鬆喝一點點小酒以及用餐

一樓的吧檯空間

走著一個低調沈穩，舒適的用餐空間

通過這個樓梯就會到二樓的調酒空間了

而二樓就是專注在調酒的部分，一樣有提供食物可以搭配著調酒來食用，先不提調酒，Knock Knock 的食物部分也是我在各大酒吧中，吃過數一數二的好吃。

二樓分為吧台區與後面的座位區域，訂位的時候就可以選擇

吧檯座位區

🍸 調酒

Knock Knock 在調酒的部分表現得很優秀，這兩季的酒單都是以不同風味主題，還呈現東方與西方飲食的文化對比，除了一般大眾能想像得到的甜食之外，還有著許多有趣的鹹食主題。

上季酒單


分為六大主題，從花、茶、湯、綠色醬汁、花生，一直到甜點，分別用東西方不同的主題來呈現調酒，其中個人最喜歡花生醬漢堡這一杯，酸甜平衡，帶有奶油與花生香氣的風味，整體非常的有趣且好喝。

花生醬漢堡

本季酒單 (2024/9~)

本季的酒單一樣分為六大主題，從早餐、茶、小點、湯、紅色料理，最後到甜點，也是分別使用東西方不同的主題來做出具有特色的調酒。

早餐

水果可頌麵包

和風早餐


茶

英式玫瑰紅茶

台灣福灣可可茶


小點

甜菜根柑橘沙拉

草仔粿

這杯是我在這一季最喜歡的一杯，如同於上季的花生醬漢堡一樣，從以往印象中的鹹食，轉變成一杯酸甜平衡的調酒，有著類似草仔粿鹹甜的風味，看似無法關聯起來，但風味卻很融合，同行朋友說像排骨湯，十分好喝且蠻耐喝的。

湯

玉米濃湯

蔭鳳梨苦瓜湯

紅色料理

紅醬瑪莉

叻沙可樂達

甜點

楊枝甘露

除了 signature 調酒之外，我們也嘗試了幾種經典調酒，如 Aviation, Bee's Kness, Negroni 與 Ramos Gin Fizz，每一杯也都做得很不錯。Knock Knock 在空間、環境、調酒與食物，各項表現得真的都蠻不錯，完整度也相當的高，整體來說是蠻值得推薦的，自己與朋友也再訪了許多次。

title.$t: Taipei Bars | KNOCK KNOCK WHO'S THERE? | Opening the Door Between Eastern and Western Food Culture | Da'an District Bar

content.$t:
KNOCK KNOCK WHO'S THERE? (hereafter "Knock Knock") is a new bar that opened at the end of 2023 / beginning of this year, founded by two industry veterans, Kevin and Emma. Between the overall atmosphere, the delicious food and the flavors of the cocktails, I can honestly say it is my favorite bar of late.

📜 Information

  • Address: 1F, No. 107-1, Section 4, Xinyi Road, Da'an District, Taipei 106
  • Phone: 02-2325-2379
  • Opening hours: 19:00 - 02:00
  • Official fan page: https://www.instagram.com/knockknock_tw/
  • Reservations: Book online

🏢  Interior and Location

Knock Knock sits in Taipei's prime bar battleground — the Xinyi Anhe area. It's not far from either Daan Station or Xinyi Anhe Station, and just across Dunhua South Road you'll find another famous bar, "The Public House," so the location is very convenient.

Knock Knock spans two floors, and it aims to offer more than just a place to drink — it's a multi-purpose space bridging art, creativity and cocktails. The first and second floors are separate, each designed to convey a different mood. The first floor is great for a casual drink and a meal.

The bar counter area on the first floor

An understated, calm and comfortable dining space

Up these stairs is the second-floor cocktail space

The second floor focuses on cocktails. Food is also served up here to pair with your drinks — and setting the cocktails aside for a moment, Knock Knock's food is among the best I've eaten at any bar.

The second floor is split into the bar counter and a seating area at the back; you can choose when booking

The bar counter seating

🍸 Cocktails

Knock Knock really shines when it comes to cocktails. The menus for both of the past two seasons have been built around different flavor themes, presenting a contrast between Eastern and Western food cultures. Beyond the sweet flavors most people would expect, there are plenty of intriguing savory themes too.

Last Season's Menu


It was divided into six major themes — flowers, tea, soup, green sauces, peanuts, and finally desserts — each expressed through different Eastern and Western motifs. My personal favorite was the Peanut Butter Burger: balanced between sweet and sour, with buttery, nutty aromas, it was both fascinating and delicious.

Peanut Butter Burger

This Season's Menu (Sept 2024 onward)

This season's menu is likewise built around six themes — breakfast, tea, small bites, soup, red dishes, and finally dessert — again drawing on both Eastern and Western motifs to create distinctive cocktails.

Breakfast

Fruit Croissant

Japanese-style Breakfast


Tea

English Rose Black Tea

Taiwan Fu Wan Cacao Tea


Small Bites

Beetroot and Citrus Salad

Caozaiguo (Mugwort Rice Cake)

This was my favorite drink of the season. Like last season's Peanut Butter Burger, it takes something normally savory and turns it into a cocktail balanced between sweet and sour, with flavors reminiscent of the salty-sweet mugwort rice cake. It sounds like an impossible pairing, but the flavors blend beautifully — my friend said it reminded him of pork rib soup. Very tasty and easy to keep sipping.

Soup

Cream of Corn Soup

Pickled Pineapple and Bitter Melon Soup

Red Dishes

Red Sauce Mary

Laksa Colada

Dessert

Mango Pomelo Sago

Besides the signature cocktails, we also tried a few classics such as the Aviation, Bee's Knees, Negroni and Ramos Gin Fizz — all very well made. Knock Knock performs strongly across the board: space, atmosphere, cocktails and food, with a high level of polish overall. It's well worth recommending, and my friends and I have been back many times.

title.$t: 台南酒吧 | Bar Alter | 隱藏在台南路橋下的酒吧 | 每一杯酒都是一道菜

content.$t:
台南是除了台北之外，另一個酒吧的一級戰區，於 2022 年底才開幕的 Bar Alter，今年的酒單「A Point To」以旅遊手冊為概念，由日常生活出發，酒單上每一杯酒都是一道菜，十分的特別有趣。

這次會選擇 Bar Alter 是因為別人推薦，它的地點也很特別，位於東門路橋旁的巷底，Uber 司機載我們過來的時候還說這附近晚上就跟廢墟一樣，你們確定他有開店嗎 🤣

📜 資訊

  • 地址：701002台南市東區東門路一段22號
  • 電話：062150502
  • 營業時間：19:00 - 02:00
  • 官方粉絲頁：https://www.instagram.com/alter_tainan/
  • 訂位方式：請洽粉絲頁 or 電話

🏢  店內環境

戶外庭園的造景

穿過最外面的鐵門後，來到 Bar Alter 的庭園，一點斑駁、一點老宅、一點工業風的氛圍，讓整個庭園在夜晚非常的有氣氛。 


第一區 - 吧台

Bar Alter 分成兩區，第一區是約有 8 個座位的吧台，所有調酒的處理也都是在這裡，中間庭園還有著廁所空間，穿過之後才會到第二區的座位區。

第一區的吧台區

第二區的座位區

🍸 調酒

非常有設計感的酒單與菜單


Alter's Margarita
Green Pepper/ Pink Guava/ Hazelnut

這杯是上一季酒單留下來的一杯，入口有著非常明顯的青椒香氣，但入口卻不會有著青椒的生澀味道，十分清新順口，後韻有著榛果的風味，搭配杯上的烤乳酪片，整體風味有趣也蠻好喝的。

熱炒第一杯 First Beer On The Table
Fried fish with peanut/ Plum wine/ Sparkling tea/ Beer

這杯很有趣，想要做的體驗是，當我們在熱炒店喝著啤酒搭配著小酒菜小魚花生的這種情境，而風味非常的有趣，上面的 Foam 是用啤酒做的，酒液清爽但有著小魚乾的風味，並且有微微的辣感。詢問了一下，辣度與小魚乾的風味，都是因為 infused 所做出來的風味，十分有趣。

甜豆水果沙拉 Sweet Bean Salad
Sweet bean/ Peach/ Jasmine/ CO2

這杯甜豆水果沙拉，如同吃沙拉一般非常的清爽，有著清新水果與花香，是一杯很適合第一杯且順口好喝。

Dongmen Club
Blood Orange/ Earl grey tea/ Raspberry/ Apple

莓果風味的 Foam，搭配伯爵茶與蘋果風味的酒液，是討喜的茶與水果風味。

Berry Fizz
Shiraz gin Four Pillars/ Palm sugar/ Soda

有著莓果風味的 Fizz，帶著果香、清爽無負擔。

Espresso Martini 2024
Brie cheese/ Grape/ Espresso/ Noix de la St Jean

這杯是 Espresso Martini的 Twist，除了咖啡香氣之外，多了一點果香，整體蠻有趣好喝的。

紅蘿蔔蛋糕 Carrot Cake
Honey black tea/ Carrot/ Palm dated/ Cumin

這杯是當天最喜愛的一杯，也是同行朋友們一致最愛的一杯，是以類似 romas 的做法，除了綿密的口感搭配蜜香紅茶的香氣之外，淡淡紅蘿蔔的香氣，完全沒有生味，這是最驚艷且為了這杯加很多分的一的風味，整體酸甜平衡又順口好喝，如果不是特別不喜歡紅蘿蔔味道的話，蠻推薦點這杯來試試看的。

20th century (twist)

Mai Tai (twist)


Bar Alter 主理人 - 柏賢

整體來說風味都算是有趣的，Bar Alter 室內空間也很舒適，Bartender 們也都很友善且很健談，體驗是很舒適輕鬆，這天晚上喝到的每一杯調酒，也都很有趣，可以體會到這杯酒想要創作出來的理念。如果有來到台南，可以來 Bar Alter 喝一杯，試試看他們的調酒。
