title.$t: Tainan Bar | Bar Alter | A Hidden Bar Under the Tainan Overpass | Every Drink Is a Dish

content.$t:
Besides Taipei, Tainan is Taiwan's other prime battleground for cocktail bars. Bar Alter only opened at the end of 2022, and this year's cocktail menu, "A Point To," is built around the concept of a travel brochure. Drawing inspiration from everyday life, every drink on the menu is presented as a dish — a wonderfully unique and fun idea.

We chose Bar Alter this time because it came highly recommended, and its location is quite unusual — at the end of an alley beside the Dongmen Road overpass. When our Uber driver dropped us off, he even said the area looks like a ruin at night, and asked if we were sure the place was actually open 🤣

📜 Information

  • Address: No. 22, Sec. 1, Dongmen Rd., East District, Tainan City 701002
  • Phone: 062150502
  • Opening hours: 19:00 - 02:00
  • Official page: https://www.instagram.com/alter_tainan/
  • Reservations: via their Instagram page or by phone

🏢  The Space

The outdoor garden landscaping

After passing through the outermost iron gate, you arrive at Bar Alter's garden — a little weathered, a little old-house, a little industrial. At night the whole garden has a wonderful atmosphere. 


Area One - the bar counter

Bar Alter is divided into two areas. The first is the bar counter with about 8 seats, where all the cocktails are made. The restrooms are in the garden in between, and beyond that you reach the second seating area.

The bar counter in Area One

The seating area in Area Two

🍸 Cocktails

The beautifully designed drink and food menus


Alter's Margarita
Green Pepper/ Pink Guava/ Hazelnut

This one is a holdover from last season's menu. There's a very distinct green pepper aroma on the nose, yet none of the raw, grassy bitterness on the palate — it's fresh and easy-drinking, with a hazelnut note on the finish. Paired with the baked cheese crisp on the rim, the overall flavor is both interesting and quite tasty.

First Beer On The Table
Fried fish with peanut/ Plum wine/ Sparkling tea/ Beer

This one is really fun — it recreates the experience of drinking beer at a Taiwanese stir-fry joint alongside a plate of dried anchovies and peanuts. The flavor is fascinating: the foam on top is made from beer, and the liquid is crisp yet carries the savory note of dried anchovies with a faint touch of heat. I asked about it, and both the spiciness and the anchovy flavor come from infusions — very clever.

Sweet Bean Salad
Sweet bean/ Peach/ Jasmine/ CO2

This Sweet Bean Salad is as refreshing as eating an actual salad, with bright fruit and floral notes — a smooth, easy-drinking choice that works perfectly as a first drink.

Dongmen Club
Blood Orange/ Earl grey tea/ Raspberry/ Apple

A berry-flavored foam over an Earl Grey and apple base — a crowd-pleasing combination of tea and fruit.

Berry Fizz
Shiraz gin Four Pillars/ Palm sugar/ Soda

A berry-driven fizz — fruity, crisp and light.

Espresso Martini 2024
Brie cheese/ Grape/ Espresso/ Noix de la St Jean

This is a twist on the Espresso Martini — beyond the coffee aroma there's an extra touch of fruitiness. Interesting and delicious overall.

Carrot Cake
Honey black tea/ Carrot/ Palm dated/ Cumin

This was my favorite of the night, and unanimously the favorite among my friends too. Made in a style similar to a ramos, it has a silky, creamy texture alongside the fragrance of honey black tea, plus a gentle carrot aroma with absolutely none of the raw vegetal edge — that was the most impressive part and earned this drink a lot of extra points. The sweet-tart balance is spot on and it goes down easily. Unless you really dislike the taste of carrot, I'd definitely recommend giving this one a try.

20th century (twist)

Mai Tai (twist)


Bar Alter's owner - Bo-Xian

Overall the flavors here are consistently interesting, the indoor space is comfortable, and the bartenders are friendly and chatty, making for a relaxed and easygoing experience. Every cocktail we had that night was fun, and you can really sense the concept behind each creation. If you find yourself in Tainan, drop by Bar Alter for a drink and give their cocktails a try.

title.$t: 台北酒吧 | HI NE NI | 隱身在巷弄內的復古摩登酒吧 | 體驗重回 1960 年代的氛圍

content.$t:
位於捷運中正紀念堂站附近，寧波西街的小巷子內，有一間 2023 年才開幕，有著舒適復古氛圍的酒吧「HI NE NI」，除了舒適的空間之外，還有個位在閣樓可以席地而坐播放電影的包廂，讓在外喝酒也可以有再家一般的舒適感。

📜 資訊

  • 地址：100台北市中正區寧波西街8巷1號
  • 電話：0223913261
  • 營業時間：19:00 - 01:00/02:00
  • 官方粉絲頁：https://www.instagram.com/hi_ne_ni_taipei/
  • 訂位方式：請洽粉絲頁 or 電話

🏢  店內環境

位於巷弄內低調的入口


挑高的室內，讓整體具有開闊的空間感

室內走的是 Mid-Century Modern (MCM) 風格，是許多 50-60 年代電影影集愛用的裝潢風格，整體有著復古與摩登的氛圍，讓你一步踏入美劇的場景內，重回 1960 年代。

from: https://www.instagram.com/hi_ne_ni_taipei/

除了吧台之外，店內有許多開放式，或是封閉式區隔開來的小包廂空間，讓客人們都可以私密與愜意，店內還有黑膠播放著音樂，整體氛圍真的很舒適。

閣樓上還有個小空間放著影集，且讓大家席地而坐，有著舒適自在的氣氛。

可以席地而坐播放電影的包廂

每個小角落都很有氣氛

🍸 調酒

如同大部分的酒吧一樣，HI NE NI 的酒單也是會隨著時間出不一樣主題的調酒酒單。

蜜與奶 Milk & Honey

由使用秘魯聖木浸泡的 Vodka，搭配麝香葡萄和 Fino Sherry，整體帶著木質與果香，酒體偏重，是一杯有著有趣風味組合的調酒。

深夜點唱機 Hi – Pop Sour

這杯的元素為金萱茶、荔枝、金桔，基酒是琴酒，酸酸甜甜帶著茶香與荔枝果香，是一杯大眾都蠻喜歡且好喝的調酒。


熱情桑格莉亞 Tropical Sangria

老爺車

摩登少女的香檳

Negroni

Aviation

整體來說，環境舒適度與調酒表現，都是值得可以來光顧的，不妨找天來 HI NE NI，來上一杯調酒，體驗重回 1960 年代的氛圍吧。

title.$t: Taipei Bar | HI NE NI | A Retro-Modern Bar Hidden in a Back Alley | Step Back into the 1960s

content.$t:
Tucked into a small alley on Ningbo West Street near MRT Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall Station is "HI NE NI", a bar that only opened in 2023 with a cozy, retro atmosphere. Besides its comfortable space, it also has an attic room where you can sit on the floor and watch movies, so drinking out can feel just as relaxing as being at home.

📜 Information

  • Address: No. 1, Lane 8, Ningbo W. St., Zhongzheng Dist., Taipei 100
  • Phone: 02-2391-3261
  • Opening hours: 19:00 - 01:00/02:00
  • Official page: https://www.instagram.com/hi_ne_ni_taipei/
  • Reservations: via their social media page or by phone

🏢  The Space

The low-key entrance tucked in an alley


The high ceilings give the interior a wonderfully open feel

The interior follows the Mid-Century Modern (MCM) style, a look favored by many films and TV series from the 50s and 60s. The overall vibe is both retro and modern, so one step inside feels like walking onto the set of an American drama and traveling back to the 1960s.

from: https://www.instagram.com/hi_ne_ni_taipei/

Besides the bar counter, there are many small nooks—some open, some closed off—giving guests privacy and ease. Vinyl records play in the background, and the whole atmosphere is genuinely comfortable.

Up in the attic there's also a small space showing TV series where everyone sits on the floor, for a relaxed, laid-back mood.

The movie room where you can sit on the floor

Every little corner has its own charm

🍸 Cocktails

Like most bars, HI NE NI rotates its cocktail menu with different themes over time.

Milk & Honey

Made with vodka infused with Peruvian palo santo, paired with muscat grapes and Fino sherry. Woody and fruity with a fairly full body—an intriguing flavor combination.

Late-Night Jukebox — Hi – Pop Sour

This one features Jin Xuan tea, lychee and kumquat over a gin base—sweet and tart with tea aromas and lychee fruitiness. A crowd-pleaser that's genuinely delicious.


Tropical Sangria

Vintage Car

The Modern Girl's Champagne

Negroni

Aviation

All in all, both the comfort of the space and the quality of the cocktails make this a bar worth visiting. Find a day to drop by HI NE NI, order a cocktail, and soak up that 1960s atmosphere.

title.$t: 嘉義住宿 | 嘉義兆品酒店 Chiayi Maison de Chine Hotel | 雲朗觀光集團旗下品牌 | 鄰近火車站與文化路夜市

content.$t:
嘉義兆品酒店，屬於雲朗觀光集團旗下品牌的飯店，地點鄰近嘉義火車站與文化路夜市，距離市區的景點，例如花磚博物館，都可以步行抵達，地點蠻便利的。

而這次因為需要一早到嘉義火車站，搭乘台灣好行上阿里山，所以想選擇離火車站不遠的住宿，選到了嘉義兆品酒店。出遊的時間剛好是平日，這次入住兩晚，大約一晚雙人房不含早餐也才兩千左右的價格，還算蠻不錯的價格。

📜  資訊

  • 入住價格：$4,317 (入住週日與週一兩晚，不含早餐)
  • 入住房型：豪華客房
  • 地址：600嘉義市西區文化路257號
  • 電話：052293998
  • 官方網站：http://chiayi.maisondechinehotel.com/
  • 訂房網站：https://www.booking.com/hotel/tw/maison-de-chine.zh-tw.html

📍 地點位置

嘉義兆品酒店位於文化路上，正門與停車場的入口都在同一側，停車場位於地下一樓與二樓，總共有 80 個車位，如果住客很多的話應該會有機會停滿。

位於地下一樓與二樓的停車場

自行開車

  • 由中山高速公路下嘉義交流道，至飯店約15分鐘
  • 由南二高下嘉義交流道，至飯店約15分鐘

火車

  • 搭火車至嘉義火車站下，車程約需5分鐘
  • 飯店備有免費接送，接送時間AM8:00~PM22:00，須前一天先預約

高鐵

  • 搭高鐵至高鐵嘉義站下，車程約需30分鐘
  • 高鐵站到飯店有付費的飯店接送，NT$250/位(單程)

🛏  房間環境


這次入住的是豪華客房雙人房，房間內呈現以木質、偏暖色調為主，除了床鋪區域，窗邊還有一區有著沙發的小客廳區域，整體空間足夠不會有壓迫感。

有著沙發的小客廳區域

沙發前方是衣櫃與備品區域

為了響應環保，現在大部分的飯店旅館，都不會主動陳列一次性的備品 (如瓶裝水、牙膏、牙刷、梳子、浴帽、香皂、刮鬍刀、刮鬍泡、棉花棒等），兆品酒店房間內有兩個玻璃水瓶，可以讓旅客到房外去裝水。


基本的茶與咖啡包

保險箱與室內拖鞋

房內進門空間

床鋪旁是浴室與廁所

衛浴其實還是有附上一次性的備品

TOTO 的免治馬桶與空間蠻大的淋浴與浴缸

🏢 飯店環境與設施

寬敞的一樓大廳

一進入嘉義兆品酒店，一樓的大廳非常的寬廣，除了左手邊的接待櫃檯外，右邊是提供輕食與咖啡的咖啡廳，有著許多桌椅的休息區，傍晚時段會在這裡提供酒精飲料無限暢飲的 Happy Hour。



傍晚時段限定 Happy Hour

Happy Hour 提供的雞尾酒

11 樓的嘉麟閣

早餐是在 11 樓的嘉麟閣，是西式的自助早餐，不過這次我們沒有選擇早餐的方案，所以不確定早餐如何，網路上評價好像普普通通。

B1 的健身房與兒童遊戲區

B1 的 VIP Lounge (大家都可以使用的開放空間)

三樓和室房的走廊

整體來說，入住比較貴的房型，平日晚間一晚也只要約兩千的價格，這樣的品質與體驗 CP 值還蠻不錯。雖然沒有到多驚艷的體驗，但是住起來也蠻舒適，房間內空間大，隔音也不會太差，飯店地點又在很方便的地方，是值得可以推薦的住宿之一。

title.$t: Chiayi Accommodation | Chiayi Maison de Chine Hotel | A Brand of the LDC Hotels & Resorts Group | Near the Train Station and Wenhua Road Night Market

content.$t:
The Chiayi Maison de Chine Hotel is a hotel under the LDC Hotels & Resorts group. It is located close to Chiayi Train Station and the Wenhua Road Night Market, and downtown attractions such as the Tile Museum are all within walking distance, so the location is quite convenient.

This time we needed to get to Chiayi Train Station early in the morning to catch the Taiwan Tourist Shuttle up to Alishan, so we wanted somewhere to stay not far from the station, and we settled on the Chiayi Maison de Chine Hotel. Our trip happened to fall on weekdays, and we stayed two nights — a double room without breakfast came to only around NT$2,000 a night, which is a pretty good price.

📜  Information

  • Price paid: $4,317 (two nights, Sunday and Monday, breakfast not included)
  • Room type: Deluxe Room
  • Address: No. 257, Wenhua Rd., West District, Chiayi City 600
  • Phone: 052293998
  • Official website: http://chiayi.maisondechinehotel.com/
  • Booking site: https://www.booking.com/hotel/tw/maison-de-chine.zh-tw.html

📍 Location

The Chiayi Maison de Chine Hotel is on Wenhua Road, with the main entrance and the car park entrance on the same side. The car park is on basement levels one and two, with 80 spaces in total — when the hotel is busy it could well fill up.

The car park on basement levels one and two

By car

  • Exit National Freeway No. 1 at the Chiayi interchange; about 15 minutes to the hotel
  • Exit National Freeway No. 3 at the Chiayi interchange; about 15 minutes to the hotel

By train

  • Take the train to Chiayi Train Station; about a 5-minute ride from there
  • The hotel offers a free shuttle service from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM; reservations must be made a day in advance

By high speed rail

  • Take the HSR to Chiayi HSR Station; about a 30-minute ride from there
  • A paid hotel shuttle runs between the HSR station and the hotel, NT$250 per person (one way)

🛏  The Room


We stayed in a Deluxe Double Room. The room is done mainly in wood tones with a warm colour palette; besides the bed area, there is a small living-room nook with a sofa by the window. The overall space is generous and never feels cramped.

The small living-room nook with a sofa

In front of the sofa are the wardrobe and amenities area

In the interest of environmental protection, most hotels these days no longer set out single-use amenities by default (such as bottled water, toothpaste, toothbrushes, combs, shower caps, soap, razors, shaving foam, cotton swabs, and so on). The Maison de Chine rooms come with two glass water bottles that guests can take outside the room to fill up.


The basic tea and coffee sachets

Safe and indoor slippers

The entryway inside the room

Next to the bed are the bathroom and toilet

The bathroom does in fact still provide single-use amenities

A TOTO washlet toilet, plus a roomy shower area and bathtub

🏢 Hotel Grounds and Facilities

The spacious ground-floor lobby

As soon as you step into the Chiayi Maison de Chine Hotel, you notice how vast the ground-floor lobby is. Besides the reception desk on the left, there is a café serving light bites and coffee on the right, along with a lounge area with plenty of tables and chairs. In the early evening, an all-you-can-drink alcoholic Happy Hour is held here.



The evening-only Happy Hour

Cocktails served at Happy Hour

Jia Lin Ge restaurant on the 11th floor

Breakfast is served at Jia Lin Ge on the 11th floor — a Western-style buffet. We didn't go for the breakfast package this time, so I can't say how it is; online reviews seem fairly average.

The gym and children's play area on B1

The VIP Lounge on B1 (an open space that everyone can use)

The corridor of the Japanese-style rooms on the third floor

All in all, even booking one of the pricier room types, a weeknight only costs about NT$2,000 — that's pretty good value for this quality and experience. It's not a jaw-dropping stay, but it is comfortable, the rooms are spacious, the soundproofing isn't bad, and the hotel is in a very convenient location, making it one of the places I'd happily recommend.

title.$t: 台中住宿 | 享得道行旅 In Joy Hotel | 逢甲商圈附近的新旅店 | 逢甲夜市步行五分鐘 | 2023 年開始營運

content.$t:
享得道行旅是星享道酒店集團旗下在 2023 年新開幕的旅店，地點位於台中中央公園與逢甲夜市商圈，只要步行五分鐘就可以進入逢甲夜市商圈，秋紅谷、新光三越，也都在步行 20 分鐘左右的距離，整體來說地點蠻便利的。

📜  資訊

  • 入住價格：$2,700 (週日晚，標準雙人房含早餐)
  • 地址：407台中市西屯區河南路二段211號
  • 電話：0427082208
  • 官方網站：http://www.injoyhotel.com.tw/
  • 訂房網站：https://www.booking.com/hotel/tw/xiang-de-dao-lu-in-joy.zh-tw.html

📍 地點位置

享得道行旅 In Joy Hotel 位於逢甲夜市與中央公園中間的河南路二段上，處於一個鬧中取靜的地點，能享受到逢甲夜市商圈的便利，卻不是位於會比較吵鬧的區域。

自行開車

國道一號(中山高速公路)大雅出口下交流道往北屯，往台中進入中清路二段，前行至經貿九路右轉，左轉經入中科路，最後右轉進入河南路二段，享得道行旅即在左手邊。

停車資訊 from: https://www.injoyhotel.com.tw/

停車場出入口位於飯店後方的小巷子內，雖然巷弄不大，因此不是非常好會車，但巷弄也不會很多車，只要開到飯店後方就可以看到停車場的出入口了。


B2 與 B3 都是住宿旅客可以停車的空間，出入都採車牌辨識，只要 check-in 的時候報車牌就可以了，十分的方便。

停車空間明亮新穎，動線也清楚

搭乘高鐵

搭乘和欣客運160號公車至逢甲大學站下車步行10分鐘即可抵達。

🏢 飯店環境與設施


一樓明亮寬廣的接待大廳

享得道行旅 In Joy Hotel 的設施還蠻多元的，除了一般常見的健身房之外，多了不少一般飯店不常見的設施，像是電競室、泡腳池或是一個販售餐具傢俱的展覽空間。

上圖：共享空間

  • 是一個閱讀與辦公的空間，讓商務客人可以在可以辦公。

左下：電競蛋

  • 開放時間：10:00-24:00
  • 價格：200元/hr
  • 介紹：https://www.injoyhotel.com.tw/portfolio/%e9%9b%bb%e7%ab%b6%e8%9b%8b/

右下：享買吧

  • 介紹：https://www.injoyhotel.com.tw/portfolio/%e8%b2%b7%e5%90%a7/

健身房

開放時間：每日06:30-21:00

舒緩泡腳池

服務時間：每日06:30-21:00，from: 官方網站


舒壓室

服務時間：週一-週日 11:00-21:00，from: 官方網站

岩盤浴

服務時間：週一-週日 9:00-21:00，from: 官方網站

休息空間


享喝吧

這裡是「享喝吧」露天酒吧，假日的時候還會有 live band 演唱，不過我們入住這天是週日，這裡晚上完全沒有開始營業。

  • 夜晚開放時間：18:00-23:00

🛏  房間環境

每一層的電梯間都有可愛的裝飾

這次入住的是 10 樓的標準雙人房，房間內空間大小算蠻大的，木質貼文的地板搭配房間內的色調，走著一個文青無印風格。床鋪的部分使用英國斯林百蘭名床，軟硬適中很好睡，房間隔音無法評論，因為這次入住最底部的房間，附近似乎都沒有住客。


有一個小小的用餐區，可以吃宵夜、小酌一杯

採用洗手台與衛浴分離的設計，所以一進門就可以看到洗手台，直接與檯面的功能結合，右邊放置零食、備品與熱水快煮壺，下方冰箱內的飲料也是可以免費使用的。



衛浴的部分與廁所是分開兩間的，位於洗手台的另一面，空間也都蠻足夠，不會感覺壓迫或是空間狹小。

🍽️ 宵夜與早餐

位於三樓的沐青餐廳

宵夜

每日在晚間九點後，三樓的沐青餐廳就會提供宵夜提供入住客人使用代幣來兌換，宵夜種類有四種可以選擇，且份量不少。

入住時候會給兩種代幣：宵夜與早餐


早餐

早餐一樣是在三樓的沐青餐廳用餐，沐青餐廳有著大量的植物裝飾，搭配木質餐桌椅，似乎是來到森林中用餐一般，整體設計的氛圍讓人很放鬆，且有種耳目一新的感覺。


早餐的種類數量不算太多，不過口味不錯，還有著像是牛肉湯、蔥油餅、銀絲卷，這類不常見於飯店早餐的品項。


連餐具都很美


    整體住起來是有超乎預期的，除了是新旅館很新穎之外，很多地方像是餐廳的設計、環境還是餐點之外，都覺得蠻不錯的。房間的部分，室內空間不錯、床也好睡，飯店內還有許多特殊且有特色的設施，再加上地點方便，去逢甲夜市完全不用擔心停車問題。

    還蠻推薦有來到台中，如果想要入住在逢甲商圈附近，可以考慮這間享得道行旅 In Joy Hotel。

title.$t: Taichung Hotel | In Joy Hotel | A New Hotel Near the Fengjia Area | 5-Minute Walk to Fengjia Night Market | Opened in 2023

content.$t:
In Joy Hotel is a new hotel under the In One City Inn Hotel Group that opened in 2023. It sits between Taichung Central Park and the Fengjia Night Market area — just a five-minute walk gets you into the Fengjia Night Market district, while Maple Garden (Qiuhonggu) and Shin Kong Mitsukoshi are both about a 20-minute walk away. Overall, the location is quite convenient.

📜  Information

  • Rate: NT$2,700 (Sunday night, standard double room with breakfast)
  • Address: No. 211, Sec. 2, Henan Rd., Xitun Dist., Taichung 407
  • Phone: 04-2708-2208
  • Official website:http://www.injoyhotel.com.tw/
  • Booking site:https://www.booking.com/hotel/tw/xiang-de-dao-lu-in-joy.zh-tw.html

📍 Location

In Joy Hotel is located on Section 2 of Henan Road, midway between Fengjia Night Market and Central Park — a quiet spot right in the middle of the action. You get all the convenience of the Fengjia Night Market area without being in the noisiest part of it.

By car

Take National Freeway No. 1 (Sun Yat-sen Freeway), exit at Daya and head toward Beitun; continue into Taichung on Sec. 2 of Zhongqing Rd., turn right onto Jingmao 9th Rd., turn left onto Zhongke Rd., then finally turn right onto Sec. 2 of Henan Rd. — In Joy Hotel will be on your left.

Parking information from: https://www.injoyhotel.com.tw/

The parking garage entrance is in a small lane behind the hotel. The lane is narrow, so passing oncoming cars isn't easy, but there isn't much traffic — just drive around to the back of the hotel and you'll see the garage entrance.


Both B2 and B3 are available for hotel guests to park. Entry and exit use license plate recognition, so you just give your plate number at check-in — very convenient.

The parking area is bright and new, with clear traffic flow

By High Speed Rail

Take Ho-Hsin Bus No. 160 and get off at the Feng Chia University stop; it's a 10-minute walk from there.

🏢 Hotel Environment and Facilities


The bright, spacious lobby on the first floor

In Joy Hotel offers a pretty diverse range of facilities. Besides the usual gym, there are quite a few amenities you don't often find in hotels, such as an esports room, a foot spa, and an exhibition space selling tableware and furniture.

Above: the shared space

  • A reading and working space where business guests can get some work done.

Bottom left: the Esports Pod

  • Opening hours: 10:00–24:00
  • Price: NT$200/hr
  • Details:https://www.injoyhotel.com.tw/portfolio/%e9%9b%bb%e7%ab%b6%e8%9b%8b/

Bottom right: In Joy Shop

  • Details:https://www.injoyhotel.com.tw/portfolio/%e8%b2%b7%e5%90%a7/

Gym

Opening hours: daily 06:30–21:00

Relaxing Foot Spa

Service hours: daily 06:30–21:00, from: official website


Relaxation Room

Service hours: Mon–Sun 11:00–21:00, from: official website

Stone Bed Sauna

Service hours: Mon–Sun 9:00–21:00, from: official website

Lounge Area


In Joy Bar

This is the open-air "In Joy Bar," which even has live band performances on weekends. However, we stayed on a Sunday, and it wasn't open at all that evening.

  • Evening hours: 18:00–23:00

🛏  The Room

Every elevator lobby has cute decorations

We stayed in a standard double room on the 10th floor. The room is quite roomy, and the wood-look flooring paired with the room's color scheme gives it an artsy, MUJI-like feel. The bed uses a Slumberland mattress from the UK — just the right firmness and very comfortable. I can't comment on soundproofing, since our room was at the very end of the hall and there didn't seem to be any other guests nearby.


There's a small dining nook, perfect for late-night snacks or a drink

The sink is separate from the bathroom, so it's the first thing you see when you walk in, integrated directly into the countertop. Snacks, amenities, and an electric kettle sit on the right, and the drinks in the fridge below are free as well.



The shower and the toilet are in two separate rooms, located on the other side of the sink. Both have plenty of space and never feel cramped or confining.

🍽️ Late-Night Snacks and Breakfast

Mu Qing Restaurant on the third floor

Late-night snacks

Every night after 9 p.m., Mu Qing Restaurant on the third floor serves late-night snacks that guests can redeem with tokens. There are four options to choose from, and the portions are generous.

At check-in you receive two kinds of tokens: one for late-night snacks and one for breakfast


Breakfast

Breakfast is also served at Mu Qing Restaurant on the third floor. The restaurant is filled with greenery paired with wooden tables and chairs, making it feel like dining in a forest. The overall design is very relaxing and refreshingly different.


The breakfast selection isn't huge, but the food tastes good, and there are items you don't often see at hotel breakfasts, such as beef soup, scallion pancakes, and steamed silver-thread rolls.


Even the tableware is beautiful


    Overall, the stay exceeded expectations. Beyond being a brand-new, modern hotel, many aspects — the restaurant's design, the atmosphere, and the food — were all impressive. As for the room, the space is generous and the bed is comfortable, plus the hotel has plenty of unique, distinctive facilities. Add in the convenient location and you never have to worry about parking when heading to Fengjia Night Market.

    If you're visiting Taichung and want to stay near the Fengjia area, In Joy Hotel is well worth considering.

title.$t: 仙台住宿 | 仙台大都會飯店 Hotel Metropolitan Sendai | 直接聯通 JR 仙台車站 | 地點熱鬧方便

content.$t:
仙台市熱鬧的區域是在仙台車站到廣瀨通之間的這個區域，因此也有相當多的飯店在這個區域。這天是入住仙台的最後一個晚上，由於隔天就要直接搭乘 JR 前往機場回程了，因此選擇了離 JR 車站非常近的「仙台大都會飯店」。

📜  資訊

  • 地址：宮城縣仙台市青葉區中央1-1-1
  • 電話：+81 22-268-2525
  • 飯店官網：https://sendai.metropolitan.jp/
  • 訂房網站：https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/metropolitan-sendai.zh-tw.html

📍 地點位置

Hotel Metropolitan (大都會飯店)，是 JR 公司旗下的飯店，因此許多城市的 Hotel Metropolitan 其實都會直接連結著 JR 車站，讓入住的旅客可以非常方便的接駁 JR 車站。

而仙台大都會飯店也是連接著 JR 仙台車站，只要步行 1~2 分鐘就可以抵達車站，地點相當的便利，不過如果是走室內，因為中間會先經過 S-PAL 百貨，所以如果下雨天想要直接透過室內從仙台大都會飯店走到仙台車站，必須要在 S-PAL 百貨的營業時間才可以喔！

🏢 飯店環境

挑高氣派的大廳

大廳的接待櫃檯

仙台大都會飯店內同時有著許多會場，提供結婚、或是各種商務開會使用，同時也有幾間餐廳位在二樓。入住這天在大廳就遇到很多穿著西裝的商務人士，似乎飯店有蠻多商務旅客入住。


🛏  房間環境

房間的設計感覺走一個沈穩但比較有年代的風格，整體色調偏黃色系，房間內的空間不算大，兩個大行李箱無法完全攤開，把空間都拿來放一個不小的圓桌與兩個沙發椅...


房間內電視蠻小的


桌上的化妝鏡

一般的備品
廁所採日式三件式乾濕分離


浴室感覺偏舊一些，但乾淨度是可以的

整體來說，飯店其實離鐵軌十分的近，但完全聽不到火車的聲音，隔音度蠻好的。床睡起來十分舒適，且這次入住的房間位於高樓層，可以看到城市的夜景，不過房間內濕氣偏重一點。

飯店地點真的十分方便，尤其是對要搭乘 JR 的旅客，如果不想花時間再從火車站移動到飯店，仙台大都會飯店的地點是蠻理想的選擇。

title.$t: Sendai Accommodation | Hotel Metropolitan Sendai | Directly Connected to JR Sendai Station | Lively, Convenient Location

content.$t:
The liveliest part of Sendai is the area between Sendai Station and Hirose-dori, so there are quite a lot of hotels here. This was our last night in Sendai, and since we would be taking the JR straight to the airport the next day for our flight home, we chose "Hotel Metropolitan Sendai," which is extremely close to the JR station.

📜  Information

  • Address: 1-1-1 Chuo, Aoba-ku, Sendai City, Miyagi Prefecture
  • Phone: +81 22-268-2525
  • Official website：https://sendai.metropolitan.jp/
  • Booking site：https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/metropolitan-sendai.zh-tw.html

📍 Location

Hotel Metropolitan is a hotel brand operated by JR, so in many cities the Hotel Metropolitan is directly connected to the JR station, making transfers extremely convenient for guests.

Hotel Metropolitan Sendai is likewise connected to JR Sendai Station — just a 1–2 minute walk away, which is very convenient. However, if you go indoors you first pass through the S-PAL department store, so if it's a rainy day and you want to walk indoors from the hotel to Sendai Station, you can only do so during S-PAL's opening hours!

🏢 Hotel Environment

The grand, high-ceilinged lobby

The reception desk in the lobby

Hotel Metropolitan Sendai also has numerous function rooms for weddings and all kinds of business meetings, plus several restaurants on the second floor. On the day we checked in, we saw plenty of people in suits in the lobby — the hotel seems to attract quite a few business travelers.


🛏  The Room

The room's design feels understated but somewhat dated, with an overall yellowish color scheme. The room isn't particularly spacious — you can't fully open two large suitcases, since much of the space is taken up by a fairly large round table and two armchairs...


The TV in the room is pretty small


The vanity mirror on the desk

Standard amenities
The bathroom is a Japanese-style three-piece unit with separate wet and dry areas


The bathroom feels a bit dated, but the cleanliness is fine

Overall, the hotel is very close to the railway tracks, yet you can't hear the trains at all — the soundproofing is quite good. The bed was very comfortable, and our room was on a high floor with views of the city at night, though the room was a little on the humid side.

The location really is extremely convenient, especially for travelers taking the JR. If you don't want to spend time getting from the station to your hotel,Hotel Metropolitan Sendai is a pretty ideal choice.

title.$t: 台北餐廳 | 台北晶華酒店- ROBIN'S 牛排屋 | 高品質牛排 | 台北牛排推薦

content.$t:
說到台北的高價位優質牛排推薦，位於晶華酒店內的 Robin's 牛排屋肯定會出現在名單之中，一直也都是很熱門不好訂位的餐廳。

而 ROBIN’S 牛排屋創立於台北京華酒店開業之初，酒店自1990年代以來一直是台北市高級酒店的代表之一。命名源自於酒店創始人之一的名字，這位創始人對於高品質餐飲有著深厚的熱情和嚴格的標準，為了紀念創始人的貢獻，餐廳以他的名字命名。

之前一直還蠻喜歡同樣為晶華旗下，位於信義誠品的牛排屋 - Just Grill，不過因為信義誠品結束營業，所以 Just Grill 目前暫時休業了，這次就選擇了一直沒有來吃過的 Robin's 牛排屋。

📜  資訊

  • 地址：10491台北市中山區中山北路二段39巷3號2樓
  • 電話：0225238000
  • 官方網站：https://www.regenttaiwan.com/dining/robins-grill
  • 線上訂位：https://inline.app/booking/regenttaipei-robinsgrill/RobinsGrill

📜  菜單

官網上有完整的菜單可以參考：https://docs.regenttaiwan.com/link/IHG_Menu/RobinsGrill.pdf

以牛排為主，也有豬、羊或是海鮮可以選擇，午餐和晚餐的品項差不多，但晚餐的價位會再高一些。和 Just Grill 一樣，都是套餐的形式，除了菜單上的主餐、湯品、甜點和飲料之外，沙拉吧與甜點是吃到飽自取的，

🍽️ 餐點

湯品與麵包

ROBIN'S 在湯品的部分與 Just Grill 提供的一樣，麵包自己覺得有點偏硬，口味與香氣蠻不錯的，但是個人還是比較喜歡 Just Grill 的酥炸麵包 (口感類似銀絲卷)

肋眼牛排 8oz


牛排的部分對我來說沒有什麼可挑惕的，香氣、口感、熟度都很不錯，8oz 的大小也還蠻剛好不會太多也不會太少到吃不飽。

餐後飲料，中規中矩

🌱 沙拉與點心吧

ROBIN'S 牛排屋的沙拉與點心吧的空間並不是很大，雖然感覺種類好像不是很多，但該有的生菜沙拉與各種配料都有，且生菜的新鮮度是我吃過最新鮮好吃的。



不過美中不足的是，這區由於空間太小，動線也沒有特別設計，導致一開始所有人點完餐後都會擠在這裡，想要拿沙拉會相當的困難。

冰淇淋與水果區

精美擺設的甜點區


甜點都蠻好吃的

整體的體驗除了沙拉吧動線實在很差之外，體驗、餐點品質真的都蠻好的，只是價位不算便宜，是個想體驗台北高級牛排館的時候，可以選擇的選項之一。

title.$t: Taipei Restaurants | Regent Taipei – ROBIN'S Grill | High-Quality Steak | Taipei Steakhouse Recommendation

content.$t:
When it comes to recommendations for high-end, high-quality steak in Taipei, ROBIN'S Grill inside the Regent Taipei is bound to make the list — it has always been a popular restaurant that's hard to book.

ROBIN'S Grill was founded when the Regent Taipei first opened, and the hotel has been one of Taipei's representative luxury hotels since the 1990s. The name comes from one of the hotel's founders, a man with a deep passion for high-quality dining and strict standards; the restaurant was named after him to commemorate his contributions.

I used to be quite fond of another steakhouse under the same Regent group, Just Grill at Eslite Xinyi. However, since Eslite Xinyi has closed, Just Grill is temporarily suspended, so this time I chose ROBIN'S Grill, which I had never tried before.

📜  Information

  • Address: 2F, No. 3, Lane 39, Section 2, Zhongshan N. Rd., Zhongshan District, Taipei 10491
  • Phone: 0225238000
  • Official website：https://www.regenttaiwan.com/dining/robins-grill
  • Online reservations：https://inline.app/booking/regenttaipei-robinsgrill/RobinsGrill

📜  Menu

The full menu is available on the official website for reference：https://docs.regenttaiwan.com/link/IHG_Menu/RobinsGrill.pdf

Steak is the focus, but there are also pork, lamb and seafood options. The lunch and dinner offerings are similar, though dinner prices are a bit higher. Like Just Grill, everything comes as a set menu: in addition to the main course, soup, dessert and drink on the menu, the salad bar and dessert bar are all-you-can-eat and self-serve.

🍽️ The Food

Soup and bread

ROBIN'S serves the same soup as Just Grill. I found the bread a little on the hard side; the flavor and aroma were quite good, but personally I still prefer Just Grill's deep-fried bread (similar in texture to a silver-thread roll).

Ribeye steak, 8oz


As for the steak, I have nothing to complain about — the aroma, texture and doneness were all excellent, and the 8oz portion was just right: not too much, but enough to leave you satisfied.

After-dinner drink — decent, nothing special

🌱 Salad and Dessert Bar

The salad and dessert bar area at ROBIN'S Grill isn't very large, and although the variety may not seem extensive, all the essentials — leafy salads and various toppings — are there, and the greens were the freshest and tastiest I've had.



The one drawback is that because the space is so small and the traffic flow isn't specially designed, everyone crowds in here right after ordering, making it quite difficult to get to the salads.

Ice cream and fruit section

Beautifully arranged dessert section


The desserts were all quite tasty

Apart from the really poor flow at the salad bar, the overall experience and food quality were genuinely very good. It's just not cheap, but it's definitely one of the options to consider when you want to experience a high-end Taipei steakhouse.

title.$t: 盛岡住宿 | 多美迎 盛岡 Dormy Inn Morioka | 天然溫泉三颯之湯 | 每日免費 Soba 宵夜 | 盛岡冷麵早餐

content.$t:
盛岡位於日本岩手縣，以盛岡冷麵、賞櫻聞名。而這次入住的「多美迎 盛岡」於2019年4月開幕，位於盛岡車站附近，交通便利，步行即可抵達盛岡鬧區。

Dormy Inn (多美迎) 是連鎖的飯店，旗下的飯店都有提供溫泉浴場，也會提供宵夜，早餐也會有當地特色的料理，「多美迎 盛岡」飯店內除了有天然溫泉大浴場之外，免費宵夜是蕎麥麵，早餐也可以品嘗到盛岡冷麵。

📜  資訊

  • 地址：〒020-0021 岩手県盛岡市中央通2-8-12
  • 電話：+81 19-624-8811
  • 官方網站：https://www.hotespa.net/hotels/morioka/
  • 訂房網站：https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/domiinsheng-gang.zh-tw.html

📍 地點位置

多美迎 盛岡，位於盛岡車站徒步約15分鐘的中央通上，但由於盛岡並沒有地鐵，如果是從盛岡車站來的話，還是有一小段的路，如果拉著行李，可以考慮搭乘盛岡市區的循環巴士蝸牛號，從車站約十分就就可以抵達飯店。

一進門的櫃檯

而飯店附近比較屬於商辦區，夜晚附近沒有什麼商家，整體蠻安靜的。不過只要步行約五分鐘，轉進飯店對面的巷子裡，就可以抵達充滿餐廳與商店熱鬧的區域，離盛岡遺跡公園也只需要步行10分鐘的距離，附近也有便利商店，地點算是方便不錯的。

🛏  房間環境

這次入住的房型格局是雙床間，格局是長型的，廁所會在進門的地方，衛浴空間則是在房間的最深處。床鋪軟硬度適中，而且隔音蠻好的，只是枕頭稍微偏小一點點。

一進門遇到的廁所

走到房間底部才會遇到的衛浴空間與洗手檯
房間內的淋浴空間

房間內的淋浴空間非常的小，光是站在裡面都會覺得有點擠，不過由於飯店有附設的大浴場，可能也因為這樣房間內的衛浴空間就沒有做很大。

整體房間的乾淨度蠻好的，感覺也都還算新，住起來蠻舒適，沒有什麼太大的問題。

冰箱內會有迎賓的青森蘋果果凍，這很好吃！

🏢 飯店設施

每天的 2pm ~ 9pm 的 free drink

多美迎 盛岡的設施不算多，主要的就是頂樓的天然溫泉(不過這裡應該不是真的溫泉)，每天下午兩點～晚上九點間，有提供免費的 welcome drink，有一台飲料機可以自由使用。

大廳的免費咖啡，也有提供外帶杯


位於 10 樓的大浴場外有一個休息區，這裡提供許多漫畫，以及販售啤酒的販賣機，讓泡完澡的的旅客可以在這裡稍作休息，來一杯清涼的啤酒，或是翻閱漫畫。

from: https://dormy-hotels.com/zh-TW/dormyinn/hotels/morioka/spa/




早上時段也有提供免費的乳酸菌飲料

🍽️ 早餐

早餐用餐空間

早餐選擇不算太多，不過有提供蠻多日式料理，也有盛岡名物「冷麵」，如果沒有來到盛岡沒有打算在外面店家試試冷麵的話，可以在早餐的時候試試看。




整體住起來覺得還算不錯，沒有什麼太大的缺點，床鋪舒適且隔音也蠻好的，可能只有離盛岡車站如果步行需要點距離，對於自駕前往的旅客，地點算蠻方便的。

title.$t: Morioka Hotel | Dormy Inn Morioka | Natural Hot Spring "Sansa no Yu" | Free Nightly Soba | Morioka Cold Noodle Breakfast

content.$t:
Morioka is located in Iwate Prefecture, Japan, and is famous for its Morioka cold noodles (reimen) and cherry blossom viewing. The hotel I stayed at this time, "Dormy Inn Morioka," opened in April 2019. It sits near Morioka Station, offers convenient transport links, and the city's downtown area is within walking distance.

Dormy Inn is a hotel chain whose properties all offer hot spring baths and late-night snacks, with breakfasts featuring local specialties. Besides its natural hot spring public bath, Dormy Inn Morioka serves free soba noodles as a late-night snack, and you can also enjoy Morioka cold noodles at breakfast.

📜  Information

  • Address: 2-8-12 Chuo-dori, Morioka, Iwate 020-0021, Japan
  • Phone: +81 19-624-8811
  • Official website: https://www.hotespa.net/hotels/morioka/
  • Booking site: https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/domiinsheng-gang.zh-tw.html

📍 Location

Dormy Inn Morioka is on Chuo-dori, about a 15-minute walk from Morioka Station. Since Morioka has no subway, it's still a bit of a hike if you're coming from the station. If you're pulling luggage, consider taking Morioka's downtown loop bus "Dendenmushi" (the Snail), which gets you from the station to the hotel in about ten minutes.

The front desk right inside the entrance

The area around the hotel is mostly a business district, so there aren't many shops open at night and it's quite quiet overall. However, just a five-minute walk away, turning into the alley across from the hotel, you reach a lively area full of restaurants and shops. Morioka Castle Ruins Park is only a 10-minute walk away, and there are convenience stores nearby too, so the location is quite convenient.

🛏  The Room

This time I stayed in a twin room with a long, narrow layout. The toilet is right by the entrance, while the bathroom is at the far end of the room. The beds were just the right firmness and the soundproofing was quite good; the only downside was that the pillows were a bit small.

The toilet right by the entrance

The bathroom and washbasin, which you only reach at the far end of the room
The shower area in the room

The shower area in the room is very small — just standing in it feels a bit cramped. But since the hotel has a large public bath, that's probably why the in-room bathroom wasn't made any bigger.

The room was very clean overall and still felt fairly new. It was comfortable to stay in, with no major issues.

There's a welcome Aomori apple jelly in the fridge — it's delicious!

🏢 Hotel Facilities

Free drinks daily from 2pm to 9pm

Dormy Inn Morioka doesn't have a huge range of facilities — the main draw is the natural hot spring on the top floor (though this probably isn't a genuine hot spring). Every day from 2pm to 9pm, free welcome drinks are available from a self-serve drinks machine.

Free coffee in the lobby, with takeaway cups available too


Outside the large public bath on the 10th floor there's a lounge area stocked with plenty of manga and a vending machine selling beer, so guests can take a break after their bath with a cold beer or a comic book.

from: https://dormy-hotels.com/zh-TW/dormyinn/hotels/morioka/spa/

from: https://dormy-hotels.com/zh-TW/dormyinn/hotels/morioka/spa/




Free probiotic yogurt drinks are also offered in the morning

🍽️ Breakfast

The breakfast dining area

There isn't a huge selection at breakfast, but there are plenty of Japanese dishes, including Morioka's famous cold noodles (reimen). If you come to Morioka but don't plan to try reimen at a restaurant, you can give it a go at breakfast.




Overall the stay was pretty good with no major drawbacks: the beds were comfortable and the soundproofing was solid. The only issue might be the walking distance from Morioka Station, though for travelers arriving by car the location is quite convenient.

title.$t: 日本秋田 | 田澤湖景點 Tazawako | 辰子像 | 漢槎宮(浮木神社) | 御座石神社 | 思い出の潟分校

content.$t:
田澤湖位於日本秋田縣，水深達423.4公尺，是日本最深的淡水湖，雖然湖很深，但湖水的透明度很高，可以很清楚的看到許多湖中的魚群。這裡也被列為日本百景之一，與附近的溫泉區都是遊客常常會來造訪的景點。

📜 資訊

  • 交通：
    • 從JR田澤湖站搭乘公車約15分鐘
    • 從JR角館站搭乘公車40分鐘
  • 官方網站：https://tazawako-kakunodate.com/ja/

必訪景點

  • 辰子像
  • 浮木神社
  • 御座石神社
  • 思い出の潟分校

  辰子像 (たつこ像)


在田澤湖最著名的景點，就是南邊湖畔邊的辰子像，在好天氣的時候，金光閃閃的辰子像，搭配藍天與倒映的湖水，風景十分美麗。
  • 地址：Katajiri Nishikicho Saimyoji, Semboku, Akita 014-0511

傳說中，在田澤湖畔的村落住著一位名叫辰子的美麗女孩，她向大藏觀音祈願百日，希望得到永遠的美貌。觀音被她的誠意所感動，指示她到森林深處喝下湧泉便得以青春永駐。然而，辰子在喝下湧泉後，幻化為龍，躍入田澤湖中成為湖神，永远徘徊在深深湖底，而之後坊間也依此傳說在湖畔竪立了辰子像。

停車資訊：

  • 漢槎宮（浮木神社）附近設有免費停車場，可供遊客停車。

交通資訊：

  • 從JR田澤湖站乘坐巴士“田澤湖環線”，在 Katajiri 下車，步行1分鐘（約30分鐘）。
  • 自駕前往：從秋田市區出發，沿國道46號約1小時車程。

  漢槎宮（浮木神社）


漢槎宮（浮木神社）位於日本秋田縣仙北市的田澤湖畔，是一座供奉流木之神的神社。神社建於德川幕府時代，原名為「漢槎宮」，後來改名為「浮木神社」。
  • 地址：日本秋田縣仙北市西木町差苗字 Katajiri Nishikicho Saimyoji, Semboku, Akita 014-0511

浮木神社的由來也有很多故事，據說江戶時代以前，田澤湖曾出現過一根巨大的浮木，從湖面伸出約2米，剩下的部分傾斜在湖底。當時有位村人將這個浮木的一部份給鋸斷帶走，結果不僅被病魔纏上最後死去，一家慘遭絕子絕孫。後來人們畏懼此事件，建立了神社於此祭拜浮木明神、槎木明神。

而另一個說法，浮木神社是為了供奉辰子而設立的，是漢槎宮的前身。

停車資訊：

  • 漢槎宮（浮木神社）附近設有免費停車場，可供遊客停車。

交通資訊：

  • 從JR田澤湖站乘坐巴士“田澤湖環線”，在 Katajiri 下車，步行1分鐘（約30分鐘）。
  • 自駕前往：從秋田市區出發，沿國道46號約1小時車程。

      御座石神社


    御座石神社位於日本秋田縣仙北市的田澤湖畔，是一座供奉龍神和美貌之神的神社。神社建於江戶時代初期，相傳是為了祭祀田澤湖的龍神而建造的。

    • 地址：日本秋田縣仙北市西木町下檜木內字相內潟1

    御座石神社的主要景點：

    • 本殿：神社的主殿，供奉龍神和美貌之神。
    • 七色木：神社內的一棵神木，從中長出了7種不同的樹木。
    • 辰子像：位於神社境內的一座辰子女神像。

    本殿：神社的主殿，供奉龍神和美貌之神
    七色木：神社內的一棵神木，從中長出了7種不同的樹木

    辰子像：位於神社境內的一座辰子女神像
    神社前面向湖面的鳥居

    停車資訊：

    • 御座石神社附近設有免費停車場，可供遊客停車。

    交通資訊：

    • 從JR田澤湖站乘坐巴士“田澤湖一周線”，在御座石神社前下車（約40分鐘）。
    • 自駕前往：從秋田市區出發，沿國道46號約1小時車程。

      思い出の潟分校


    思い出の潟分校（Omoide no Katabunko）是位於日本秋田縣仙北市田澤湖畔的一座廢校，現已改建為博物館。該校建於1882年，1974年廢校，2004年修復後對外開放。內部展示了昭和年代的教室、圖書館、禮堂等設施，以及當時的學生用品和照片。遊客可以通過參觀博物館，了解日本鄉村小學的歷史和文化。

    • 地址：日本秋田縣仙北市田沢湖生保内字潟分1-3

    思い出の潟分校原為田澤湖町立生保內小學的潟分校，由於學生人數減少而於1974年廢校。廢校後，校舍一度荒廢，直到2004年，當地居民集資修繕校舍，並將其改建為博物館。




    停車資訊：

    • 思い出の潟分校附近設有免費停車場，可供遊客停車。

    交通資訊：

    • 從JR田澤湖站乘巴士“田澤湖一周線”，在上田子ノ木（Uenakono）站下車，步行15分鐘即可抵達。
    • 自駕前往：從秋田市區出發，沿國道46號約1小時車程。

    其他資訊：

    • 開放時間：9:00-17:00，週二（非節假日）休息
    • 門票：成人300日元，兒童150日元

title.$t: Akita, Japan | Lake Tazawa Attractions | Statue of Tatsuko | Kansa-gu Shrine (Ukigi Shrine) | Gozanoishi Shrine | Omoide no Katabunko

content.$t:
Lake Tazawa is located in Akita Prefecture, Japan. With a depth of 423.4 meters, it is the deepest freshwater lake in Japan. Despite its depth, the water is remarkably clear, and you can easily spot schools of fish swimming in the lake. It is also listed as one of Japan's 100 Landscapes, and together with the nearby hot spring areas, it is a spot travelers frequently visit.

📜 Information

  • Getting there:
    • About 15 minutes by bus from JR Tazawako Station
    • 40 minutes by bus from JR Kakunodate Station
  • Official website：https://tazawako-kakunodate.com/ja/

Must-Visit Spots

  • Statue of Tatsuko
  • Ukigi Shrine
  • Gozanoishi Shrine
  • Omoide no Katabunko

  Statue of Tatsuko (Tatsuko-zo)


The most famous sight at Lake Tazawa is the Statue of Tatsuko on the southern shore. On a fine day, the golden, gleaming statue set against the blue sky and its reflection in the lake makes for a truly beautiful scene.
  • Address: Katajiri Nishikicho Saimyoji, Semboku, Akita 014-0511

Legend has it that a beautiful girl named Tatsuko lived in a village on the shore of Lake Tazawa. She prayed to the Okura Kannon for one hundred days, wishing for eternal beauty. Moved by her sincerity, Kannon told her to go deep into the forest and drink from a spring so that her youth would last forever. However, after drinking from the spring, Tatsuko transformed into a dragon and plunged into Lake Tazawa, becoming the lake's deity, forever wandering its deep waters. Later, based on this legend, the Statue of Tatsuko was erected on the lakeshore.

Parking information:

  • There is a free parking lot near Kansa-gu Shrine (Ukigi Shrine) available for visitors.

Transport information:

  • From JR Tazawako Station, take the "Lake Tazawa Loop" bus and get off at Katajiri, then walk 1 minute (about 30 minutes in total).
  • By car: about a 1-hour drive from downtown Akita City along National Route 46.

  Kansa-gu Shrine (Ukigi Shrine)


Kansa-gu Shrine (Ukigi Shrine) sits on the shore of Lake Tazawa in Semboku City, Akita Prefecture, and enshrines the deity of driftwood. The shrine was built during the Tokugawa shogunate era and was originally named "Kansa-gu," later renamed "Ukigi Shrine."
  • Address: Katajiri Nishikicho Saimyoji, Semboku, Akita 014-0511, Japan

There are many stories about the origin of Ukigi Shrine. It is said that before the Edo period, a huge piece of driftwood appeared in Lake Tazawa, protruding about 2 meters above the surface with the rest slanting down to the lakebed. A villager sawed off part of the driftwood and took it away, only to be struck by illness and eventually die, with his entire family line coming to an end. Fearful of this incident, people built a shrine here to worship Ukigi Myojin and Sagi Myojin.

According to another account, Ukigi Shrine was established to enshrine Tatsuko and was the predecessor of Kansa-gu Shrine.

Parking information:

  • There is a free parking lot near Kansa-gu Shrine (Ukigi Shrine) available for visitors.

Transport information:

  • From JR Tazawako Station, take the "Lake Tazawa Loop" bus and get off at Katajiri, then walk 1 minute (about 30 minutes in total).
  • By car: about a 1-hour drive from downtown Akita City along National Route 46.

      Gozanoishi Shrine


    Gozanoishi Shrine stands on the shore of Lake Tazawa in Semboku City, Akita Prefecture, and enshrines the dragon deity and the deity of beauty. Built in the early Edo period, it is said to have been founded to worship the dragon god of Lake Tazawa.

    • Address: 1 Ainaigata, Shimohinokinai, Nishiki-cho, Semboku City, Akita Prefecture, Japan

    Main highlights of Gozanoishi Shrine:

    • Main hall: the shrine's principal hall, enshrining the dragon deity and the deity of beauty.
    • Seven-Colored Tree: a sacred tree within the shrine grounds from which seven different kinds of trees grow.
    • Statue of Tatsuko: a statue of the goddess Tatsuko located within the shrine grounds.

    Main hall: the shrine's principal hall, enshrining the dragon deity and the deity of beauty
    Seven-Colored Tree: a sacred tree within the shrine from which seven different kinds of trees grow

    Statue of Tatsuko: a statue of the goddess Tatsuko within the shrine grounds
    The torii gate in front of the shrine facing the lake

    Parking information:

    • There is a free parking lot near Gozanoishi Shrine available for visitors.

    Transport information:

    • From JR Tazawako Station, take the "Lake Tazawa Loop" bus and get off at the Gozanoishi Shrine stop (about 40 minutes).
    • By car: about a 1-hour drive from downtown Akita City along National Route 46.

      Omoide no Katabunko


    Omoide no Katabunko is a closed school on the shore of Lake Tazawa in Semboku City, Akita Prefecture, Japan, now converted into a museum. Built in 1882, it closed in 1974 and was restored and opened to the public in 2004. Inside you'll find Showa-era classrooms, a library, an auditorium and other facilities, along with student belongings and photographs from the period. Visiting the museum offers insight into the history and culture of rural Japanese elementary schools.

    • Address: 1-3 Katabun, Obonai, Tazawako, Semboku City, Akita Prefecture, Japan

    Omoide no Katabunko was originally the Kata branch school of Tazawako Town's Obonai Elementary School, and it closed in 1974 due to declining student numbers. After closing, the school building fell into disrepair until 2004, when local residents raised funds to restore it and convert it into a museum.




    Parking information:

    • There is a free parking lot near Omoide no Katabunko available for visitors.

    Transport information:

    • From JR Tazawako Station, take the "Lake Tazawa Loop" bus, get off at Uenakono stop, and walk 15 minutes.
    • By car: about a 1-hour drive from downtown Akita City along National Route 46.

    Other information:

    • Opening hours: 9:00–17:00, closed on Tuesdays (except public holidays)
    • Admission: 300 yen for adults, 150 yen for children

title.$t: 日本秋田 | 田澤湖景點 | 思い出の潟分校 Omoide no Katabunko | 保存良好的懷舊日式小學校

content.$t:
在秋田縣的田澤湖旁，除了有名的辰子像與御座石神社之外，你知道在湖畔旁的森林中，有一座保存良好的日式小學校嗎？來到了思い出の潟分校，彷彿時光倒流，置身於昔日的校園生活中，回到了從前日式小學校裡。

📜 資訊

  • 地址：Ichinowatashi-222-8 Tazawakokata, Semboku, Akita 014-1203
  • 營業時間：09:00 - 16:00 (週二休館)
  • 門票：
    • 個人：成人 ¥300，兒童 ¥150
    • 20人以上團體：成人 ¥200，兒童 ¥100
  • 官方網站：http://www.city.semboku.akita.jp/sightseeing/spot/04_katabunko.html

🚃 地點交通資訊

思い出の潟分校位於秋田縣的田澤湖旁，坐落在翠綠的森林中，交通上相對比較不是那麼的便利，只能透過自駕，或是搭乘公車抵達。

  • 從JR田澤湖站搭乘羽後交通巴士「田澤湖一期線」在「上田之木」站下車步行15分鐘
  • 從JR田澤湖站開車約20分鐘

思い出の潟分校門前有一大片空地都可以免費停車，如果自駕前來不需要擔心停車位的問題。

🏞️ 內部環境

入校必須換拖鞋

思い出の潟分校，又稱生保內小學校潟分校，歷史悠久，創建於明治15年(1882年)。當時它是田澤湖町立生保內小學校的一個分校，培育了許多周圍孩子的成長。

然而，時光流轉，1974年，這座小學校結束了它的教育使命，整整三十年，它孤獨地被遺棄在茂密的森林中。直到2004年經過修復，這座小學校重新向公眾開放，成為了一個供人參觀的景點。

入館金額

如今，思い出の潟分校已經沒有學生在上課了，但它仍然完整地保留了當初的面貌。



思い出の潟分校共擁有兩層樓，儘管空間不算寬敞，但仍容納了低、中、高三個班級的教室，並擁有一個體育館。這座木造的日式建築散發出懷舊的氛圍，展示櫃裡陳列著當年的書籍和用具等，讓遊客能夠悠然參觀，並慢慢地捕捉美好瞬間。

展示一些當時的文具用品

這些展示的課本都可以翻閱

陽光灑進來的光影很美

牆上有當時每年的全校合照

二樓是中、高年級的兩間教室

時光暫停的感覺

一樓教室的另一側是體育館與廁所，體育館不大，還有一個講台，很像是個日劇或是日漫中會出現的日本小學場景。



置身其中，彷彿穿越時光隧道，能夠感受到昔日日本鄉村小學的風貌。周圍綠意盎然的森林更增添了一份寧靜與幽雅，讓這座森林小學顯得更加迷人。

---

思い出の潟分校這個景點是偶然在網路上搜尋找到的，發現有蠻多人都來參觀過這裡，也說內部很有懷舊感很好拍。雖然這個地點整體不大，慢慢逛應該半小時內就可以參觀完，不過保存與規劃的蠻好的，有來到田澤湖遊玩的話，不妨留個一小時的時間，繞過來日式小學校走走。

title.$t: Akita, Japan | Lake Tazawa Attractions | Omoide no Katabunko | A Beautifully Preserved Nostalgic Japanese Elementary School

content.$t:
Beside Lake Tazawa in Akita Prefecture, aside from the famous Statue of Tatsuko and Gozanoishi Shrine, did you know there is a beautifully preserved Japanese elementary school hidden in the forest by the lakeshore? Stepping into Omoide no Katabunko feels like traveling back in time, immersing yourself in school life of days gone by, back inside an old-fashioned Japanese elementary school.

📜 Information

  • Address: Ichinowatashi-222-8 Tazawakokata, Semboku, Akita 014-1203
  • Opening hours: 09:00 - 16:00 (closed Tuesdays)
  • Admission:
    • Individual: adults ¥300, children ¥150
    • Groups of 20 or more: adults ¥200, children ¥100
  • Official website：http://www.city.semboku.akita.jp/sightseeing/spot/04_katabunko.html

🚃 Getting There

Omoide no Katabunko sits beside Lake Tazawa in Akita Prefecture, nestled in lush green forest. Access is not particularly convenient — you can only get there by car or by bus.

  • From JR Tazawako Station, take the Ugo Kotsu bus "Tazawako Ikki Line," get off at "Uedanoki" stop and walk 15 minutes
  • About a 20-minute drive from JR Tazawako Station

There is a large open lot in front of Omoide no Katabunko where you can park for free, so if you're driving there's no need to worry about parking.

🏞️ Inside the School

You must change into slippers to enter

Omoide no Katabunko, also known as the Kata Branch School of Obonai Elementary School, has a long history, founded in 1882 (Meiji 15). Back then it was a branch campus of Tazawako Town's Obonai Elementary School, nurturing the growth of many local children.

But times changed, and in 1974 the school's educational mission came to an end. For a full thirty years it stood abandoned and alone in the dense forest. It was not until restoration work in 2004 that the school reopened to the public and became a sightseeing spot.

Admission fees

Today there are no longer any students at Omoide no Katabunko, yet it still retains its original appearance completely intact.



Omoide no Katabunko has two floors. Although the space isn't large, it still houses classrooms for lower, middle and upper grades, plus a gymnasium. This wooden Japanese-style building exudes a nostalgic atmosphere, with display cases showing books and school supplies from the era, letting visitors wander at leisure and slowly capture those lovely moments.

Stationery and school supplies from the era on display

You're free to flip through these old textbooks

The sunlight streaming in creates beautiful light and shadow

Group photos of the whole school from each year hang on the wall

The second floor holds the two classrooms for middle and upper grades

It feels like time has stopped

On the other side of the ground-floor classrooms are the gymnasium and restrooms. The gym is small and even has a stage — it looks just like the kind of Japanese elementary school scene you'd see in a J-drama or anime.



Standing inside, it feels like passing through a time tunnel, and you can sense what a rural Japanese elementary school was once like. The lush green forest surrounding it adds a layer of tranquility and grace, making this school in the woods all the more charming.

---

I stumbled across Omoide no Katabunko while searching online, and found that quite a few people had visited, all saying the interior is full of nostalgia and very photogenic. The site isn't big overall — taking it slowly, you can see everything in under half an hour — but it's very well preserved and thoughtfully arranged. If you're visiting Lake Tazawa, it's worth setting aside an hour to swing by and explore this old Japanese elementary school.

title.$t: 秋田住宿 | 田澤湖住宿 | 天然温泉 田沢湖レイクリゾート 田澤湖溫泉度假酒店 Tazawako Lake Resort & Onsen | 日式溫泉旅館 | 寵物友善客房

content.$t:
這次有計畫要到田澤湖與角館附近走走，又不想拉車跑太遠回到盛岡住宿，因此想選擇在田澤湖附近的住宿。不過因為這天是假日週六，這附近的住房也是蠻熱門的，最後選擇了這間田澤湖溫泉度假酒店。

📜  資訊

  • 入住日期：2024-04-06 (六)
  • 入住房型：日式客房
  • 付款方式：可刷卡
  • 飯店地址：Shimotakano-82-117 Tazawako Obonai, Semboku, Akita 014-1201
  • 聯絡電話：+81187462016
  • 訂房網站：https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/morinikaze-tazawako.zh-tw.html
  • 官方網站：https://tazawako-lakeresort.com/

📍 地點位置

田澤湖溫泉度假酒店並不是位於田澤湖湖畔的旅館，他距離田澤湖大約還有 3 公里的距離，如果入住這間飯店，想要到田澤湖走走還是需要開車比較方便。

田澤湖溫泉度假酒店的停車空間相當多，不用擔心沒有車位

不過要來到田澤湖溫泉度假酒店，應該只有自駕或是包車比較方便了，如果要搭乘大眾交通工具，可以從田澤湖車站轉乘公車，但是不如湖畔邊的飯店這麼方便，公車站牌只有在外面的路上，還需要步行約一公里才能到飯店。

🏢 飯店環境

一進入飯店，就可以看到稍微挑高且明亮的大廳，前方就是辦理入住的接待櫃檯，而飯店總共有兩個館，本館與別館，日式的客房都在別館，本館都是西式客房。

不同的是，本館與別館雖然分開，但它們是連通的，不用擔心還需要走到戶外才能到，只需簡單穿過通道即可輕鬆抵達目的地。

房間內的介紹有著整個飯店的地圖

🛏  房間環境

田澤湖溫泉度假酒店有各種不同的房型，除了一般的西式客房、日式客房之外，比較特別的是，也有可以與寵物一起入住的寵物客房。

這次我們入住的房型是日式客房，位在別館，日式客房空間非常的大，有 41 平方米，如同傳統日式溫泉旅館一般是榻榻米的地板，只是並不是日式鋪床，而是床墊的形式，房內雖然明顯感覺得出年代感，但乾淨度維持的還算不錯。

衛浴廁所區域

衣櫃裡有提籃，方便去大浴池溫泉時候使用


冰箱、快煮壺、加濕器等等的室內設備

房間空間真的很大，除了床之外，還有一個小茶几搭配日式的座椅，如果不習慣，也有窗邊的桌椅可以使用，可以在這裡吃吃宵夜，或是小酌一杯。且房間內有著衛浴空間，如果沒有要去大浴池，在房間內也可以洗澡。(之前在日光住到的溫泉旅館房內就沒有衛浴)


房內的備品

進門時有發現鞋櫃上有一卷膠帶，一開始不知道是什麼用途，後來看到介紹&聽到別人說，才知道原來是因為飯店位於郊區，常常有機會會有蟲跑進房間，膠帶是給你拿來黏蟲的，的確入住有在房內看到一隻蟲。

🏢 飯店設施

販賣部

由於是定位在渡假溫泉酒店，飯店內的設施其實算蠻多的，除了溫泉大浴池之外，還有桌球、撞球，甚至漫畫閱讀空間，讓入住的客人可以好好在飯店內享受與放鬆。

溫泉大浴池

開放時間：

  • 早上 5:00~9:00
  • 晚上 15:00~24:00

溫泉大浴池的部分在一樓，記得可以先來櫃檯旁的浴衣區，挑選一件自己喜歡的浴衣，這裡種類蠻多的，也有分不同的 size，也有提供小朋友 size 的浴衣。


後面也有不同 size 可以套套看大小

溫泉浴池如同日本大多數的溫泉一般是有分男女的裸湯，除了盥洗區、室內池之外，也有戶外的露天溫泉池，每天早上每天早上男女浴池也會交換，讓大家可以泡到不一樣的戶外景色。

from 官網：https://tazawako-lakeresort.com/facilities

from 官網：https://tazawako-lakeresort.com/facilities

兒童遊戲區

位於本館通往別館的通道，有著很小很小一區的兒童遊戲區，這裡是開放空間，所以應該是 24 小時都可以使用的空間。

販賣部

位於接待櫃台正對面有一小區販賣部，這裡販售各類的伴手禮、衣服、紀念品與酒類，可以在可以買到許多清酒、或是在地的啤酒。

營業時間：7:00~21:00

交誼空間

位於本館 1F 有一個備有吸菸室的交誼空間，這裡有免費的飲料、咖啡，也有許多販售飲料與酒類的販賣機。

開放時間：24 hr



遊戲空間

位於本館另一側 2 樓有一個多功能的空間，這裡有著桌球、撞球、許多遊戲機台，還有一間漫畫閱讀室可以使用。桌球與撞球如果要使用是要收費的，需要去櫃檯租借器具。

開放時間：10:00~22:00


充足且都蠻新的漫畫 (2,300 本)，但是都是日文

面向同一側很像在上課的漫畫閱讀室

🍽️ 晚餐與早餐

早餐與晚餐都是為在別館 1 樓的餐廳 - 「碧(あお) 423」，都是採取自助餐的形式，有蠻多日式的餐點。座位有分一般開放式座位、需要脫鞋的榻榻米日式座位區，與最後方的幾間包廂。

  • 早餐時間：7:00~9:00
  • 晚餐時間：17:30~21:00 (有分流 17:30 / 19:30 入場)

開放式座位區

需要脫鞋的榻榻米日式座位區

晚餐


牛排鐵板燒還行

晚餐的口味就普普通通，不過選項與菜色蠻多的，許多網誌寫到的松葉蟹吃到飽與石狩鍋表演都沒有了，酒類的部分也是需要另外收費。


酒類的價格

早餐


早餐也是普通，西式的餐點比較少，有蠻多日式的選擇可以試試。


----

出發前有稍微搜尋一下網路上許多網誌的評價都不錯，不過整體來說，假日入住偏貴，一間房大約是七千台幣左右，旅館偏老舊有年代感，不過不會不乾淨，只是主要覺得床墊睡起來沒那麼舒服，再加上枕頭超小，與老舊冷氣機很吵，這間晚上其實並沒有睡得很好。

不過如果來到田澤湖附近，想體驗一下傳統日式溫泉旅館與大浴池，可以考慮看看。

title.$t: Akita Accommodation | Lake Tazawa Stay | Tazawako Lake Resort & Onsen | Japanese-Style Hot Spring Ryokan | Pet-Friendly Rooms

content.$t:
This time we planned to explore the Lake Tazawa and Kakunodate area, and didn't want to drive all the way back to Morioka to spend the night, so we decided to look for accommodation near Lake Tazawa. However, since this was a Saturday, rooms in the area were quite in demand, and in the end we chose Tazawako Lake Resort & Onsen.

📜  Information

  • Check-in date: 2024-04-06 (Sat)
  • Room type: Japanese-style room
  • Payment: Credit cards accepted
  • Address: Shimotakano-82-117 Tazawako Obonai, Semboku, Akita 014-1201
  • Phone: +81187462016
  • Booking site：https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/morinikaze-tazawako.zh-tw.html
  • Official website：https://tazawako-lakeresort.com/

📍 Location

Tazawako Lake Resort & Onsen is not a lakeside hotel — it's about 3 km away from Lake Tazawa, so if you stay here and want to visit the lake, having a car is much more convenient.

There's plenty of parking at Tazawako Lake Resort & Onsen, so no need to worry about finding a space

Getting here is really only convenient by self-drive or private charter. If you rely on public transport, you can transfer to a bus from Tazawako Station, but it isn't as convenient as the lakeside hotels — the bus stop is out on the main road, and you'd still need to walk about a kilometre to reach the hotel.

🏢 Hotel Environment

As soon as you step inside, you see a bright lobby with a slightly raised ceiling, with the check-in reception desk right in front. The hotel has two wings: the Main Building and the Annex. All the Japanese-style rooms are in the Annex, while the Main Building has Western-style rooms.

Although the two buildings are separate, they're connected indoors, so you don't have to step outside — just walk through a passageway to get where you're going.

The in-room guide includes a map of the whole hotel

🛏  The Room

Tazawako Lake Resort & Onsen offers a variety of room types. Besides the usual Western- and Japanese-style rooms, it also has something rather special: pet-friendly rooms where you can stay with your furry companion.

We stayed in a Japanese-style room in the Annex. The room is very spacious at 41 square metres, with tatami flooring just like a traditional Japanese hot spring ryokan — except instead of futons laid out on the floor, there are proper mattresses. The room clearly shows its age, but it's kept reasonably clean.

The bathroom and toilet area

There's a basket in the wardrobe, handy for trips to the large communal bath


In-room amenities such as a fridge, electric kettle and humidifier

The room really is spacious: besides the beds, there's a low table with Japanese-style floor seating, and if that's not your thing, there's also a table and chairs by the window where you can enjoy a late-night snack or a drink. The room has its own bathroom too, so if you don't feel like going to the big communal bath, you can shower in your room. (The hot spring ryokan we stayed at in Nikko previously had no en-suite bathroom.)


In-room toiletries and amenities

On arriving we noticed a roll of tape on the shoe cabinet and had no idea what it was for. Later, after reading the guide and hearing from others, we learned that because the hotel is out in the countryside, insects often get into the rooms — the tape is for catching them. Sure enough, we did spot a bug in the room during our stay.

🏢 Hotel Facilities

The shop

As a hot spring resort hotel, it has quite a lot of facilities. Besides the large hot spring baths, there's table tennis, billiards and even a manga reading room, so guests can relax and enjoy themselves without leaving the property.

Large Hot Spring Baths

Opening hours:

  • Morning 5:00–9:00
  • Evening 15:00–24:00

The large hot spring baths are on the first floor. Remember to stop by the yukata corner next to the reception desk first and pick out a yukata you like — there's a good range of designs and sizes, including children's sizes.


There are different sizes at the back so you can try them on for fit

Like most hot springs in Japan, the baths are nude and separated by gender. Besides the washing area and indoor pools, there are also outdoor open-air baths, and the men's and women's baths are swapped each morning so everyone gets to enjoy a different outdoor view.

from the official site：https://tazawako-lakeresort.com/facilities

from the official site：https://tazawako-lakeresort.com/facilities

Kids' Play Area

In the passageway linking the Main Building to the Annex there's a very, very small kids' play area. It's an open space, so it's presumably accessible 24 hours a day.

The Shop

Directly opposite the reception desk is a small shop selling all kinds of souvenirs, clothing, gifts and alcohol — you can pick up plenty of sake or local beers here.

Opening hours: 7:00–21:00

Lounge Area

On the 1F of the Main Building there's a lounge area with a smoking room. Free drinks and coffee are available here, along with plenty of vending machines selling drinks and alcohol.

Open: 24 hr



Games Area

On the 2nd floor at the other end of the Main Building there's a multi-purpose space with table tennis, billiards, plenty of arcade machines and a manga reading room. Table tennis and billiards are chargeable — you need to rent the equipment at the front desk.

Opening hours: 10:00–22:00


A good selection of fairly new manga (2,300 volumes) — all in Japanese, though

The manga reading room, with all the seats facing one way like a classroom

🍽️ Dinner and Breakfast

Both breakfast and dinner are served at "Ao 423" (碧/あお 423), the restaurant on the 1st floor of the Annex. Both are buffet-style with plenty of Japanese dishes. Seating includes regular open seating, a shoes-off tatami Japanese seating area, and a few private rooms at the very back.

  • Breakfast: 7:00–9:00
  • Dinner: 17:30–21:00 (staggered entry at 17:30 / 19:30)

The open seating area

The shoes-off tatami Japanese seating area

Dinner


The teppanyaki steak was decent

Dinner was fairly average in taste, though there was a good range of options and dishes. The all-you-can-eat snow crab and the Ishikari hotpot show that many blogs mention are no longer offered, and alcohol costs extra.


Drinks price list

Breakfast


Breakfast was also just average. There aren't many Western items, but there's a good range of Japanese dishes worth trying.


----

Before the trip I'd browsed a number of blogs and the reviews were mostly positive. Overall, though, staying on a weekend is on the pricey side — around NT$7,000 per room. The hotel is somewhat dated, though not unclean; my main issue was that the mattress wasn't especially comfortable, the pillows were tiny, and the old air-conditioning unit was very noisy, so I didn't sleep particularly well that night.

Still, if you're in the Lake Tazawa area and want to experience a traditional Japanese hot spring ryokan and its large communal baths, it's worth considering.

title.$t: 仙台住宿 | 仙台一番町大和 Roynet 飯店 Daiwa Roynet Hotel Sendai Ichibancho PREMIER | 地點熱鬧方便 | 房間內還有按摩椅

content.$t:
舒適寬敞的大廳

來到仙台的第一天，我們選擇了入住連鎖的 Daiwa Roynet 位於廣瀨通附近的飯店，這區熱鬧方便，附近有非常多的餐廳，距離仙台車站也只需要沿著商店街，步行約 10~15 分鐘就可以抵達了，整體來說地點蠻不錯的。

📜  資訊

  • 入住日期：2024-04-05 (五)
  • 入住房型：放鬆雙人房
  • 付款方式：可刷卡
  • 飯店地址：4 Chome-2-2 Ichibancho, Aoba Ward, Sendai, Miyagi 980-0811
  • 聯絡電話：+81227967685
  • 訂房網站：https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/daiwa-roynet-sendai-ichibanchou.zh-tw.html

📍 地點位置

飯店位於廣瀨通，從廣瀨通車站的西出口5出來，直接就可以看到飯店了。除非附近很多餐廳很熱鬧之外，飯店樓下直接就是一間 Lawson，如果需要採買什麼零食、或是早餐都很方便。

🏢 飯店環境

仙台一番町大和 Roynet 飯店比較屬於商務類型，除了生活上會用到的洗衣機、自動販賣機，或是微波爐之外，就沒有其他的設施了。

飯店的一樓是一間有對外營業的餐廳，如果有加價早餐也是在樓下用餐。

接待大廳位於二樓，有一個蠻寬敞的空間，可以在這裡稍作休息，但二樓的休息空間是不能飲食的，如果有購買什麼宵夜或是零嘴都還是只能回到自己的房間才能食用。

接待櫃檯

櫃檯旁也有兩台自助報到的機器

免費取用的咖啡機 (咖啡超級苦)

現在因為因應環保，飯店都不會主動提供備品，改成放在大廳讓有需要的人自由取用。這間飯店準備的除了一般備品之外，還有很多化妝品、蒸氣眼罩、漱口水，以及各種不同的泡澡入浴劑，還是第一次看到這麼豐富的，應有盡有。

各種豐富的備品

各種入浴劑

🛏  房間環境

這次入住的房間是放鬆雙人房(官網上的翻譯)，每層樓似乎只有這麼一間，很不錯的是房間裡面就裡面備有一個按摩椅可以使用，非常適合常常在日本旅遊走很多路之後，回到房間可以使用按摩椅放鬆！


房間內整體的空間相較於日本很多飯店，其實空間算蠻夠的，兩個 24~26吋大的行李箱，在房間內攤開也沒有什麼問題，不會太過於擁擠。

靠近們口附近還有一塊可以攤開行李箱的空間

電視與書桌區域

各種電棒燙的備品

茶包就普普通通

浴室的空間也蠻大的，有一個單人泡澡的浴缸，可以使用在大廳拿到的入浴劑。而衛浴空間和洗手台與廁所中間也還有用個玻璃門隔起來。




---

整體來說，這間飯店住宿體驗還蠻不錯，床軟硬度適中好睡之外，隔音也蠻好的，房間內的按摩椅實在很適合每天走很多路的遊客，再加上地點很方便，不論是透過地鐵移動，或是要找在附近餐廳都很方便。

title.$t: Sendai Hotel | Daiwa Roynet Hotel Sendai Ichibancho PREMIER | Lively, Convenient Location | Massage Chair in the Room

content.$t:
A comfortable, spacious lobby

On our first day in Sendai, we chose to stay at the Daiwa Roynet chain hotel near Hirosedori. The area is lively and convenient, with plenty of restaurants nearby, and Sendai Station is only about a 10–15 minute walk away along the shopping arcade. Overall, the location is pretty great.

📜  Information

  • Stay date: 2024-04-05 (Fri)
  • Room type: Relax Double Room
  • Payment: Credit cards accepted
  • Address: 4 Chome-2-2 Ichibancho, Aoba Ward, Sendai, Miyagi 980-0811
  • Phone: +81227967685
  • Booking site：https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/daiwa-roynet-sendai-ichibanchou.zh-tw.html

📍 Location

The hotel is on Hirosedori; come out of West Exit 5 of Hirosedori Station and you'll see it right away. Besides the many restaurants and the lively atmosphere nearby, there's a Lawson right downstairs, which makes it super easy to grab snacks or breakfast.

🏢 Hotel Facilities

Daiwa Roynet Hotel Sendai Ichibancho is more of a business hotel. Apart from everyday conveniences such as washing machines, vending machines and a microwave, there aren't any other facilities.

On the first floor there's a restaurant that's also open to the public; if you add breakfast to your booking, it's served downstairs as well.

The reception lobby is on the second floor and offers a fairly spacious area where you can take a short break, but eating and drinking aren't allowed in that second-floor lounge, so any late-night snacks or treats you buy have to be eaten back in your own room.

The reception desk

There are also two self check-in machines beside the front desk

A free-to-use coffee machine (the coffee is super bitter)

These days, for environmental reasons, hotels no longer hand out amenities automatically; instead they're placed in the lobby for guests to take as needed. Besides the usual items, this hotel offers plenty of cosmetics, steam eye masks, mouthwash and all sorts of bath salts — it's the first time I've seen such a rich selection with everything you could want.

An abundant range of amenities

All kinds of bath salts

🛏  The Room

We stayed in the Relax Double Room (the official site's translation), and it seems there's only one such room per floor. The best part is that the room comes with a massage chair — perfect for travellers in Japan who walk a lot all day and want to unwind back in the room!


Compared with many hotels in Japan, the room is actually quite roomy. Two 24–26 inch suitcases can be opened up in the room without any problem, and it doesn't feel cramped.

There's also space near the entrance to open up your suitcase

The TV and desk area

Various hair-styling tools provided

The tea bags were just so-so

The bathroom is also quite spacious, with a single-person soaking tub where you can use the bath salts you picked up in the lobby. The bathing area is separated from the sink and toilet by a glass door.




---

Overall, the stay here was a pretty good experience: the bed was just the right firmness and comfortable to sleep on, the soundproofing was good, and the in-room massage chair is perfect for travellers who walk a lot every day. Add in the convenient location — easy for getting around by subway or finding restaurants nearby — and it's a solid choice.

title.$t: 日月潭住宿 | 日月潭大飯店 Sun Moon Lake Hotel | 湖景第一排連結環湖自行車道 | 景觀湖景泡湯池 | 雅緻湖景套房

content.$t:
來到了日月潭，挑選住宿的時候往往都會希望可以面對湖景，從房間內就可以享受美麗的日月潭湖景。而日月潭大飯店就不僅直接位於湖景第一排，門口也直接連結環湖自行車道，只要下樓就可以直達被稱為全球十大最美自行車道的日月潭環湖自行車道。

📜  資訊

  • 入住日期：2024-01-13 (六)
  • 入住房型：雅緻湖景套房 (15 坪)
  • 住宿價格：$9,900
  • 付款方式：可刷卡，可打統編
  • 飯店地址：555南投縣魚池鄉中山路419號
  • 聯絡電話：0492855511
  • 官方網站：http://www.smlh.com.tw/

📍 地點位置

位於環湖的中山路上的正門

日月潭大飯店有兩個出入口，一個位於環湖的中山路上，另一個出入口與環湖腳踏車道連接，如果要辦理入住都會是從正門入內，停車場也是在環湖中山路上。

自行開車/停車場


由於日月潭大飯店並沒有自己的地下室內停車場，停車場都是在飯店外的戶外停車場，且因為腹地不大，有數個停車場都可以停。如果開車前來，飯店門口的接待人員會直接引導你到還有車位的停車場，停車場都不遠，也可以先下行李在門口，再去停車。

大眾運輸

主要以台灣好行-日月潭線為主，可以直接搭到水社碼頭。

時刻表：http://www.ntbus.com.tw/tour-sml.html

飯店接駁車

日月潭大飯店提供從飯店到水社碼頭的免費接駁車，約一個小時一般，需半小時前提前預約。

時刻表：http://www.smlh.com.tw/location/index.php?index_id=23

🏢 飯店環境與設施

接待大廳

日月潭大飯店雖然已經是有年代的飯店了，不過維持的還算不錯，整體環境明亮整潔。最大賣點就是 B2 餐廳外與環湖自行車道直接連結，且提供入住旅客可以免費騎乘自行車，可以在 B2 這裡自由取用。


而室內的設施都位在地下室 B3 的區域，這裡有蠻多不同的設施可以使用，有投籃機、冰球機、手足球機、桌球、撞球、SWITCH遊戲室、PS4遊戲室、兒童遊戲區等等。

🛏  房間環境


房間分為湖景與山景，這次入住的是雅緻湖景套房，房間內的空間非常的大，整體是走一個木質的風格，房間與客廳都是使用深色的木地板，但房間內的燈光偏暗。


床的部分也非常的大，是兩個單人床大小加起來的 King Size，軟硬度也適中，睡起來算是蠻舒適的。


寬廣的客廳空間與書桌


床頭有一個智慧音箱


備品的部分有著濾掛咖啡、日月潭紅茶，與小餅乾


廁所與衛浴空間也很大，有乾濕分離，還有一個非常大的泡澡池，白天的時候可以邊泡澡邊欣賞日月潭的湖景。





不過浴室的部分有明顯感覺飯店的年代感，稍微都有點偏舊且有些長年的水漬。


而客廳外面還有一個小陽台，可以直接面對湖景，早晨的時候這裡是面向東方，可以直接在房間內就可以看到日出。

陽台看出去的湖景

🍽️ 早餐與晚餐


早餐與晚餐都是在 B2 的餐廳用餐，由於之前入住的經驗，日月潭附近其實沒什麼特別好吃的東西，晚上店家也不算多，這次就直接選的日月潭大飯店的晚餐($800/人)，不過真的是一個錯誤的選擇。

日月潭大飯店的晚餐是自助餐的形式，除了菜色沒有很多之外，口味真的不是很好吃... 一個人 $800 原這價格真的是完全不行，如果有入住的人千萬不要選擇。


早餐的話就普普通通，不至於到前一天晚餐那麼的可怕...




---
涵碧樓前的蔣公碼頭

整體住起來的體驗覺得還好，除了房間真的很大之外，設施稍微也都有年代了。雖然是假日入住，但一晚近萬元的這種住宿品質，真心覺得不是很值得，尤其加價的晚餐品質真的是無法接受。

title.$t: Sun Moon Lake Accommodation | Sun Moon Lake Hotel | Front-Row Lake Views Connected to the Round-the-Lake Cycling Path | Lake-View Soaking Tub | Elegant Lake View Suite

content.$t:
When visiting Sun Moon Lake, most people hope to find a room facing the lake so they can enjoy the beautiful scenery right from inside. Sun Moon Lake Hotel is not only located in the front row facing the lake — its entrance also connects directly to the round-the-lake cycling path, so you only have to head downstairs to reach what has been called one of the ten most beautiful bike paths in the world.

📜  Information

  • Stay date: 2024-01-13 (Sat)
  • Room type: Elegant Lake View Suite (15 ping)
  • Price: $9,900
  • Payment: Credit cards accepted, company tax ID invoices available
  • Address: No. 419, Zhongshan Rd., Yuchi Township, Nantou County 555
  • Phone: 0492855511
  • Official website: http://www.smlh.com.tw/

📍 Location

The main entrance on Zhongshan Road, which circles the lake

Sun Moon Lake Hotel has two entrances: one on Zhongshan Road around the lake, and another connecting to the round-the-lake bike path. Check-in is done through the main entrance, and the parking lots are also along Zhongshan Road.

Driving / Parking


Since Sun Moon Lake Hotel doesn't have its own underground parking garage, all parking is in outdoor lots outside the hotel. Because the grounds are small, there are several lots you can use. If you arrive by car, the greeters at the entrance will direct you to a lot with available spaces — none are far away — and you can drop off your luggage at the entrance first before parking.

Public Transportation

Mainly the Taiwan Tourist Shuttle – Sun Moon Lake Route, which takes you directly to Shuishe Pier.

Timetable: http://www.ntbus.com.tw/tour-sml.html

Hotel Shuttle

Sun Moon Lake Hotel offers a free shuttle between the hotel and Shuishe Pier, running roughly once an hour; reservations must be made at least half an hour in advance.

Timetable: http://www.smlh.com.tw/location/index.php?index_id=23

🏢 Hotel Environment & Facilities

The lobby

Although Sun Moon Lake Hotel is a fairly old property, it has been maintained reasonably well, and the overall environment is bright and clean. Its biggest selling point is that the area outside the B2 restaurant connects directly to the round-the-lake bike path, and guests can borrow bicycles for free, available to take on B2.


The indoor facilities are all located on B3, where there's quite a variety to enjoy: a basketball shooting machine, air hockey, foosball, table tennis, billiards, a Switch game room, a PS4 game room, a kids' play area, and more.

🛏  The Room


Rooms come in lake-view and mountain-view types. This time we stayed in the Elegant Lake View Suite, which is very spacious with an overall wood-toned style — both the bedroom and living room have dark wood flooring — though the lighting in the room is on the dim side.


The bed is also very large — a King size made from two single beds put together — with a moderate firmness that makes for a fairly comfortable sleep.


The spacious living room and desk


There's a smart speaker by the bedside


In-room amenities include drip coffee bags, Sun Moon Lake black tea, and cookies


The bathroom is also very large, with wet and dry areas separated, plus a very big soaking tub — during the day you can soak while taking in the Sun Moon Lake scenery.





That said, the bathroom clearly shows the hotel's age — things are a bit dated, with some long-standing water stains.


Outside the living room there's also a small balcony facing the lake. It faces east, so in the morning you can watch the sunrise right from your room.

The lake view from the balcony

🍽️ Breakfast & Dinner


Both breakfast and dinner are served at the restaurant on B2. From past visits, there isn't really anything particularly tasty around Sun Moon Lake, and there aren't many places open in the evening, so this time we went straight for the hotel's dinner ($800/person) — which turned out to be a mistake.

Dinner at Sun Moon Lake Hotel is buffet style. Not only was the selection limited, the food really didn't taste good... At $800 per person, it's simply not acceptable. If you're staying here, definitely don't choose it.


Breakfast was just okay — at least not as terrible as the previous night's dinner...




---
Chiang Kai-shek Pier in front of The Lalu

Overall, the stay was just so-so. Apart from the genuinely spacious room, the facilities are showing their age. Even though we stayed on a weekend, for nearly NT$10,000 a night this quality really doesn't feel worth it — especially the add-on dinner, which was truly unacceptable.

title.$t: 關西自由行 | 大阪住宿 | 大阪東急卓越大酒店 Osaka Excel Hotel Tokyu | 本町與心齋橋站附近 | 飯店新穎且空間大

content.$t:
年底入住，遇到飯店前路上的年度點燈

大阪東急卓越大酒店 Osaka Excel Hotel Tokyu 是在剛好疫情前， 2019 年底才開幕的一間新飯店，相對起來算蠻新的飯店，實際入住後發現整體也維持的不錯，都還是蠻新的。

而這次會選擇這間飯店，主要是在找尋大阪住宿的時候，差不多價位的幾間飯店裡，發現這家房間的空間最大，而且是比其他間大了不少，所以最後才選擇入住這間飯店。

📜  資訊

  • 付款方式：可刷卡
  • 入住房型：高級雙人房
  • 入住價格：¥36,120 (周四週五兩晚，含早餐)
  • 飯店地址：4 Chome-1-15 Kyutaromachi, Chuo Ward, Osaka, 541-0056
  • 聯絡電話：+81662520109
  • 訂房網站：https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/osaka-excel-hotel-tokyu.zh-tw.html

📍 地點位置

一出本町站就可以看到飯店的建築

大阪東急卓越大酒店離地鐵站「本町」很近，從地鐵站出口到飯店門口大概也只需要步行 2 分鐘就可以抵達，而本町站又是一個很方便的站，離逛街熱區「心齋橋」只有一站的距離，交通樞紐大阪難波也只有兩站的距離，若是要到大阪站，也不需要轉車。

飯店這棟建築的一樓有星巴克與一間甜點店 (FRUiT hanafru)，附近也有一間全家與一間7-11，後方是難波別院（南御堂），而比較特別的是這棟建築還特別建立成拱門的形狀，在前方就可以直接看到難波別院。

難波別院（南御堂）

🏢 飯店環境

Osaka Excel Hotel Tokyu 的飯店大廳位於 16 樓，除了 2~4 樓是對外營業的餐廳之外，從 16 樓往下都是房間，而 17 樓是早餐用餐的餐廳與會議室。

要辦理住宿，必須從側邊的入口，直接搭乘電梯到 16 樓抵達飯店大廳，而要到入住的房間也必須要再從 16 樓轉電梯才能抵達喔，這點會有一點點的麻煩。


飯店大廳

電梯一抵達16樓，印入眼簾的是明亮的整排落地窗，與寬廣的大廳。16 樓整層樓都是大廳的空間，除了接待櫃檯、交誼區之外，大廳酒吧也在這裡。



開放空間一樣有著大片的景觀玻璃窗

大廳區域不只空間開闊，採光也非常的好，白天的時候在這裡可以舒適地觀賞街景，夜晚十分也是一個看夜景的好地方！

大廳酒吧 MIDO

在大廳的一邊，有著大廳酒吧 MIDO，酒吧內空間不大且位置不多，屬於與大廳融為一起的開放式空間。在這裡可以一邊欣賞城市夜景一邊喝上一杯，應該是蠻舒適的體驗。這次在大阪去了外面的酒吧 (大阪酒吧：CRAFTROOM)，回來的時候大廳酒吧已準備打烊，就沒機會在這裡喝上一杯了。


大廳酒吧的酒單，價格也不貴

🛏  房間環境

相較於一般的日本旅館來說，Osaka Excel Hotel Tokyu 的房間是真的有比較大不少，大型行李箱兩三個都可以完全攤平在地板上的空間，不像其他日本旅館住起來就會有一點壓迫的感覺，房間空間大小蠻不錯的。


洗手台是在外面，廁所與浴室分開兩間作乾濕分離，基本的備品都很齊全，光是杯子就給了六個，除了快煮壺外也有附上一個冰桶，方便晚上在飯店想小酌一杯可以去裝點冰塊。

不過洗手台的設計不太好，水龍頭與洗手台的距離有點遠，所以每次開關水都一定會把檯面弄濕，而且會愈來越濕。

備品有附一包入浴劑

電視大小適中，前方有個書桌

採光不錯，窗戶外是街景

浴室與廁所是分開的，但是浴室的缺點就是，內部沒有任何可以掛毛巾或是放置衣服的架子，必須要打開門放在外面的衣架，這個設計其實蠻不方便的，尤其在天氣冷的時候。




🏢 飯店設施

飯店內的設施其實也簡簡單單，除了大廳酒吧之外，就只有健身房與吃早餐的餐廳而已了。

健身房

健身房非常的陽春

早餐餐廳


早餐的餐廳位於最高樓層 17 樓，可以從大廳走樓梯上去，或是直接從內部電梯抵達 17 樓也可以喔。早餐用餐的環境一樣有著大片落地窗，除了採光景色很好之外，整體的空間也是很寬廣舒適的。




早餐菜色的部分，種類與數量蠻多的，而且除了一般飯店常出現的西式早餐之外，有著許多日式的食物，像是串炸、章魚燒、玉子燒，或是許多的漬物，也有烏龍麵與味增湯可以取用，整體很豐盛而且口味也不錯，搭配舒適的環境，體驗蠻好的。





床頭很有設計的吊燈

這次居住的體驗還算蠻不錯的，除了浴室與洗手台設計不是很好之外，櫃檯接待順暢、房間舒適度，還有不錯的早餐，再加上地點方便，整體來說算是不錯的體驗，如果入住大阪是個可以推薦的住宿之一。

房間內白天的採光

title.$t: Kansai Independent Travel | Osaka Accommodation | Osaka Excel Hotel Tokyu | Near Hommachi and Shinsaibashi Stations | Brand-New Hotel with Spacious Rooms

content.$t:
We stayed at the end of the year and caught the annual illumination on the street in front of the hotel

The Osaka Excel Hotel Tokyu is a new hotel that opened at the end of 2019, just before the pandemic, so it's still relatively new. After actually staying here, we found that the property has been well maintained and everything still feels quite fresh.

The main reason we chose this hotel is that, while searching for accommodation in Osaka, we found that among the several hotels in a similar price range, this one had the largest rooms — and by a considerable margin — so in the end we decided to stay here.

📜  Information

  • Payment: credit cards accepted
  • Room type: Superior Double Room
  • Price: ¥36,120 (two nights, Thursday and Friday, breakfast included)
  • Address: 4 Chome-1-15 Kyutaromachi, Chuo Ward, Osaka, 541-0056
  • Phone: +81662520109
  • Booking site: https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/osaka-excel-hotel-tokyu.zh-tw.html

📍 Location

The hotel building is visible as soon as you exit Hommachi Station

Osaka Excel Hotel Tokyu is very close to Hommachi subway station — only about a 2-minute walk from the station exit to the hotel entrance. Hommachi is also a very convenient station: it's just one stop from the shopping hotspot Shinsaibashi and two stops from the transport hub Osaka Namba, and you can reach Osaka Station without changing trains.

On the ground floor of the building there is a Starbucks and a dessert shop (FRUiT hanafru), and nearby there's a FamilyMart and a 7-Eleven. Behind the hotel is Namba Betsuin (Minami Mido) temple. What's particularly distinctive is that the building was designed in the shape of an archway, so you can see Namba Betsuin straight through from the front.

Namba Betsuin (Minami Mido)

🏢 The Hotel

The lobby of Osaka Excel Hotel Tokyu is on the 16th floor. Apart from floors 2 to 4, which house restaurants open to the public, everything below the 16th floor is guest rooms, while the 17th floor holds the breakfast restaurant and meeting rooms.

To check in you have to use the side entrance and take the elevator directly up to the lobby on the 16th floor, and then transfer to another elevator on the 16th floor to get to your room — which is slightly inconvenient.


The Lobby

The moment the elevator reaches the 16th floor, you're greeted by a bright row of floor-to-ceiling windows and a spacious lobby. The entire 16th floor is lobby space — besides the reception desk and lounge area, the lobby bar is here too.



The open area also has large panoramic windows

The lobby area isn't just spacious — the natural light is excellent too. During the day you can comfortably take in the street views from here, and at night it's a great spot for the city lights!

Lobby Bar MIDO

On one side of the lobby is the lobby bar MIDO. The bar isn't large and has only a few seats — it's an open space that blends right into the lobby. Enjoying a drink here while taking in the night view of the city would be a pretty comfortable experience. This time in Osaka we went out to a bar (Osaka bar: CRAFTROOM), and by the time we got back the lobby bar was already closing, so we never got the chance for a drink here.


The lobby bar's drink menu — prices are reasonable too

🛏  The Room

Compared with typical Japanese hotels, the rooms at Osaka Excel Hotel Tokyu really are noticeably larger — there's enough floor space to lay two or three large suitcases completely flat. It doesn't feel cramped the way many Japanese hotels do; the room size is very good.


The washbasin is outside, and the toilet and bathroom are in two separate rooms for a proper wet/dry separation. The basic amenities are all there — they even provide six cups — and besides the electric kettle there's an ice bucket, handy for grabbing some ice if you fancy a nightcap in the room.

The washbasin design isn't great though: the faucet is a bit far from the basin, so every time you turn the water on or off you inevitably splash the counter, and it just gets wetter and wetter.

The amenities include a packet of bath salts

The TV is a good size, with a desk in front of it

Good natural light, with street views out the window

The bathroom and toilet are separate, but the downside of the bathroom is that there's no rack inside at all for hanging towels or placing clothes — you have to open the door and put them on the hanger outside. That design is really inconvenient, especially in cold weather.




🏢 Hotel Facilities

The hotel's facilities are pretty simple: apart from the lobby bar, there's only a gym and the breakfast restaurant.

Gym

The gym is extremely basic

Breakfast Restaurant


The breakfast restaurant is on the top floor, the 17th. You can take the stairs up from the lobby, or use the internal elevator to reach the 17th floor. The dining area likewise has large floor-to-ceiling windows — besides the great light and views, the space overall is roomy and comfortable.




As for the breakfast spread, there's plenty of variety and quantity. Besides the Western breakfast items you usually find at hotels, there are lots of Japanese dishes such as kushikatsu, takoyaki and tamagoyaki, plus many kinds of pickles, and udon and miso soup are available too. It's a generous spread and tastes good, and paired with the comfortable setting it made for a great experience.





Stylishly designed pendant lamps by the bed

Overall this was a pretty good stay. Aside from the less-than-ideal bathroom and washbasin design, check-in at the front desk was smooth, the room was comfortable, the breakfast was good, and the location is convenient — all in all a solid experience, and one of the places I'd recommend if you're staying in Osaka.

Daytime light in the room

title.$t: 關西自由行 | 京都景點 | 錦市場 Nishiki Market | 歷史悠久的京都廚房 | 體驗當地美食與歷史氛圍 | 必吃美食與伴手禮

content.$t:
位於京都的錦市場，擁有非常久的歷史，早至平安時代在此地區就已經開始建立了市場，到了 1615 年錦市場成為江戶幕府在京都授權的三個魚類批發商之一，這就是錦市場作為成熟魚市場的開始，傳承至今。

這次住宿的地點正好就在錦市場對面 (延伸閱讀：京都四條河原町 Forza 飯店)，挑了一天中午左右的時間來這裡逛逛，吃點錦市場中的美食。

📜 資訊

  • 地址：Nakagyo Ward, Kyoto, 604-8055
  • 營業時間：店家約 9~12 點陸續營業，售完為止
  • 官方網站：https://www.kyoto-nishiki.or.jp/

📍 地點交通與店鋪地圖

位於高倉通的入口處

地點與交通

錦市場，是位於寺町通與高倉通之間的一條傳統商店街，可以搭地鐵到阪急京都線「京都河原町」站或是「烏丸」站，都步行5分鐘內就可以抵達，交通十分的便利。

錦市場地圖

from: https://www.kyoto-nishiki.or.jp/map/

🍽️ 錦市場店鋪

錦市場通常被稱為「京都的廚房」，在這裡擁有超過一百多家商店和攤位，販售各種新鮮的食材、海鮮、熟食、日本特色商品和手工藝品等，這裡是遊客和當地居民尋找美食和獨特商品的理想場所。

三木雞卵

在京都錦市場裡，田中雞卵與三木雞卵這兩家玉子燒很有名，兩間店都各有人推崇，我們這次挑了三木雞卵的玉子燒來試試看。三木雞卵創業於1938年，已有90多年歷史，其玉子燒加入錦的地下水、利尻海帶和嚴選的乾鰹魚片精心熬製的湯汁，讓玉子燒有著更豐富的香氣與口味。

  • 地址：京都市中京区錦小路通富小路西入ル東魚屋町182
  • 營業時間：
    • 平日：09:00 - 16:30
    • 假日：09:00 - 17:00
  • 定休日：無
  • 官網介紹：https://www.kyoto-nishiki.or.jp/stores/mikikeiran/


來到三木雞卵，玉子燒絕對是必吃的品項， 招牌玉子燒(だし卷) 口感綿密扎實，除了滿滿蛋香味之外，還有著高湯的香氣，自己覺得還蠻喜歡的，不過可惜就是這幾天京都天氣很冷，所以玉子燒都是冰的。(後來有看到別人介紹田中雞卵會幫你加熱)

錦魚力


錦魚力始於1919年，是一家烤魚特色餐廳，特色是主打鯛魚和海鰻，店舖前會有各種海鮮類的串燒或是炸串，可以一目了然選擇想要吃的品項。

  • 地址：京都市中京区錦小路通富小路西入ル北側
  • 營業時間：10:00 - 18:00
  • 定休日：不定休
  • 官網介紹：https://www.kyoto-nishiki.or.jp/stores/uoriki/


戌前屋

戌前屋就不是錦市場裡面的老店了，這間主打烤雞肉串與牛肉串的串燒燒烤店，於2023年春季才開幕，現在連 Google Map 都還找不到這個地標，跟上面的錦魚力在同一側，距離沒多遠的地方。

  • 地址：京都市中京区東魚屋町１７１番地
  • 營業時間： 10:00 - 19:00
  • 定休日：無
  • 官網介紹：https://www.kyoto-nishiki.or.jp/stores/inumaeya/


店內還有座位區，可以點了烤串後，在店內的座位區享用

烤串都還不錯吃，雞肉烤的很多汁，搭配醬汁整體表現是還不錯的。和牛串的肉質也很軟嫩，不過有一點小串且一串就要 ¥1,800，相較起來 CP 值低了一點。

另外，店內的油煙味有點重，如果坐在裡面吃，過沒多久身上都會沾滿烤肉味。

烤雞肉串 ¥700

烤和牛串 ¥1,800

抹茶スイーツ館 茶和々

在錦市場裡有幾家賣抹茶相關產品的專賣店，這家茶和々以宇治抹茶為主，一樓販售各式的抹茶甜點與伴手禮，二樓是咖啡廳，除了提供抹茶之外，還有蕨麻糬、凍糕、豆沙餡等等的點心。

我們由於想找一個地方休息一下，因此就選了去茶和々二樓的咖啡廳，點杯抹茶來喝喝看。

  • 地址：京都市中京區錦小路通中大屋町 498-1 高倉東入
  • 營業時間： 
    • 1F：10:00 - 18:00
    • 2F：10:30 - 17:30
  • 定休日：無
  • 官網介紹：https://www.kyoto-nishiki.or.jp/stores/sawawa/


中規中矩的抹茶

鱧秀 錦本店

2017 年營業的「鱧秀」，是以蝦料理為主，在這裡可以選擇各類的蝦子、烤蝦，裡面也有座位區，可以搭配幾款日本酒來品嚐。

  • 地址：京都市中京区中魚屋町504
  • 營業時間： 
    • 平日：11:00 - 18:00
    • 假日：10:00 - 18:00
  • 定休日：星期一
  • 官網介紹：https://www.kyoto-nishiki.or.jp/stores/hamohide/

京つけもの 西利錦店

京つけもの是一間以販售漬物為主的專門店。

  • 地址：京都市中京區錦小路高倉通西入中尾屋町 508
  • 營業時間： 09:00 - 18:00
  • 定休日：無
  • 官網介紹：https://www.kyoto-nishiki.or.jp/stores/nishiri/

こんなもんじゃ (豆乳甜甜圈)

錦市場內的這家熱門的藤野豆乳甜甜圈，大約是30年前開業，是北野天滿宮附近經營了近60年的「京都藤野」的分店，看網路上幾個介紹都說會大排長龍，且值得一試，這次兩次經過錦市場人潮都沒有到太多。

  • 地址：京都市中京區錦小路通堺町西北角
  • 營業時間： 10:00 - 18:00
  • 定休日：無
  • 官網介紹：https://www.kyoto-nishiki.or.jp/stores/konnamonja/

錦市場是一個充滿活力、色彩豐富且具有濃厚歷史氛圍的地方，很適合遊客來體驗和品味京都的文化和美食，在這裡可以找到許多當地的食物，也可以體驗濃厚京都風味的古老市場，蠻推薦可以來走一趟的。

至於市場內有哪些店，錦市場官網其實做得蠻好的，資訊內容都非常的清楚，也可以參考看看錦市場的官方網站：

https://www.kyoto-nishiki.or.jp/stores/
