title.$t: Kansai Independent Travel | Kyoto Attractions | Nishiki Market | Kyoto's Historic Kitchen | Experience Local Food and History | Must-Eat Treats and Souvenirs

content.$t:
Nishiki Market in Kyoto has a very long history. A market began to take shape in this area as early as the Heian period, and in 1615 Nishiki Market became one of the three fish wholesalers officially authorized by the Edo shogunate in Kyoto — the beginning of Nishiki as a fully fledged fish market, a tradition that continues to this day.

Our accommodation on this trip happened to be right across from Nishiki Market (Further reading: Hotel Forza Kyoto Shijo Kawaramachi), so we picked one day around noon to come and stroll around and sample some of the market's food.

📜 Information

  • Address: Nakagyo Ward, Kyoto, 604-8055
  • Opening hours: shops open gradually from around 9 a.m. to 12 p.m., until sold out
  • Official website: https://www.kyoto-nishiki.or.jp/

📍 Location, Access and Shop Map

The entrance on Takakura-dori

Location and Access

Nishiki Market is a traditional shopping street running between Teramachi-dori and Takakura-dori. You can take the subway to Kyoto-Kawaramachi Station or Karasuma Station on the Hankyu Kyoto Line; both are within a 5-minute walk, so access is very convenient.

Nishiki Market Map

from: https://www.kyoto-nishiki.or.jp/map/

🍽️ Shops in Nishiki Market

Nishiki Market is often called "Kyoto's Kitchen." There are more than one hundred shops and stalls here selling all kinds of fresh ingredients, seafood, prepared foods, Japanese specialty goods, handicrafts and more — an ideal spot for both tourists and locals to hunt for good food and unique items.

Miki Keiran

In Kyoto's Nishiki Market, two tamagoyaki shops — Tanaka Keiran and Miki Keiran — are especially famous, and both have their loyal fans. This time we chose to try Miki Keiran's tamagoyaki. Founded in 1938, Miki Keiran has more than 90 years of history. Its tamagoyaki is made with a broth carefully simmered from Nishiki's groundwater, Rishiri kombu and carefully selected dried bonito flakes, giving the omelet a richer aroma and flavor.

  • Address: 182 Higashiuoyacho, Nishikikoji-dori Tominokoji Nishi-iru, Nakagyo-ku, Kyoto
  • Opening hours:
    • Weekdays: 09:00 - 16:30
    • Weekends/holidays: 09:00 - 17:00
  • Closed: none
  • Official page: https://www.kyoto-nishiki.or.jp/stores/mikikeiran/


At Miki Keiran, tamagoyaki is an absolute must. The signature dashimaki tamago has a dense, silky texture; besides the full aroma of egg, there's also the fragrance of the dashi broth. I quite liked it. The only pity was that Kyoto was very cold during those days, so the tamagoyaki was served cold. (I later saw someone mention that Tanaka Keiran will heat it up for you.)

Nishiki Uoriki


Founded in 1919, Nishiki Uoriki is a restaurant specializing in grilled fish, with sea bream and conger eel (hamo) as its signature offerings. In front of the shop you'll find all sorts of seafood skewers, grilled or deep-fried, so you can see at a glance what you'd like to eat.

  • Address: Nishikikoji-dori Tominokoji Nishi-iru, north side, Nakagyo-ku, Kyoto
  • Opening hours: 10:00 - 18:00
  • Closed: irregular
  • Official page: https://www.kyoto-nishiki.or.jp/stores/uoriki/


Inumaeya

Inumaeya is not one of Nishiki Market's long-established shops. This yakitori-style grill specializing in chicken and beef skewers only opened in spring 2023 — it can't even be found on Google Maps yet. It's on the same side as Nishiki Uoriki above, not far away.

  • Address: 171 Higashiuoyacho, Nakagyo-ku, Kyoto
  • Opening hours: 10:00 - 19:00
  • Closed: none
  • Official page: https://www.kyoto-nishiki.or.jp/stores/inumaeya/


There's also a seating area inside, so you can order your skewers and enjoy them at a table

The skewers were pretty tasty — the chicken was grilled nice and juicy, and with the sauce the overall showing was quite good. The wagyu skewer was very tender too, though the portion was a little small and one skewer costs ¥1,800, so it's relatively poor value.

Also, the smell of cooking smoke inside is fairly strong; if you sit inside to eat, before long you'll be covered in the smell of grilled meat.

Grilled chicken skewer ¥700

Grilled wagyu skewer ¥1,800

Matcha Sweets Hall Sawawa

There are several shops in Nishiki Market specializing in matcha products. Sawawa focuses on Uji matcha: the first floor sells all kinds of matcha sweets and souvenirs, while the second floor is a café that, besides matcha, also offers warabi mochi, parfaits, sweet red bean treats and more.

Since we wanted somewhere to rest for a bit, we chose the second-floor café at Sawawa and ordered a matcha to try.

  • Address: 498-1 Nakaoyacho, Nishikikoji-dori Takakura Higashi-iru, Nakagyo-ku, Kyoto
  • Opening hours: 
    • 1F: 10:00 - 18:00
    • 2F: 10:30 - 17:30
  • Closed: none
  • Official page: https://www.kyoto-nishiki.or.jp/stores/sawawa/


A solid, by-the-book matcha

Hamohide Nishiki Main Store

Opened in 2017, "Hamohide" focuses on shrimp dishes. Here you can choose from all kinds of shrimp and grilled prawns, and there's also a seating area where you can pair them with a few varieties of sake.

  • Address: 504 Nakauoyacho, Nakagyo-ku, Kyoto
  • Opening hours: 
    • Weekdays: 11:00 - 18:00
    • Weekends/holidays: 10:00 - 18:00
  • Closed: Mondays
  • Official page: https://www.kyoto-nishiki.or.jp/stores/hamohide/

Kyo Tsukemono Nishiri Nishiki Store

Kyo Tsukemono is a specialty shop dealing mainly in Japanese pickles.

  • Address: 508 Nakaoyacho, Nishikikoji Takakura-dori Nishi-iru, Nakagyo-ku, Kyoto
  • Opening hours: 09:00 - 18:00
  • Closed: none
  • Official page: https://www.kyoto-nishiki.or.jp/stores/nishiri/

Konna Monja (soy milk doughnuts)

This popular Fujino soy milk doughnut shop in Nishiki Market opened about 30 years ago and is a branch of "Kyoto Fujino," which has been operating near Kitano Tenmangu for nearly 60 years. Several online write-ups say there are long queues and it's worth a try, though on both of our visits to Nishiki Market the crowds weren't too bad.

  • Address: Northwest corner of Nishikikoji-dori and Sakaimachi, Nakagyo-ku, Kyoto
  • Opening hours: 10:00 - 18:00
  • Closed: none
  • Official page: https://www.kyoto-nishiki.or.jp/stores/konnamonja/

Nishiki Market is a lively, colorful place steeped in history, perfect for visitors who want to experience and savor Kyoto's culture and cuisine. You can find plenty of local foods here and soak up the atmosphere of an old market full of Kyoto character — I'd definitely recommend a visit.

As for which shops are in the market, the official Nishiki Market website is actually very well made, with very clear information. You can check it out here:

https://www.kyoto-nishiki.or.jp/stores/

title.$t: 關西自由行 | 京都美食 | 小川咖啡堺町錦店 Ogawa Coffee Nishiki | 在日式庭院品嚐一杯咖啡 | 錦市場旁美食

content.$t:
小川珈琲創立於 1952 年，是京都在地老字號的咖啡店之一，起初以咖啡零售為主，後來不只日本也進軍了美國市場。而在迎接創立70周年的 2022 年，在熱鬧的錦市場附近開了這間新的店「小川珈琲 堺町錦店」，以町家風格改建，保留著古老城市的歷史韻味。

由於我們位於京都的住宿沒有選擇早餐，想在附近找一些特別或是好吃的早餐，就找了一天來小川珈琲堺町錦店吃早午餐。

📜 資訊

  • 地址：〒604-8127 Kyoto, Nakagyo Ward, Kikuyacho, 519-1
  • 營業時間：07:00–20:00
  • 線上預約：https://tabelog.com/kyoto/A2601/A260201/26037151/
  • 付款方式：可刷卡
  • 官方網站：https://www.oc-ogawa.co.jp/nishiki/

📍 地點與店內環境

小川咖啡堺町錦店位於錦市場旁，從豆乳甜甜圈的攤位旁的街道走進來就會看到了(堺町通和錦小路交界處)。店的外觀很低調，且沒有招牌，如果不是靠著 Google Map 還真的會很容易錯過找不到。

只有地板上的標誌可以辨識

店內與店外一樣走的低調簡樸的設計，以灰色為主體，水泥色的地板。入口處有一個工作吧台，這裡除了是製作咖啡的地方外，還有販售各式杯具、咖啡器具，或是也可以在這裡直接購買咖啡豆，而吧台後方式廚房區域，旁邊的座位區隔開。


進門處有沙發區，讓候位的客人等待

小川咖啡堺町錦店現在是們熱門的一家店，據說不論早餐或是下午茶時間都會需要排隊，而我們到訪的這天是平日的11點前左右，人潮也是不少，約等了一兩組後才順利入坐。其實堺町錦店是有二樓空間的，但這天並沒有開放讓內用的客人入坐。

不過 Tabelog 是有開放預約的喔，從早上 11 點後的時間開始就可以在網路上預約，如果有確定要到訪，也可以直接從網路上預約訂位。

而在座位區中間的地方有一個小中庭，這裡有著日式造景


🍽️ 菜單與餐點


現在的菜單大多都是採取直接掃 QRcode，線上看菜單，而菜單也都有英文可以參考，每一個餐點也都還有照片。

菜單連結：https://www.oc-ogawa.co.jp/nishiki/menu/


炭焼きトースト　糀バター、目玉焼きとポテト入りソーセージ

Charcoal Grilled Toast with Koji Butter,Fried Egg and Sausage with Potatoes

￥1,400 

我們抵達的時間還不到 11 點，主要是想來這裡吃早餐且喝杯咖啡，剩著最後時段點了兩份 Morning Menu 的 Toast Set，再各點一杯咖啡。Toast Set 的份量不算多，只有上圖照片上的這些食物，比較適合當早餐吃。

吐司可以選擇兩種不同的吐司，很Ｑ很有嚼勁，搭配 Koji Butter ，口感搭配起來很好吃。熟食的部分就是一個太陽蛋、烤洋蔥，以及沒有吃過的馬鈴薯香腸，比較特別的是馬鈴薯香腸，沒想到這樣弄在一起一片的，第一次吃到蠻新鮮的。

一個太陽蛋、烤洋蔥，馬鈴薯香腸

在日式庭院品嚐咖啡

整體的體驗蠻好的，店員們英文溝通順暢，店內簡樸舒適，如果做到日式庭院旁的座位，用餐過程是很舒服的。另外餐點好吃，咖啡好喝，只是現在比較熱門，如果有計畫要來小川咖啡堺町錦店，可以考慮先線上預約避免久候喔。

title.$t: Kansai Independent Travel | Kyoto Food | Ogawa Coffee Sakaimachi Nishiki | Enjoy a Cup of Coffee in a Japanese Garden | Great Eats Beside Nishiki Market

content.$t:
Founded in 1952, Ogawa Coffee is one of Kyoto's long-established local coffee shops. It started out mainly in coffee retail, and later expanded not only across Japan but also into the U.S. market. In 2022, marking its 70th anniversary, it opened this new store, "Ogawa Coffee Sakaimachi Nishiki," near the bustling Nishiki Market. Renovated in machiya townhouse style, it preserves the historic charm of the old city.

Since our accommodation in Kyoto didn't include breakfast, we wanted to find something special or delicious nearby for breakfast, so one day we came to Ogawa Coffee Sakaimachi Nishiki for brunch.

📜 Information

  • Address: 〒604-8127 Kyoto, Nakagyo Ward, Kikuyacho, 519-1
  • Opening hours: 07:00–20:00
  • Online reservations: https://tabelog.com/kyoto/A2601/A260201/26037151/
  • Payment: Credit cards accepted
  • Official website: https://www.oc-ogawa.co.jp/nishiki/

📍 Location and Interior

Ogawa Coffee Sakaimachi Nishiki is located right next to Nishiki Market. Walk in from the street beside the soy milk doughnut stall and you'll see it (at the intersection of Sakaimachi-dori and Nishikikoji). The exterior is very low-key with no signboard, so without Google Maps it would be really easy to miss.

Only the marking on the ground identifies the shop

The interior follows the same understated, simple design as the exterior, dominated by grey tones with cement-colored floors. There's a working bar at the entrance, which is not only where the coffee is made but also where they sell all kinds of cups and coffee equipment; you can also buy coffee beans directly here. Behind the bar is the kitchen area, separated from the seating area beside it.


There's a sofa area at the entrance for waiting customers

Ogawa Coffee Sakaimachi Nishiki is a popular spot these days—apparently you'll need to queue at both breakfast and afternoon tea times. We visited on a weekday just before 11 a.m. and there were still plenty of people; we got seated after waiting for one or two groups. The Sakaimachi Nishiki store actually has a second floor, but it wasn't open for dine-in customers that day.

That said, Tabelog does take reservations—slots from 11 a.m. onward can be booked online, so if you're sure you're going, you can reserve a table directly online.

In the middle of the seating area there's a small courtyard with Japanese-style landscaping.


🍽️ Menu and Food


These days the menu is mostly accessed by scanning a QR code and viewing it online. The menu is available in English, and every dish comes with a photo.

Menu link: https://www.oc-ogawa.co.jp/nishiki/menu/


炭焼きトースト　糀バター、目玉焼きとポテト入りソーセージ

Charcoal Grilled Toast with Koji Butter,Fried Egg and Sausage with Potatoes

￥1,400 

We arrived just before 11 a.m., mainly wanting breakfast and a cup of coffee here, so we caught the last of the Morning Menu and ordered two Toast Sets plus a coffee each. The Toast Set isn't a huge portion—just the food you see in the photo above—so it's better suited as a breakfast.

You can choose between two kinds of toast; it's wonderfully chewy and pairs beautifully with the koji butter. The cooked items are a sunny-side-up egg, grilled onion, and a potato sausage I'd never had before. The potato sausage was the most unusual part—I never imagined the two combined into one patty like that, and it was refreshing to try for the first time.

A sunny-side-up egg, grilled onion, and potato sausage

Enjoying coffee in a Japanese garden

Overall the experience was great: the staff communicate smoothly in English, and the interior is simple and comfortable. If you get a seat beside the Japanese garden, the meal is a very relaxing experience. The food is tasty and the coffee is good—it's just quite popular now, so if you're planning to visit Ogawa Coffee Sakaimachi Nishiki, consider booking online in advance to avoid a long wait.

title.$t: 關西自由行 | 京都住宿 | 京都四條河原町 Forza 飯店 Hotel Forza Kyoto Shijo Kawaramachi | 位於錦市場旁最熱鬧區域 | 交通方便且平價的飯店

content.$t:
這次是第一次來京都自由行，在選擇飯店的需求上，主要希望「交通方便」、「飯店不要太舊」，在訂房網站上搜尋了一下，最後選擇了這間京都四條河原町 Forza 飯店，除了地點就在四條河原町站附近之外，直接從地下街就可以走進飯店，在天氣非常冷的時候，不用走上外面吹風，是很不錯的一個優點。

📜  資訊

  • 付款方式：可刷卡
  • 入住房型：高級雙人房
  • 入住價格：¥44,226 (平日四晚，不含早餐)
  • 飯店地址：〒600-8005 Kyoto, Shimogyo Ward, Tachiuri Higashimachi, 25-1
  • 聯絡電話：+81752548251
  • 訂房網站：https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/hoteruhuorutuajing-du-si-tiao-he-yuan.zh-tw.html?aid=8003516

📍 地點位置

京都四條河原町 Forza 就位在最熱鬧的四條河原町站附近，周邊眾多百貨、餐廳、藥妝店，走路只需 2~3 分鐘就可以到四條河原町地鐵站，熱鬧錦市場就在對街，走路2分鐘就可以抵達，就算走到花見小路或是八阪神社也都在 15 分鐘內的時間，地點可以說是非常的方便。

🏢 飯店環境

Forza 飯店的大廳位在 B1，所以從一樓平面的入口進來之後，必須再搭乘電梯或是手扶梯到地下一樓，而從地下街的入口則可以直接進入到櫃檯大廳的地方。

但要注意，只有從正門進入，才有電梯與手扶梯，如果是從地下街的入口進入飯店，會有幾階的樓梯(兩段，約20階)，搬運大行李就會比較不方便喔。


B1 大廳通往地下街 11 號出口


B1 大廳通往地下街的出口只有階梯 (外面還有一段要下到地下街的階梯)

接待大廳

除了有工作人員的櫃檯之外，接待大廳也有多台自動 check-in / check-out 的櫃檯，可以在這裡不需要工作人員就可以完成入住，而機器上都有各國語言，使用上也不會太困難。

可以自助入住且直接刷卡付款





大廳有一個座位很多的休息區

清酒免費兌換

只要入住 Forza 飯店，每晚每一位住客都可以到櫃檯去領取一枚代幣，然後使用這個機器，兌換一杯免費的清酒，不過這裡的清酒就很基本款平價的清酒，口味自己覺得好像都還好。

🛏  房間環境


房間偏暗且走的是一個暖色調的燈光，乾淨度蠻不錯的。空間不算大，靠窗的地方有一個長椅，兩個大行李箱打開攤平可以放在下面，才不會卡到走道的移動空間。


電視與日本必備的加濕器

簡單的備品與來自由布院的瓶裝水

除了一般的備品之外，房內還有一台 Panasonic 的 NanoCare 蒸臉機，號稱可以讓皮膚有更好的保濕效果。

窗戶旁的小長椅

廁所衛浴的空間大小一般，有免治馬桶、與一個單人 size 的浴缸。


🏢 飯店設施

飯店其實比較偏向商務旅館，所以也沒有什麼設施，只有自動販賣機與洗衣機可以使用。

早餐空間

早餐的部分我們在訂房的時候沒有一起購買，現場詢問了一下價格是一人 2000 日圓，採自助式的早餐，可以當天有需要再來購買。

飯店官網的 Menu:

https://www.hotelforza.jp/kyotoshijo/breakfast/



大廳裡隨時可取用的咖啡機

title.$t: Kansai Trip | Kyoto Accommodation | Hotel Forza Kyoto Shijo Kawaramachi | Right Next to the Lively Nishiki Market | Convenient and Affordable

content.$t:
This was our first independent trip to Kyoto, and when picking a hotel our main criteria were "convenient transport" and "not too old a building." After searching the booking sites for a while, we settled on Hotel Forza Kyoto Shijo Kawaramachi. Besides being located right by Shijo Kawaramachi Station, you can walk straight into the hotel from the underground shopping street — a really nice plus when the weather is freezing, since you don't have to go outside into the wind.

📜  Information

  • Payment: credit cards accepted
  • Room type: Superior Double Room
  • Price: ¥44,226 (four weekday nights, breakfast not included)
  • Address: 〒600-8005 Kyoto, Shimogyo Ward, Tachiuri Higashimachi, 25-1
  • Phone: +81752548251
  • Booking site：https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/hoteruhuorutuajing-du-si-tiao-he-yuan.zh-tw.html?aid=8003516

📍 Location

Hotel Forza Kyoto Shijo Kawaramachi sits right near the bustling Shijo Kawaramachi Station, surrounded by department stores, restaurants and drugstores. It's only a 2–3 minute walk to the Shijo Kawaramachi subway station, and the lively Nishiki Market is just across the street, about 2 minutes on foot. Even Hanamikoji Street and Yasaka Shrine are within 15 minutes' walk — the location is extremely convenient.

🏢 Hotel Environment

The Forza's lobby is on B1, so after entering from the street-level entrance on the first floor you have to take the elevator or escalator down one floor. From the underground street entrance, however, you can walk straight into the reception lobby.

One thing to note: the elevator and escalator are only available if you enter through the main entrance. If you come in from the underground street entrance there are several steps (two flights, about 20 steps), which makes hauling large luggage more of a hassle.


The B1 lobby leads to Exit 11 of the underground street


The exit from the B1 lobby to the underground street has stairs only (and there's another flight outside going down to the underground street)

Reception Lobby

Besides the staffed front desk, the lobby also has several automated check-in / check-out kiosks where you can complete check-in without any staff assistance. The machines support multiple languages, so they're not difficult to use.

Self check-in with direct credit card payment





The lobby has a lounge area with plenty of seating

Free Sake

Every guest staying at Forza can pick up one token at the front desk per night and use this machine to redeem a free cup of sake. That said, the sake here is a pretty basic, inexpensive one — the flavor was just so-so to me.

🛏  The Room


The room is on the dim side with warm-toned lighting, and cleanliness was quite good. It isn't large, but there's a bench by the window with space underneath for two large suitcases opened flat, so they don't block the walkway.


TV and the humidifier that's a must in Japan

Simple amenities and bottled water from Yufuin

Besides the usual amenities, the room also has a Panasonic NanoCare facial steamer, said to give your skin better moisturizing.

The little bench by the window

The bathroom is average in size, with a washlet toilet and a single-size bathtub.


🏢 Hotel Facilities

The hotel is really more of a business hotel, so there aren't many facilities — just vending machines and washing machines.

Breakfast Area

We didn't add breakfast when booking. We asked on site and it was 2,000 yen per person for a buffet-style breakfast, which you can just buy on the day if you feel like it.

Menu on the hotel's official site:

https://www.hotelforza.jp/kyotoshijo/breakfast/



A coffee machine in the lobby, available anytime


Overall the stay was pretty good, and the location is genuinely convenient — whether heading to Arashiyama or straight to Osaka, no transfers are needed. The neighborhood is lively at night too, with restaurants and bars all within walking distance.

Check-in and check-out are now both done via self-service machines, but they offer multiple language options, and if you need help the staff speak good English, so communication is no problem.

title.$t: 關西自由行 | 京都美食 | 嵐山喜重郎 Kijurou | 隱身於嵐山巷弄中丼飯專賣店 | 在日式庭園旁用餐

content.$t:
嵐山是京都熱門的觀光景點，除了有許多可以購買紀念品或伴手禮的店之外，這裡也有很多的餐廳選擇。在嵐山最熱鬧的大街上，有一間「嵐山喜重郎」，隱身在旁邊的小路中，要不是門口有招牌，不然一般人很容易就錯過不會發現這間店。

📜 資訊

  • 地址：18-27 Sagatenryuji Kitatsukurimichicho, Ukyo Ward, Kyoto, 616-8374
  • 營業時間：11:00–20:30
  • 線上菜單：https://gurunavi.com/zh-hant/c150212/mn/menu1/rst/
  • 付款方式：可現金，可刷卡
  • 官方網站：https://kijurou.gorp.jp/

📍 地點與店內環境

位於小路口的招牌

嵐山喜重郎 Kijurou 距離京福電氣鐵道的嵐山站步行 4 分鐘，離阪急嵐山站步行 15 分鐘，位在熱鬧嵐山大街上的某一條巷弄內，路上有招牌與菜單，我們也是看完菜單，查了一下 Google 評分後，覺得好像還不錯，就選擇這間店來當作在嵐山的午餐。

走到底右手邊的建築物就是「嵐山喜重郎 Kijurou」

當天抵達的時間是下午一點，店外還需要排隊，稍微等了一陣子才入場

外觀與入口是簡樸的日式建築

店內一樣是簡樸的日式風格，座位其實算蠻多的，有四人桌、也有靠窗邊的雙人座位，只是來訪的人也很多，所以用餐時間還是會需要稍微等待一下。而窗外有一個小小的日式庭園，坐在窗邊的座位會好像在日式庭園內用餐，是一個蠻舒適的體驗。

嵐山喜重郎的日式庭園

📜  菜單

在門外的座位排隊的時候，店員就會給你菜單可以先看，菜單是以各種丼飯定食為主，有些定食還可以選擇肉的克數(100g/ 150g)，讓訪客可以有更多種的選擇。

更完整詳細的菜單詳見官網：https://kijurou.gorp.jp/




🍽️ 餐點


和牛牛排丼飯定食(茶泡飯)

丼飯的套餐會是這樣一組，除了丼飯本身之外，還會有著一碗味增湯，與日式的一些漬物。牛排的部分肉質吃起來蠻香的，左下方的那壺是茶，可以做成茶泡飯來享用。

牛肉蓋飯丼飯定食+湯豆腐

另一份選擇了湯豆腐與牛肉燒肉的丼飯，湯豆腐是上桌後會開火，食用前要先煮到滾，湯豆腐意外的非常好吃，除了口感滑順之外，豆香非常的香，而牛肉燒肉也十分出色，烤的很香的炭火味，搭配肉質不錯的牛肉，整體吃起來覺得很好吃。與上一份餐點相比，會比較推薦這份。

剛好也看到有販售京都風味的氣泡調酒，就選了一個“京都香橙”來試試看，但喝起來覺得不是很好喝，如果想要喝點什麼搭配餐點的話，可以不用考慮這個，點杯生啤或許比較好。


這次沒有事先查太多嵐山要吃什麼，主要是來到嵐山之後才直接 Google 當下附近的餐廳，找評分高的就進去了，而這間「嵐山喜重郎 」自己覺得還不錯，有來嵐山要吃午餐的話，可以把這間列入考慮之一。

title.$t: Kansai Independent Travel | Kyoto Food | Arashiyama Kijurou | A Donburi Specialist Hidden in an Arashiyama Alley | Dining Beside a Japanese Garden

content.$t:
Arashiyama is one of Kyoto's most popular tourist areas. Besides the many shops selling souvenirs and gifts, there are also plenty of restaurant options here. Tucked away in a small side lane off Arashiyama's busiest main street is "Arashiyama Kijurou" — if it weren't for the sign at the lane entrance, most people would easily walk right past without ever noticing this restaurant.

📜 Information

  • Address: 18-27 Sagatenryuji Kitatsukurimichicho, Ukyo Ward, Kyoto, 616-8374
  • Opening hours: 11:00–20:30
  • Online menu: https://gurunavi.com/zh-hant/c150212/mn/menu1/rst/
  • Payment: cash and credit cards accepted
  • Official website: https://kijurou.gorp.jp/

📍 Location and Interior

The sign at the entrance to the lane

Arashiyama Kijurou is a 4-minute walk from Arashiyama Station on the Keifuku Electric Railroad and a 15-minute walk from Hankyu Arashiyama Station. It sits in one of the alleys off the bustling Arashiyama main street, with a sign and menu displayed out on the lane. After reading the menu and checking its Google rating, we thought it looked pretty good, so we picked this place for lunch in Arashiyama.

The building at the end of the lane on the right is "Arashiyama Kijurou"

We arrived at 1 p.m. and there was still a queue outside, so we waited a little while before being seated

The exterior and entrance are simple, traditional Japanese architecture

Inside, the style is likewise simple and Japanese. There are actually quite a few seats — four-person tables as well as two-person seats by the window — but since so many people come here, you'll still need to wait a bit during meal times. Outside the window there's a small Japanese garden, so sitting by the window feels almost like dining inside the garden itself — a very pleasant experience.

The Japanese garden at Arashiyama Kijurou

📜  Menu

While you queue at the seats outside, the staff will hand you a menu to look over in advance. The menu centers on various donburi set meals, and for some sets you can even choose the portion of meat (100g / 150g), giving diners more options.

For the full, detailed menu, see the official website: https://kijurou.gorp.jp/




🍽️ The Food


Wagyu Steak Donburi Set (with Ochazuke)

The donburi set comes as a full tray like this: besides the rice bowl itself, there's a bowl of miso soup and some Japanese pickles. The steak was fragrant and tasty, and the small pot at the bottom left holds tea, which you can pour over the rice to enjoy it as ochazuke.

Beef Donburi Set + Yudofu (Hot Tofu)

For the other order we chose the yudofu with grilled beef donburi. The yudofu is lit over a flame after it arrives at the table and needs to come to a boil before eating. It was surprisingly delicious — silky in texture with a wonderfully rich soybean aroma. The grilled beef was also excellent, with a lovely smoky charcoal flavor and good-quality meat. Overall it was really tasty, and compared with the previous dish, I'd recommend this one more.

We also spotted some Kyoto-flavored sparkling cocktails on offer, so we tried a "Kyoto Yuzu." Unfortunately it didn't taste very good — if you want something to drink with your meal, you can skip this one; a draft beer would probably be a better choice.


This time we didn't research much in advance about where to eat in Arashiyama — we simply Googled nearby restaurants once we arrived and went into a highly rated one. Personally, I thought "Arashiyama Kijurou " was pretty good, so if you're looking for lunch in Arashiyama, it's worth considering.

title.$t: 關西自由行 | 京都美食 | Miyako Soba & Udon | 販賣烏龍麵與蕎麥麵的立食餐廳 | 一早來碗熱熱的烏龍湯麵

content.$t:
Miyako Soba & Udon 是一間專賣烏龍麵與蕎麥麵(其實還有一些壽司)的小餐廳，特別的是他沒有座位，顧客都是圍繞著吧台站著吃飯。由於位於我們住的飯店斜對面，前一天晚上無意間發現這家小店，而且竟然一大早 7:30 就開始營業了，就決定找一天早晨來當作早餐。

📜 資訊

  • 地址：Tachiuri Nakanocho, Shimogyo Ward, Kyoto, 600-8006
  • 營業時間：07:30–22:00
  • 價位：¥410 ~ ¥690 日幣不等
  • 付款方式：只收現金
  • 官方粉絲頁：https://www.instagram.com/miyakosobamiyakomiyako

🍽️ 店內環境與食物

一開始以為 Miyako Soba & Udon 是一間獨特的小店，後來才發現其實他是連鎖店，而且在我們居住的京都河原町這附近就有兩家，這次到訪的分店就位在京都河原町站旁。

店內空間小小的，只有一個大約可以站 7~8 人的吧檯，沒有座位，吧檯內的廚房工作區空間也不大。

餐點的部分也蠻單純的，主要就是販售各種組合搭配的烏龍麵或是蕎麥麵，菜單上直接就有中文與英文，且價格十分的便宜。除了現煮的烏龍麵與蕎麥麵之外，吧台上的架子也有販售飯糰或壽司。


飯糰與壽司

油炸豆腐 + 烏龍麵 ¥ 440


溫泉蛋 + 油炸蔬菜餅 + 油炸豆腐 + 烏龍麵 ¥ 670


出餐的速度非常的快，大概點完一兩分鐘後餐點就會送來了。口味的話還行，至少點到的這兩晚都不會不好吃，在寒冷的冬天早晨吃一碗熱熱的烏龍麵當早餐還蠻舒服的。

如果冬天來訪京都，早餐不知道要吃什麼，不妨來試試看這家方便快速，立食的烏龍麵與蕎麥麵吧！

title.$t: Kansai Independent Travel | Kyoto Food | Miyako Soba & Udon | A Stand-and-Eat Shop Serving Udon and Soba | A Bowl of Hot Udon Soup First Thing in the Morning

content.$t:
Miyako Soba & Udon is a small restaurant specializing in udon and soba (and actually some sushi too). What makes it special is that there are no seats — customers all stand around the counter to eat. Since it sits diagonally across from our hotel, we stumbled across this little shop the night before, and were surprised to find it opens as early as 7:30 in the morning, so we decided to come by one morning for breakfast.

📜 Information

  • Address: Tachiuri Nakanocho, Shimogyo Ward, Kyoto, 600-8006
  • Opening hours: 07:30–22:00
  • Price range: ¥410 ~ ¥690
  • Payment: cash only
  • Official page:https://www.instagram.com/miyakosobamiyakomiyako

🍽️ The Shop and the Food

At first I thought Miyako Soba & Udon was a unique one-off shop, but later found out it's actually a chain — there are even two branches near Kyoto Kawaramachi where we stayed. The branch we visited this time is right next to Kyoto Kawaramachi Station.

The interior is tiny, with just one counter that fits about 7–8 standing customers and no seats; the kitchen work area inside the counter isn't very big either.

The menu is fairly simple, mainly various combinations of udon or soba. The menu comes directly in Chinese and English, and the prices are very cheap. Besides the freshly cooked udon and soba, the rack on the counter also sells rice balls and sushi.


Rice balls and sushi

Fried Tofu + Udon ¥ 440


Onsen Egg + Vegetable Tempura Fritter + Fried Tofu + Udon ¥ 670


The food comes out extremely fast — usually within a minute or two of ordering. The taste is decent; at least both of the bowls we ordered were far from bad, and having a hot bowl of udon for breakfast on a cold winter morning felt really comforting.

If you're visiting Kyoto in winter and can't decide what to have for breakfast, why not give this quick and convenient stand-and-eat udon and soba shop a try!

title.$t: 關西自由行 | 京都酒吧 | House of KI NO BI | 季之美京都展示店 | 琴酒品飲 | 販售限定 House Gin

content.$t:
季之美是日本首間琴酒蒸餾廠，一直都是琴酒中表現亮眼且屬於中高價位的一個品牌，這次來到了京都，當然要來參觀一下季之美在京都展示店，House of KI NO BI。

📜 資訊

  • 地址：358 Kawaramachi Doori Nijo Agaru Shimizu-cho, Nakagyo Ward, Kyoto, 604-0911日本
  • 營業時間：
    • 15:00–21:00 (週三、週四、週日)
    • 15:00–22:00 (週五、週六)
  • 價格：參觀免費
  • 官方網站：https://kyotodistillery.jp/en/house_kinobi/

📍 地點與交通

https://kyotodistillery.jp/en/house_kinobi/

House of KI NO BI 位於京都市役所前站，離熱鬧的京都河原町車站相隔一個地鐵站，不論是透過地鐵，還是直接搭乘公車，House of KI NO BI 的位置都不會太遠。

這次剛好在京都河原町車站附近吃晚餐，就直接搭乘公車過去，House of KI NO BI 的位置也不會太難找，就在很顯眼的大馬路旁，經過很容易就會發現。

🏢 店內環境

日式低調的入口處

House of KI NO BI 的建築物總共有兩層，扣掉會員制才能進去的 Gin Palace 與要預約的品嚐空間 Konwa no ma ，剩下來的空間並沒有很大。

二樓的空間一個是 Konwa no ma，這是一個品飲室，可以品嚐構成 KI NO BI 的六種元素，感覺應該是很不錯的體驗，但這裡需要事前預約，且只有日文的介紹，參加了可能也聽不懂他在介紹什麼，所以這次就沒有選擇了。

二樓展區的空間

另一半的空間就是展區，有一些蒸餾過程的介紹、原料來源、瓶身演進歷史，或是不同元素的香氣展示等等，如果平常有在喝季之美，或是對於他製作與風味有興趣的，這個展區空間可以讓你更了解季之美製作與風味的來源。

蒸餾過程的介紹

原料來源

瓶身演進歷史

不同元素的香氣展示

季之美使用了11種來自日本的草本植物與辛香料，杜松子、鳶尾、扁柏、日本柚子、檸檬、玉露綠茶、山椒、花椒葉、紅紫蘇、薑和青竹，區分為六大元素：

  • Base: 杜松子、鳶尾、扁柏
  • Citrus: 日本柚子、檸檬
  • Herbal: 山椒、花椒葉
  • Spice: 薑
  • Green Tea: 玉露綠茶
  • Fruity & Floral: 紅紫蘇、青竹

分別蒸餾，再與伏見清酒釀酒廠的水混合在一起，製作出平衡完美、清新順口的季之美。

一樓的座位區

而一樓除了會員制才能進去的 Gin Palace 之外，只有一個吧檯、座位區與商品陳列區。在一樓的吧檯，可以品嘗到季之美的不同品項，也可以直接點選使用季之美調酒。

約六人座位的吧台區

🍸 季之美品飲

House of KI NO BI 的一樓吧台，目前有 13 種不同版本的季之美可以品飲，五款琴酒調酒可以選擇，另外還有 soft drink 像是通寧水、薑汁汽水等等可以直接單點，也有一些些的下酒小點可以選擇。

House of KI NO BI 的 Menu

這次選擇了 KI NO BI Tasting Flight Set "KI-KI-KI NO BI"，可以選擇三款各 15ml 的季之美來品嚐，挑了 KI NO BI House Gin、KI NO TOU 以及 KI NO BI Edition K 三款。

Tasting Flight Set 送上來的時候會依據風味的強烈度排序，推薦你先從風味最不強烈的開始品嚐，也推薦再點一瓶通寧水，可以搭配著不同風味來品飲。

品飲方式推薦

第一輪先直接純飲三款季之美，試試看他最原始的味道，接著放入一顆冰塊，融水降溫後再品飲喝第二輪。最後第三輪倒入通寧水，感受三隻不同季之美做成 Gin and Tonic 的風味變化。

  • 第一輪：直接純飲
  • 第二輪：放入一顆冰塊
  • 第三輪：加入更多冰塊與通寧水
Gin & Tonic

KI NO BI House Gin

非常清新、最明顯有著柚子、柑橘類的香氣，這隻是 House of KI NO BI 限定販售，是以原版的季之美為基礎，再用了「季の美 House」後園的井水調和至43%，比著原版的季之美更加清新與柔順，不論純飲、加入冰塊，或是加入通寧水都很適合。

KI NO BI Edition K

其實我本來想試試看 Edition G 的香檳桶，但可惜目前是缺貨的狀態，所以就選擇了另一隻過泥煤桶的 Edition K。

這隻將季之美陳年於 Kilchoman 的泥煤威士忌桶之中，做出的 Edition K 有著淡淡的泥煤香氣，跟季之美原來的柚子與柑橘香氣意外的非常融合，尤其加入了通寧水後的 G&T 非常優秀。自己其實不是很喜歡泥煤威士忌，但這隻 Edition K 淡淡的泥煤味卻是剛剛好，搭配季之美本來的風味，真的是一隻做得很不錯的琴酒。

KI NO TOU

季之美糖島， Kyoto Old Tom Gin，是以來自沖繩的 Kokutou 黑糖調和，被放在最後一款。它的香氣與入口都有非常明顯的黑糖香氣，口感帶甜且圓潤。不過自己覺得除了黑糖香氣之外，並沒有像前兩隻一樣覺得非常驚艷。

KI NO BAI

由於對於季之美出的梅酒 - 季之梅也很好奇，也點了一杯做 Gin & Soda。

會有專人調製

這款季之梅，除了使用京都當地的梅子浸泡季之美之外，後續還浸泡了北海道的 haskap berries (藍靛果)，最後加入日本最北方島嶼的糖，製作出來的這瓶季之梅，整體顏色偏紅。

這瓶出來的味道跟一般想像中的梅酒不太一樣，有一點利口酒的感覺，我自己還是比較喜歡原始版的梅酒。

整體來說，如果平常有在喝琴酒，且很多季之美品項都還沒喝過的話，那非常值得來 House of KI NO BI 一趟，直接來試試看好奇且有興趣的不同版本季之美。

不過店內販售的季之美，價格不會比外面酒專來得更便宜，再加上不能退稅，除了購買 KI NO BI House Gin，之外，如果想購買比較常見的品項，直接到附近的酒專買會便宜很多喔。

title.$t: Kansai Travel | Kyoto Bars | House of KI NO BI | KI NO BI Kyoto Showroom | Gin Tasting | Exclusive House Gin

content.$t:
KI NO BI comes from Japan's first gin distillery, and it has always been a standout, mid-to-high-priced gin brand. Since I was in Kyoto this time, I of course had to visit KI NO BI's Kyoto showroom, House of KI NO BI.

📜 Information

  • Address: 358 Kawaramachi Doori Nijo Agaru Shimizu-cho, Nakagyo Ward, Kyoto, 604-0911, Japan
  • Opening hours:
    • 15:00–21:00 (Wed, Thu, Sun)
    • 15:00–22:00 (Fri, Sat)
  • Price: Free admission
  • Official website: https://kyotodistillery.jp/en/house_kinobi/

📍 Location & Transportation

https://kyotodistillery.jp/en/house_kinobi/

House of KI NO BI is located near Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Station, just one subway stop from the bustling Kyoto-Kawaramachi Station. Whether you take the subway or simply hop on a bus, it's never far away.

This time I happened to be having dinner near Kyoto-Kawaramachi Station, so I just took a bus over. House of KI NO BI isn't hard to find either — it sits right along a prominent main road, so you'll spot it easily as you pass by.

🏢 Inside the Venue

The understated Japanese-style entrance

The House of KI NO BI building has two floors. Once you exclude the members-only Gin Palace and the reservation-only tasting room Konwa no ma, the remaining space isn't very large.

One part of the second floor is Konwa no ma, a tasting room where you can sample the six elements that make up KI NO BI. It sounds like a great experience, but it requires a reservation in advance and is only presented in Japanese — you probably wouldn't understand the explanations, so I skipped it this time.

The exhibition area on the second floor

The other half of the floor is the exhibition area, with displays on the distillation process, the origins of the botanicals, the evolution of the bottle design, and the aromas of the different elements. If you regularly drink KI NO BI, or are curious about how it's made and where its flavors come from, this exhibition space will give you a much better understanding.

Introduction to the distillation process

Origins of the botanicals

The evolution of the bottle design

Aroma displays of the different elements

KI NO BI uses 11 Japanese botanicals and spices — juniper, orris root, hinoki cypress, yuzu, lemon, gyokuro green tea, sansho pepper, kinome (sansho leaf), red shiso, ginger and bamboo — grouped into six elements:

  • Base: juniper, orris root, hinoki cypress
  • Citrus: yuzu, lemon
  • Herbal: sansho pepper, kinome (sansho leaf)
  • Spice: ginger
  • Green Tea: gyokuro green tea
  • Fruity & Floral: red shiso, bamboo

Each is distilled separately, then blended with water from a sake brewery in Fushimi, creating the perfectly balanced, fresh and smooth KI NO BI.

The seating area on the first floor

Apart from the members-only Gin Palace, the ground floor has just a bar counter, a seating area and a product display area. At the bar you can taste the various KI NO BI expressions, or order cocktails made with KI NO BI.

The bar counter, seating about six

🍸 KI NO BI Tasting

The ground-floor bar at House of KI NO BI currently offers 13 different KI NO BI expressions to taste and five gin cocktails to choose from. There are also soft drinks such as tonic water and ginger ale available on their own, plus a small selection of bar snacks.

The House of KI NO BI menu

I went with the KI NO BI Tasting Flight Set "KI-KI-KI NO BI," which lets you pick three 15 ml pours. I chose KI NO BI House Gin, KI NO TOU and KI NO BI Edition K.

The tasting flight is served in order of flavor intensity; they recommend starting with the mildest. I'd also suggest ordering a bottle of tonic water so you can pair it with each of the different expressions.

Recommended way to taste

For the first round, drink all three neat to get their most original flavors. Then add a single ice cube and taste again as the ice melts and cools them down. For the third round, pour in tonic water and enjoy how the three different gins change as Gin and Tonics.

  • Round 1: neat
  • Round 2: with one ice cube
  • Round 3: with more ice and tonic water
Gin & Tonic

KI NO BI House Gin

Extremely fresh, with pronounced yuzu and citrus aromas. This one is sold exclusively at House of KI NO BI: it's based on the original KI NO BI but cut to 43% with well water from the back garden of "KI NO BI House," making it fresher and smoother than the original. It works beautifully neat, over ice, or with tonic water.

KI NO BI Edition K

I originally wanted to try Edition G, aged in champagne casks, but it was out of stock, so I went with Edition K, finished in peated whisky casks instead.

Edition K is aged in Kilchoman peated whisky casks, giving it a gentle peat aroma that blends surprisingly well with KI NO BI's original yuzu and citrus notes — especially as a G&T with tonic water, which was outstanding. I'm not usually a fan of peated whisky, but the subtle smokiness here is just right, and paired with KI NO BI's original character it makes for a really well-crafted gin.

KI NO TOU

KI NO TOU, or Kyoto Old Tom Gin, is blended with kokuto brown sugar from Okinawa, and was served last. Both its aroma and palate carry a very distinct brown sugar character, sweet and rounded. That said, beyond the brown sugar note, I didn't find it as impressive as the previous two.

KI NO BAI

I was also curious about KI NO BAI, the plum liqueur from KI NO BI, so I ordered one as a Gin & Soda.

A bartender mixes it for you

For KI NO BAI, local Kyoto plums are steeped in KI NO BI, followed by haskap berries from Hokkaido, and finally sugar from Japan's northernmost island is added — resulting in a bottle with a distinctly reddish color.

The taste isn't quite what you'd expect from a typical umeshu; it feels more like a liqueur. Personally, I still prefer classic plum wine.

Overall, if you enjoy gin and haven't tried many of the KI NO BI expressions yet, House of KI NO BI is well worth a visit — you can sample whichever versions you're curious about right there.

That said, the KI NO BI sold in the shop isn't cheaper than at outside liquor stores, and tax refunds don't apply. So apart from the KI NO BI House Gin, if you want to buy the more common expressions, heading to a nearby liquor store will be much cheaper.

KI NO TEA bought at a liquor store, and the exclusive House Gin bought in-store

content.$t:
Bee's Knees 是位於京都靠近鴨川河畔旁的一間酒吧，主題是禁酒令時代的地下酒吧 (Speakeasy)，外觀低調難發現，正門上還寫著「Book Store」，直到推開門才會發現裡面別有洞天，近年來連續幾年都入圍亞洲50大酒吧，今年 2023 年為 No. 44。

📜 資訊

  • 地址：604-0961 Kyoto, Nakagyo Ward, Kamiyacho, 364 マツヤビル 1F
  • 營業時間：18:00–01:00
  • 價格：單杯 ¥1,800 ~ ¥2,100 日幣不等，無坐席費
  • 官方粉專：https://www.instagram.com/bees.knees.kyoto

📍 地點與店內環境

門口只寫了 Book Store，不知道的人會以為是間書店

Bee's Knees 位於熱鬧的京都河源町站附近，這裡商店、餐廳林立，要來到 Bee's Knees，要進入西木屋町通這條小巷子，但由於沒有招牌，很容易一不小心就會錯過，這次抵達的時候剛好已經有人在門口等待，才比較好確認店家位置。

看到上方有著一個蜜蜂的小招牌就是了

Bee's Knees 六點開門，當天抵達的時間是週一晚上的七點左右，結果已經客滿需要候位了... 熱門程度相當的驚人。

現在的候位方式採取 app 排隊，下載特定的 app 之後，只要在店內登記，就不用在門口等待了，可以到附近去逛逛，當有位置的時候店家會透過 app 通知你，只要在 15 內回來店裡就可以囉，相當的方便。

沒有排隊多久就有位置了

一進來店裡就聽到很有節奏的音樂，很像在歐美國家的酒吧一般，完全不是走日式的風格，店內也幾乎都是外國遊客，氣氛十分的熱鬧。

而店內空間其實也沒有很大，除了大約可以坐 10 人的吧台外，再加上門口旁邊的桌子就沒有位置了，且店內走道比較窄一點，整體感受稍微偏擁擠。

📜 Menu




這裡的消費方式就跟日本大多數酒吧不太一樣，沒有收取座席費，價格直接就是酒單上的價格，單杯價位相對於在大阪與福岡的酒吧高一些些。酒單上的酒很多看起來都是由經典出發做 twist 後的特調酒單，看起來都很有趣，很多都會想要試試看。

🍸 調酒

Sakura Bee's Knees (¥ 1,900)

ROKU Gin / SG KOME / ZUBROWKA / Sakura Leaf / Absinthe / Grapefruit Juice / Apple Juice / Lemon / Honey / Cinnamon

這杯是 Bee's Knees 的變化版，加了十分多的原料，但整體的平衡感不錯，花香、蜂蜜與果香搭配起來，可以算是當晚最喜歡的一杯。

Ninja Smash (¥ 2,100)

Ki No Bi Gin / Yuzu & Passionfruit / Lemon / Shiso Leaf / Sparkling Sake / Green Tea Aroma

以季之美琴酒為基底的這杯 Ninja Smash，整體有著百香果風味，帶有酸甜好入口，吸管旁附上紫蘇葉就口的時候可以聞到紫蘇香氣，最浮誇的是會倒乾冰，讓整個畫面很好拍很有記憶點。

Florist Sour (¥ 1,900)

Lavender Gin / St-Germain Elderflower Liqueur / Rose Syrup / Lemon / Egg White

以花香為主體的這杯 Florist Sour，用了薰衣草琴酒、接骨木花香甜酒還有玫瑰花糖漿，整杯的確花香爆發，口感也因為有蛋白多了綿密的層次，到對我來說稍稍偏甜一點。

Bamboo Forest (¥ 2,000)

Hendricks Gin / Homemade Botanical Wine / Elderflower /Passion fruits/ Maric acid

這杯一樣是花香配上百香果，做出來的風味和方向其實很不錯，但這杯實在太甜... 一上來的時候是難以入口的甜，放了一下融水後才比較好。

Ki No Tea Bee's Knees (¥ 2,300)

最後跟 bartender 說想要一杯帶著茶風味的 Bee's Knees，他就用季之茶做的經典 Bee's Knees，可惜季之茶原本的風味基本上都被蓋過去，這杯就沒有特別驚豔與記憶點。

五杯 10,200 

整體來說體驗是還不錯的，除了氣氛很熱鬧外，連續入選亞洲五十大酒吧的酒的品質都有一定水準。好不好喝這很主觀，只是對我來說大部分真的是偏甜，點了好幾杯的口味都是蠻甜的，甚至有一杯到了無法入口的甜，可能就是可以體驗一次的酒吧。

content.$t:
Bee's Knees is a bar in Kyoto near the banks of the Kamo River, themed around the underground speakeasies of the Prohibition era. The exterior is so understated it's easy to miss, and the front door even reads "Book Store" — only when you push it open do you discover the world hidden inside. It has made Asia's 50 Best Bars list several years running, coming in at No. 44 in 2023.

📜 Information

  • Address: 604-0961 Kyoto, Nakagyo Ward, Kamiyacho, 364 マツヤビル 1F
  • Opening hours: 18:00–01:00
  • Prices: ¥1,800 – ¥2,100 per drink; no seating charge
  • Official page: https://www.instagram.com/bees.knees.kyoto

📍 Location & Atmosphere

The door only says "Book Store" — anyone who doesn't know would think it's a bookshop

Bee's Knees sits near the bustling Kyoto Kawaramachi Station, an area packed with shops and restaurants. To get there you turn into the small lane of Nishikiyamachi Street, but since there's no signboard it's very easy to walk right past. When we arrived there happened to be people already waiting at the door, which made it easier to confirm we were in the right place.

Look for the small bee sign above — that's the place

Bee's Knees opens at six. We arrived around seven on a Monday evening, and it was already full with a waiting list... its popularity is quite astonishing.

Waiting is now handled through a queueing app. After downloading the app and signing in at the bar, you don't have to wait at the door — you can go wander nearby, and the bar will notify you through the app when a seat opens up. Just come back within 15 minutes and you're set. Very convenient.

We didn't have to wait long before a seat opened up

The moment you step inside you're greeted by pulsing, rhythmic music — it feels just like a bar in Europe or the US, not at all Japanese in style. Almost all the guests are foreign visitors, and the atmosphere is lively.

The space itself isn't very big: aside from a bar counter seating around 10 people plus a table by the entrance, there's nowhere else to sit, and the aisles are fairly narrow, so it feels a little cramped overall.

📜 Menu




The way you pay here is a bit different from most Japanese bars: there's no seating charge, and what you pay is simply the price on the drinks list. Per-glass prices are a touch higher than at bars in Osaka or Fukuoka. Many of the drinks on the list are twists on the classics, and they all look interesting — I wanted to try quite a few.

🍸 Cocktails

Sakura Bee's Knees (¥ 1,900)

ROKU Gin / SG KOME / ZUBROWKA / Sakura Leaf / Absinthe / Grapefruit Juice / Apple Juice / Lemon / Honey / Cinnamon

This is a variation on the Bee's Knees. It packs in a lot of ingredients, yet the balance is good — floral notes, honey and fruit come together nicely, making it my favourite drink of the night.

Ninja Smash (¥ 2,100)

Ki No Bi Gin / Yuzu & Passionfruit / Lemon / Shiso Leaf / Sparkling Sake / Green Tea Aroma

Built on Ki No Bi gin, this Ninja Smash leads with passionfruit, sweet-tart and easy to drink. A shiso leaf tucked beside the straw releases its aroma as you sip, and the most theatrical touch is the dry ice they pour in, making for a very photogenic, memorable presentation.

Florist Sour (¥ 1,900)

Lavender Gin / St-Germain Elderflower Liqueur / Rose Syrup / Lemon / Egg White

This floral-forward Florist Sour uses lavender gin, elderflower liqueur and rose syrup — the flowery aromas really do burst out, and the egg white adds a silky extra layer. For my taste, though, it was just a touch on the sweet side.

Bamboo Forest (¥ 2,000)

Hendricks Gin / Homemade Botanical Wine / Elderflower /Passion fruits/ Maric acid

This one again pairs floral notes with passionfruit, and the flavour direction is actually quite good — but it was simply far too sweet... When it first arrived it was almost undrinkably sweet; it only improved after sitting a while and diluting.

Ki No Tea Bee's Knees (¥ 2,300)

At the end I asked the bartender for a tea-flavoured Bee's Knees, and he made the classic using Ki No Tea gin. Unfortunately the original character of the Ki No Tea was basically buried, so this one wasn't especially impressive or memorable.

Five drinks, ¥10,200 

Overall it was a pretty good experience: besides the lively atmosphere, the quality of the drinks at a bar that keeps making Asia's 50 Best is certainly up to standard. Whether you like the taste is subjective — for me, most of them were genuinely on the sweet side. Several of the drinks I ordered were quite sweet, and one was even too sweet to drink. It's probably a bar worth experiencing once.

title.$t: 關西自由行 | 大阪酒吧 | CRAFTROOM (クラフトルーム) | 隱身在商場地下二樓的小酒吧 | 2023 亞洲五十大酒吧 No.62 | 2024 亞洲五十大酒吧 No.28

content.$t:
這次停留大阪的時間很少，大部分時間都留在京都了，剩著最後一天下午傍晚的時候，來到了口袋名單的其中一家酒吧 - 「Craftroom」。

Craftroom 的主理人藤井隆先生曾經在 2016 年參加 World Class 世界賽拿到第二名，而 Craftroom 今年也入選 Asia's 50 Best Bars 的 No. 62，是一家在出發關西之前就有收藏的酒吧，也是在朋友們推薦的清單之一。

📜 資訊

  • 地址：530-0001 Osaka, Kita Ward, Umeda, 1 Chome−3−1 B2-70 Osaka Ekimae Daiichi Building
  • 營業時間：16:00–00:00 (週日公休)
  • 價格：單杯 ¥1,000 ~ ¥1,800 日幣不等，外加坐席費 ¥500/人
  • 官方網站：https://craft-room.jp/

📍 地點與店內環境

低調簡約的店門口

Craftroom 離大阪站不遠，最近的 JR 站是北新地，搭地鐵來的話可以到西梅田站，而這次我是在大阪站附近逛完後，從大阪站過去，地下街其實都有聯通，可以直接透過地下街走到 Craftroom 所在的商業大樓。但大阪這裡地下實在很複雜，怕走進去會迷路根本走不到，所以選擇直接走路面過去，步行約 5, 6 分鐘就會到了，距離十分的近。

Craftroom 位於一棟商業混合大樓內的地下二樓，大樓內有著各種居酒屋、餐廳、便利商店或是其他類型的店，可以看一下牆壁上貼的店舖位置圖就會不難找到 Craftroom 的位置囉！


Craftroom 店內空間不大，只有一個六人座位的吧台與後方區域的一個五人座小圓桌空間，燈光偏暗淡柔和，當天是放著舒適的日式爵士音樂，整體氛圍蠻不錯的。而店裡從下午四點就開始營業了，五點抵達的時候店內還沒有其他的客人，一直到六點過後才慢慢有常客出現。

後方有衣架可以掛外套

五人座小圓桌空間

📜 Menu


消費方式如同大多數日式酒吧一般，有收取座席費 (¥500/人)，會有一盤下酒的小零食，有酒單的部分除了經典調酒之外，還有一些 Signature (特調)，價位都落在 ¥1,300~¥1,500 之間，以當下匯率算起來折合台幣大約一杯調酒是 $260~$300 之間。

🍸 調酒

主理人藤井隆先生

Signature G&T (¥ 1,000)

House Gin, Australian Tonic, Grapefruit, Juniper

第一杯選了 Signature G&T，非常清爽好喝，使用兩種 Gin 混合，除了增強酒體也多花香的清新，搭配鮮新水果葡萄柚的香氣，整體來說蠻喜歡這杯的！

Citrus Sprits (¥ 1,200) 

Vodka, Riesling, Tea, Local Citrus, Tonic

這杯一樣也是走清爽路線，主體的味道會是 Riesling 這個葡萄酒的風味，但搭配通寧水與柑橘，會把味道變得更柔和清爽，也是蠻適合當作前一兩杯或是餐前酒來飲用。

Oriental Farm (¥ 1,500) 

Rum, Jasmine Kombucha, Grapefruit, Celery, Herbs

接著點了 Signature，這杯風味蠻有趣的，以蘭姆酒為基底，用了茉莉花康普茶搭配“芹菜”，整杯除了本來康普茶的味道之外，多了微微的芹菜風味，味道蠻特殊微妙，但是是順口好喝的一杯。

調製這杯的時候使用 Rolling 的方式

整體來說在這家店的體驗還蠻不錯的，雖然只點了三杯酒，但三杯都還蠻不錯的。店裡因為小小一間，所以氣氛也蠻溫馨的，主理人藤井隆先生與另一位 bartender 員工也蠻熱情會跟你聊聊天，且他們的英文都蠻好，聊起天來很順暢。

可惜大多數日本的店內都還是不禁菸的，當天在有其他客人來店裡，開始點煙的時候就放棄點下一杯酒離開店裡了，未來有機會到了大阪會考慮二訪。

title.$t: Kansai Independent Travel | Osaka Bars | CRAFTROOM (クラフトルーム) | A Small Bar Hidden on the Second Basement Floor of a Shopping Complex | Asia's 50 Best Bars 2023 No.62 | Asia's 50 Best Bars 2024 No.28

content.$t:
This time I spent very little time in Osaka — most of it was spent in Kyoto. With only the last afternoon and early evening left, I headed to one of the bars on my must-visit list - "Craftroom".

Craftroom's owner, Mr. Takashi Fujii, took second place in the World Class global competition back in 2016, and this year Craftroom was also named No. 62 on Asia's 50 Best Bars. It was a bar I had bookmarked before setting off for Kansai, and it was also on the list of places recommended by friends.

📜 Information

  • Address: 530-0001 Osaka, Kita Ward, Umeda, 1 Chome−3−1 B2-70 Osaka Ekimae Daiichi Building
  • Opening hours: 16:00–00:00 (closed on Sundays)
  • Prices: ¥1,000 ~ ¥1,800 per drink, plus a seating charge of ¥500 per person
  • Official website: https://craft-room.jp/

📍 Location & Interior

The understated, minimalist entrance

Craftroom isn't far from Osaka Station; the nearest JR station is Kitashinchi, and if you come by subway you can get off at Nishi-Umeda Station. This time, after wandering around near Osaka Station, I made my way over from there. The underground malls are actually all connected, so you can walk through them straight to the commercial building where Craftroom is located. But the underground in Osaka is genuinely complicated, and I was afraid I'd get lost and never make it, so I chose to walk at street level instead — it takes only about 5 or 6 minutes, so it's really close.

Craftroom is on the second basement floor of a mixed-use commercial building. The building is home to all kinds of izakayas, restaurants, convenience stores and other shops — just check the store directory posted on the wall and you'll have no trouble finding Craftroom!


Craftroom is a small space, with just a six-seat bar counter and a small round table for five in the back area. The lighting is dim and soft, and on the day I visited they were playing relaxing Japanese jazz — the overall atmosphere was quite lovely. The bar opens as early as 4 p.m.; when I arrived at five there were no other customers yet, and it wasn't until after six that regulars slowly began to appear.

There's a coat rack at the back for your jacket

The small round table area seating five

📜 Menu


The payment system is like most Japanese bars: there's a seating charge (¥500 per person), which comes with a small plate of snacks to go with your drinks. Besides classic cocktails, the drink list also features some signature creations, priced between ¥1,300 and ¥1,500 — at the exchange rate at the time, that works out to roughly NT$260–$300 per cocktail.

🍸 Cocktails

Owner Mr. Takashi Fujii

Signature G&T (¥ 1,000)

House Gin, Australian Tonic, Grapefruit, Juniper

For my first drink I chose the Signature G&T — extremely refreshing and delicious. It uses a blend of two gins, which not only strengthens the body but also adds more floral freshness, paired with the aroma of fresh grapefruit. Overall I really liked this one!

Citrus Sprits (¥ 1,200) 

Vodka, Riesling, Tea, Local Citrus, Tonic

This one also goes down the refreshing route. The dominant flavor is that of the Riesling wine, but paired with tonic water and citrus, the taste becomes softer and crisper. It's well suited as one of your first drinks or as an aperitif.

Oriental Farm (¥ 1,500) 

Rum, Jasmine Kombucha, Grapefruit, Celery, Herbs

Next I ordered a signature, and this one had a very interesting flavor. Built on a rum base, it uses jasmine kombucha paired with "celery" — beyond the original kombucha flavor, there's a subtle hint of celery. The taste is quite unusual and nuanced, yet it's a smooth, easy-drinking glass.

This one was prepared using the rolling technique

Overall the experience at this bar was quite good. Although I only ordered three drinks, all three were excellent. Because the place is small, the atmosphere is warm and cozy, and owner Mr. Takashi Fujii and the other bartender on staff are friendly and happy to chat with you — their English is also very good, so conversation flows easily.

It's a shame that most establishments in Japan still allow smoking indoors. That day, when other customers came in and started lighting up, I gave up on ordering another drink and left. If I get the chance to return to Osaka in the future, I'd consider a second visit.

content.$t:
希爾頓集團是世界上最大酒店的連鎖品牌之一，也是大家印象中的高階飯店品牌，這次入住的福岡海鷹希爾頓飯店，也是旗下的五星酒店。

由於公司出差的原因，這次是第二次入住福岡海鷹希爾頓飯店了，房間裡可以直接看福岡塔夜景、俯瞰博多灣的海景，福岡巨蛋也就在飯店旁邊而已。不過缺點是離市區實在是很遠，幾乎都要直接靠 Uber 移動才會比較方便。

📜  資訊

  • 付款方式：可刷卡
  • 飯店地址：2 Chome-2-3 Jigyohama, Chuo Ward, Fukuoka, 810-8650
  • 聯絡電話：+81928448111
  • 訂房網站：https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/hilton-fukuoka-sea-hawk.zh-tw.html?aid=8003516

📍 地點位置

福岡海鷹希爾頓飯店位於福岡巨蛋旁，離熱鬧的市區有一段距離，而離最近的地鐵站「唐人町」走路也要 15 分鐘，這個地點對於要在市區逛逛的遊客來說，真的是蠻不方便的。

這次交通都是靠 Uber，從福岡海鷹希爾頓到熱鬧的區域(天神、中洲川端)，距離約 5~6 公里，平均 Uber 價格一趟都落在 2200~2600 日圓之間，大概就是台幣四五百左右，相較於台灣的價格是偏高一些，所以要選擇這個住宿點，最大要考慮交通的這個問題。

🏢 飯店環境

福岡海鷹希爾頓飯店的主要入口與接待大廳都在四樓，而一樓是給大型遊覽車、公車，或是團體遊客的入口。不論是一樓還是四樓的大廳，空間都非常的寬廣且明亮，也有不少的沙發座椅可以讓住客稍作休息，或是坐在大廳聊聊天。

接近聖誕節出現的聖誕樹
寬廣氣派的大廳

接待櫃檯也很多，人潮多的時候也不需要等候太久

一樓的宴會場

一樓也是有著非常寬廣的空間

福岡海鷹希爾頓飯店樓高有 35 層樓，這裡除了客房之外，有為數不少的餐廳散落在不同的樓層，四樓還有一整區的商店街，雖然看起來這些店面都不是很好逛，但至少讓住在不是市區的住客，不用外出就可以有些商店可以逛，也還有一家全家便利商店，在夜晚可以採買一些食物或是酒類。


🛏  房間環境

這間希爾頓已經營業很久了，所以房間的設備其實看起來也點年代，這次入住與五年前房間長相設備幾乎是一模一樣，房間不算大但以日本來說也不小，有點像是乾乾淨淨的商務旅館。


被分配到的是一間雙人房，床的大小是標準雙人床大小，這次一人入住的話很夠睡，床的軟硬度也蠻適中舒適的。我這次剛好被分配到同行最小的房間，不過空間也很足夠讓大行李箱整個攤開。房內有基本的備品、電視、書桌椅等等。



空間適中

衛浴的部分也是正常大小，與五年前不一樣的是多了免治馬桶
有著一個標準大小的單人浴缸

很商務旅館的備品

🏢 飯店設施

早餐用餐區

早餐用餐區位於四樓接待櫃檯的後方，整個區域很漂亮，直接挑高的大廳，配上許多燈飾，整個非常氣派高級的感覺，座位數也很多。

不過早餐種類不多，而且口味自己覺得還好，連續吃了三天其實有點失望，沒有想像中高級飯店那種好吃又豐富的早餐。

然後雖然用餐區的座位很多，但取餐區的區域很小，所以當遇到團體客人或是尖峰時間的時候，取餐都會要大排長龍，這次三天我就遇到一天有團體客，取餐的時間都要花超級久...

健身房

健身房位於五樓，空間不大而且蠻陽春的


岩風呂

位於七樓有著泡湯區，可以讓住客使用

from: https://www.hilton.com.cn/zh-hk/hotel/fukuoka/hilton-fukuoka-sea-hawk-FUKHIHI/index.html

福岡海鷹希爾頓自己覺得住起來的體驗就普普通通，房間雖然乾淨但設施稍有點年代感，且早餐沒有想像中的好吃... 再來的話，地點太遠也是一個蠻大的缺點，如果來到福岡這個住宿不會是自己的首選，可能比較適合商務客，或是人數比較多的團體客人。

title.$t: Fukuoka Hotels | Hilton Fukuoka Sea Hawk | Upscale Seaside Hotel Next to the Fukuoka Dome | Night Views of Fukuoka Tower

content.$t:
Hilton is one of the largest hotel chains in the world and is widely seen as a high-end hotel brand. The Hilton Fukuoka Sea Hawk, where I stayed this time, is one of its five-star properties.

Thanks to a business trip, this was my second stay at the Hilton Fukuoka Sea Hawk. From the room you can look straight out at the night view of Fukuoka Tower and the sea view over Hakata Bay, and the Fukuoka Dome is right next to the hotel. The downside, though, is that it's really far from the city center — you pretty much have to rely on Uber to get around conveniently.

📜  Information

  • Payment: credit cards accepted
  • Address: 2 Chome-2-3 Jigyohama, Chuo Ward, Fukuoka, 810-8650
  • Phone: +81928448111
  • Booking site: https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/hilton-fukuoka-sea-hawk.zh-tw.html?aid=8003516

📍 Location

The Hilton Fukuoka Sea Hawk sits right beside the Fukuoka Dome, some distance from the lively city center. Even the nearest subway station, Tojinmachi, is a 15-minute walk away, so the location is genuinely inconvenient for travelers who want to explore downtown.

This trip I relied entirely on Uber. From the Hilton Fukuoka Sea Hawk to the busy areas (Tenjin, Nakasu-Kawabata) is about 5–6 km, and the average Uber fare runs between 2,200 and 2,600 yen per ride — roughly NT$400–500, a bit pricey compared with Taiwan. So if you're considering this hotel, transportation is the biggest thing to think about.

🏢 Hotel Environment

The main entrance and reception lobby of the Hilton Fukuoka Sea Hawk are on the fourth floor, while the first floor serves as the entrance for large tour coaches, buses and group guests. Both the first- and fourth-floor lobbies are extremely spacious and bright, with plenty of sofas and seating where guests can take a break or sit and chat.

The Christmas tree that appears as Christmas approaches
A vast, grand lobby

There are lots of reception desks, so you don't have to wait long even when it's busy

The banquet hall on the first floor

The first floor is also incredibly spacious

The Hilton Fukuoka Sea Hawk is 35 stories tall. Besides guest rooms, quite a few restaurants are scattered across different floors, and the fourth floor has an entire shopping arcade. The shops don't look particularly exciting, but at least guests staying away from downtown have somewhere to browse without going out. There's also a FamilyMart convenience store where you can pick up food or drinks at night.


🛏  The Room

This Hilton has been open for a long time, so the in-room fittings do look somewhat dated. The room this time looked and was equipped almost exactly the same as five years ago. It isn't large, but by Japanese standards it isn't small either — a bit like a clean, tidy business hotel.


I was assigned a double room with a standard-size double bed — more than enough for one person, and the mattress firmness was just right and comfortable. I happened to get the smallest room among our group, but there was still plenty of space to fully open a large suitcase. The room has the basic amenities, a TV, a desk and chair, and so on.



A reasonable amount of space

The bathroom is a normal size too; unlike five years ago, it now has a washlet toilet
There's a standard-size single bathtub

Very business-hotel-style amenities

🏢 Hotel Facilities

Breakfast Area

The breakfast area is behind the fourth-floor reception desk. The whole space is beautiful — a soaring high-ceilinged hall with lots of light fixtures, giving it a very grand, upscale feel, and there's plenty of seating.

The breakfast selection isn't very wide, though, and I found the flavors just so-so. After three days in a row I was a bit disappointed — not the delicious, abundant breakfast you'd imagine at a luxury hotel.

And although there's lots of seating in the dining area, the buffet serving area is very small, so when tour groups arrive or during peak hours, long lines form just to get food. On one of my three days there was a tour group, and getting food took forever...

Gym

The gym is on the fifth floor — small and pretty basic


Rock Bath (Iwaburo)

There's a hot spring bathing area on the seventh floor available to guests

from: https://www.hilton.com.cn/zh-hk/hotel/fukuoka/hilton-fukuoka-sea-hawk-FUKHIHI/index.html

Personally, I found the stay at the Hilton Fukuoka Sea Hawk merely average. The rooms are clean but the fittings feel a little dated, and the breakfast wasn't as tasty as I'd hoped... On top of that, the far-flung location is a significant drawback. If I were coming to Fukuoka, this wouldn't be my first choice; it's probably better suited to business travelers or larger groups.

title.$t: 澳洲自由行 | 布里斯本市區景點篇 | 布里斯本市政廳 | 布里斯本長廊商場 | 南岸公園 | 皇后街購物中心 | 故事橋

content.$t:
布里斯本是澳洲昆士蘭州首府，亦是昆士蘭州人口最多之城市，臨近觀光勝地黃金海岸市，很多人都會把兩個城市排在一起旅遊。而布里斯本河貫穿布里斯本中心區域，所以公共運輸除了巴士、火車之外，渡輪也是居民或是遊客日常使用的交通工具，其中一條免費路線的渡輪更是很方便遊客使用。

市區景點列表：

  • 布里斯本市政廳
  • 布里斯本長廊商場
  • 南岸公園
  • 皇后街購物中心
  • 故事橋

  布里斯本市政廳 Brisbane City Hall

布里斯本市區最具指標性的景點，就是位於喬治國王廣場 King George Square 的布里斯本市政廳了。市政廳除了是市議會的辦公地點，也在 1978 年登錄為國家遺產，並被認為是布里斯本最美麗的建築之一，且在建設的時候，布里斯本市政廳也是布里斯本最高的建築。

  • 地址：64 Adelaide St, Brisbane City QLD 4000
  • 營業時間：08:00 ~ 17:00 (假日 09:00 開始)
  • 交通方式：
    • 火車：抵達中央車站再步行 5 分鐘
    • 公車：Ann Street Stop at City Hall
  • 官方網站：http://www.brisbane.qld.gov.au/


市政廳內通往上方鐘塔的電梯

來到了布里斯本市政廳，最上層常常都會有一些藝術展覽，且千萬別錯過通往塔頂鐘樓的免費導覽(全英文)，如果沒預約是無法自行上去的，可以直接在櫃台預約，時間到了會有一位員工帶你上去並做導覽，會介紹市政廳的歷史，還有鐘樓的一些故事等等，時間大約 10~15 分鐘。

市政廳的美麗夜景

  布里斯本長廊 Brisbane Arcade

布里斯本長廊商場建立於 1923 年，位於皇后街購物中心內，是一個歷史悠久的購物商場，也是目前布里斯本最古老的購物拱廊，於 1992 年被登錄於昆士蘭文化遺產。布里斯本長廊保有了歷史氛圍，裏面有著許多精品小店，包含藝術、時尚，或是珠寶販售的店家。

  • 地址：Brisbane Arcade, 160 Queen St, Brisbane City QLD 4000
  • 營業時間：09:00 ~ 17:00 ( 週日 10:00 ~ 16:00)
  • 交通方式：
    • 火車：抵達中央車站再步行 6 分鐘
    • 公車：Adelaide Street Stop 42 near Albert St
  • 官方網站：http://www.brisbanearcade.com.au/


  南岸公園 South Bank Parklands

南岸公園，可以說是布里斯本城市中的一片綠洲，在1988年是世界博覽會的展覽場地，現在轉變成為大型的市民親水公園。這裡有著大片的人造沙灘、游泳池、摩天輪，還有許多的餐廳與假日市集，昆士蘭博物館與藝術中心也都在南岸公園這裡，不論是平日假日，這裡都是當地居民休閒遊樂與享受生活的地方。

  • 地址：Clem Jones Promenade, South Brisbane QLD 4101
  • 營業時間：公園 24 hr
  • 交通方式：
    • 火車：抵達 South Brisbane 
    • 公車：Grey St at South Brisbane station
  • 官方網站：https://www.visitbrisbane.com.au/south-bank

布里斯本地標也在南岸公園這裡

小時侯常多次來訪布里斯本，由於住很近，以前沒事都會來南岸公園玩，南岸公園是印象最深刻的地方，景色與多年前相比並沒有變化太多。


  皇后街購物中心 Queen Street Mall

皇后街購物中心於 1982 年由伊莉莎白女皇二世開幕，經過多次擴建、翻新，成為現在的模樣，雖然稱為 Mall ，但是其實並不是一個百貨商場，他是一個位於皇后街的步行區域，這附近有許多的商店與百貨集中在這一區，有著 700 多家商店與六個購物中心。

皇后街購物中心的區域為一個長方形，這裡算是布里斯本最精華的購物區，不論服飾、要裝，或是紀念品與餐廳，都可以在這一區找到你想要的東西。

  • 地址：Queen St, Brisbane City QLD 4000澳洲
  • 營業時間：24 hr，視商家而定
  • 交通方式：
    • 火車：抵達中央車站再步行 8 分鐘
    • 公車：Adelaide Street Stop/ George Street Stop /Edward Street Stop

Myer 是皇后街購物中心內的一間大型百貨


  故事橋 Story Bridge

故事橋 Story Bridge 建造於1940年6月6日，橋身的96%建築材料都是取自澳洲當地，主要功用是連接布里斯本北部和南部。而為什麼會叫做「故事橋」，是因為橋的設計者是 John Douglas Story ，這座橋就是以他的名字命名的，才會叫做 Story Bridge。

由於故事橋是世界上唯一能攀爬的三座橋之一，每年也吸引了很多遊客來這裡體驗，雖然說是攀爬，但並不是那種需要手腳並用的辛苦攀爬，故事橋的攀爬體驗適是走樓梯上去橋上，觀賞橋上的景色。

更詳細的介紹可以參考：澳洲自由行 | 布里斯本市區景點篇 | 故事橋 Story Bridge | 世界上僅有的3座可攀爬橋樑之一 | Felons Barrel Hall 河岸啤酒餐廳

  • 地址：State Route 15, New Farm QLD 4169
  • 營業時間：24 hr
  • 交通方式：市區可搭乘 300, 306, 322, 370, 375, 379 到 Wickham Street Stop 下車再步行 10 分鐘
布里斯本龍柏動物園(旅遊網誌)

整理來說，布里斯本相較於珀斯與墨爾本，旅遊景點比較少一些，多了一些大城市的氣息，由於鄰近黃金海岸，大家通常也會把布里斯本與黃金海岸一起排在同一趟旅程。

title.$t: Australia Independent Travel | Brisbane City Attractions | Brisbane City Hall | Brisbane Arcade | South Bank Parklands | Queen Street Mall | Story Bridge

content.$t:
Brisbane is the capital of Queensland, Australia, and the state's most populous city. It sits close to the tourist hotspot of the Gold Coast, so many people pair the two cities together on one trip. The Brisbane River runs right through the city centre, so besides buses and trains, ferries are also an everyday means of transport for both residents and visitors — and one free ferry route is especially convenient for travellers.

List of city attractions:

  • Brisbane City Hall
  • Brisbane Arcade
  • South Bank Parklands
  • Queen Street Mall
  • Story Bridge

  Brisbane City Hall

The most iconic landmark in central Brisbane is Brisbane City Hall, located on King George Square. Besides serving as the offices of the City Council, it was listed on the National Heritage register in 1978 and is considered one of Brisbane's most beautiful buildings. At the time it was built, Brisbane City Hall was also the tallest building in the city.

  • Address: 64 Adelaide St, Brisbane City QLD 4000
  • Opening hours: 08:00 ~ 17:00 (from 09:00 on holidays)
  • Getting there:
    • Train: arrive at Central Station, then a 5-minute walk
    • Bus: Ann Street Stop at City Hall
  • Official website: http://www.brisbane.qld.gov.au/


The lift inside City Hall leading up to the clock tower

At Brisbane City Hall, the top floor often hosts art exhibitions, and be sure not to miss the free guided tour (in English only) up to the clock tower. You can't go up on your own without a booking — just reserve at the front desk, and when your time comes a staff member will take you up and give you a tour, covering the history of City Hall and stories about the clock tower. It takes about 10–15 minutes.

The beautiful night view of City Hall

  Brisbane Arcade

Brisbane Arcade was built in 1923 and sits within the Queen Street Mall precinct. It's a shopping arcade with a long history — in fact the oldest surviving shopping arcade in Brisbane — and it was added to the Queensland Heritage Register in 1992. Brisbane Arcade retains its historic atmosphere and is home to many boutique shops selling art, fashion and jewellery.

  • Address: Brisbane Arcade, 160 Queen St, Brisbane City QLD 4000
  • Opening hours: 09:00 ~ 17:00 (Sunday 10:00 ~ 16:00)
  • Getting there:
    • Train: arrive at Central Station, then a 6-minute walk
    • Bus: Adelaide Street Stop 42 near Albert St
  • Official website: http://www.brisbanearcade.com.au/


  South Bank Parklands

South Bank Parklands could be called an oasis in the middle of Brisbane. It was the site of the 1988 World Expo and has since been transformed into a large waterfront public park. There's a big man-made beach, swimming pools, a Ferris wheel, plus plenty of restaurants and weekend markets. The Queensland Museum and the arts centre are also here at South Bank. Weekday or weekend, this is where locals come to relax and enjoy life.

  • Address: Clem Jones Promenade, South Brisbane QLD 4101
  • Opening hours: park open 24 hr
  • Getting there:
    • Train: arrive at South Brisbane 
    • Bus: Grey St at South Brisbane station
  • Official website: https://www.visitbrisbane.com.au/south-bank

The Brisbane sign landmark is also here at South Bank

I visited Brisbane many times as a child, and since we lived nearby I'd often come to South Bank Parklands with nothing particular to do. South Bank is the place I remember most vividly, and the scenery hasn't changed all that much compared with years ago.


  Queen Street Mall

Queen Street Mall was opened in 1982 by Queen Elizabeth II and, after several expansions and refurbishments, has become what it is today. Although it's called a "Mall", it isn't actually a department store complex — it's a pedestrian precinct along Queen Street, where a large number of shops and department stores are concentrated, with over 700 stores and six shopping centres.

The Queen Street Mall area forms a rectangle and is considered the very heart of Brisbane's shopping district. Whether it's clothing, formal wear, souvenirs or restaurants, you can find whatever you're after in this area.

  • Address: Queen St, Brisbane City QLD 4000, Australia
  • Opening hours: 24 hr, depending on individual stores
  • Getting there:
    • Train: arrive at Central Station, then an 8-minute walk
    • Bus: Adelaide Street Stop / George Street Stop / Edward Street Stop

Myer is a large department store within Queen Street Mall


  Story Bridge

Story Bridge was completed on 6 June 1940, with 96% of its construction materials sourced locally in Australia. Its main purpose is to connect the northern and southern sides of Brisbane. As for why it's called the "Story Bridge" — it's named after John Douglas Story, the public servant behind the project, hence the name Story Bridge.

Since Story Bridge is one of only three bridges in the world you can climb, it draws many visitors every year. Despite the word "climb", it isn't a strenuous hands-and-feet scramble — the Story Bridge climb experience involves walking up stairs onto the bridge to take in the views from the top.

For a more detailed write-up, see: Australia Independent Travel | Brisbane City Attractions | Story Bridge | One of Only 3 Climbable Bridges in the World | Felons Barrel Hall Riverside Beer Restaurant

  • Address: State Route 15, New Farm QLD 4169
  • Opening hours: 24 hr
  • Getting there: from the city centre, take bus 300, 306, 322, 370, 375 or 379 to Wickham Street Stop, then walk 10 minutes
Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary, Brisbane (travel blog post)

All in all, compared with Perth and Melbourne, Brisbane has somewhat fewer tourist attractions and more of a big-city feel. Since it's close to the Gold Coast, most people combine Brisbane and the Gold Coast into the same trip.

content.$t:
故事橋 Story Bridge 

布里斯本市區的景點，相較於珀斯或是墨爾本又再更少一點，故事橋接近 Fortitude Valley 這一區，是一座跨越布里斯班河的懸臂橋，連接布里斯本北部和南部。而故事橋最特別的，是全世界只有3座可供遊客攀爬的橋梁之一，如果有興趣的話，在 KKday 或是 Klook 上都有攀爬故事橋的行程可以購買。

  • 地址：State Route 15, New Farm QLD 4169
  • 交通：市區可搭乘 300, 306, 322, 370, 375, 379 到 Wickham Street Stop 下車再步行 10 分鐘



🌉 故事橋

故事橋 Story Bridge 建造於1940年6月6日，橋身的96%建築材料都是取自澳洲當地，主要功用是連接布里斯本北部和南部。而為什麼會叫做「故事橋」，是因為橋的設計者是 John Douglas Story ，這座橋就是以他的名字命名的，才會叫做 Story Bridge。

下方河岸旁的 Felons Barrel Hall

攀爬體驗

https://www.kkday.com/zh-tw/product/148907

由於故事橋是世界上唯一能攀爬的三座橋之一，每年也吸引了很多遊客來這裡體驗，雖然說是攀爬，但並不是那種需要手腳並用的辛苦攀爬，故事橋的攀爬體驗適是走樓梯上去橋上，觀賞橋上的景色。

  • kkday: https://www.kkday.com/zh-tw/product/148907
  • klook: https://www.klook.com/zh-TW/activity/6566

從河岸旁觀看故事橋

🍺 Felons Barrel Hall

Felons Barrel Hall 是啤酒釀酒廠 Felons Brewing Co. 在故事橋旁、布里斯本河河畔旁開的一家啤酒餐廳，由於他的地點很不錯，可以直接在戶外座位欣賞夜晚的故事橋，所以一到了晚上都會有蠻多人潮來這間餐廳用餐與喝酒，整個餐廳的區域其實非常的大，不太會找不到位置，只是河岸邊的位置很早就會都坐滿人。

我們這次抵達故事橋的時候是下午，不過因為也沒有特別安排其他行程，就決定直接在這裡喝一杯，以及傍晚在這裡用餐。



menu


點餐方式可以直接掃座位前面的 QRcode 線上點餐，點完餐就可以直接信用卡刷卡了，完全不用走過去櫃檯點餐，接著服務生就會把食物與酒水送到你的位置上。



在線上點一杯 Gin & Tonic 也可以直接在點餐網站上面選好自己想要的客製化。

Art of Booze Gin & Tonic ($13)

Felons Margarita Sour Beer ($9)

  炸雞與綠咖哩飯


食物的話就普普通通，不用期待太高，不過可以在河岸邊可以從下午、日落，一直到夜晚，欣賞布里斯本河與故事橋的景色。最後面接近碼頭的地方，還有一區懶骨頭座位區，可以很舒適地坐在這，喝上一杯啤酒，欣賞故事橋的夜景。

懶骨頭座位區


故事橋夜景

如果沒有要去攀爬故事橋，故事橋本身這個景點我自己覺得還好，如果沒有太多時間其實不需要特地跑過來看，因為他其實就是個會打燈的鐵橋。不過如果時間充裕，來到故事橋這裡，不妨放慢步調，可以坐在河岸邊的餐廳這裡休息喝上一杯。

title.$t: Australia Independent Travel | Brisbane City Attractions | Story Bridge | One of Only 3 Climbable Bridges in the World | Felons Barrel Hall Riverside Beer Restaurant

content.$t:
Story Bridge 

Brisbane's city-centre attractions are even fewer than those in Perth or Melbourne. Story Bridge sits close to the Fortitude Valley area — it's a cantilever bridge spanning the Brisbane River, connecting the north and south sides of the city. What makes Story Bridge really special is that it's one of only three bridges in the world that visitors can climb. If you're interested, climbing tours are available for purchase on both KKday and Klook.

  • Address: State Route 15, New Farm QLD 4169
  • Getting there: From the city, take bus 300, 306, 322, 370, 375 or 379 to the Wickham Street Stop, then walk about 10 minutes



🌉 Story Bridge

Story Bridge was built on 6 June 1940, and 96% of its construction materials were sourced locally within Australia. Its main purpose is to link the northern and southern parts of Brisbane. As for why it's called "Story Bridge" — the bridge's designer was John Douglas Story, and the bridge was named after him, hence the name Story Bridge.

Felons Barrel Hall down by the riverside

The Climb Experience

https://www.kkday.com/zh-tw/product/148907

Since Story Bridge is one of only three climbable bridges in the world, it draws plenty of visitors every year. Although it's called a "climb," it isn't the kind of strenuous hands-and-feet scramble you might imagine — the Story Bridge climb experience is really about walking up a staircase onto the bridge and taking in the views from up top.

  • kkday: https://www.kkday.com/zh-tw/product/148907
  • klook: https://www.klook.com/zh-TW/activity/6566

Story Bridge viewed from the riverbank

🍺 Felons Barrel Hall

Felons Barrel Hall is a beer restaurant opened by the brewery Felons Brewing Co. right beside Story Bridge on the banks of the Brisbane River. Thanks to its great location — you can admire Story Bridge at night straight from the outdoor seating — the place gets pretty busy in the evenings with people eating and drinking. The venue is actually very large, so you're unlikely to be left without a seat; it's just that the riverside spots fill up early.

We arrived at Story Bridge in the afternoon, and since we hadn't planned anything else, we decided to just have a drink here and then stay on for dinner in the early evening.



menu


To order, just scan the QR code at your table and order online. Once you're done, you can pay directly by credit card — no need to walk over to a counter at all. A server will then bring your food and drinks straight to your table.



When ordering a Gin & Tonic online, you can also pick your own customisations right on the ordering site.

Art of Booze Gin & Tonic ($13)

Felons Margarita Sour Beer ($9)

  Fried chicken and green curry rice


The food is just so-so — don't set your expectations too high — but you do get to sit by the river from afternoon through sunset and into the night, taking in views of the Brisbane River and Story Bridge. At the far end near the wharf there's also a beanbag seating area where you can lounge comfortably with a beer in hand and enjoy Story Bridge lit up at night.

The beanbag seating area


Story Bridge at night

If you're not doing the bridge climb, I personally think Story Bridge itself is just okay as an attraction — if you're short on time there's really no need to make a special trip out here, because at the end of the day it's simply an illuminated steel bridge. That said, if you have time to spare, it's worth slowing down when you come to Story Bridge and settling in at the riverside restaurant for a relaxing drink.

title.$t: 澳洲自由行 | 布里斯本市區住宿篇 | Meriton Suites Herschel Street, Brisbane | 澳洲連鎖酒店公寓 | 高樓層遠眺布里斯本夜景

content.$t:
布里斯本是我們這次澳洲行的最後一站，會在布里斯本住上四個晚上，找住宿一樣想方便洗衣、有簡單廚房，且因為最後可能會常常去熱鬧區域採買，想找地點不要離皇后街購物中心太遠的地方。最後綜合考量，挑了這間位於 Roma Street Station 對面的 Meriton Suites Herschel Street, Brisbane。

Meriton Suites 是一個澳洲的連鎖飯店集團，目前在澳洲各地都有不同的分館，光是布里斯本其實就有兩間，一間是我們住的位於 Herschel Street，另一間在 Adelaide Street，靠近故事橋，離熱鬧區域就稍遠一點了。

📜  資訊

  • 入住天數：四晚 (週一～週四)
  • 入住房型：單臥室奢華套房 (不含早餐)
  • 住宿價格：台幣 $17,555 (平均一晚 4400)
  • 付款方式：可刷卡
  • 飯店地址：43 Herschel St, Brisbane City QLD 4000
  • 聯絡電話：+61739998000
  • 訂房網站：https://www.booking.com/hotel/au/meriton-serviced-apartments-brisbane-herschel-street.zh-tw.html?aid=8003516
  • 官方網站：https://www.meritonsuites.com.au/our-hotels/qld/brisbane/herschel-street/


📍 地點位置

正如飯店的命名一般，Meriton Suites Herschel Street, Brisbane 就是位在 Herschel Street 上的飯店，這裡距離交通轉運大站 Roma Street Station 只隔一條馬路，步行不到五分鐘就到了，對於要前往龍柏動物園 Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary，或是從機場過來都十分方便。

走到市中心的皇后街購物中心與市政廳也只要不到 10 分鐘，隔壁一條路 3 分鐘步行路程就有一間超市 Woolworths，且要到南岸公園，下一條巷子裡就可以走 Kurilpa Bridge 過河到對岸去，當初看到這地點就覺得蠻不錯的。

🏢 飯店環境

寬敞的大廳與接待櫃檯

飯店的一樓一進門就是一個很簡單的大廳與接待櫃檯，後方就是通往樓層的電梯了，由於樓層非常的多，電梯也有區分往 25 樓層以下的房間在左邊的電梯，25 樓到 74 樓層的房間在右邊電梯。

而電梯除了大廳與一樓的游泳池健身房之外，其餘是沒有樓層按鈕的，只要刷房卡後就會自動分派電梯，只會到你的樓層，這點在安全性上也很不錯。


🛏  房間環境


抵達房間樓層後，外面走廊簡簡單單，如同一般的公寓一樣，沒有太多其他的裝潢與設計。而 Meriton Suites Herschel Street, Brisbane 總共分為五種房型，不同的房型也對應到不同的樓層：
  • Standard Suite: 可住2人，樓層1~10
  • 1 Bedroom Luxury Suite: 可住2人，樓層11~21
  • 2 Bedroom Luxury Suite: 可住4人，樓層22~24
  • 2 Bedroom Altitude Suite: 可住4人，樓層65~73
  • 3 Bedroom Altitude Suite: 可住6人，樓層65~74
一進門可以看到寬廣的客廳

我們這次選擇的是 1 Bedroom Luxury Suite，但似乎是被分配到 22 樓的 2 Bedroom Luxury Suite，可是一間房間被鎖起來不能使用，不過整體的空間很大。由於是在高樓層，一打開也可以看到布里斯本市區的夜景，不過我們這間房間剛好是面向車站，很可惜的沒有正對著河景。

布里斯本夜景

電視可以直接透過 Chromecast 連結

廚房的設施也非常的齊全，除了有一個大中島與大冰箱之外，也有完整的瓦斯爐、烤箱、微波爐、洗碗機，且各式餐具、杯子也都很齊全，幾乎需要的東西都有了。

客廳旁的開放式廚房

中島下面有洗碗機


膠囊咖啡機

微波爐與碗盤

齊全的杯子

有附上兩顆洗碗機清潔錠，用完可以再跟櫃台要

洗衣機與烘衣機

白天採光也很好，不需開燈就很亮

衛浴與廁所


衛浴與廁所是乾濕分離，浴室與廁所也是直接分開兩間，空間大小都蠻足夠的，小缺點是浴缸上那片擋水玻璃偏小，淋浴的時候還是很容易會把水噴到浴缸外面。


備品的部分




隔音方面，在房間內的隔音不錯，四個晚上下來晚上睡覺都沒有聽到其他房間的聲音，不過由於大門的門縫其實算大，所以在客廳可以聽到其他間房小孩的哭聲。

另外，目前 Meriton Suites Herschel Street, Brisbane 沒有提供每天的 housekeeping 服務，而且有 housekeeping 那天也只有幫你倒垃圾跟鋪床而已，其餘的備品不會幫你補充，有用完的話要再跟櫃台要。

不過整體住起來，不論是硬體設備還是空間大小，都還算蠻舒適的，加上地點方便，讓我們可以每天在布里斯本逛完可以很快地回到房間休息，設備充足的廚房還可以讓我們自己準備晚餐來吃。

content.$t:
Brisbane was the final stop on this Australia trip, and we stayed here for four nights. As with our other stays, we wanted somewhere with easy laundry and a simple kitchen, and since we expected to do a lot of shopping in the busy areas towards the end, we also wanted a location not too far from Queen Street Mall. After weighing everything up, we picked Meriton Suites Herschel Street, Brisbane, right across from Roma Street Station.

Meriton Suites is an Australian hotel chain with properties all over the country. Brisbane alone has two: the one we stayed at on Herschel Street, and another on Adelaide Street near the Story Bridge, which is a little further from the lively part of the city.

📜  Information

  • Length of stay: four nights (Monday–Thursday)
  • Room type: 1 Bedroom Luxury Suite (breakfast not included)
  • Price: NT$17,555 (about NT$4,400 per night)
  • Payment: credit cards accepted
  • Address: 43 Herschel St, Brisbane City QLD 4000
  • Phone: +61739998000
  • Booking site: https://www.booking.com/hotel/au/meriton-serviced-apartments-brisbane-herschel-street.zh-tw.html?aid=8003516
  • Official website: https://www.meritonsuites.com.au/our-hotels/qld/brisbane/herschel-street/


📍 Location

Just as the name suggests, Meriton Suites Herschel Street, Brisbane sits on Herschel Street, only one road away from the major transport hub Roma Street Station — less than a five-minute walk. That makes it very convenient for heading to Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary, or for arriving from the airport.

It's also under 10 minutes on foot to Queen Street Mall and City Hall in the city centre, and there's a Woolworths supermarket just one street over, about a three-minute walk. To reach South Bank Parklands, you can take the Kurilpa Bridge in the next lane over and cross the river. The location looked great to us from the start.

🏢 Hotel Facilities

The spacious lobby and reception desk

Step through the ground-floor entrance and you're in a simple lobby with the reception desk; behind it are the lifts up to the guest floors. Because the building has so many floors, the lifts are split: rooms below level 25 use the left-hand lifts, and rooms from level 25 to 74 use the right-hand ones.

Apart from the lobby and the ground-floor pool and gym, the lifts have no floor buttons at all. You simply tap your room card and a lift is assigned automatically, taking you only to your own floor — a nice touch for security.


🛏  The Room


Once you reach your floor, the corridor is plain and simple, much like an ordinary apartment building, without much extra decoration or design. Meriton Suites Herschel Street, Brisbane has five room types in total, and each type corresponds to different floors:
  • Standard Suite: sleeps 2, floors 1–10
  • 1 Bedroom Luxury Suite: sleeps 2, floors 11–21
  • 2 Bedroom Luxury Suite: sleeps 4, floors 22–24
  • 2 Bedroom Altitude Suite: sleeps 4, floors 65–73
  • 3 Bedroom Altitude Suite: sleeps 6, floors 65–74
A spacious living room greets you at the door

We booked the 1 Bedroom Luxury Suite, but seemed to have been assigned a 2 Bedroom Luxury Suite on the 22nd floor — with one of the bedrooms locked off and unavailable. Either way, the space was very generous. Being high up, we could see Brisbane's night skyline as soon as we opened the door, although our room happened to face the station, so sadly we didn't get a direct river view.

Brisbane by night

The TV can be cast to directly via Chromecast

The kitchen is very well equipped: besides a large island bench and a big fridge, there's a full gas cooktop, oven, microwave and dishwasher, plus a complete set of cutlery and glassware. Pretty much everything you'd need is there.

The open kitchen beside the living room

There's a dishwasher under the island


Capsule coffee machine

Microwave and dishware

A full set of glasses

Two dishwasher tablets are provided; ask reception for more once you've used them

Washing machine and dryer

Great natural light during the day — no need to turn on the lights

Bathroom and Toilet


The bathroom has separate wet and dry areas, and the bathroom and toilet are in two separate rooms, both reasonably spacious. One small drawback: the splash panel over the bathtub is a bit small, so it's easy to spray water outside the tub while showering.


The toiletries provided




As for noise, the soundproofing inside the bedroom is good — over four nights we never heard anything from other rooms while sleeping. However, the gap under the front door is fairly wide, so in the living room you can hear children crying in other apartments.

Also, Meriton Suites Herschel Street, Brisbane currently doesn't offer daily housekeeping, and on the days housekeeping does come, they only take out the rubbish and make the bed — they won't restock your amenities, so if you run out you'll need to ask reception.

Overall, though, the stay was comfortable in terms of both the facilities and the amount of space. Combined with the convenient location, we could get back to the room to rest quickly after a day out in Brisbane, and the well-equipped kitchen even let us cook our own dinners.

title.$t: 嘉義住宿 | 大山自在民宿 | 在山林內的古三合院住一晚 | 龍眼林製茶廠 | 揉茶體驗 DIY

content.$t:
大山自在民宿位於梅山上，是個非常有特色的民宿，這裡的房間是把超過 50 年的三合院改建成民宿。民宿老闆除了民宿，也有自己經營茶廠，因此在民宿這裡也有揉茶 DIY 體驗，可以自己動手揉茶，自己揉出屬於你自己的茶。

除了可以住在古色古香的傳統三合院內，近距離接觸大自然之外，附近還有竹林秘境與美麗的茶園，很適合來這裡住上一碗，體驗大自然。

📜  資訊

  • 入住天數：一晚 (2023-09-08~2023-09-09)
  • 入住房型：全房型，包含雙人房、四人房與六人房
  • 民宿地址：603嘉義縣梅山鄉龍眼林9鄰3號 
  • 聯絡電話：05-2571123

📍 地點位置

大山自在位於嘉義梅山上，上山後要先經過太平三十六彎、太平雲梯與太平老街後，才會抵達海拔超過一千公尺山上的民宿，除了自行開車外應該沒有其他任何方法可以抵達。這裡雖然也屬於阿里山支脈的一部分，但是由於不太算是觀光熱區，也可以說是個遠離喧鬧人潮的淨土。

🏠 民宿環境與房間

古色古香的三合院走道

中間三間房共用入口

大山自在民宿是由傳統建築改建而成，保留了原來建築的風味，總共有五間房間，分別可以住雙人、四人、六人不等。房間內樸實簡單，沒有電視也沒有冷氣，其中中間的三間房間，還會一起共用一個小客廳。

中間共用的小客廳


有小閣樓的六人房

四人房

雙人房

另一間空間比較小的雙人房

民宿內的每一間房間都是雅房，沒有自己的衛浴設備，衛浴與廁所在房間外面。而房間內雖然沒有冷氣，但由於是在高山上，夜晚的山上其實蠻涼的。

位於走廊盡頭的廁所與衛浴

這裡也有飲水機與曬衣桿可以使用

這裡約有數間廁所與衛浴提供房客共同使用，沒有提供一次性的備品，有提供沐浴乳與洗髮精，與吹風機提供使用。




🌱 龍眼林茶廠/揉茶體驗 DIY 

民宿的另一區，就是平常龍眼林茶廠製茶的區域，也是 DIY 揉茶體驗的地方。住宿在大山自在民宿，可以一起選擇 DIY 揉茶體驗 (300/人)，最後可以拿到兩包自己揉捻出來的茶葉，是個很有趣好玩的體驗。


所謂的「揉捻」，是利用機械或手的力量，使茶菁轉動相互磨擦，造成部分的茶芽組織受到破壞，茶芽汁液流出，黏附在茶芽表面，而不同的力道、溫度或是平均度，都會對於最後茶葉成品有非常大且直接的影響。

開始揉捻後不久的茶葉

由於整個揉捻過程至少要超過兩小時，過程中民宿主人還會泡不同的茶讓大家來品嚐，在稍作休息之餘，可以品嚐茶廠內好喝的茶。



揉捻完成後大家的茶葉

揉捻完成後，就會靜置一段時間讓它發酵，最後等到用完晚餐後，晚間我們回到民宿的時候，才開始做烘茶的動作。


烘茶過程中，陣陣的茶香就會撲鼻而來，整間茶廠都會充滿了茶香味，在夜晚寧靜的山林中聞著陣陣茶香，讓人身心放鬆。最後各自裝袋，一包屬於自己的茶就完成囉！


在裝袋前還有一個小步驟，就是讓大家來盲測誰揉出來的茶好喝！

在一樣的茶葉量、一樣的水量、溫度、時間，品嚐大家揉捻出來的茶當中細細的差異，可以感受到有的會偏澀，有的清淡，有的茶感重一點，都跟下午揉捻的時間、力道、手的溫度有著深厚的關係。

民宿還有幾隻野貓，會在附近走來走去

🍽️ 早餐

早餐用餐的地方是在旁邊的主棟，早餐很豐盛，都是自行準備的中式早餐，如果有素食同行者老闆也會準備全素的早餐喔。


可以在這裡品茶與老闆聊天

🌄 周遭環境與風景

從民宿看到的日出 (可惜當天雲層有點多)

除了大山自在民宿本身之外，由於地處梅山山上，天氣好的時候隔天一定要起床看看日出，直接打開房門，在民宿的空地就可以直接看到美麗的日出景色了。

民宿本身附近都是茶園，山巒搭配茶園的美景，這景色也是隨時隨地都可以在民宿看到。

旁邊還有一個小竹林道，也可以趁著早晨到竹林內走走，體驗當下的寧靜與大自然。

有日本感的竹林道

隔天一大早，當好遇上茶廠曬茶葉的時刻，整個三合院的廣場就會被直接拿來使用，鋪上一整片翠綠色的新鮮茶葉，這景色也是住在都市的我們很不容易看到的。




在民宿門口守候的貓咪們

住宿的房間由於是有歷史的三合院改建，雖然沒有很新，但乾淨度不錯，由於在深山內可能也避免不了會有一些些蟲類出現在房間內，且隔音大概是唯一缺點吧，基本上幾乎是等於沒隔音。

不過大山自在民宿很適合想要暫時遠離都市喧囂，來山林內度假的旅客，老闆與老闆娘很親切熱情，手工揉茶體驗也是很有趣且學到不少，還是蠻推薦可以來住上一晚！

  • 台灣旅遊 | 台灣住宿清單
