title.$t: Chiayi Stay | Dashan Zizai B&B | A Night in a Century-Old Courtyard House in the Mountains | Longyanlin Tea Factory | Tea-Rolling DIY Experience

content.$t:
Dashan Zizai B&B sits up on Meishan Mountain and is a truly distinctive guesthouse — the rooms here are converted from a traditional three-sided courtyard house (sanheyuan) that is over 50 years old. Besides running the B&B, the owner also runs his own tea factory, so guests can take part in a DIY tea-rolling experience and roll their very own tea by hand.

Apart from staying inside the charming traditional courtyard house and getting up close with nature, there is also a hidden bamboo forest and beautiful tea plantations nearby — a great place to spend a night and soak up the natural surroundings.

📜  Information

  • Length of stay: one night (2023-09-08~2023-09-09)
  • Room types booked: all room types, including double, quad and six-person rooms
  • Address: No. 3, Neighborhood 9, Longyanlin, Meishan Township, Chiayi County 603 
  • Phone: 05-2571123

📍 Location

Dashan Zizai is located up in Meishan, Chiayi. Driving up the mountain you first pass the Taiping 36 Bends, the Taiping Suspension Bridge and Taiping Old Street before reaching the guesthouse, which sits at over 1,000 meters above sea level — there is basically no way to get here other than by car. Although this area is part of the Alishan range, it isn't really a tourist hotspot, so it feels like a peaceful haven far from the crowds.

🏠 The Guesthouse and Rooms

The charming old corridor of the courtyard house

The three middle rooms share one entrance

Dashan Zizai B&B was converted from a traditional building and retains the character of the original structure. There are five rooms in total, sleeping two, four or six people. The rooms are plain and simple, with no TV and no air conditioning, and the three rooms in the middle also share a small living room.

The shared little living room in the middle


The six-person room with a small loft

The quad room

The double room

Another, slightly smaller double room

All the rooms here are without en-suite facilities; the bathrooms and toilets are outside the rooms. And although there is no air conditioning in the rooms, being high in the mountains, the nights are actually quite cool.

The toilets and bathrooms at the end of the corridor

There is also a water dispenser and clothes-drying racks for guests

There are several toilets and bathrooms shared among guests. No disposable toiletries are provided, but body wash, shampoo and hair dryers are available.




🌱 Longyanlin Tea Factory / DIY Tea-Rolling Experience 

Another part of the property is where the Longyanlin Tea Factory normally processes tea — and it's also where the DIY tea-rolling experience takes place. When staying at Dashan Zizai you can add on the DIY tea-rolling experience (NT$300 per person), and in the end you take home two packs of tea you rolled yourself. It's a really fun and interesting experience.


"Rolling" means using machinery or the hands to make the tea leaves tumble and rub against each other, breaking down some of the leaf tissue so that the juices seep out and coat the surface of the leaves. Different pressure, temperature and evenness all have a huge, direct impact on the finished tea.

The leaves shortly after rolling begins

Since the whole rolling process takes at least two hours, the owner brews different teas along the way for everyone to taste, so you can enjoy the factory's delicious teas while taking a break.



Everyone's tea leaves after rolling

Once the rolling is done, the leaves are left to rest and oxidize for a while. Only after dinner, when we returned to the guesthouse in the evening, did the roasting begin.


During roasting, waves of tea fragrance fill the air and the whole factory is scented with tea. Breathing in that aroma in the quiet mountain night is deeply relaxing. Finally everyone bags up their own tea — and your very own pack of tea is complete!


Before bagging there's one more little step: a blind tasting to see whose hand-rolled tea tastes best!

With the same amount of leaves, the same amount of water, temperature and steeping time, you can taste the subtle differences between everyone's tea — some slightly astringent, some light, some with a stronger body — all closely tied to the time, pressure and hand temperature during the afternoon's rolling.

There are also a few stray cats wandering around the guesthouse

🍽️ Breakfast

Breakfast is served in the main building next door. It's a generous, home-made Chinese-style breakfast, and if anyone in your group is vegetarian the owner will also prepare a fully vegetarian breakfast.


You can sip tea and chat with the owner here

🌄 The Surroundings and Scenery

Sunrise seen from the guesthouse (a pity there was a bit too much cloud that day)

Beyond the guesthouse itself, since it sits high in the Meishan mountains, you really should get up to watch the sunrise the next morning if the weather is good — just open your door and you can see the beautiful sunrise right from the open ground of the guesthouse.

The guesthouse is surrounded by tea plantations, and the sight of rolling mountains paired with tea fields can be enjoyed from the property at any time.

There is also a small bamboo forest trail beside it — a lovely place for a morning stroll to enjoy the quiet and the nature around you.

A bamboo path with a Japanese feel

Early the next morning we happened to catch the tea factory sun-withering its leaves: the entire courtyard plaza is put to use, spread with a carpet of bright green fresh tea leaves — a scene city dwellers like us rarely get to see.




Cats keeping watch at the guesthouse entrance

Because the rooms are converted from a historic courtyard house, they aren't exactly new, but they are reasonably clean. Being deep in the mountains, the occasional insect in the room is unavoidable, and the sound insulation is probably the only real drawback — there is essentially none.

That said, Dashan Zizai B&B is perfect for travelers who want to escape the noise of the city for a while and unwind in the mountains. The owner and his wife are warm and friendly, and the hand-rolled tea experience is both fun and educational. I'd definitely recommend spending a night here!

title.$t: 澳洲自由行 | 布里斯本郊區行程 | 龍柏動物園 Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary | 世界上第一個無尾熊保護區

content.$t:
微笑的無尾熊

說到澳洲的動物，聯想到的一定是無尾熊與袋鼠，而位於布里斯本的龍柏動物園，成立於 1927 年，是世界上歷史最悠久、也是規模最大的無尾熊保護區。這次澳洲行一路玩到最後到了布里斯本，已經沒有安排什麼行程了，主要在這裡悠哉晃晃與購物，而唯一一個行程就是到龍柏動物園看無尾熊與餵袋鼠。

現在澳洲法規目前只有昆士蘭州可以合法近距離的接觸無尾熊，所以布里斯本的龍柏動物園，是少數幾個還可以體驗抱無尾熊的地方了。

  • 地址：708 Jesmond Rd, Fig Tree Pocket QLD 4069
  • 門票：https://ecom.roller.app/lonepinekoalasanctuary/newprogressivecheckout/en/home
  • 營業時間：09:00 – 17:00
  • 官方網站：https://lonepinekoalasanctuary.com/
  • 聯絡電話：+61733781366

🚃 地點交通資訊

Roma Street Bus Station 上車的月台

龍柏動物園距離布里斯本市區約15公里，除了自駕以外，從布里斯本市區要抵達龍柏動物園主要利用搭乘公車，距離也不遠，車程 35min 就可以抵達。

如果想先透過火車，也可以選擇搭乘火車到 Toowong station 再轉公車，不過如果要從市區出發，這樣不會比較快 & 方便，最後還是要轉搭一樣的公車，不如直接從市區搭乘公車過來會比較方便。

另外還有搭乘船的方式，市中心的遊客中心有販售套票，有興趣的話可以去瞭解看看。

龍柏動物園區的公車站牌

搭乘 430 公車，市區上車地點可以是 Roma Street Bus Station 或是更接近市中心的 Queen Street Station，而最後一站就是龍柏動物園了，到時候回程上車也是從一樣的地方候車。

🏞️ 龍柏動物園園區

看到這個無尾熊雕像就是入口了！

入口處並不大，直接在這裡購票後就可以入園，也因為只有一個購票處，同時比較多遊客進來的時候就會需要在這裡等待一下，需要等前面的人一組一組購票，然後入園。另外如果要購買袋鼠飼料，也要在這裡就直接購買喔！進去裡面就沒有地方可以買了。(一包 2 澳元)

等待購票與入園

龍柏動物園的園區並不算大大，主要分成三大區(我們去的時候還沒有最左邊這區)，園區內以無尾熊和袋鼠為最大宗的動物，我們花最多時間的就是在無尾熊與袋鼠這兩區。

龍柏動物園地圖，如果圖片失效請到：https://lonepinekoalasanctuary.com/interactive-map/

從上面地圖的右半部，可以看到每天固定活動的時程，包含餵食野生鸚鵡、無尾熊解說、抱無尾熊等等的活動都有固定時間，有些活動需要另外購票、有些活動是免費的，只要時間到的時候到那個地方就可以參加。

有哪些活動可以參考官方的介紹：

  • https://ecom.roller.app/lonepinekoalasanctuary/newprogressivecheckout/en/products

🦜 Wild Lorikeet Feeding

The rainbow lorikeet 是澳洲的一種彩虹鸚鵡，這個活動員工會準備好餵食的飼料湯，然後解說完會倒進去每一個可以拿起來的容器裡面，遊客就可以拿在手上，鸚鵡們會爭先恐後的飛過來吃。


鸚鵡非常的多，不但吃得很快還會亂噴，還會直接飛到遊客的頭上 🤣 ，是蠻有趣的體驗，不過只有一大早跟最後兩個場次，早上場次遊客應該人會少一點，可以抓準時間來體驗看看。


🐨 Koala Talk and Hold a Koala

Koala Talk 與 Hold a Koala 是在同一個區域，有事先購票預定的遊客，可以在時間到的時候，到這個櫃檯來準備 Hold a Koala 的活動，主要是可以讓遊客抱著無尾熊拍照。

而 Koala Talk 是在旁邊的開放區域，員工會講解無尾熊的生態還有這個保育區關於無尾熊的一些故事，這個活動是免費參加的，只要時間到了過來找位置或是站在旁邊就可以聽囉。

🦘袋鼠區

袋鼠區其實就是一大片隔離出來給袋鼠居住的草原，只要有購買園區的袋鼠飼料，就可以在這裡餵食袋鼠們，通過這個入口後，就會看到非常非常多的袋鼠了。

非常多在休息的袋鼠

草原範圍蠻大的，旁邊也都還有規劃袋鼠休息區，只要在休息區內的袋鼠就不可以打擾他們。另外，這裡也有好幾種不同種類的袋鼠，大家都一起生活在這片大草原上，只要拿著飼料，肚子餓的袋鼠自己就會靠進過來了。



不妨可以早一點抵達園區就去先去餵袋鼠，因為有看到別人說下午後可能袋鼠都被遊客餵飽了。不過我們這天早上和下午的時候，袋鼠們都還是很捧場都會來吃。


🍽️ 餐廳與被無尾熊環繞的用餐區

龍柏動物園內只有兩間店有賣食物，一間是在入口外面的 Riverside Cafe，另一間是園區內比較像是動物園餐飲部。裏面的食物基本上就是貴，口味可能也一般般，最經濟實惠的方式是自己帶食物到用餐區來吃，這次我們為了方便，就直接購買裏面的食物了。

用餐區是一個被無尾熊環繞的座位區！

用餐區是一個被無尾熊環繞的座位區，可以近距離邊看著無尾熊邊用餐。這裡的無尾熊可不是小貓兩三隻而已，而是非常的多，前面的位置都可以看到很多無尾熊在樹上。

開放式的用餐區

無尾熊非常的多！

各種無尾熊睡姿

你知道無尾熊上廁所會先到地上嗎？

整體來說蠻推薦的，這也是來到布里斯本大家的必備行程之一，如果有時間的話安排來一趟龍柏動物園吧，不只可以看到非常多的無尾熊，也可以與袋鼠們近距離接觸，都是來到澳洲一定要體驗的行程！

title.$t: Australia Independent Travel | Brisbane Suburban Day Trip | Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary | The World's First Koala Sanctuary

content.$t:
A smiling koala

When you think of Australian animals, koalas and kangaroos are surely the first to come to mind. Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary in Brisbane, founded in 1927, is the world's oldest and largest koala sanctuary. On this Australia trip, Brisbane was our final stop and we hadn't planned much of an itinerary — mostly just strolling around and shopping. The one activity we did plan was visiting Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary to see koalas and feed kangaroos.

Under current Australian regulations, Queensland is the only state where close contact with koalas is legal, so Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary in Brisbane is one of the few places where you can still experience holding a koala.

  • Address: 708 Jesmond Rd, Fig Tree Pocket QLD 4069
  • Tickets: https://ecom.roller.app/lonepinekoalasanctuary/newprogressivecheckout/en/home
  • Opening hours: 09:00 – 17:00
  • Official website: https://lonepinekoalasanctuary.com/
  • Phone: +61733781366

🚃 Getting There

The boarding platform at Roma Street Bus Station

Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary is about 15 km from downtown Brisbane. Other than driving yourself, the main way to get there from the city is by bus — it's not far, and the ride takes only about 35 minutes.

If you'd rather take the train first, you can ride to Toowong station and transfer to a bus. But if you're starting from the city centre, this isn't any faster or more convenient, since you end up transferring to the same bus anyway. It's simpler to just take the bus straight from the city.

There's also a river cruise option — the visitor centre downtown sells combo tickets, so check it out if you're interested.

The bus stop at Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary

Take bus 430; in the city you can board at Roma Street Bus Station or at Queen Street Station, which is closer to the centre. The last stop is Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary, and you catch the bus back from the same place.

🏞️ Inside Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary

When you see this koala statue, you've found the entrance!

The entrance area isn't very big. You buy your tickets right here and then head in. Since there's only one ticket counter, you may have to wait a bit when a lot of visitors arrive at once, as groups are served one by one before entering. Also, if you want kangaroo feed, buy it here — there's nowhere to buy it once you're inside! (AU$2 per bag)

Waiting to buy tickets and enter

The sanctuary isn't especially large and is mainly divided into three sections (the leftmost one hadn't opened yet when we visited). Koalas and kangaroos are by far the most numerous animals here, and those two areas are where we spent most of our time.

Map of Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary — if the image doesn't load, visit: https://lonepinekoalasanctuary.com/interactive-map/

On the right-hand side of the map above you can see the daily activity schedule, including wild lorikeet feeding, koala talks, holding a koala and more — all at set times. Some activities require a separate ticket and others are free; just show up at the right place when it's time.

For a full list of activities, check the official page:

  • https://ecom.roller.app/lonepinekoalasanctuary/newprogressivecheckout/en/products

🦜 Wild Lorikeet Feeding

The rainbow lorikeet is a colourful Australian parrot. For this activity, staff prepare a liquid feed and, after the talk, pour it into individual containers you can pick up and hold. The lorikeets then swoop in, jostling with one another to eat.


There are tons of lorikeets — they eat fast, splatter the feed everywhere, and will even land right on your head 🤣. It's a really fun experience. There are only two sessions, one first thing in the morning and one at the end of the day; the morning session tends to be less crowded, so time your visit accordingly.


🐨 Koala Talk and Hold a Koala

The Koala Talk and Hold a Koala take place in the same area. Visitors who have pre-booked can come to this counter at the appointed time for the Hold a Koala experience, where you get to hold a koala and have your photo taken.

The Koala Talk is held in the open area next to it, where staff explain koala ecology and share stories about the koalas in the sanctuary. This one is free — just show up when it starts and grab a seat or stand nearby to listen.

🦘 Kangaroo Area

The kangaroo area is essentially a large fenced-off grassland where the kangaroos live. As long as you've bought the sanctuary's kangaroo feed, you can feed them here. Once you pass through this entrance, you'll see kangaroos everywhere.

Lots of kangaroos resting

The grassland is quite spacious, with designated kangaroo rest areas along the sides — any kangaroo inside a rest area must not be disturbed. There are also several different kangaroo species all living together on this big meadow, and hungry ones will come right up to you as soon as you're holding feed.



It's worth arriving early and feeding the kangaroos first, since some people say the kangaroos are already full from visitors by the afternoon. That said, on our visit the kangaroos happily came over to eat both in the morning and the afternoon.


🍽️ Restaurants and a Dining Area Surrounded by Koalas

There are only two places selling food at Lone Pine: Riverside Cafe outside the entrance, and one inside the park that's more like a typical zoo food court. The food inside is basically just expensive and the taste is fairly average — the most economical option is to bring your own food to the dining area. This time, for convenience, we just bought food inside.

The dining area is a seating zone surrounded by koalas!

The dining area is a seating zone surrounded by koalas, so you can eat while watching them up close. And we're not talking about just a couple of koalas — there are loads of them, and from the seats up front you can see plenty perched in the trees.

The open-air dining area

So many koalas!

All kinds of koala sleeping poses

Did you know koalas climb down to the ground to go to the toilet?

Overall, I'd definitely recommend it — this is one of the must-do outings when visiting Brisbane. If you have the time, plan a trip to Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary. Not only will you see tons of koalas, you can also get up close with kangaroos — both essential Australian experiences!

title.$t: 澳洲自由行 | 布里斯本市區美食篇 | The Pancake Manor | 百年教堂內的 24 小時鬆餅老店

content.$t:
對於台灣人來說，隨處可見的 24 小時便利商店，24小時的店好像不是很稀奇，但你有看過開 24 小時的鬆餅店嗎？

在布里斯本市區，有一間在百年教堂建築內的鬆餅老店，與一般澳洲店家早早打烊不一樣，他竟然是一間 24 小時營業的鬆餅店，不論是早餐、午餐，或是半夜想要來吃宵夜的時候，就跟台灣 24 小時便利商店一樣一直都營業著！

  • 地址：18 Charlotte St, Brisbane City QLD 4000
  • 菜單：https://www.pancakemanor.com.au/menu-pancake-manor
  • 電話：+61732216433

📍地點與店內環境

The Pancake Manor 距離熱鬧的皇后接購物區不遠，座落在賭場附近，接近 Charlotte St 與 George St 的交界處。建築物前身是百年教堂 St Luke's Church of England, Brisbane，在 1904 年建立，直到 1979 年才被租下成為 The Pancake Manor，至今也是有了 40 多年的歷史。

教堂歷史：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/St_Luke's_Church_of_England,_Brisbane

由於身處教堂建築物內，在 The Pancake Manor 內用餐的體驗很特殊，光是坐在裡面都很有氣氛了。而除了百年歷史建築的教堂之外，24 小時營業是另一個非常大的特點！雖然我不是很了解究竟誰半夜還會想來吃鬆餅，但是在都很早關門的歐美國家裡面，這種 24 小時營業的餐廳真的是很少見到。

保留了教堂內部古色古香的裝潢氣氛

內部空間很大，座位也很多，有各種兩人、四人，或是多人的座位區，很適合三五好友的聚會。我們來的這天，有遇到一家人、朋友聚會，也有老師帶學生來用餐的。


座椅都很有教堂的氣氛

🍽️ 餐點

鮮奶油黑咖啡

由於是鬆餅店，主要的餐點當然就是鬆餅囉，除了很基本款的鬆餅配上奶油之外，還有各種鬆餅早午餐的組合，會搭配培根、薯餅等等這類的鹹食，或是澳洲餐廳基本款的漢堡、三明治，讓來用餐的顧客也有鹹食的選擇。


兩種不同的早午餐 set

口味的話我自己覺得是普普通通，鬆餅份量算多但有點乾，不需要有太多期待，如果想吃厲害的鬆餅可能有更多其他鬆餅店可以選擇。

不過這間價格不算太貴，店內裝潢氣氛又很特別，如果有來到布里斯本，想嚐鮮或是半夜肚子餓了不知道要去哪找食物，那可以考慮來看看這間 The Pancake Manor。

title.$t: Australia Independent Travel | Brisbane City Food | The Pancake Manor | A 24-Hour Pancake Institution Inside a Century-Old Church

content.$t:
For Taiwanese, 24-hour convenience stores are everywhere, so a shop that never closes hardly seems remarkable — but have you ever seen a pancake restaurant open 24 hours a day?

In central Brisbane there's a long-standing pancake restaurant housed inside a century-old church building. Unlike most Australian eateries, which close early, this one is actually open 24 hours a day. Breakfast, lunch, or a late-night supper craving — just like a Taiwanese 24-hour convenience store, it's always open!

  • Address: 18 Charlotte St, Brisbane City QLD 4000
  • Menu: https://www.pancakemanor.com.au/menu-pancake-manor
  • Phone: +61732216433

📍 Location & Interior

The Pancake Manor is not far from the bustling Queen Street Mall shopping area, sitting near the casino close to the intersection of Charlotte St and George St. The building was formerly the century-old St Luke's Church of England, Brisbane, built in 1904. It wasn't until 1979 that it was leased and became The Pancake Manor, giving it more than 40 years of history.

Church history: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/St_Luke's_Church_of_England,_Brisbane

Because it's inside a church building, dining at The Pancake Manor is a rather special experience — just sitting inside already feels atmospheric. Besides the century-old heritage church setting, being open 24 hours is another major highlight! I'm not entirely sure who craves pancakes in the middle of the night, but in Western countries where everything closes early, a 24-hour restaurant like this is genuinely rare.

The quaint, old-world church interior has been preserved

The interior is spacious with plenty of seating — tables for two, four, or larger groups — making it great for getting together with friends. On the day we visited, we saw families, groups of friends, and even a teacher bringing students in for a meal.


Even the seating has a church-like feel

🍽️ The Food

Black coffee with whipped cream

Since it's a pancake house, pancakes are of course the main event. Beyond the basic pancakes with butter, there are all sorts of pancake brunch combos paired with savoury items like bacon and hash browns, plus Australian restaurant staples such as burgers and sandwiches, so diners who prefer savoury food have options too.


Two different brunch sets

As for the taste, I personally found it just average — the portions are generous but the pancakes were a bit dry, so don't set your expectations too high. If you're after truly outstanding pancakes, there are probably better options elsewhere.

That said, the prices aren't too steep and the decor and atmosphere are genuinely unique. If you're in Brisbane and want to try something different — or you're hungry in the middle of the night with nowhere to go — then The Pancake Manor is worth considering.

title.$t: 澳洲自由行 | 布里斯本市區美食篇 | 隱藏在市區的花園咖啡廳 | Coffee Iconic

content.$t:
雖然咖啡之都是墨爾本，但布里斯本市區其實也是充滿了各種咖啡廳/早午餐店，由於我們在布里斯本除了龍柏動物園之外，並沒有特別排其他的行程，所以是走一個很悠哉、早上隨意到街上找一間咖啡廳去吃早餐與喝咖啡的路線。

因為事先也沒有做功課，都是前一天晚上或是當天早上才打開 Google Map，看一下附近有什麼評分高一點的咖啡廳，剛好就找到這家離我們飯店很近、評分又蠻高的 Coffee Iconic。

  • 地址：340 George St, Brisbane City QLD 4000
  • 官方FB：https://www.facebook.com/coffeeiconic.au
  • 電話：+61430007037

📍地點

位於布里斯本市區喬治街上的 Coffee Iconic，前台的店面並沒有很大與起眼，不過幾次路過都發現上班或是中午時間，店外都很多人在等待，很多附近的上班族都會來這裡買咖啡與食物。

最外頭放著幾種麵包類的食物，店內除了賣咖啡，也有販賣豆子

食物價位都在 10 澳元以內

可頌與咖啡的組合餐

📜 菜單 Menu

早餐的菜單 (供應時段 7:30~14:00)

午餐菜單 (供應時段 10:30~14:00)

咖啡與其他飲品

🏞️ 店內環境

Coffee Iconic 的招牌上其實是寫著「Coffee Iconic, coffee garden」，最有特色的應該就是他後院的戶外花園用餐區了。沿著入口旁類似防火巷的巷子進到後院，會發現後院別有洞天，就像是一個在城市裡隱藏的世外桃源一般，有著充滿綠意的戶外用餐花園。

從入口旁類似防火巷的巷子進到後院



每個角落都很有特色

餐點的部分 Coffee Iconic 有簡單的麵包、可頌、三明治，到正餐類的炒飯、義大利麵或漢堡等等都有，但是由於我們只是來吃早餐，簡單點了可頌跟咖啡，不知道其他餐點的口味如何，不過咖啡的部分蠻好喝的。


事後查了一下才發現其實蠻多人推這間的，也有不少人寫過這間的食記，原來也是小有名氣的一家店，其他食物的部分似乎也蠻不錯，有機會來到布里斯本的人可以來試試看這間，隱藏在城市裡的花園咖啡廳。

title.$t: Australia Independent Travel | Brisbane City Food | A Hidden Garden Café Downtown | Coffee Iconic

content.$t:
Melbourne may be Australia's coffee capital, but downtown Brisbane is also packed with cafés and brunch spots. Apart from Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary, we didn't plan anything in particular in Brisbane, so we took it easy and simply wandered the streets each morning looking for a café for breakfast and coffee.

Since we hadn't done any research beforehand, we would just open Google Maps the night before or that same morning to see which nearby cafés had higher ratings. That's how we came across Coffee Iconic, which was very close to our hotel and had quite good reviews.

  • Address: 340 George St, Brisbane City QLD 4000
  • Official Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/coffeeiconic.au
  • Phone: +61430007037

📍Location

Located on George Street in central Brisbane, Coffee Iconic has a shopfront that isn't very big or eye-catching. Yet every time we walked past during commuting hours or lunchtime, there were plenty of people waiting outside — lots of office workers from the area come here to grab coffee and food.

Several kinds of baked goods are displayed out front; besides coffee, the shop also sells beans

Food is all priced under AUD 10

The croissant and coffee combo

📜 Menu

Breakfast menu (served 7:30–14:00)

Lunch menu (served 10:30–14:00)

Coffee and other drinks

🏞️ The Setting

The sign actually reads "Coffee Iconic, coffee garden," and its most distinctive feature has to be the outdoor garden dining area out back. Walking down the fire-lane-like alley beside the entrance into the backyard, you'll discover a whole other world — a lush, green outdoor dining garden that feels like a hidden oasis in the middle of the city.

Entering the backyard via the fire-lane-like alley beside the entrance



Every corner has its own character

As for the food, Coffee Iconic offers everything from simple breads, croissants and sandwiches to full meals like fried rice, pasta and burgers. Since we only came for breakfast, we just ordered a croissant and coffee, so we can't say how the other dishes taste — but the coffee was really good.


Looking it up afterwards, we found that quite a few people recommend this place and a fair number have written reviews about it — turns out it's fairly well known. The other dishes seem pretty good too, so if you get the chance to visit Brisbane, do try this garden café hidden in the heart of the city.

title.$t: 台中住宿 | 台中大毅老爺行旅 The Place Taichung | 旅店中的美術館 | 美術館旁的藝術旅館

content.$t:
台中大毅老爺行旅於 2018 年開幕，位於草悟道商圈、國立台灣美術館旁，距離審計新村僅 7 分鐘步行路程（約 500 公尺），地段十分優越，總共有 170 間客房。今年年初來到台中時，雖然沒入住，但就已經將他列為住宿候選名單。

在搜尋網路上資訊時，台中大毅老爺行旅最有名的就是頂樓的星空房，建築外觀以獨特幾何形狀及通透大片玻璃轉換出不同角度之方框，直接從房間內的沙發就可以觀看夜空，是在網路上很熱門的住宿房型，不過相對的價格也比較高一些，這次我們只有選擇了一般的客房入住。

📜  資訊

  • 入住日期：2023-06-23
  • 入住房型：綠光客房
  • 住宿價格：$
  • 付款方式：可刷卡，可打統編
  • 飯店地址：台中市西區英才路601號
  • 聯絡電話：0423766732
  • 訂房網站：https://www.booking.com/hotel/tw/tai-zhong-da-yi-lao-ye-xing-lu.zh-tw.html?aid=8003516

📍 地點位置

大毅老爺行旅位於台中英才路上，國立台灣美術館停車場正對面，所以如果飯店停車場客滿的時候，也可以去停對面的戶外停車場。

大眾運輸

台鐵

  • 自臺中車站(復興路)搭乘51號公車至大墩文化中心(英才路)步行1分鐘抵達。

客運(朝馬站)

  • 自朝馬轉運站(朝富路)搭乘75號公車大墩文化中心(五權路)步行4分鐘抵達。

自行開車

停車場出入口位於英才路上，正對飯店的左手方，出入口很小，一次只能有一台車通過，沒有辦法雙向會車，所以出入的時候要注意一下。

車道也不是很寬，要小心行駛

車道與停車空間也不大，所以很快就會客滿囉，我們大約五點多抵達，已經剩下幾個車位而已了，所以想要停室內的住客可能要早一點進來停車，否則特約的停車場都是室外的停車位了。

總共地下兩層可以停，每一層約只有15~20 個車位

🏢 飯店環境

一樓的 check-in 櫃檯比較小，尖峰時刻可能會需要等待一下

一樓大廳的空間不大，不過充滿了設計感，飯店主打「在旅店中遇見人文藝術的風景」，定期都會舉辦不同的藝術展覽，而每一層樓的電梯間，就是藝術展覽的展區！

不定期的藝術展覽

每當電梯門打開，就是新的展覽體驗

🛏  房間環境

房間內也是充滿了設計感

房間走的是純白潔淨的風格，格局方正，充滿了線條與幾何圖形的設計，整體乾淨明亮、簡潔又通滿設計感，打開房間的第一印象還蠻不錯的。

雙床房與頂上的黑色軌道燈

床前面的電視與小桌椅

簡單的備品，有濾掛咖啡與茶包
冰箱只有提供兩瓶水

浴室

浴室採乾濕分離，淋浴廁所也有分開兩間，不過比較奇妙一點的是並沒有一個固定隔間隔開浴室與房間區域，而是只有用布簾來分開區域。

洗手台與檯面蠻寬敞的

有注意到連洗手乳標籤設計都很文青嗎？

獨立的一間，有 TOTO 的免治馬桶

另一間是淋浴間


淋浴間裡面的置物檯

🏢 飯店設施


大毅老爺行旅並沒有什麼設施，只有最基本的健身房而已

活力製作所(健身房)

  • 樓層：2F
  • 開放時間 05：00~23：00


樓梯間的冰塊製造機

🍽 早餐

早餐位於一樓的ZEBRA義式餐廳，不過因為餐廳座位有限，加上整棟飯店有 150 間房間，很容易會遇到客滿需要長時間等待的狀況，再加上外面等待空間不大，所以會導致尖峰時刻很多人會塞在大廳...

明亮的用餐區域


早餐菜色與一般飯店差不多，沒有什麼道特別驚艷的地方，不過口味也不差，品項種類數量中等偏少一點。





整體來說體驗還算不錯，房間有設計感明亮舒適，隔音的部分也不會到太差 (或是剛好附近大家都很安靜？)，充滿藝術氣息的住宿空間是一個蠻不一樣的體驗。隔天我們到審計新村走走，車子還可以直接停在停車場，不用開出去再找停車位，如果有計劃到附近這區遊玩，大毅老爺行旅是可以列入考慮的選項之一。

title.$t: Taichung Hotel | The Place Taichung | A Museum Inside a Hotel | An Art Hotel Next to the Museum of Fine Arts

content.$t:
The Place Taichung opened in 2018. It sits in the Calligraphy Greenway district, right next to the National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts, and is only a 7-minute walk (about 500 meters) from Shen Ji New Village — a superb location. The hotel has a total of 170 guest rooms. When I visited Taichung earlier this year I didn't stay here, but it was already on my shortlist of places to stay.

When searching online, the most famous feature of The Place Taichung is the Starry Sky Room on the top floor. The building's exterior uses distinctive geometric shapes and large panes of clear glass to create frames at different angles, so you can gaze at the night sky right from the sofa in your room. It's a very popular room type online, though the price is correspondingly higher — this time we only booked a standard room.

📜  Information

  • Date of stay: 2023-06-23
  • Room type: Green Light Room
  • Price: $
  • Payment: Credit cards accepted; company tax ID invoices available
  • Address: No. 601, Yingcai Rd., West District, Taichung City
  • Phone: 0423766732
  • Booking site：https://www.booking.com/hotel/tw/tai-zhong-da-yi-lao-ye-xing-lu.zh-tw.html?aid=8003516

📍 Location

The Place Taichung is on Yingcai Road, directly across from the parking lot of the National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts, so if the hotel's own garage is full you can park in the outdoor lot opposite.

Public transport

Taiwan Railway

  • From Taichung Station (Fuxing Rd.), take bus No. 51 to Dadun Cultural Center (Yingcai Rd.), then walk 1 minute.

Intercity bus (Chaoma Station)

  • From Chaoma Transfer Station (Chaofu Rd.), take bus No. 75 to Dadun Cultural Center (Wuquan Rd.), then walk 4 minutes.

Driving

The garage entrance is on Yingcai Road, to the left as you face the hotel. It's very narrow — only one car can pass at a time and there's no room for two cars to pass each other, so take care going in and out.

The ramp isn't very wide either, so drive carefully

The ramp and parking area are both small, so spaces fill up fast. We arrived around 5 p.m. and only a few spots were left, so guests who want indoor parking should come early — otherwise the partner lots are all outdoor.

There are two basement levels, each with only about 15–20 spaces

🏢 Hotel environment

The check-in desk on the ground floor is fairly small, so you may have to wait at peak times

The ground-floor lobby isn't large, but it's full of design flair. The hotel's concept is "encountering the landscape of art and culture inside a hotel," and it regularly hosts different art exhibitions — the elevator lobby on every floor doubles as an exhibition space!

Rotating art exhibitions

Every time the elevator doors open, a new exhibition experience awaits

🛏  The room

The room is full of design touches too

The room follows a clean, all-white style with a squared-off layout full of lines and geometric shapes. Overall it's clean and bright, simple yet design-forward — a pretty good first impression when you open the door.

The twin beds and the black track lighting overhead

The TV and small table and chairs in front of the beds

Simple amenities, including drip coffee bags and tea bags
The fridge only holds two bottles of water

Bathroom

The bathroom separates wet and dry areas, with the shower and toilet in two separate rooms. What's a bit odd, though, is that there's no fixed partition between the bathroom and the bedroom area — just a fabric curtain.

The sink and counter are quite spacious

Did you notice how artsy even the hand soap labels are?

A separate room with a TOTO washlet toilet

The other room is the shower


The shelf inside the shower

🏢 Hotel facilities


The Place Taichung doesn't have many facilities — just a basic gym

Vitality Studio (Gym)

  • Floor: 2F
  • Open 05:00–23:00


The ice machine in the stairwell

🍽 Breakfast

Breakfast is served at ZEBRA, the Italian restaurant on the ground floor. But seating is limited and the hotel has 150 rooms, so it's easy to run into a full house and a long wait. The waiting area outside is small too, which means a lot of people end up crowding the lobby at peak times...

The bright dining area


The breakfast spread is about the same as most hotels — nothing especially wow, though the flavors aren't bad. The variety is average to slightly limited.





Overall the experience was pretty good: the room is stylish, bright and comfortable, and the soundproofing wasn't bad either (or maybe our neighbors just happened to be quiet?). Staying in a space so full of artistic atmosphere is a refreshingly different experience. The next day we strolled over to Shen Ji New Village and could leave the car in the garage instead of driving out to hunt for parking. If you're planning to explore this part of town, The Place Taichung is definitely worth considering.

title.$t: 澳洲自由行 | 珀斯郊區行程 | 費里曼圖 Fremantle | 西澳必遊海港城市 | Fremantle 市集與彩虹貨櫃屋 | Little Creatures Brewery 小天使精釀啤酒

content.$t:
來到珀斯旅遊，不能錯過在珀斯近郊的郊區行程，除了有名的短尾袋鼠島 RottnestIsland 與尖峰石陣之外，被稱為西澳必遊海港城市的 Fremantle 也絕對是一個必訪的景點。

Fremantle 位於澳洲西岸天鵝河的入海口，是一個海港城市，許多自由行的遊客或是當地人，都會在假日的時候來到 Fremantle 休閒遊玩，享受海港城市的度假氛圍。

  • 澳洲旅遊局官網：Fremantle 旅遊指南

🚃 地點交通資訊

Fremantle 位於澳洲西岸，距離珀斯市區約 20 公里，自駕約 20~30 分鐘，搭乘火車也只需要半小時的車程就到了，距離相當的近。

車票的部分推薦直接購買 DayRider 一日票，因為單程從市區到 Fremantle 就要 5澳元了，10 澳元的一日票絕對划算，到了 Fremantle 還可以用一日票搭各種公車。

搭乘火車也十分簡單，直接從伯斯市區的車站搭乘 Fremantle Line (藍線)，直接搭到最後一站就到了。月台上也都有很清楚的標示，不用擔心會找不到乘車處。

月台上都有很清楚的標示

Perth railway station 寬敞的月台

列車內蠻新的也維持的蠻乾淨

🏞️ Fremantle 熱門景點


曾被譽為世界上保存最佳的19世紀港口城市，Fremantle 的街道也很有歷史的氛圍，一離開火車站走入 Fremantle 街道，就好像走入了 19 世紀時候的街道一樣。市區的範圍並不大，大部分所有的景點都可以用步行的方式抵達，如果有購買一日卷，也可以搭乘當地的公車喔！

Fremantle 火車站


Fremantle 的景點不算太多，比較像是一個休閒的度假地，主要大家常會去的點有幾個：

  • Fremantle Markets 費里曼圖市場
  • Fremantle Prison 費里曼圖監獄
  • Fremantle Roundhouse 圓屋舊監獄
  • Fremantle Fishing Boat Harbour 費里曼圖漁船港
  • WA Maritime Museum 海事博物館

還有一個在網路上找到的打卡景點：

  • The Containbow 彩虹貨櫃屋

  ⛲️ Fremantle Markets 費里曼圖市場



外觀為維多利亞式建築的 Fremantle Markets，是一個在1897 年開始建立的公共市場，市場裡面除了農產品之外，還販售著各式各樣的特色小物、服飾、手工藝品，當中的美食區也是遊客必訪的景點之一！
  • 地址：South Terrace &, Henderson St, Fremantle WA 6160
  • 營業時間：每週五、六與日，09:00 ~ 18:00
  • 官方網站：http://www.fremantlemarkets.com.au/


特色小物、服飾、手工藝品區域

美食區

雖然相較於墨爾本的維多利亞女皇市場 Queen Victoria Market 小的非常多，不過市場雖不大，但各式各樣的東西都有，只是空間限制的關係，市場內就會顯得十分擁擠。

Brazilian Barbecue WA


由於我們到了 Fremantle Markets 已經接近中午，就在市場內的美食區找食物來吃，剛好經過了這間 Brazilian Barbecue WA，試吃他的烤牛肉後覺得很不錯，就選擇這間了，實際上也真的蠻好吃的，是可以推薦的一家店。


牛肉烤得很不錯

THE HONEYCAKE

7澳幣一塊蛋糕

這家是在搜尋 Fremantle 景點的時候，有看到不只一篇網誌介紹這個蜂蜜蛋糕，然後都說很好吃，所以我們也特別買了一塊來吃。不知道是吃不懂還是真的不合胃口，我是覺得自己不是很喜歡且又不便宜... 不過口味這種很主觀，大家可以試試看，只是我自己不會推薦就是了。



  🚧 Fremantle Prison 費里曼圖監獄



Fremantle Prison 於 1855 年開放，是西澳的第一座監獄，也是該州唯一一座被列入世界遺產名錄的建築。最初是用來關押從英國運來的罪犯，在 1886 年被移交給殖民地政府，供當地判刑的囚犯使用。Fremantle Prison 一直使用到 1991 年，是澳洲歷史最悠久的監獄之一。
  • 地址：1 The Terrace, Fremantle WA 6160
  • 開放時間：09:00 ~ 17:00 (週三與週五到晚上 21:00 )
  • 官方網站：https://fremantleprison.com.au/




不過，費里曼圖監獄並沒有開放讓遊客自由參觀，都必須要參加不同的 Tour，跟著導覽在固定時間一起進入，有好幾種不同且具特色的行程可以選擇，但我們這次時間有限，就沒有選擇進去了，可能至少要在 Fremantle 住上一天或是早一點來，比較有充裕的時間。


以下是各種行程所需時間，如果想要參觀的可以安排一下時間來訪
  • 監獄之旅 Prison Tours：行程總長 1 hr 15 min
  • 隧道之旅 Tunnels Tour：行程總長 2 hr 30 min
  • 火把之旅 Torchlight Tour：行程總長 1 hr 30 min (週三週五夜間限定)
各種行程的票價


  🛖 Fremantle Roundhouse 圓屋舊監獄



Fremantle Roundhouse 是為關押定居地任何被定罪的罪犯而建造的，到 1886 年就沒有再使用了，當它不再用作監獄後，就成為了警察局的拘留所，到 1890 年代後期，又被作為水上警察的住宿。
  • 地址：15 Captains Ln, Fremantle WA 6160
  • 官方網站：http://www.fremantleroundhouse.com.au/
  • 開放時間：10:30 ~ 15:30

圓屋舊監獄旁的瞭望臺風景



  🌈 The Containbow 彩虹貨櫃屋



這個彩虹貨櫃屋算是近期才比較多人去的景點，是由 Fremantle 市委託 Marcus Canning 所設計，由 9 個回收的貨櫃所製成一個拱形的形狀，高9米，長19米，重約66噸，在 2016 年建立。


位於海灘保護區的橋樑之間，毗鄰費里曼圖市入口處的坎寧高速公路，The Containbow 其實距離熱鬧的市區有一段距離，如果從 Fremantle 火車站走路過來要 25 分鐘，而這附近也沒有什麼其他東西，如果是夏天也不是很建議走一大段路過來。不過這次我們因為有購買一日卷，所以就直接搭乘公車就可以抵達囉！


天氣好的時候，彩虹的貨櫃配上藍天，拍起來還蠻美蠻特別的。不過這裡就真的是個打卡景點，除了有點距離之外，附近也沒有什麼東西，可以斟酌一下來遊玩的時間，考慮是不是要過來這裡。

The Containbow 建造過程：

🍽️ Little Creatures Brewery 小天使精釀啤酒


費里曼圖 Fremantle 是非常有名的飲食城市，除有許多義大利和亞洲餐廳外，由於鄰近海港，也還有許多不同的海鮮餐廳。

這次我們挑了當地有名的一家精釀啤酒廠餐廳 - Little Creatures Brewery, Fremantle (小天使精釀啤酒)，他就位於有名的 Fremantle Fishing Boat Harbour，在這裡吹著海風，吃點小點與品嚐當地的精釀啤酒。
  • 地址：40 Mews Rd, Fremantle WA 6160澳洲
  • 營業時間：09:00 ~ 22:00
  • 官方網站：https://littlecreatures.com.au/


Little Creatures Brewery 是一家在 Fremantle 創立的啤酒廠，於 1996 年由四位朋友創立，現在除了啤酒廠之外還兼餐廳，餐廳提供各種食物，包括披薩、漢堡和薯條。啤酒種類蠻多的，可以直接到他們官網看介紹：https://littlecreatures.com.au/beers/




食物的話就是一般般適合配啤酒的食物，不過當天色漸漸暗之後，啤酒廠內會越來越熱鬧也更有氣氛，如果不知道要去哪吃點東西喝一杯，可以來這間有歷史的啤酒廠參觀，也順便來喝一杯澳洲啤酒。只是後來發現原來台北也有開了分店，如果有興趣也可以先到台北店嚐鮮看看。




整體來說，Fremantle 蠻適合來這裡一日遊，距離珀斯市區其實也很近，只需要 30分鐘的車程，可以來這裡感受一下海港城市的氛圍，體驗當地人度假氣氛。

title.$t: Australia Independent Travel | Perth Day Trips | Fremantle | Must-Visit Port City in Western Australia | Fremantle Markets & The Containbow | Little Creatures Brewery

content.$t:
When traveling to Perth, don't miss the day trips just outside the city. Besides the famous Rottnest Island (home of the quokkas) and The Pinnacles, Fremantle — known as the must-visit port city of Western Australia — is absolutely another spot you shouldn't skip.

Fremantle sits at the mouth of the Swan River on Australia's west coast. It's a port city where many independent travelers and locals alike come on weekends to relax and soak up the holiday atmosphere of a harbour town.

  • Tourism Australia official site: Guide to Fremantle

🚃 Location & Transport Info

Fremantle lies on Australia's west coast, about 20 km from central Perth — roughly a 20–30 minute drive, or just half an hour by train. It's really close.

For tickets, I recommend buying the DayRider day pass. A one-way trip from the city to Fremantle alone costs AUD 5, so the AUD 10 day pass is definitely worth it. Once in Fremantle you can also use the day pass on all the local buses.

Taking the train is very simple: from a station in central Perth, hop on the Fremantle Line (the blue line) and ride it all the way to the final stop. The platforms are clearly signposted, so there's no worry about finding your way.

The platforms are all clearly signposted

The spacious platforms at Perth Railway Station

The trains are fairly new and kept quite clean

🏞️ Popular Attractions in Fremantle


Once hailed as the best-preserved 19th-century port city in the world, Fremantle's streets have a wonderfully historic feel. The moment you step out of the train station onto the streets of Fremantle, it's like walking into the 19th century. The town centre isn't large, and most attractions are within walking distance — though if you've bought a day pass you can also hop on the local buses!

Fremantle Railway Station


Fremantle doesn't have a huge number of attractions — it's more of a laid-back holiday spot. The main places people usually visit are:

  • Fremantle Markets
  • Fremantle Prison
  • Fremantle Roundhouse
  • Fremantle Fishing Boat Harbour
  • WA Maritime Museum

And one more photo spot I found online:

  • The Containbow (rainbow shipping container arch)

  ⛲️ Fremantle Markets



Housed in a Victorian-style building, Fremantle Markets is a public market established in 1897. Beyond fresh produce, the market sells all kinds of quirky goods, clothing and handicrafts — and its food court is one of the must-visit spots for travelers!
  • Address: South Terrace &, Henderson St, Fremantle WA 6160
  • Opening hours: Friday, Saturday and Sunday, 09:00 – 18:00
  • Official website: http://www.fremantlemarkets.com.au/


The area for quirky goods, clothing and handicrafts

The food court

It's far smaller than Melbourne's Queen Victoria Market, but even though the market is compact it stocks a bit of everything — the only downside being that the limited space makes it feel very crowded inside.

Brazilian Barbecue WA


Since we arrived at Fremantle Markets close to midday, we looked for something to eat in the market's food court. We happened to walk past Brazilian Barbecue WA, tried a sample of their roast beef and thought it was great, so we went with them. It really was pretty tasty — a place I'd happily recommend.


The beef was very well grilled

THE HONEYCAKE

AUD 7 per slice of cake

While researching Fremantle attractions, I came across more than one blog raving about this honey cake, so we made a point of buying a slice. Maybe my palate just doesn't get it, or maybe it simply wasn't to my taste — personally I didn't really like it, and it wasn't cheap either... That said, taste is very subjective, so give it a try if you like; I just wouldn't recommend it myself.



  🚧 Fremantle Prison



Fremantle Prison opened in 1855 as Western Australia's first prison, and it's the only World Heritage-listed building in the state. It was originally used to hold convicts transported from Britain, and in 1886 it was handed over to the colonial government for locally sentenced prisoners. Fremantle Prison remained in use until 1991, making it one of Australia's longest-serving prisons.
  • Address: 1 The Terrace, Fremantle WA 6160
  • Opening hours: 09:00 – 17:00 (until 21:00 on Wednesdays and Fridays)
  • Official website: https://fremantleprison.com.au/




However, Fremantle Prison isn't open for visitors to wander through freely — you have to join one of the tours and enter with a guide at set times. There are several different, distinctive tours to choose from, but our time was limited this trip so we didn't go in. You'd probably need to stay a night in Fremantle or arrive earlier in the day to have enough time.


Below are the durations of the various tours — if you'd like to visit, plan your time accordingly.
  • Prison Tours: total duration 1 hr 15 min
  • Tunnels Tour: total duration 2 hr 30 min
  • Torchlight Tour: total duration 1 hr 30 min (Wednesday and Friday evenings only)
Ticket prices for the various tours


  🛖 Fremantle Roundhouse



The Fremantle Roundhouse was built to hold any convicted criminals in the settlement, and it stopped being used as a prison in 1886. After that it became a police lock-up, and by the late 1890s it was used as accommodation for the water police.
  • Address: 15 Captains Ln, Fremantle WA 6160
  • Official website: http://www.fremantleroundhouse.com.au/
  • Opening hours: 10:30 – 15:30

The view from the lookout beside the Roundhouse



  🌈 The Containbow



The Containbow is a relatively recent attraction that has been drawing more visitors. Commissioned by the City of Fremantle and designed by Marcus Canning, it was built in 2016 from nine recycled shipping containers formed into an arch — 9 metres high, 19 metres long and weighing about 66 tonnes.


Standing between the bridges in the beach reserve, next to the Canning Highway at the entrance to the City of Fremantle, The Containbow is actually some distance from the lively town centre. It's a 25-minute walk from Fremantle Railway Station, and there isn't much else nearby, so I wouldn't really recommend the long walk in summer. This time, though, we had a day pass, so we simply took the bus straight there!


On a fine day, the rainbow containers against the blue sky photograph beautifully and look quite unique. Still, this really is just a photo spot — it's a bit of a trek and there's nothing much around, so weigh up your schedule before deciding whether to make the trip.

The construction of The Containbow:

🍽️ Little Creatures Brewery


Fremantle is a well-known food destination. Alongside its many Italian and Asian restaurants, its harbourside location also means plenty of seafood places to choose from.

This time we picked a famous local craft brewery restaurant — Little Creatures Brewery, Fremantle. It sits right on the well-known Fremantle Fishing Boat Harbour, where you can feel the sea breeze, nibble on some snacks and sample the local craft beer.
  • Address: 40 Mews Rd, Fremantle WA 6160, Australia
  • Opening hours: 09:00 – 22:00
  • Official website: https://littlecreatures.com.au/


Little Creatures Brewery is a brewery founded in Fremantle in 1996 by four friends. Today it's not only a brewery but also a restaurant serving all kinds of food, including pizza, burgers and fries. There's quite a range of beers — you can browse them all on their official site: https://littlecreatures.com.au/beers/




The food is pretty standard beer-friendly fare, but as the sky darkens the brewery gets livelier and the atmosphere really picks up. If you're not sure where to grab a bite and a drink, this historic brewery is worth a visit — and a chance to try an Australian beer while you're at it. I later found out they've even opened a branch in Taipei, so if you're curious you can get a taste there first.




All in all, Fremantle is well suited to a day trip. It's really close to central Perth — only a 30-minute ride — and a great place to soak up the atmosphere of a harbour city and experience how the locals spend their days off.

title.$t: 澳洲自由行 | 珀斯市區住宿篇 | Citadines St Georges Terrace Apartments Perth | 位於市中心交通最方便的商辦區 | 三種不同房型介紹

content.$t:
珀斯市區熱鬧的區域不算太大，在搜尋飯店的時候，大致上分為北橋區域、伊莉莎白堤岸到珀斯車站中間這區，或是東邊的區域也有不少住宿。
  • 北橋區域：商店林立，不少餐廳、酒吧或是夜生活都在這區。
  • 伊莉莎白堤岸到珀斯車站：這區有著著名的觀光景點，要去海伊街或是伊莉莎白堤岸都很方便，離國王公園也是最近的區域。
  • 東邊區域：這一區飯店價格通常會比較平價一點，且可以選擇的飯店不少，但離景點就稍遠了，只有離袋鼠島比較近，其他需要靠公車才能到熱鬧的區域。
最後還是希望方便一點，且也想避開太過於熱鬧可能晚上會很吵的區域，最後找到了這間 Citadines St Georges Terrace Apartments Perth，位於海伊街隔一條街的商辦區域，交通方便夜晚又很安靜，是一個滿不錯的地點。

📜  資訊

  • 入住天數：七晚 (包含六日)
  • 入住房型：豪華單房公寓、行政一室公寓、尊爵單房公寓 (都不含早餐)
  • 住宿價格：台幣 $34,072 (三種房型總和)
  • 付款方式：可刷卡
  • 飯店地址：185 St Georges Terrace, Perth WA 
  • 聯絡電話：+61892263355
  • 訂房網站：https://www.booking.com/hotel/au/theterrace.zh-tw.html?aid=8003516
  • 官方網站：Citadines St Georges Terrace

📍 地點位置

Citadines St Georges Terrace Apartments Perth 是四星級的飯店，位於 St Georges Terrace 這條路上，外觀就和附近的商辦大樓一樣並不是特別起眼，如果從機場到市區，Elizabeth Quay 火車站會是距離飯店最近的車站，步行只要大約五分鐘而已。

雖然這區看起來算商辦區，晚上的時候會變得很安靜，不過距離熱鬧的海伊街或是伊莉莎白堤岸都其實只差一個街區而已，附近步行到超市也只需要 5min 的路程，整體來說這的地點是真的蠻理想的。

飯店大門也十分低調簡約，很容易會錯過

🏢 飯店環境

一樓的接待櫃檯

Citadines St Georges Terrace Apartments Perth 感覺有點像是商務旅館，一樓大廳只有小小的櫃檯與一個沙發區，基本上就沒有其他東西了，空間也不大。入口處有個 4~5 階的階梯，如果攜帶大行李可能需要自己搬上來，旁邊有無障礙的小型升降梯，不過看起來應該是要聯絡工作人員他才會來幫你使用。


每層樓的走道也不算寬敞

洗衣房

 對於來遊玩一陣子的旅客來說，能洗衣服是蠻重要的一個設施，雖然 Citadines St Georges Terrace Apartments Perth 在房間內沒有提供洗衣機，不過在 2 樓 & 6 樓設有洗衣房，提供住客免費洗衣服與烘衣服，入住房間內也會提供洗衣粉，可以拿著洗衣粉來這裡使用。

洗衣房裡面有一台洗衣機與一台烘衣機

房間內提供的洗衣粉

不過要注意的是，洗衣房有限制使用時間，只能在每天的早上 7 點 ~ 晚上 9 點之間使用，其他時間會上鎖，每天會有員工來鎖門，如果超過 9 點衣服還沒拿出來，員工也會直接把門鎖起來，必須要去櫃檯請他們再來開一次門。

🛏  房間環境

這次入住了三種房型，「豪華單房公寓」、「行政一室公寓」和「尊爵單房公寓」，會在短短一週就住三種房型也是蠻意外的，主因是本來中間三天規劃要去參加粉紅湖的 Tour，所以前後訂了同一家，剛好只剩下不同房型，結果粉紅湖的 Tour 沒有如期成行，又臨時在中間訂房，又是第三種房型，這次才變成一次住三種房型。

豪華單房公寓

豪華單房公寓是最基本的房型，我們這次入住七樓的房型，主要是沒有附電磁爐所以無法開伙，不過基本的微波爐、烤麵包機這些都有，所以如果在超市買一些微波食品或是麵包都還可以。

豪華單房公寓還有一個沙發躺椅，整體空間不算小，床舖的大小也很大，是兩張單人床並起來的大小，算是蠻舒適的。



衛浴的空間就不算大，尤其是淋浴的部分，空間非常小，小到連轉身都會有點卡的那種，不過乾淨度不錯，簡單明亮。



備品

行政一室公寓

行政一室公寓價格比最基本的豪華單房公寓貴一些些，這次我們一樣被安排在七樓的房間，主要是多了電磁爐與比較大的料理空間，其他的設備都是一樣的。但我覺得這間房間反而比較小，從床舖大小變成標準雙人床就知道比較小，而且也沒有沙發躺椅。


衛浴的空間與上一間大小差不多，不過淋浴空間有比較大一些，不會有上一間淋浴空間那樣太小的壓迫感。


不過這間房的採光不是很好，只有一個非常小的對外窗戶，且房間內有跟另一間房可以連通的門(鎖的)，也因為這樣隔音變的更差，覺得是這三間房間之中最不理想的房型。

尊爵單房公寓

最後一間尊爵單房公寓，這次被安排在一樓的房間，算是等級再高一點的房型，除了床的 size 很大、有沙發椅，空間也非常大之外，他還有一個很大的按摩浴缸。

不過因為房間在一樓，對外窗戶就必須都要拉上窗簾。(一樓等於二樓的位置，因為第一層是 Ground Floor)

只是他的浴缸是跟房間在一起...

按摩浴缸在意義不明的位置

尊爵單房公寓一樣有廚房流空間與電磁爐，不過相對的就稍微小一點。但在衛浴的部分就非常大了，連洗手台都直接有兩副。




整體住宿起來缺點大概就是隔音不是太好，可以聽到隔壁間開水的聲音跟鬧鐘聲，其餘都還不錯，面對我們複雜的三張訂單不同房型，櫃檯人員也處理得蠻好的。在第一次要換房的時候，櫃檯人員還有先帶我們去第二間房間先看一下，讓我們決定要不要換房間，且行李也是自動送到第二間。

入住後半段剛好遇到一位來自中國的員工，很熱情也幫助我們很多，讓我們在溝通房型這些的時候不用一直用英文，速度快很多。

title.$t: Australia Independent Travel | Perth City Accommodation | Citadines St Georges Terrace Apartments Perth | The Most Convenient Business District in the City Center | Three Room Types Reviewed

content.$t:
The lively part of central Perth isn't all that big. When searching for hotels, the options roughly break down into the Northbridge area, the stretch between Elizabeth Quay and Perth Station, or the eastern area, which also has plenty of accommodation.
  • Northbridge area: Lined with shops; many restaurants, bars and most of the nightlife are here.
  • Elizabeth Quay to Perth Station: This area has the famous tourist attractions, and it's very convenient for getting to Hay Street or Elizabeth Quay. It's also the closest area to Kings Park.
  • Eastern area: Hotel prices here are usually a bit more affordable and there are quite a few to choose from, but it's a little far from the attractions. It's only close to Heirisson Island (Kangaroo Island); otherwise you need to take a bus to reach the busier areas.
In the end we still wanted somewhere convenient, while also avoiding areas so lively that they'd be noisy at night. We eventually found Citadines St Georges Terrace Apartments Perth, located in the business district just one street away from Hay Street — convenient for transport yet quiet at night, a pretty great location.

📜  Information

  • Length of stay: seven nights (including the weekend)
  • Room types booked: Deluxe Studio, Executive Studio, Premier Studio (all without breakfast)
  • Price: NT$34,072 (total for all three room types)
  • Payment: credit cards accepted
  • Address: 185 St Georges Terrace, Perth WA 
  • Phone: +61892263355
  • Booking site: https://www.booking.com/hotel/au/theterrace.zh-tw.html?aid=8003516
  • Official website: Citadines St Georges Terrace

📍 Location

Citadines St Georges Terrace Apartments Perth is a four-star hotel on St Georges Terrace. From the outside it looks just like the surrounding office towers and isn't especially eye-catching. If you're coming from the airport into the city, Elizabeth Quay station is the closest station to the hotel — only about a five-minute walk.

Although this looks like an office district and gets very quiet at night, the lively Hay Street and Elizabeth Quay are really only one block away, and the supermarket is just a 5-minute walk. Overall, the location is genuinely ideal.

The hotel entrance is also very understated and simple — easy to walk right past

🏢 Hotel Facilities

The reception desk on the ground floor

Citadines St Georges Terrace Apartments Perth feels a bit like a business hotel. The ground-floor lobby has only a small reception desk and a sofa area — basically nothing else, and the space isn't large. There are 4–5 steps at the entrance, so if you have big luggage you may need to carry it up yourself. There's a small accessible lift beside them, but it looks like you have to contact a staff member to come and operate it for you.


The corridors on each floor aren't very wide either

Laundry Room

 For travellers staying a while, being able to do laundry is a pretty important amenity. Although Citadines St Georges Terrace Apartments Perth doesn't provide washing machines in the rooms, there are laundry rooms on the 2nd & 6th floors offering free washing and drying for guests. Laundry powder is also provided in the room, so you can just bring it along and use it here.

The laundry room has one washing machine and one dryer

The laundry powder provided in the room

One thing to note is that the laundry room has restricted hours — it can only be used between 7am and 9pm each day, and it's locked at other times. A staff member comes to lock the door daily, so if your clothes are still inside after 9pm they'll lock the door anyway and you'll have to go to reception and ask them to come open it again.

🛏  The Rooms

This time we stayed in three room types: the "Deluxe Studio", the "Executive Studio" and the "Premier Studio". Staying in three different room types in just one week was rather unexpected — the main reason was that we'd originally planned to join a Pink Lake tour for three days in the middle, so we booked the same hotel before and after, and only different room types happened to be available. Then the Pink Lake tour didn't go ahead as planned, so we booked last-minute for the middle days too, which turned out to be a third room type. That's how we ended up staying in three room types in one trip.

Deluxe Studio

The Deluxe Studio is the most basic room type. This time we stayed on the seventh floor. The main drawback is that there's no induction cooktop, so you can't really cook, but it does have the basics like a microwave and toaster, so buying some microwave meals or bread at the supermarket works fine.

The Deluxe Studio also has a chaise longue, and the space overall isn't small. The bed is large too — the size of two single beds pushed together — so it's quite comfortable.



The bathroom isn't very big, especially the shower — it's so small that even turning around feels a bit cramped. That said, it's clean, simple and bright.



Toiletries and amenities

Executive Studio

The Executive Studio costs a little more than the most basic Deluxe Studio. This time we were again assigned a room on the seventh floor. The main additions are an induction cooktop and a larger kitchen area; everything else is the same. But I actually felt this room was smaller — you can tell from the bed, which drops to a standard double — and there's no chaise longue either.


The bathroom is about the same size as the previous room, but the shower is a bit bigger, so you don't get that cramped, closed-in feeling.


However, the natural light in this room isn't great — there's only one very small exterior window — and the room has a (locked) connecting door to the room next door, which makes the soundproofing even worse. I'd say it was the least ideal of the three rooms.

Premier Studio

The last one was the Premier Studio, and this time we were given a room on the first floor. It's a step up in class: besides a very large bed, a sofa and a really spacious layout, it also has a big spa bath.

But because the room is on the first floor, the curtains on the exterior windows have to stay closed. (The "first floor" here is the equivalent of the second level, since the bottom level is the Ground Floor.)

The only thing is, the tub is right there in the bedroom...

The spa bath in a rather baffling spot

The Premier Studio also has a kitchen counter and induction cooktop, though they're slightly smaller. The bathroom, on the other hand, is huge — it even has two sinks.




Overall, the main downside of the stay is that the soundproofing isn't great — you can hear the neighbours running water and their alarm clocks. Everything else was good. Even with our complicated set of three separate bookings for different room types, the front desk handled it very well. Before our first room change, staff even took us to see the second room first so we could decide whether we wanted to move, and our luggage was delivered to the second room automatically.

In the latter half of our stay we happened to meet a staff member from China who was very warm and helped us a lot, so we didn't have to keep discussing room types in English — it made everything much faster.

title.$t: 澳洲自由行 | 珀斯郊區行程 | 羅特尼斯島 Rottnest Island | 尋找世界最快樂的動物 | 短尾矮袋鼠 Quokkas

content.$t:
說到珀斯郊區行程除了尖峰石陣之外，有著短尾矮袋鼠 Quokkas 的羅特尼斯島，絕對也是珀斯郊區必訪景點。短尾矮袋鼠主要生活在西澳海岸的一些小島上，而羅特尼斯島又被稱作 「Quokka Island」，沒有被破壞的島上生態，讓短尾矮袋鼠可以在小島上自在的生活。

  • 地址：Rottnest Island
  • 官方網站：https://www.rottnestisland.com/

🚃 地點交通資訊

Rottnest Express 的購票處

要前往 Rottnest Island 必須搭乘渡輪前往，而在珀斯有三個港口可以搭乘前往 Rottnest Island 的渡輪，市中心、Fremantle 或是 Hillary。

基本上如果是住在珀斯市區，要出發前往 Rottnest Island，就直接在市區搭渡輪前往最方便，不論 Fremantle 或是 Hillary，其實距離市區也還蠻遠。

渡輪公司Rottnest ExpressSealinkRottnest Fast Ferries
出發地點Perth City
Fremantle		FremantleHillary
訂票網站訂購船票訂購船票訂購船票
價格票價表票價表票價表

如果想要找便宜一點的票，也可以選擇購買 Kkday or Klook 上面的票，有時候都會比官網販賣的還要便宜，我們一開始也是選擇 Klook 上的票，購買付費後一直沒有收到購買成功的回覆，詢問客服也說還在作業中，結果到了前兩天才回說沒有票了...害我們臨時趕快再回官網上訂購，有這次經驗真的對 Klook 大扣分，未來應該都不會選擇在 Klook 上購買了。

如果在官網購買，刷卡後就會馬上拿到電子票卷囉，當天只需要出示 QR code 在上船前給工作人員掃描就可以了。



船上會一起載運自行車，如果有一起租借的下船就可以直接領取了

蠻新的船，乾乾淨淨的

有上下兩層樓可以乘坐

🚲 租借自行車

島上唯一一家租借自行車的價目表

在 Rottnest Island 上，交通方式只能選擇火車、公車或是自行車，而火車是觀光用只有一條短短的線，如果沒有要去島中央，那火車就不太適合。

最多人使用的還是租借自行車，機動性高又比較方便，租借自行車可以直接跟搭乘的渡輪公司租借，這樣一下船就可以有車騎，或是到了島上再租。

左邊是預約櫃檯，右邊大排長龍的才是現場租車...

不過出發前有看到別人推薦一定要租借電動自行車，但電動自行車的價位是一般自行車的兩倍以上，且只有在島上才能租，大家可以斟酌看看。我們這次是選擇了電動自行車，也還好真的有租電動自行車，Rottnest Island 其實不小，又是不少上坡下坡如果是騎一般自行車應該會超級累。

如果確定要租借自行車，建議可以事先上網預約，我們這次沒有預約，光排隊就等了好久...直接浪費了不少在島上觀光的時間。

這裡的租借流程要先選好你的安全帽，在排隊的隊伍旁邊就會有不同 size 的安全帽，記得到櫃台前先選好適合自己的安全帽，到了櫃檯就是直接租車付款，然後取車就可以離開了。

電動自行車
另外，在租車的時候會有一筆押金，要記得把單子收好，最後還車還需要到櫃檯去做刷退的動作，才會把押金退回來喔！


還車後在離開前要記得去退押金

🏞️ Rottnest Island

https://www.rottnestisland.com/island-map

羅特尼斯島（Rottnest Island）是來到珀斯自由行遊客必遊的景點之一，這座寧靜島嶼有著未被破壞的自然環境，許多美麗海灘和寧靜海灣，很多人都會在這裡潛水、游泳和浮潛。最大的亮點應該就是短尾矮袋鼠了，這些野生的短尾矮袋鼠不會怕人，而且最常出現的地方就是遊客聚集的地點，所以在碼頭附近可以遇到最多的短尾矮袋鼠。

如果是和我們一樣早上抵達，下午 4:30 的船就要離開的話，要走完整個島又去體驗各種活動是非常有難度的，所以可能要鎖定想要去的地方。我們是鎖定主要想要多花點時間看 Quokkas，以及看看海岸線風景四處晃晃就好，也沒有一定要繞整個島一圈。

出發沒多久就在路邊遇到的 Quokkas

羅特尼斯島 Rottnest Island 可以分為東西南北跟中部五個區域：
  • 東邊：港口、商店與餐廳的區域，這裡最多遊客聚集，也是最多 Quokkas 的地點。
  • 北邊與南邊：北邊與南邊有著許多海灘和海灣，適合浮潛或是海上活動。
  • 西邊：距離比較遠，這裡的特色是賞鯨與賞海豚。
  • 中部：中部有著一些湖泊，與歷史遺跡。
沿途的海岸風景


許多人會在沙灘邊休憩玩水


在用過午餐離開港口區域後，一路往北的海岸線走，天空非常的藍且海水很清澈，沿途的景色都很美。不過天氣是蠻炎熱的，所以到了北邊 The Basin 這個點停留，這裡有涼亭、廁所，還有販售冰淇淋，可以稍做休息。


The Basin




不過實在是太熱，我們沒有繼續往西邊走，走到大約北部的中間點，就往中部的粉紅湖方向走，一路回到港口區域。

粉紅湖

在澳洲的粉紅湖，是由於湖水藻類的大量繁殖，湖水的鹽份偏高，使得湖水的顏色隨著鹽份濃度的變化而改變，而夏季會因為湖水乾枯，比較看不出來明顯的粉紅色。

羅特尼斯島中部的湖都會有淡淡的粉紅色


遇到一隻正要吃果子的 Quokkas

靠近港口區域後，路上就很容易看到 Quokkas 的蹤跡了，不論是路邊的樹下、還是餐廳門口，或是垃圾桶旁邊都會有，不過在垃圾桶旁邊的 Quokkas 就真的有點像大老鼠...

像大老鼠的 Quokkas 

路邊在睡覺的 Quokkas

睡眼惺忪的 Quokkas


在奸笑的 Quokkas


微笑的 Quokkas



港口區域的遊客中心


羅特尼斯島整體是一個可以度假、好好放鬆的島嶼，天氣好的時候，藍天配上清澈的海水十分優美，而且島上很多原，還有各類的浮潛、賞鯨甚至跳傘活動。另外，島上也有一些住宿，如果時間比較充裕，也可以考慮直接就在島上住宿，雖然價格不是很便宜，但這樣就可以有更多的時間停留在島上好好的體驗島上的自然環境。

title.$t: Australia Independent Travel | Perth Day Trips | Rottnest Island | Meeting the World's Happiest Animal | Quokkas

content.$t:
When it comes to day trips from Perth, besides the Pinnacles, Rottnest Island with its quokkas is definitely another must-visit spot outside Perth. Quokkas mainly live on a few small islands off the coast of Western Australia, and Rottnest Island is also known as "Quokka Island" — its unspoiled ecology lets the quokkas live freely on the island.

  • Address: Rottnest Island
  • Official website: https://www.rottnestisland.com/

🚃 Getting There

The Rottnest Express ticket counter

To get to Rottnest Island you have to take a ferry, and in Perth there are three ports you can depart from: the city centre, Fremantle or Hillary.

Basically, if you're staying in central Perth, the most convenient option is to take the ferry straight from the city to Rottnest Island — both Fremantle and Hillary are actually quite far from the city.

Ferry companyRottnest ExpressSealinkRottnest Fast Ferries
Departure pointPerth City
Fremantle		FremantleHillary
Booking siteBook ticketsBook ticketsBook tickets
PriceFare tableFare tableFare table

If you're looking for cheaper tickets, you can also buy through KKday or Klook, which are sometimes cheaper than the official sites. We originally chose a Klook ticket, but after paying we never received a booking confirmation. Customer service kept saying it was still being processed, and then just two days before the trip they told us the tickets were sold out... which forced us to rush back to the official website and book again. After that experience, Klook really lost a lot of points in our book, and we probably won't buy from Klook again in the future.

If you book on the official website, you get your e-ticket immediately after paying by card. On the day, you just show the QR code for staff to scan before boarding.



Bicycles are carried on the ferry too — if you rent one with your ticket, you can pick it up right after disembarking

A fairly new boat, nice and clean

There are two decks to sit on

🚲 Renting a Bike

The price list of the island's only bike rental shop

On Rottnest Island, your transport options are the train, the bus or a bicycle. The train is a tourist line and only covers one short route, so unless you're heading to the centre of the island it isn't very useful.

Most people rent a bike — it's flexible and convenient. You can rent one directly from the ferry company so you have a bike as soon as you step off the boat, or rent one once you're on the island.

The left side is the reservation counter; the long queue on the right is for walk-in rentals...

Before the trip we'd seen people recommend definitely renting an e-bike, but e-bikes cost more than twice as much as regular bikes and can only be rented on the island, so weigh it up for yourself. We went with e-bikes this time, and thank goodness we did — Rottnest Island is actually quite big, with plenty of ups and downs, so riding a regular bike would have been exhausting.

If you're sure you want to rent a bike, we suggest booking online in advance. We didn't, and just waiting in line took ages... which wasted quite a lot of our sightseeing time on the island.

The rental process here starts with picking your helmet — there are helmets in different sizes next to the queue, so remember to pick one that fits before you reach the counter. At the counter you simply rent and pay, then collect your bike and you're off.

The e-bike
Also, there's a deposit charged when you rent, so keep your receipt safe — when you return the bike you need to go back to the counter to have the charge refunded to get your deposit back!


Remember to get your deposit refunded after returning the bike and before you leave

🏞️ Rottnest Island

https://www.rottnestisland.com/island-map

Rottnest Island is one of the must-visit spots for independent travellers coming to Perth. This peaceful island has an unspoiled natural environment with many beautiful beaches and quiet bays, and lots of people come here to dive, swim and snorkel. The biggest highlight has to be the quokkas — these wild little creatures aren't afraid of people, and they most often appear right where tourists gather, so you'll see the most quokkas near the ferry terminal area.

If, like us, you arrive in the morning and have to leave on the 4:30 pm ferry, it's very hard to cover the whole island and try all the different activities, so you'll probably need to pick a few target spots. We focused on spending more time with the quokkas and cruising around to enjoy the coastal scenery — we didn't feel we had to circle the entire island.

A quokka we met by the roadside not long after setting off

Rottnest Island can be divided into five areas — east, west, south, north and central:
  • East: the harbour, shops and restaurants. This is where the most tourists gather, and also where you'll find the most quokkas.
  • North and south: plenty of beaches and bays, great for snorkelling and water activities.
  • West: farther away, and known for whale and dolphin watching.
  • Central: a few lakes and some historic sites.
Coastal scenery along the way


Lots of people relaxing and playing in the water by the beach


After lunch we left the harbour area and rode north along the coastline. The sky was incredibly blue and the water crystal clear — the scenery along the way was gorgeous. It was quite hot, though, so we stopped at The Basin in the north, where there are shelters, toilets and ice cream for sale, perfect for a short rest.


The Basin




It really was too hot, though, so we didn't continue west. Once we reached roughly the middle of the north coast, we headed towards the pink lake in the centre of the island and made our way back to the harbour area.

The pink lake

Australia's pink lakes get their colour from a huge bloom of algae in the water; the lakes are very salty, and the colour changes with the salt concentration. In summer the water dries up, so the pink is less obvious.

The lakes in the middle of Rottnest Island all have a faint pink tint


We came across a quokka about to eat a berry

Once you get close to the harbour area, quokkas are easy to spot everywhere — under roadside trees, at restaurant entrances, even beside the rubbish bins, although the ones by the bins really do look a bit like giant rats...

A quokka that looks like a giant rat 

A quokka sleeping by the roadside

A bleary-eyed quokka


A quokka with a sly grin


A smiling quokka



The visitor centre in the harbour area


Overall, Rottnest Island is a great place for a holiday and a proper relaxing break. On a fine day the blue sky and crystal-clear water are beautiful, the island is full of open natural scenery, and there are all sorts of activities from snorkelling and whale watching to skydiving. There's also accommodation on the island, so if you have more time you might consider staying overnight — it isn't cheap, but it gives you far more time to soak up the island's natural environment.

title.$t: 澳洲自由行 | 珀斯郊區行程 | 尖峰石陣日落和觀星之旅 The Pinnacles | 蘭斯林滑沙體驗 Lancelin | Lumineer Adventure Tours

content.$t:
The Pinnacles

尖峰石陣 (The Pinnacles) 是珀斯郊區最著名的景點之一，距離珀斯市區約兩小時的車程也不算遠，附近的 Lancelin 滑沙，也是一個很熱門的體驗景點，很適合自駕或是參加 local tour 一日遊一次玩這兩個景點。

Lancelin Sand Dunes 

🗺 尖峰石陣日落和觀星之旅

由於這趟旅程我們沒有打算自駕，因此郊區的行程都打算利用參加 Local Tour 的方式，一開始訂購了三天兩夜的粉紅湖之旅，但由於人數不夠三天前被通知沒有成行，臨時又再 KKday 上面找 The Pinnacles 與 Lancelin 相關的行程。

The Pinnacles 與 Lancelin 相關的行程有蠻多種不同的 package，應該是不同的當地旅遊公司推出來的行程組合，不外乎除了這兩個點之外，大部分都還會去龍蝦工廠，品嚐龍蝦，不過最後我們選擇了這個能在 The Pinnacles 看日落與觀星的行程，覺得應該就算自駕也很難得可以在沙漠觀星。

訂購方式也蠻容易，在 KKday or Klook 上訂購付款完，出發前一天就會收到當地旅行社寄來的通知信，告訴你要幾點在什麼地方集合，這次當地的旅行社是 Lumineer Adventure Tours，接送地點只要是珀斯市區的飯店都會到門口來接你，只要約定的時間到了在門口等就可以囉。

出發前一天才會收到  Lumineer Adventure Tours 的接送時間表

出發當天在旅館門口等了一陣子，後來  Lumineer Adventure Tours 的車子才出現，是一台約可以乘坐 10~15 人上下的一台中型箱型車(?)，陸續在珀斯市區繞了幾趟，把人都接完之後就開始出發今日的行程了！

Lumineer Adventure Tours 的車子

這趟行程只有 Lancelin 與 The Pinnacles，且重頭戲在 The Pinnacles 沙漠上晚餐與觀星，從珀斯市區出發到 Lancelin 約要一個半小時的車程，抵達 Lancelin 之後會先讓大家在鎮上休息一下，上廁所 & 買東西吃 (如果有需要的話)，但這小鎮實在是很不熱鬧，幾乎沒有人煙，也沒有什麼東西好逛的。

Lancelin


🏝️ Lancelin Sand Dunes

Lancelin Sand Dunes

  • 地址：Beacon Rd, Lancelin WA 6044
  • 開放時間：24hr

Lancelin 沙丘是西澳洲最大的沙丘，沙丘面積廣大且純白，由於鄰近印度洋，在海浪與風力的影響下，海風將沙子吹到沙丘的位置，並逐漸堆積成沙丘的形狀。

純白混著貝殼的細沙

我們這次的 Tour，車上就有準備好幾塊滑沙板，如果是自行前往的話，附近也有出租滑沙板的店家。

如何滑沙？走到頂端然後乘坐滑沙板滑下來 🤣 

體驗蠻有趣的，而且滑下來的速度不慢，一歪掉通常就會翻車，但因為是細沙所以也不至於會受傷，只是一定會滿身都是沙。不過因為沙丘蠻高的，傾斜角度也高，如果滑下去要拿著滑沙板爬回沙丘頂其實蠻累的，所以大部分人都玩個2~3次體驗而已。

Lancelin Sand Dunes 

不過呢，很可惜一開始天氣不是很好，雖然到 Lancelin 沙丘的時候沒有在下雨，但天空是整片黑的，所以沒辦法看到藍天配白沙丘的美麗景色。

離開前還遇到一個小插曲，我們的車子竟然在一個沙坑卡住！需要大家一起下來推車，好不容易才脫離沙坑，也是很有趣的體驗。


⛰️ The Pinnacles 

在離開 Lancelin 沙丘之後，需要再大約一小時的車程才能夠抵達位於 Nambung National Park 內的尖峰石陣 The Pinnacles。尖峰石陣 The Pinnacles 是西澳著名的特色地理景觀，數千數萬座尖石聳立在沙漠中，好像來到不同星球一般，遼闊寧靜的奇景，真的很值得親身體驗一次。

Nambung National Park

  • 地址：Nambung WA 6521
  • 開放時間：24hr

值得一提的是，在離開 Lancelin 沙丘前往尖峰石陣的路上有下起了不小的雨，不過不久後就停了，也因為這樣馬路上有些許小水窪，等到接近 Nambung National Park 的時候，遇到很多野生袋鼠就跑出來路上喝水，至少一路上遇到20隻以上的野生袋鼠！

車子靠近就會跳回一旁的樹叢

離車子很近的野生袋鼠


司機會先放大家在遊客中心附近的廁所先停一下，因為接下來進入沙漠後就不會有廁所了，而且會一路到晚餐結束後。

尖峰石陣是南邦國家公園(Nambung National Park) 的一部份，沙漠上有著成千上萬聳立的石灰岩柱，很像一根一根奇形怪狀的石筍，也有人稱這裡為怪石陣，在這一片遼闊的沙漠中，景色真的很壯麗奇特。

這裡的沙子混著細小的貝殼

從景觀台上眺望沙漠區

這個 Tour 最大優勢就是，你可以看到三種不同時段的尖峰石陣，一開始抵達大約六點左右，這時候天空還很明亮，接著會迎接夕陽，在尖峰石陣看夕陽也是超級美，整片沙漠會被染成橘紅色，與一開始明亮的景色有著不一樣的氛圍。

迎接夕陽

🍽️ 沙漠晚餐

這個 Tour 總共分兩台車，接著 Tour 的領隊兼司機們就會開始準備大家的晚餐，主要是一些沙拉輕食，與現烤的熱狗夾麵包，配上紅白酒！

自備瓦斯罐與烤爐，現烤熱狗

簡單卻豐盛的晚餐

自由取用的紅白酒與無酒精飲料

像自助餐一樣可以自由取用

晚餐！

除了準備晚餐之外，Tour 還會幫大家準備椅子，可以在這裡欣賞夕陽與稍候夜晚的滿天星空，大家可以自由取餐，配上夕陽在沙漠中享用晚餐，雖然晚餐簡簡單單的，但是在在這種環境下用餐的體驗下卻是一生難得的體驗。


慢慢地迎接日落

在寧靜的沙漠中欣賞美景與配上一杯紅酒

🌌 沙漠觀星

接著也是今日行程的重頭戲，「沙漠觀星」！ Tour 準備了兩台天文望遠鏡，會直接架起來在沙漠中，讓大家可以實際觀看天空的星星，也會準備小型的望遠鏡發給大家來使用。

無光害下的滿天星斗

在這沙漠中真的是完完全全的無光害，可以看到滿天的星星，司機兼導遊們就會開始介紹星體，還有各種星座，搭配方位讓你了解哪些是什麼星座與他的一些故事。但說真的這真的是英文聽力大考驗了，各種星體專有名詞加上導遊的濃厚澳洲腔，實在是聽得一知半解，突然覺得自己英文能力歸零的感覺 😅。不過就算聽不懂，也可以好好用身體感受這環境與美景。

使用快門延長拍出來的景色

大約會在這裡待到晚上九點的時間，才會準備回程回到珀斯市區，最後大約11點半左右才回到市區，結束今天的行程。

回程離開沙漠的路超級暗

這次的尖峰石陣日落和觀星之旅本來不在我們計劃之中，因為粉紅湖的 Tour 沒成行才臨時選擇的，但是這次的 Tour 應該可以說是整趟澳洲之旅最印象深刻且覺得很推薦的行程了，不論是沙漠中的美景、夕陽或是滿天星斗，還是在第一次在沙漠中的晚餐與觀星體驗，都是非常印象深刻的。

另外，這天的 Tour 應該也是使用英文最多的一天，在一開始上車的時候，意外坐在最前面司機的旁邊，結果整路上司機都會跟你聊天，濃濃的澳洲腔一開始真的是很困難...如果像是觀星的時候配上專有名詞就真的是完全聽不懂了🤪。這趟參加的其他團員也都很友善，蠻會主動互相聊聊天，跟之前在墨爾本參加的兩個 Tour 感覺不太一樣。

結論的話，這個 Tour 是蠻推薦的，如果有來到珀斯也有想要去看尖峰石陣，不如考慮來場深度一點的尖峰石陣之旅吧！

title.$t: Australia Independent Travel | Day Trips from Perth | The Pinnacles Sunset & Stargazing Tour | Sandboarding at Lancelin | Lumineer Adventure Tours

content.$t:
The Pinnacles

The Pinnacles is one of the most famous attractions in the countryside around Perth. It's only about a two-hour drive from downtown Perth, which isn't far at all, and the nearby sandboarding at Lancelin is another very popular experience. It's perfect to visit both spots in a single day, either by self-driving or by joining a local tour.

Lancelin Sand Dunes 

🗺 The Pinnacles Sunset & Stargazing Tour

Since we weren't planning to drive ourselves on this trip, we decided to join local tours for all the out-of-town excursions. We originally booked a three-day, two-night Pink Lake tour, but three days beforehand we were told it had been cancelled due to insufficient numbers, so at the last minute we searched KKday for tours related to The Pinnacles and Lancelin.

There are quite a few different packages covering The Pinnacles and Lancelin — presumably combinations offered by different local tour companies. Aside from these two spots, most of them also include a visit to a lobster factory to sample lobster. In the end, though, we chose this tour, which lets you watch the sunset and go stargazing at The Pinnacles, since even with your own car it would be hard to get a chance to stargaze in the desert.

Booking is quite easy too: once you've booked and paid on KKday or Klook, the day before departure you'll receive a notification email from the local travel agency telling you what time and where to meet. This time the local operator was Lumineer Adventure Tours. As long as you're staying at a hotel in downtown Perth, they'll come pick you up at the door — just wait outside at the appointed time.

The  Lumineer Adventure Tours pickup schedule only arrives the day before departure

On the day of departure we waited outside the hotel for a while before the  Lumineer Adventure Tours vehicle finally showed up — a mid-sized van (?) seating roughly 10–15 people. It made a few loops around downtown Perth, and once everyone had been picked up, the day's itinerary began!

The Lumineer Adventure Tours van

This tour only covers Lancelin and The Pinnacles, with the highlight being dinner and stargazing in the desert at The Pinnacles. It's about an hour and a half's drive from downtown Perth to Lancelin, and once you arrive in Lancelin everyone gets a short break in town for the restroom & to buy something to eat (if needed). But this little town is really quiet — hardly a soul around and nothing much to browse.

Lancelin


🏝️ Lancelin Sand Dunes

Lancelin Sand Dunes

  • Address: Beacon Rd, Lancelin WA 6044
  • Opening hours: 24hr

The Lancelin sand dunes are the largest in Western Australia — vast and pure white. Because they sit right next to the Indian Ocean, waves and wind carry the sand inland, where it gradually piles up into these dune formations.

Pure white fine sand mixed with shell fragments

Our tour had several sandboards ready in the van; if you come on your own, there are also shops nearby that rent sandboards.

How do you sandboard? Walk to the top and ride the board down 🤣 

It's a lot of fun, and you pick up a fair bit of speed on the way down. Tilt off balance and you'll usually wipe out, but since it's fine sand you won't really get hurt — you'll just end up covered in sand. That said, the dunes are quite tall and steep, so hauling the board back up to the top is pretty exhausting, which is why most people only do it 2–3 times just for the experience.

Lancelin Sand Dunes 

Unfortunately, the weather wasn't great at first. It wasn't raining when we reached the Lancelin dunes, but the sky was completely dark and overcast, so we didn't get to see the gorgeous scene of blue skies over white dunes.

There was also a little incident before we left: our van actually got stuck in a sand pit! Everyone had to get out and push, and it took some effort to get free — another fun experience in its own right.


⛰️ The Pinnacles 

After leaving the Lancelin dunes, it's roughly another hour's drive to reach The Pinnacles, located within Nambung National Park. The Pinnacles is one of Western Australia's most famous geological landmarks — thousands upon thousands of limestone spires rising from the desert, making you feel as though you've landed on another planet. This vast, serene wonder is truly worth experiencing in person.

Nambung National Park

  • Address: Nambung WA 6521
  • Opening hours: 24hr

It's worth mentioning that on the road from the Lancelin dunes to The Pinnacles we got hit by fairly heavy rain, though it stopped before long, leaving small puddles on the road. As we approached Nambung National Park, lots of wild kangaroos came out onto the road to drink — we spotted at least 20 wild kangaroos along the way!

They hop back into the bushes as the van gets close

A wild kangaroo right beside the van


The driver first stops everyone at the restrooms near the visitor centre, because once you head into the desert there are no toilets — right through until after dinner.

The Pinnacles are part of Nambung National Park. Thousands upon thousands of limestone pillars rise from the desert, looking like oddly shaped stalagmites — some people call it the "strange rock formation." Against this vast expanse of desert, the scenery is truly magnificent and otherworldly.

The sand here is mixed with tiny shell fragments

Looking out over the desert from the viewing platform

The biggest advantage of this tour is that you get to see The Pinnacles at three different times of day. We arrived around six o'clock, when the sky was still bright, and then came the sunset — watching the sun go down over The Pinnacles is absolutely stunning, with the whole desert dyed orange-red, a completely different mood from the bright scenery earlier.

Waiting for the sunset

🍽️ Dinner in the Desert

This tour ran with two vehicles in total, and the tour leaders/drivers then started preparing everyone's dinner — mainly some salads and light bites, plus freshly grilled hot dogs in buns, paired with red and white wine!

They bring their own gas canisters and grill for freshly cooked hot dogs

A simple yet generous dinner

Help-yourself red and white wine and soft drinks

Help yourself, buffet style

Dinner!

Besides dinner, the tour also sets out chairs so you can sit and enjoy the sunset and, later, the star-filled night sky. Everyone helps themselves to the food and dines in the desert with the sunset as a backdrop. The meal itself is simple, but eating in a setting like this is a once-in-a-lifetime experience.


Slowly welcoming the sunset

Taking in the view with a glass of red wine in the quiet desert

🌌 Stargazing in the Desert

Next comes the real highlight of the day: "stargazing in the desert"! The tour brought two astronomical telescopes and set them up right there in the desert so everyone could actually observe the stars, and they also handed out small binoculars for everyone to use.

A sky full of stars with zero light pollution

Out here in the desert there really is absolutely no light pollution, and you can see a sky brimming with stars. The drivers-cum-guides start introducing celestial objects and various constellations, pointing out directions so you can understand which constellations are which along with some of their stories. Honestly though, it's a serious English listening test — all sorts of astronomical jargon combined with the guides' thick Australian accents meant I only half-understood, and suddenly felt like my English had reset to zero 😅. But even if you can't follow it all, you can still soak up the environment and the beauty with your own senses.

A shot taken with a long exposure

We stayed here until around nine at night before heading back to downtown Perth, finally arriving back in the city around 11:30 pm, wrapping up the day's itinerary.

The road out of the desert on the way back is pitch dark

This Pinnacles sunset and stargazing tour wasn't originally in our plans — we only picked it at the last minute because the Pink Lake tour was cancelled. But it turned out to be the most memorable and most highly recommended part of our entire Australia trip: the beautiful desert scenery, the sunset, the star-filled sky, and our first-ever dinner and stargazing experience in a desert all left a deep impression.

Also, this was probably the day we used the most English. When we first got on the van, I happened to sit right up front next to the driver, and he chatted with me the whole way — that thick Australian accent was really tough at first... and once you add astronomical jargon during the stargazing, it became completely incomprehensible 🤪. The other people on this tour were all very friendly and happy to strike up conversations, which felt quite different from the two tours we joined earlier in Melbourne.

In conclusion, this tour comes highly recommended. If you're visiting Perth and want to see The Pinnacles, why not go for a more in-depth Pinnacles experience!

title.$t: 澳洲自由行 | 珀斯市區酒吧篇 | 珀斯著名琴酒吧 The Flour Factory (已改名 ARARA and Tupí) | Gin and Tonic

content.$t:
Gin and Tonic from The Flour Factory

這次來到珀斯，因為本來預計的三天粉紅湖行程沒有成團，在市區的時間就多了不少，就計劃可以找一間珀斯市區的酒吧。在網路上查珀斯有什麼有名、或是值得一去的酒吧的時候，看到了這間 The Flour Factory，主打超過 100 種琴酒的琴酒專門酒吧，離住宿的地方也步行就可以抵達，就找了一天晚上來這裡體驗看看。

  • 地址：16 Queen St, Perth WA 6000
  • 網站：https://sneakersandjeans.com.au/arara
  • 電話：+611800763253

🍸 店內環境

位於 Queen St 上的 The Flour Factory

The Flour Factory 位於 Queen St 上，在一座充滿歷史意義的建築內，在 19 世紀初是一家麵粉廠，2014 年成為珀斯市區著名的琴酒吧，這裡除了酒吧之外，二樓的空間還常常會當作婚禮的場地與舉辦各式各樣的活動，也是一間評價還不錯的餐酒館。不過，我們造訪的時間是2023年三月，而 The Flour Factory 在四月底就要結束營業，改名成為另一間新的店「ARARA and Tupí」。

The Flour Factory 入口處

一進入店內其實會分成左手邊的開放區域與正前方的候位區，一開始我們跟著人群在候位區排隊，因為似乎座位區沒有位置，所以等了一陣子。輪到我們的時候才知道，原來如果只是想來喝酒，完全不用排隊，直接進去左手邊的開放區域就可以了。

沒有固定座位的開放區

入內後只要自己找空位或是站著，沒有任何座位與消費限制，需要點酒的時候直接到吧台點酒與立即付款，這種方式也顛覆我平常去酒吧的習慣，現場也是放著很大聲的音樂，比較偏美式酒吧或是 pub 的感覺。

在吧台點酒付款


The Flour Factory 主推超過 100 種世界各地的琴酒，自己也有蒸餾廠，有出自家品牌的琴酒，在吧台工作區後面有陳列了部分酒類，中間的輪盤可以讓不知道要喝什麼琴酒的人隨機選擇，選到了任何一種琴酒後就會幫你用 Gin and Tonic 的方式來呈現。

📜 Menu


酒類品項主要是以琴酒為主，雖然 Menu 上只有列幾種 Gin and Tonic 的搭配，不過還是可以用想要的風味與口感來請 Bertender 推薦琴酒喔。

其他調酒品項

🍸 Gin and Tonic

既然是以琴酒為主，那一杯 Gin and Tonic 就是必點的品項了，在現場有發現大部分的人都是點 Gin and Tonic，把 Gin and Tonic 當作啤酒一樣一杯接一杯。這裡使用的通寧水都是 Fever Tree 的通寧水，會根據不同琴酒特性搭配選擇不同的通寧水。

請 Bartenter 推薦兩隻澳洲當地琴酒來做 Gin and Tonic

 這裡還有一個有趣的品項叫做 G&T Tree，會有一個充滿各種風味數杯的 Gin and Tonic，放置在一個像是樹的鐵架上，除了可以品嚐各種不同 Gin and Tonic 之外，也是很適合打卡拍照的一個品項，不過這通常應該要多一點來比較適合，只能借用一下網路上的圖片。

photo from: https://www.theurbanlist.com/perth/a-list/the-flour-factory-gin-and-tonica-tree


整體的體驗是蠻新鮮的，畢竟也是比較少會在國外的酒吧喝酒，只是與一般大家想像中的酒吧體驗稍微不太一樣，在詢問調酒師琴酒的推薦的時候，也沒有得到太多資訊，比較像是一個量產 Gin and Tonic 的吧台 🤣，至於琴酒品項的數量蠻多，雖然無法跟台灣一些知名琴酒吧相比，但有不少澳洲當地的琴酒，有機會找到可能很少見的琴酒。

title.$t: Australia Independent Travel | Perth City Bars | Perth's Famous Gin Bar The Flour Factory (now renamed ARARA and Tupí) | Gin and Tonic

content.$t:
Gin and Tonic from The Flour Factory

On this trip to Perth, the three-day Pink Lake tour we had originally planned didn't get enough people to run, so we ended up with a lot more time in the city and decided to look for a bar in downtown Perth. While searching online for famous or worthwhile bars in Perth, I came across The Flour Factory, a dedicated gin bar boasting over 100 kinds of gin, and it was within walking distance of our accommodation, so we picked an evening to go and check it out.

  • Address: 16 Queen St, Perth WA 6000
  • Website: https://sneakersandjeans.com.au/arara
  • Phone: +611800763253

🍸 The Venue

The Flour Factory on Queen St

The Flour Factory sits on Queen St, inside a building full of history. In the early 19th century it was a flour mill, and in 2014 it became a well-known gin bar in downtown Perth. Besides the bar, the space on the second floor is often used as a wedding venue and for all sorts of events, and it's also a fairly well-reviewed gastro bar. That said, we visited in March 2023, and The Flour Factory was set to close at the end of April and reopen under a new name, "ARARA and Tupí".

The entrance to The Flour Factory

Once inside, the space splits into an open area on the left and a waiting area straight ahead. At first we joined the crowd queuing in the waiting area, since the seated section appeared to be full, so we waited for quite a while. When our turn came, we found out that if you just want to drink, there's no need to queue at all — you can walk straight into the open area on the left.

The open area with no assigned seating

Once in, you just find an empty spot or stand — there's no seating requirement or minimum spend. When you want a drink, you go straight to the bar to order and pay on the spot. This turned my usual bar-going habits upside down; the music was also playing very loudly, giving it more of an American-style bar or pub feel.

Ordering and paying at the bar


The Flour Factory's main draw is its 100-plus gins from around the world. They also have their own distillery and produce their own house-brand gin. Part of the collection is displayed behind the bar's work area, and the wheel in the middle lets anyone who can't decide spin for a random gin — whichever one you land on will be served to you as a Gin and Tonic.

📜 Menu


The drinks list is centred on gin. Although the menu only lists a few Gin and Tonic pairings, you can still tell the bartender the flavour and style you're after and ask for a gin recommendation.

Other cocktails on offer

🍸 Gin and Tonic

Since gin is the focus here, a Gin and Tonic is a must-order. On the night, I noticed most people were ordering Gin and Tonics, downing them one after another like beer. The tonic used here is all Fever Tree, and they choose different tonics to match the characteristics of each gin.

We asked the bartender to recommend two local Australian gins for our Gin and Tonics

 There's another fun item here called the G&T Tree — several Gin and Tonics in a range of flavours, arranged on a tree-shaped metal stand. Besides letting you taste a variety of Gin and Tonics, it's also very photogenic. That said, it's probably better suited to a larger group, so I can only borrow a photo from the internet.

photo from: https://www.theurbanlist.com/perth/a-list/the-flour-factory-gin-and-tonica-tree


Overall it was a pretty novel experience — after all, I don't often drink at bars overseas. It's just a little different from the bar experience most people would imagine: when we asked the bartender for gin recommendations, we didn't get much information, and it felt more like a bar mass-producing Gin and Tonics 🤣. As for the gin selection, there's plenty of it, and while it can't compare with some of Taiwan's famous gin bars, there are a good number of local Australian gins, so you may well find some rare bottles here.
