title.$t: 澳洲自由行 | 珀斯市區景點篇 | 國王公園 |  赫裡森島(袋鼠島) | 海伊街購物中心 | 倫敦閣 | 伊莉莎白堤岸 | 藍色船屋 | 西澳大學

content.$t:
珀斯市區市景

珀斯是西澳州的首府，也是澳洲的第四大城市，而最精華與一般遊客會到的區域為市中心，又被稱為 Perth CBD。這個區域不算大，景點其實也不算太多，可以走悠哉漫遊的步調來逛市中心，而且 Perth CBD 有著各種路線的免費貓公車 CAT (Central Area Transit)，基本上除非要到郊區，不然都不太需要購買車票喔。

市區景點列表：

  • 國王公園
  • 赫裡森島
  • 海伊街購物中心
  • 倫敦閣
  • 伊莉莎白堤岸
  • 藍色船屋
  • 西澳大學

  國王公園 Kings Park

國王公園於 1895 年正式開放，為了紀念愛德華七世國王登上英國王位而命名為國王公園，現今其全名是「國王公園暨植物園」 (Kings Park and Botanic Garden) ，佔地 400 公頃，是南半球最大的城市公園，公園內的植物園展示了多種西澳洲地區豐富多樣的植物物種，其中包括許多獨特的澳洲本土植物。

植物園步道入口

而國王公園還擁有廣闊的草地和湖泊，提供了許多休閒活動的場所，除了步道規劃十分完善之外，更有觀景台可以俯瞰珀斯市區和天鵝河的壯麗景觀，網路上推薦觀看珀斯市區夜景的地點就是在國王公園內。

更詳細的介紹可以參考：澳洲自由行 | 珀斯市區景點篇 | 國王公園 Kings Park | 南半球最大城市公園 | 遠眺珀斯市區夜景

  • 地址：Fraser Ave, Perth WA 6005
  • 營業時間：24 hr
  • 交通方式：935 或 Blue Cat 到 Wadjuk Way Kings Park 站下車 (stop 26)
  • 官方網站：https://www.bgpa.wa.gov.au/kings-park


公園內有名的玻璃拱形橋


  赫裡森島 Heirisson Island

Heirisson Island 是位於天鵝河上的的小島，在珀斯市中心的東側，是一個免費又可以近距離看袋鼠的景點，島上有七隻救援而來放養的灰袋鼠，因為時常與人類接觸，他們也都不怕人，定期會有管理人員來餵食。

更詳細的介紹可以參考：澳洲自由行 | 珀斯市區景點篇 | 赫裡森島 Heirisson Island | 城市中的袋鼠島 | 野生放養袋鼠

  • 地址：31°57′58″S 115°52′50″E
  • 開放時間：24 hr
  • 交通方式：自行開車 或 Red Cat 到 Braithwaite St Trinity College (stop 80) 站下車再步行15分鐘



  海伊街購物中心 Hay Street Mall

海伊街購物中心 Hay Street Mall 其實不是指一個百貨商場，他其實是海伊街位於 Barrack Street 和 William Streets 中間的一段步行區域，與另一條平行的 Murray Street Mall 是珀斯市區最熱鬧且知名度最高的購物街區之一。

  • 地址：Hay Street Mall 
  • 開放時間：24 hr
  • 交通方式：Red Cat stop 3, or 86 或是 Blue Cat stop 3

Hay Street Mall 與 Murray Street Mall 這裡聚集了許多商店、百貨與超市，像是大型百貨 Myer Perth、H&M、UNIQLO 或是超市 Woolworths 、藥局 Chemist Warehouse 都可以在這裡找到，在周邊也有不少餐廳或是餐酒館，逛街逛累了還可以去吃點東西。

不過如果跟其他大城市比起來，我覺得 Hay Street Mall 能逛的東西其實沒有很多，這兩個街區也沒多大，比較像是來到珀斯市區，順道可以逛逛的區域。

夜晚的時候， Hay Street Mall 靠近 William Streets 這裡會聚集不少遊民，有些會大吼大叫，像是肯德基與麥當勞門口與店內都會有不少，自己覺得有一些些不太安全的感覺，晚上就沒有很建議再過來這一區了。

  倫敦閣 London Court

倫敦閣 London Court 位於  Hay Street Mall 與 St Georges Terrace 之間，建於 1937 年，設計採用了伊麗莎白時代的建築特色，是有著濃厚英式風格的建築。他其實是一條小小的購物長廊，但是是一條非常具有英倫風味的購物長廊，走在裡面好像走在古代的英國巷弄間。

  • 地址：647 Hay St, Perth WA 6000
  • 開放時間：07:00 - 21:00
  • 交通方式：Red Cat stop 3, or 86 或是 Blue Cat stop 3
  • 官方網站：https://londoncourt.com.au/

不過 London Court 裏面的商家就還好了，跟外面比較起來屬於比較時代悠久的商家，可以進來拍拍照走一走就可以囉。


  伊莉莎白堤岸 Elizabeth Quay 

伊莉莎白堤岸(伊莉莎白碼頭)，是位於珀斯市中心天鵝河河畔的水岸區域，這裡其實歷史悠久，但經過重新規劃與開發後，現在是一個充滿餐廳與現在設施的繁華熱鬧地區，也是如果要前往 Rottnest Island 可以直接從市中心搭船的港口。

  • 地址：The Esplanade, Perth WA 6000
  • 開放時間：24hr
  • 交通方式：Red Cat stop 3, or 86 或是 Blue Cat stop 3
  • 官方網站：http://www.elizabethquay.com.au/

這裡有著許多餐廳與酒吧，有異國風味的泰式料理、美式的漢堡，也有海鮮餐廳，雖然價位都蠻高的，不過在這裡用餐且喝上一杯的體驗應該蠻舒適。另外有名的還有「天鵝鐘塔 The Bell Tower」與「伊莉莎白堤岸橋 Elizabeth Quay Bridge」。

天鵝鐘塔 The Bell Tower

天鵝鐘塔 The Bell Tower，是由18根鐘組成的一組鐘，懸掛在一座82.5米高的特製銅和玻璃鐘樓上，形狀特殊，可以登塔眺望珀斯市區與天鵝河的景色，門票大約是 10 澳幣左右。

伊莉莎白堤岸橋 Elizabeth Quay Bridge

伊莉莎白堤岸這裡到了夜晚還會打燈，配上日落時分的夕陽，整體景色非常的美，如果沒有要來這裡用餐，也是很推薦在好天氣的傍晚，來這裡走走看看美景。

日落時分的伊莉莎白堤岸

  藍色船屋 Blue Boat House

藍色船屋這個景點算是個打卡景點，連周杰倫的歌「粉色海洋」MV也在此取景，而他的名稱其實是 The Crawley Edge Boatshed，但通常大家都直接稱做 Blue Boat House 了，連 Google 地標都是 Blue Boat House。

  • 地址：1 Kings Park Ave, Crawley WA 6009
  • 開放時間：24hr
  • 交通方式：Bus 23, 950 or 995


這個船屋其實一開始是私人所有，建於 1972 年，2001 年才被重新油漆為藍色，並經過多次易主與整修，現今已經是一個自由行旅客熱門的景點。(團體客應該不會特別跑過來看這個船屋)

Blue Boat House 其實位於國王公園旁，只是地段有點偏遠，免費的公車 Cat Bus 都沒有抵達，我們這天就有購買車票，搭乘一般的公車過來這個景點。



  西澳大學 University of Western Australia


西澳大學位於 Blue Boat House 附近，通常也不是個旅客會特別過來的景點，它是西澳第一所大學，加上特殊的沙岩建築和壯觀的植物園，在澳洲被歸為6所砂岩學府之一，其中 Winthrop Hall 搭配前面的草地與藍天，是西澳大學著名的拍照點。

  • 地址：35 Stirling Hwy, Crawley WA 6009
  • 開放時間：24hr
  • 交通方式：Bus 23, 97, 950 or 995

content.$t:
Perth city skyline

Perth is the capital of Western Australia and Australia's fourth-largest city. The most interesting area, and the one most visitors head to, is the city centre, also known as the Perth CBD. This area isn't very big and there actually aren't that many attractions, so you can explore the city centre at a leisurely, strolling pace. What's more, the Perth CBD has free CAT (Central Area Transit) buses running on various routes, so unless you're heading to the suburbs, you basically don't need to buy a ticket at all.

List of city attractions:

  • Kings Park
  • Heirisson Island
  • Hay Street Mall
  • London Court
  • Elizabeth Quay
  • Blue Boat House
  • University of Western Australia

  Kings Park

Kings Park officially opened in 1895 and was named in honour of King Edward VII's accession to the British throne. Today its full name is "Kings Park and Botanic Garden" , and it covers 400 hectares, making it the largest inner-city park in the Southern Hemisphere. The botanic garden within the park showcases a wide variety of plant species from across Western Australia, including many unique Australian native plants.

Entrance to the Botanic Garden walking trail

Kings Park also has vast lawns and lakes offering plenty of space for recreation. Besides the excellently designed walking trails, there are lookouts with magnificent views over the Perth city centre and the Swan River. The spot most recommended online for viewing Perth's night skyline is right here in Kings Park.

For a more detailed introduction, see: Australia Independent Travel | Perth City Attractions | Kings Park | The Largest Inner-City Park in the Southern Hemisphere | Views of Perth's Night Skyline

  • Address: Fraser Ave, Perth WA 6005
  • Opening hours: 24 hr
  • Getting there: Bus 935 or the Blue Cat, alight at Wadjuk Way Kings Park (stop 26)
  • Official website: https://www.bgpa.wa.gov.au/kings-park


The park's famous glass arch bridge


  Heirisson Island

Heirisson Island is a small island in the Swan River on the eastern side of Perth's city centre. It's a free attraction where you can see kangaroos up close. Seven rescued western grey kangaroos roam freely on the island, and because they're used to human contact they aren't afraid of people. Rangers come to feed them regularly.

For a more detailed introduction, see: Australia Independent Travel | Perth City Attractions | Heirisson Island | A Kangaroo Island in the City | Free-Roaming Wild Kangaroos

  • Address: 31°57′58″S 115°52′50″E
  • Opening hours: 24 hr
  • Getting there: Drive yourself, or take the Red Cat to Braithwaite St Trinity College (stop 80) and walk 15 minutes



  Hay Street Mall

Hay Street Mall isn't actually a department store or shopping centre — it's the pedestrianised stretch of Hay Street between Barrack Street and William Street. Together with the parallel Murray Street Mall, it's one of the liveliest and best-known shopping precincts in central Perth.

  • Address: Hay Street Mall 
  • Opening hours: 24 hr
  • Getting there: Red Cat stop 3, or bus 86, or Blue Cat stop 3

Hay Street Mall and Murray Street Mall are home to plenty of shops, department stores and supermarkets — you'll find the large department store Myer Perth, H&M and UNIQLO, as well as the supermarket Woolworths and the pharmacy Chemist Warehouse. There are also quite a few restaurants and gastropubs nearby, so you can grab a bite when you get tired of shopping.

That said, compared with other big cities, I felt Hay Street Mall doesn't have all that much to browse, and neither precinct is very large. It's more of an area you can wander through while you're in central Perth.

At night, the section of Hay Street Mall near William Street attracts quite a few homeless people, some of whom shout loudly — there are usually a number of them outside and inside the KFC and McDonald's. It felt a little unsafe to me, so I wouldn't really recommend coming back to this area after dark.

  London Court

London Court sits between Hay Street Mall and St Georges Terrace. Built in 1937, it was designed in the Elizabethan architectural style and has a strongly British feel. It's actually a small shopping arcade, but a wonderfully English one — walking through it feels like strolling down an old British laneway.

  • Address: 647 Hay St, Perth WA 6000
  • Opening hours: 07:00 - 21:00
  • Getting there: Red Cat stop 3, or bus 86, or Blue Cat stop 3
  • Official website: https://londoncourt.com.au/

The shops inside London Court are just so-so, though — compared with those outside, they're rather old-fashioned establishments. Coming in to take a few photos and have a stroll is enough.


  Elizabeth Quay 

Elizabeth Quay is a waterfront precinct on the banks of the Swan River in central Perth. The area has a long history, but after being redesigned and redeveloped it's now a bustling district full of restaurants and modern facilities. It's also the harbour from which you can catch a ferry straight from the city centre to Rottnest Island.

  • Address: The Esplanade, Perth WA 6000
  • Opening hours: 24hr
  • Getting there: Red Cat stop 3, or bus 86, or Blue Cat stop 3
  • Official website: http://www.elizabethquay.com.au/

There are lots of restaurants and bars here — exotic Thai cuisine, American-style burgers and seafood restaurants too. Prices are all fairly high, but dining here with a drink in hand should be a pretty pleasant experience. Also famous here are "The Bell Tower" and the "Elizabeth Quay Bridge".

The Bell Tower

The Bell Tower is a set of 18 bells hung in a purpose-built copper-and-glass campanile 82.5 metres tall. Its shape is quite distinctive, and you can climb the tower for views over central Perth and the Swan River. Admission is around AU$10.

Elizabeth Quay Bridge

Elizabeth Quay is lit up at night, and combined with the sunset it makes for a truly beautiful scene. Even if you're not dining here, I'd highly recommend coming for a stroll on a fine evening to take in the views.

Elizabeth Quay at sunset

  Blue Boat House

The Blue Boat House is very much an Instagram-check-in spot — the music video for Jay Chou's song "Pink Ocean" was even filmed here. Its actual name is The Crawley Edge Boatshed, but everyone just calls it the Blue Boat House, and even the Google Maps landmark is listed as Blue Boat House.

  • Address: 1 Kings Park Ave, Crawley WA 6009
  • Opening hours: 24hr
  • Getting there: Bus 23, 950 or 995


The boatshed was originally privately owned. Built in 1972, it was only repainted blue in 2001, and after changing hands and being renovated several times it has become a popular attraction for independent travellers. (Tour groups probably wouldn't make a special trip out to see it.)

The Blue Boat House is actually right next to Kings Park, but the location is a bit out of the way and the free CAT buses don't reach it. On this day we bought tickets and took a regular bus out to the spot.



  University of Western Australia


The University of Western Australia is near the Blue Boat House. It isn't usually a place travellers make a special trip to see, but it was Western Australia's first university, and with its distinctive sandstone buildings and impressive botanic gardens it's counted as one of Australia's six sandstone universities. Winthrop Hall, with the lawn in front and blue sky above, is UWA's most famous photo spot.

  • Address: 35 Stirling Hwy, Crawley WA 6009
  • Opening hours: 24hr
  • Getting there: Bus 23, 97, 950 or 995

title.$t: 澳洲自由行 | 珀斯市區景點篇 | 赫裡森島 Heirisson Island | 城市中的袋鼠島 | 野生放養袋鼠

content.$t:
在珀斯市區有一個步行就可以抵達，又是免費可以近距離看袋鼠的景點 - 『赫裡森島 Heirisson Island』，通常被俗稱珀斯市區的袋鼠島。它是一座位於天鵝河上的小島，中間隔跨 Causeway Bridge，島上除了停車場之外，就是袋鼠的棲息區囉！

  • 地址：31°57′58″S 115°52′50″E
  • 開放時間：24 hr

🚃 地點交通資訊

Heirisson Island 是位於天鵝河上的的小島，除了開車直接到停車場之外，沒有任何可以直接抵達的交通工具，最接近也最方便的方式，就是搭乘紅貓公車 Rad Cat 到這一站：Braithwaite St Trinity College，沿著 Causeway 走大約 10~15 分鐘，穿過一半的 Causeway Bridge 就可以抵達 Heirisson Island 囉！

前方就是 Heirisson Island

如果不確定怎麼走，可以直接用 Google Map 步行的導航，他走的路線是正確的。(我們就是跟著 Google Map 導航走過來)

沿著 Causeway Bridge 走一段就會看到這景色，往前就是入口了

🏞️ Heirisson Island

為了怕袋鼠跑到馬路上而做的圍籬入口


禁止帶狗、也不能餵食袋鼠

這個圍欄的入口沒有上鎖，不過設計成袋鼠的手無法打開的門，所以通過這個門之後都要記得再把門關上，袋鼠們才不會不小心跑出去喔！

島上沒有任何建設，維持原始的風貌

進來之後就可以開始尋找袋鼠囉！島上有七隻救援而來放養的灰袋鼠，因為時常與人類接觸，他們也都不怕人，定期會有管理人員來餵食。

不過因為這天天氣蠻熱的，這個 Heirisson Island 的範圍也不是說多小，再加上有一區一區的樹林，天氣熱的時候袋鼠可能都躲起來了，一開始走了一大圈其實都找不到...

繼續一邊曬太陽一邊找袋鼠...

島上的原住民雕像

最後終於在深處的樹陰地方，找到一隻正在吃草的袋鼠了！

完全不怕人，但也完全不理人

在 Heirisson Island 待了一個半小時，最後其實近距離就只有遇到這隻袋鼠了.... 還有一隻躲在樹林深處，其他的五隻真的是完全找不到在哪 😅。

Heirisson Island 比較像是一個很小的景點，當天來其實也都沒有遇到什麼遊客，畢竟它離市中心還是有一小段的距離，如果有在珀斯停留比較多天，想找個市區附近走走，可以考慮來 Heirisson Island 晃晃，看看有沒有機會巧遇袋鼠！

Causeway Bridge 上的天鵝河河景

title.$t: Australia Independent Travel | Perth City Attractions | Heirisson Island | The Kangaroo Island in the City | Free-Roaming Wild Kangaroos

content.$t:
In central Perth there is an attraction you can walk to and where you can see kangaroos up close for free - "Heirisson Island", commonly nicknamed Perth city's own Kangaroo Island. It is a small island on the Swan River, crossed in the middle by the Causeway Bridge. Apart from the car park, the island is entirely a kangaroo habitat!

  • Address: 31°57′58″S 115°52′50″E
  • Opening hours: 24 hr

🚃 Getting There

Heirisson Island is a small island on the Swan River. Other than driving straight to the car park, there is no public transport that goes directly there. The closest and most convenient way is to take the Red CAT bus to this stop: Braithwaite St Trinity College, then walk along the Causeway for about 10-15 minutes. Once you cross half of the Causeway Bridge you'll arrive at Heirisson Island!

Heirisson Island lies straight ahead

If you're not sure of the way, just use Google Maps walking navigation - the route it gives is correct. (That's exactly how we got here.)

Walk a little along the Causeway Bridge and you'll see this view; the entrance is just ahead

🏞️ Heirisson Island

The fenced entrance, built to stop kangaroos from wandering onto the road


No dogs allowed, and no feeding the kangaroos

The gate in this fence isn't locked, but it's designed so kangaroo paws can't open it. So after you go through, remember to close the gate behind you so the kangaroos don't accidentally get out!

There are no buildings on the island; it keeps its original natural look

Once inside, you can start hunting for kangaroos! There are seven rescued grey kangaroos living freely on the island. Since they're often in contact with people, they're not afraid of humans, and rangers come to feed them regularly.

However, the weather was pretty hot that day, and Heirisson Island isn't exactly tiny - plus there are patches of woodland, so on hot days the kangaroos tend to hide away. At first we walked a whole loop and couldn't find any...

Still searching for kangaroos while baking in the sun...

The Aboriginal statue on the island

Finally, deep in a shady grove, we found a kangaroo munching on grass!

Completely unafraid of people - and completely uninterested in them too

We spent an hour and a half on Heirisson Island, and in the end this was the only kangaroo we got close to.... There was one more hiding deep in the woods, and we really couldn't find the other five at all 😅.

Heirisson Island is more of a small, low-key attraction; we hardly saw any other visitors that day, since it's still a little way from the city centre. If you're staying in Perth for several days and want somewhere near the city for a stroll, consider wandering over to Heirisson Island and seeing whether you get lucky with a kangaroo encounter!

Swan River views from the Causeway Bridge

title.$t: 澳洲自由行 | 珀斯市區景點篇 | 國王公園 Kings Park | 南半球最大城市公園 | 遠眺珀斯市區夜景

content.$t:
說到珀斯市區必訪的景點，國王公園 Kings Park 絕對是其中之一。國王公園於 1895 年正式開放，為了紀念愛德華七世國王登上英國王位而命名為國王公園，現今其全名是「國王公園暨植物園」 (Kings Park and Botanic Garden) ，佔地 400 公頃，是南半球最大的城市公園，公園內的植物園展示了多種西澳洲地區豐富多樣的植物物種，其中包括許多獨特的澳洲本土植物。

國王公園全區地圖

而國王公園還擁有廣闊的草地和湖泊，提供了許多休閒活動的場所，除了步道規劃十分完善之外，更有觀景台可以俯瞰珀斯市區和天鵝河的壯麗景觀，網路上推薦觀看珀斯市區夜景的地點就是在國王公園內！

  • 地址：Fraser Ave, Perth WA 6005
  • 營業時間：24 hr
  • 官方網站：https://www.bgpa.wa.gov.au/kings-park

🚃 地點交通資訊

Botanic Garden 的入口處

公車

要抵達國王公園內又不用走太多路的話，可以選擇 935 (要付費) 與藍貓公車 Blue Cat (免費)，到 Fraser Av Old Tea Pavilion 或是 Wadjuk Way Kings Park 站下車是最方便的囉！

Elizabeth Quay 公車站
Blue Cat Bus
  • Fraser Av Old Tea Pavilion: 位於國王公園內的 Fraser Ave 上，這裡可以遠眺城市景和河景
  • Wadjuk Way Kings Park: 直接到 Botanic Garden 的入口處

充滿林蔭，很美的 Fraser Ave

🏞️ 公園內景點

Fraser Ave (弗雷澤大道)

Fraser Ave 是位於國王公園靠近市區入口處的一條路，這條路充滿林蔭，且可以遠眺城市景和河景，天氣好的時候非常的美。

如果時間充裕的話，推薦搭公車進來的時候，可以在 Fraser Av Old Tea Pavilion 這站下車，欣賞一下這裡的風景，之後再慢慢沿著步道走進去喔！

遠眺珀斯市景和河景

State War Memorial (州戰爭紀念碑)

State War Memorial

在國王公園內， Botanic Garden 的入口處旁，有一個特別的地方，那就是州戰爭紀念碑 (State War Memorial) 以及紀念火焰 (Flame of Remembrance) 和反思池 (Pool of Reflection)。

州戰爭紀念碑用來紀念在戰爭中犧牲的西澳洲士兵，它是珀斯最重要的紀念碑之一，也是國王公園的主要地標之一。

Flame of Remembrance & Pool of Reflection

在州戰爭紀念碑旁邊，有一座被稱為紀念火焰的紀念物。這個火焰象徵著對戰爭中失去的生命的永恆紀念。火焰的周圍是反思池，它創造出一個寧靜和平的氛圍，供人們反思戰爭的代價和犧牲。

在 State War Memorial 後方一樣可以遠眺城市景喔！

Botanic Garden (植物園)

國王公園內的植物園，其實是一整區的步道，這條步道也可以說是國王公園內最熱門的步道，除了有豐富的各種西澳植物之外，步道還有區分各種不同澳洲環境，可以感受到從熱帶雨林到沙漠、從海岸到山區的不同生態環境，讓遊客了解在不同澳洲的區域有哪些獨特的澳洲本土植物，整體來說我覺得規劃還蠻不錯的。另外，沿著步道一直走，也可以抵達熱門的玻璃天空步道，非常值得來植物園這區走走。

植物園步道全區地圖


澳洲沙漠區

各種不同豐富的植物！

Lotterywest Federation Walkway (玻璃拱形橋)

這個玻璃拱形橋是蠻多人介紹國王公園都會提到的景點，大概位在植物園步道一半的地方，當只要看到木棧道出現，就代表玻璃拱形橋就在眼前了。

玻璃拱形橋前的木棧道

玻璃拱形橋

不過這個玻璃拱形橋是有開放時間的喔，只有早上九點到下午五點間才會開放，如果是來國王公園看夜景的遊客，是沒有辦法上來這個玻璃拱形橋的。


Pioneer Women's Memorial


這裡其實是有個紀念雕像在噴水池旁，不過我們來的這時候，這區剛好在準備活動，所以前方有架一個舞台就把噴水池與紀念雕像圍起來了。

國王公園還是許多文化活動和節日慶典的舉辦地點。每年都有各種音樂會、藝術展覽和市集在這裡舉行。

DNA Tower (DNA塔)

造型特別的DNA塔

DNA塔是國王公園的最高觀景點，建於 1966 年，其雙樓梯模仿脫氧核糖核酸 (DNA) 的雙螺旋結構，是應公園當時的負責人約翰·比爾德 (John Beard) 的要求建造的。

塔位於的地點剛好沒什麼風景可以看...

作為一個城市公園，珀斯市區的國王公園蠻值得來走走，許多人還會來這裡觀看珀斯夜景，不過因為免費的貓公車大多都傍晚就沒了，我們這次也就沒有特別來看夜景，搭乘大共運輸來國王公園看夜景的話要注意回程時間與交通工具囉。

title.$t: Australia Independent Travel | Perth City Attractions | Kings Park | The Largest City Park in the Southern Hemisphere | Overlooking the Perth City Night View

content.$t:
When it comes to must-visit attractions in downtown Perth, Kings Park is definitely one of them. Kings Park officially opened in 1895 and was named in honour of King Edward VII's accession to the British throne. Today its full name is "Kings Park and Botanic Garden" . Covering 400 hectares, it is the largest city park in the Southern Hemisphere. The botanic garden within the park showcases the rich diversity of plant species from Western Australia, including many unique Australian native plants.

Map of the whole Kings Park area

Kings Park also has vast lawns and lakes, offering plenty of space for leisure activities. Besides its very well-planned walking trails, there are lookouts where you can take in the magnificent views of the Perth city centre and the Swan River. The spot recommended online for viewing Perth's night skyline is right here in Kings Park!

  • Address: Fraser Ave, Perth WA 6005
  • Opening hours: 24 hr
  • Official website: https://www.bgpa.wa.gov.au/kings-park

🚃 Getting There

The entrance to the Botanic Garden

Bus

To reach Kings Park without walking too far, you can take bus 935 (paid) or the Blue Cat bus (free). Getting off at Fraser Av Old Tea Pavilion or Wadjuk Way Kings Park is the most convenient option!

Elizabeth Quay bus stop
Blue Cat Bus
  • Fraser Av Old Tea Pavilion: Located on Fraser Ave inside Kings Park, where you can look out over the city and river views
  • Wadjuk Way Kings Park: Takes you straight to the entrance of the Botanic Garden

Fraser Ave, beautifully lined with shady trees

🏞️ Attractions Inside the Park

Fraser Ave

Fraser Ave is a road near the city-side entrance of Kings Park. Lined with shady trees, it offers sweeping views of the city and the river, and it's absolutely beautiful on a fine day.

If you have time, I recommend getting off the bus at the Fraser Av Old Tea Pavilion stop to enjoy the scenery here, then stroll slowly along the path further into the park!

Looking out over the Perth skyline and the river

State War Memorial

State War Memorial

Inside Kings Park, right beside the entrance to the Botanic Garden, there is a special place: the State War Memorial, along with the Flame of Remembrance and the Pool of Reflection.

The State War Memorial commemorates the Western Australian soldiers who died in war. It is one of Perth's most important memorials and one of the main landmarks of Kings Park.

Flame of Remembrance & Pool of Reflection

Next to the State War Memorial stands a monument known as the Flame of Remembrance. This flame symbolises eternal remembrance of the lives lost in war. Surrounding the flame is the Pool of Reflection, creating a calm and peaceful atmosphere where people can reflect on the cost and sacrifices of war.

You can also enjoy city views from behind the State War Memorial!

Botanic Garden

The Botanic Garden inside Kings Park is essentially a whole network of walking trails, and it's arguably the most popular trail area in the park. Besides the abundance of Western Australian plants, the trail is divided into sections representing different Australian environments, so you can experience everything from rainforest to desert, from coast to mountains, and learn which unique native Australian plants grow in each region. Overall, I think it's very well designed. What's more, if you keep following the trail you'll reach the popular glass walkway in the sky—this area is really worth a visit.

Map of the Botanic Garden trails


The Australian desert section

All kinds of rich and varied plants!

Lotterywest Federation Walkway (the glass arch bridge)

This glass arch bridge is an attraction mentioned by almost everyone who writes about Kings Park. It's roughly halfway along the Botanic Garden trail—once you see the wooden boardwalk appear, you know the glass arch bridge is just ahead.

The wooden boardwalk before the glass arch bridge

The glass arch bridge

Note, though, that the glass arch bridge has set opening hours—it's only open between 9 am and 5 pm. So if you come to Kings Park for the night view, you won't be able to go up onto the glass bridge.


Pioneer Women's Memorial


There is actually a memorial statue here beside the fountain, but when we visited, this area was being set up for an event, so a stage had been erected in front, fencing off the fountain and the statue.

Kings Park is also a venue for many cultural events and festivals. Every year all sorts of concerts, art exhibitions and markets are held here.

DNA Tower

The distinctively shaped DNA Tower

The DNA Tower is the highest lookout point in Kings Park. Built in 1966, its double staircase mimics the double-helix structure of deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA), and it was built at the request of John Beard, who was then the director of the park.

The tower happens to sit where there isn't much of a view...

As a city park, Kings Park in Perth is well worth a visit, and many people come here to see the Perth night view. However, since the free Cat buses mostly stop running by early evening, we didn't make a special trip for the night view this time. If you're taking public transport to Kings Park for the night view, be sure to check the return times and transport options.

墨爾本 - 雅拉河畔夜景

墨爾本位於澳洲的東岸維多利亞州內，是澳洲目前第二大的城市，市內擁有眾多的維多利亞式建築，數量在全球僅次於倫敦，更因為城內存在大量維多利亞時期遺留下的大量各式的大型教堂而有著「教堂之城」之美譽。

聖保羅座堂 St Paul's Cathedral Melbourne

墨爾本的咖啡文化非常活躍，起源於義大利人帶來的咖啡文化，在墨爾本發揚光大，城市內咖啡店林立，許多有名的店家都在墨爾本，巷弄內也很容易遇到個人特色的獨立咖啡店與烘豆坊，因此又被稱為「咖啡之都」。

市區景點與餐廳

費蓮達火車站 Flinders Street Railway Station

✈️ 機場到市區交通

從墨爾本機場往返市區，可以選擇搭乘公車再轉車，或是 SkyBus (機場快線接駁巴士)，當然也可以直接選擇 Uber，不過如果是旅行者，除了 Uber 最方便快速且經濟實惠的方式就是直接搭乘機場快線 SkyBus 囉！

  • 機場到市區：T4 -> T3 -> T1 -> 市區(Southern Cross Station)
  • 市區到機場：市區(Southern Cross Station) -> T1
時刻表：
SkyBus 的班次非常的多，大約 10~15 分鐘就會有一班車了，可以參考https://www.skybus.com.au/melbourne-city-express/timetable/

票價：(2023年)

Trip fares One way Return

機場到市區

國際航班抵達墨爾本會從 T2 (2 號航廈) 入境出來，而國內線的話是從 T4，不過其實這幾個航廈也不是多很大，相距都不會太遠。

購票方式也很簡單，只要入境之後，在航廈內就會看到 SkyBus 的櫃檯了，上面有很清楚的票價與很多台購票機，自己選一選直接刷卡就可以了，如果購買來回票會比較便宜，但要記得把票卷收好。如果要更優惠，也可以使用 Klook 或是 KKday 這類平台事先購買車票，票價有可能會比直接購來還要便宜。

至於在哪搭車也不會很困難，因為一走出來就會超明顯直接看到 SkyBus 的停靠站，拿著票去跟著排隊就好，完全沒有難度。


一樓的車內有許多置放大行李的空間

市區下車的地方

市區到機場

市區的搭車地點在 Southern Cross Station，也就是從機場過來下車的同一地方(對面月台)，在車站中一樣會有 SkyBus 的服務中心與購票機，也有很清楚的指標告訴你應該要到哪一個月台候車。

這裡會有出發到墨爾本機場(MEL)與阿瓦隆機場(AVV)兩班車，因為月台在隔壁而已，候車時稍微要注意一下不要搭錯車囉。




🚌 市區交通

路面電車(Tram)

Tram 候車月台

在墨爾本市區主要的大眾運輸工具，就是路面電車(Tram)、公車(Bus)，以及火車(Train)了，如果是在市中心遊覽，通常比較常使用路面電車或是公車，如果要前往郊區則比較多機會使用到火車或是公車。

公車(Bus)

Free Tram Zone

from: www.ptv.vic.gov.au

在市區中心的區域，有一區 Free Tram Zone，只要在這個區域內搭乘路面電車(Tram)，都是不需要任何費用也不需要購買票卷的喔！Free Tram Zone 的範圍基本上已經包含所有墨爾本市區的景點了，如果行程在市區內就完全不需要購買 myki 卡來使用，而且電車車次很多，只要都搭乘路面電車來遊覽墨爾本市區就很方便了。

Free Tram Zone 範圍：Free-Tram-Zone-Map-Map 

(連結失效請直接到官網 www.ptv.vic.gov.au)

路面電車(Tram)車廂內

Free Tram Zone 搭車注意事項：

  • 不需要購買 myki 卡
  • 上下車地點都在 Free Tram Zone 內就不用刷卡 (touch on or off)
  • 上車或是下車任一地點在 Free Tram Zone 之外就必須要刷卡
  • 當列車準備要離開 Free Tram Zone 會有通知
  • 除了路面電車(Tram)以外的交通工具在 Free Tram Zone 都要付費

touch on or off (刷卡)

myki 簡介


myki 是墨爾本通用的交通票卷，任何搭乘大眾運輸的乘客都必須使用 myki，如果乘客在搭乘時沒有myki，將需要現場購買一張，且無法使用現金來搭乘大眾運輸。另外，myki 也不可以退卡，只會在4年有效期後自動失效，且有效期無法延長，對於遊客其實不是很友善的交通票卷。

Southern Cross Station 的服務中心

如果要購買 myki ，各大火車站都有售票機或是服務中心，少數的一些 Tram 月台也有購票機器可以使用，或是到便利商店也可以購買。

myki money: 分為兩小時或一天的票價，只要在兩小時內不論刷幾次都只會扣固定的價格，而超過兩小時就會變成 day fare

content.$t:
Melbourne - Night view along the Yarra River

Melbourne is located in the state of Victoria on Australia's east coast and is currently the country's second-largest city. The city is home to a huge number of Victorian-era buildings — second only to London worldwide — and because of the many large churches of all kinds left over from the Victorian period, it has also earned the nickname "the City of Churches."

St Paul's Cathedral Melbourne

Melbourne's coffee culture is incredibly vibrant. Originally brought over by Italian immigrants, it flourished here, and the city is packed with cafés. Many famous roasters and coffee shops are based in Melbourne, and it's easy to stumble upon distinctive independent cafés and roasteries tucked away in the laneways — which is why the city is also known as the "coffee capital."

City Attractions and Restaurants

Flinders Street Railway Station

  • Australia Independent Travel | Melbourne Travel | Melbourne Overview | City & Airport Transport SkyBus | myki Transit Card
  • Australia Independent Travel | Melbourne City Attractions | Flinders Street Station | Federation Square | Royal Arcade | Graffiti Lane | State Library Victoria | Queen Victoria Market
  • Australia Independent Travel | Melbourne City Attractions | Queen Victoria Market | Seasonal Wednesday Night Market | A Market with a Century of History

Attractions Around Melbourne

Great Ocean Road - The Twelve Apostles
  • Australia Independent Travel | Melbourne Day Trips | Puffing Billy Railway | Vintage Coal-Fired Steam Train | Transport Info and How to Buy Tickets
  • Australia Independent Travel | Melbourne Day Trips | The Great Ocean Road Day Tour | The Twelve Apostles and Otway National Park | Go West Tours
  • Australia Independent Travel | Melbourne Day Trips | Phillip Island Day Tour | Rainbow Huts | Moonlit Sanctuary Wildlife Park | Penguin Parade | Go West Tours

Where to Stay in Melbourne

  • Australia Independent Travel | Melbourne City Accommodation | Clarion Suites Gateway | A Well-Located Apartment Hotel with Full Facilities

✈️ Airport to City Transport

To travel between Melbourne Airport and the city, you can take a public bus and transfer, or catch the SkyBus (the airport express shuttle bus). Of course, you can also just take an Uber — but for travellers, aside from Uber, the most convenient, fastest and most economical option is simply to hop on the SkyBus airport express!

  • Airport to city: T4 -> T3 -> T1 -> City (Southern Cross Station)
  • City to airport: City (Southern Cross Station) -> T1
Timetable:
SkyBus runs very frequently — roughly every 10–15 minutes. See https://www.skybus.com.au/melbourne-city-express/timetable/

Fares: (2023)

Trip fares One way Return
Adult 
$22.00 $44.00 $34.00
Child 
$4.00 $8.00 $6.00
Senior 
$18.00 $36.00 $30.00

Airport to City

International flights arriving in Melbourne clear immigration at T2 (Terminal 2), while domestic flights come out at T4. That said, these terminals aren't especially large and they're all close to one another.

Buying tickets is easy too. Once you're through immigration you'll spot the SkyBus counter inside the terminal, with fares clearly displayed and plenty of ticket machines. Just make your selection and pay by card. Return tickets are cheaper, but remember to keep your ticket safe. For an even better deal, you can buy tickets in advance on platforms like Klook or KKday, where the price may be lower than buying on the spot.

Finding where to board isn't hard either — as soon as you step outside, the SkyBus stop is impossible to miss. Just take your ticket, join the queue, and you're set. No difficulty at all.


The lower deck has plenty of space for large luggage

The drop-off point in the city

City to Airport

The city boarding point is at Southern Cross Station — the same place where the airport bus drops you off (on the opposite platform). Inside the station there's also a SkyBus service centre and ticket machines, plus clear signage telling you which platform to wait at.

There are two services here, one to Melbourne Airport (MEL) and one to Avalon Airport (AVV). Since the platforms are right next to each other, pay a little attention while waiting so you don't board the wrong bus.




🚌 Getting Around the City

Tram

Tram waiting platform

The main forms of public transport in central Melbourne are trams, buses and trains. If you're sightseeing in the city centre, you'll mostly use trams or buses; if you're heading to the outer suburbs, you're more likely to need trains or buses.

Bus

Free Tram Zone

from: www.ptv.vic.gov.au

In the central city there's an area called the Free Tram Zone. Anywhere within this zone, riding the tram is completely free and no ticket is required! The Free Tram Zone basically covers all of Melbourne's city-centre attractions, so if your itinerary stays within the CBD there's no need to buy a myki card at all. Trams also run frequently, so getting around central Melbourne by tram alone is very convenient.

Free Tram Zone map: Free-Tram-Zone-Map-Map 

(If the link is broken, go directly to the official site www.ptv.vic.gov.au)

Inside a tram

Things to note when riding in the Free Tram Zone:

  • No need to buy a myki card
  • If both boarding and alighting points are within the Free Tram Zone, you don't need to tap (touch on or off)
  • If either your boarding or alighting point is outside the Free Tram Zone, you must tap on/off
  • There will be an announcement when the tram is about to leave the Free Tram Zone
  • All transport other than trams requires payment, even within the Free Tram Zone

touch on or off (tapping your card)

Introduction to myki


myki is Melbourne's universal transit card. All passengers using public transport must use myki; if you don't have one when boarding, you'll need to buy one on the spot, and you cannot pay cash for public transport. What's more, myki cards can't be refunded — they simply expire automatically after their 4-year validity period, which can't be extended. So it's not a particularly tourist-friendly ticketing system.

The service centre at Southern Cross Station

To buy a myki, all major train stations have ticket machines or service centres. A small number of tram platforms also have ticket machines, and you can buy one at convenience stores as well.

myki purchase and top-up machine

A myki card costs AU$6, and this can't be put toward fares or refunded... Before using myki, you should understand that there are two ways to load value: myki pass and myki money

myki money: divided into two-hour and daily fares. Within two hours you'll only be charged a fixed amount no matter how many times you tap on, and once you exceed two hours it becomes a day fare

How to Buy a myki


Choose whether to buy a new myki or top up an existing one (two different options)


Buying a new card — select the Fare Type

It then moves automatically to the top-up step

The minimum top-up is AU$7

You can pay with cash or credit card

Checking Services and Timetables

Melbourne's public transport website has a  Journey planner feature that helps you plan routes and check timetables. In practice, though, the information on Google Maps these days is just as accurate and the interface is far easier to use than the PTV planner, so in the end I just used Google Maps and found it more than sufficient.

title.$t: 澳洲自由行 | 墨爾本市區住宿篇 | Clarion Suites Gateway | 地段很好設施齊全的公寓式酒店

content.$t:
這次在選擇墨爾本住宿的時候，基本的需求就是在入住的六天內可以住同一間，避免移動行李的不方便，房內也要有洗衣機或是飯店有洗衣房可以使用，最後就是交通方便的地點。找了一輪有發現在這需求下的墨爾本住宿都不太便宜...最後找到了雖然有點年代感，但是評價與地點不差的四星級公寓式酒店 Clarion Suites Gateway。

📜  資訊

  • 入住天數：六晚 (包含六日)
  • 入住房型：單臥室套房 (不含早餐)
  • 住宿價格：台幣 $35,421
  • 付款方式：可刷卡
  • 飯店地址：1 William St, Melbourne VIC 3000
  • 聯絡電話：+61392968888
  • 訂房網站：https://www.booking.com/hotel/au/clarion-suites-gateway.zh-tw.html?aid=8003516

📍 地點位置

Clarion Suites Gateway 的地點不是位於 Melbourne CBD (墨爾本市中心) 最熱鬧的逛街區域，他位在 Melbourne CBD 的左下區域，南十字車站 Southern Cross Station 與費蓮達火車站 Flinders Street Railway Station 的中間，往返機場(南十字車站)與前往郊區(費蓮達火車站)都十分的方便，可以簡單透過步行抵達兩個大型交通樞紐。

步行

從機場到市區會在南十字車站下車，接著只要步行約10 分鐘(800 公尺)就可以抵達 Clarion Suites Gateway 了。

建議出了南十字車站後先直直走到 Flinders St，再沿著 Flinders St 走沿路才會是平坦且好拉行李的路，如果沿著 Google 最短路徑導航的路中間會上上下下不是很好走。(我們一開始就是走這條路...後來才發現走下面比較好走)

比較好走的路徑

路面電車

由於 Melbourne CBD (墨爾本市中心) 內的路面電車 (Tram) 都是免費的 (在 Free Tram Zone 內)，所以也可以考慮搭乘電車來抵達飯店，不過由於沒有一班車就可以從南十字車站抵達 Clarion Suites Gateway，要轉車一次加上拖著行李上車下車，整體時間可能差不多，可以衡量看看或許直接用走的會比較輕鬆喔！

自行開車

飯店也有提供停車場，不像台灣入住飯店都可以免費停車，澳洲許多飯店的停車費是要另外計費的，Clarion Suites Gateway 停車一天的收費是 30 元澳幣 (約 600 台幣)，有需要可以參考一下飯店官網的說明：https://www.clarionsuitesgateway.com.au/hotel-information/car-parking/

🏢 飯店環境

入口有個小階梯 (旁邊有無障礙坡道)

一進門的接待櫃檯

一進門其實就感覺到飯店的年代感，不過整體的環境是乾淨明亮的，且一樓大廳蠻寬敞。由於我們抵達的時間不是假日，可能入住的旅客也沒很多，所以辦理住宿的流程蠻順暢的，除了房費之外，飯店會另外收取一筆押金，退房後檢查沒有任何問題才會退還。


Clarion Suites Gateway 附設的餐廳位在一樓，叫做 William Bar & Cafe，不過從疫情期間開始就暫時停止營業，所以現在入住也都不包含早餐囉。

簡單樸素的電梯間

飯店內沒有太多設施，有一個室內游泳池，不過我們也沒有去使用，就沒特別去拍照了，附上官方網站上的照片：

Photo from: https://www.clarionsuitesgateway.com.au/gallery/

🛏  房間環境

房間內自然採光不錯

客廳與廚房

一進門的客廳與開放式廚房

這次預定的是無景觀的單臥室套房，房間內的空間非常大，除了有區隔出一間臥室之外，客廳的部分是結合開放式廚房，且有一個很大的檯面，不論是做菜還是置物都很方便！

客廳一角有一個小辦公桌與不是很大的電視

寬敞的廚房空間

廚房的部分設施很充足，瓦斯爐、雙門中型冰箱、微波爐、烤箱、烤麵包機、快煮壺等等應有盡有，各類的碗盤、鍋具基本上也都有，非常適合想要自己開伙的住客，只要自己去超市購買油與調味料，就可以在房間內的廚房烹煮囉！

各類的碗盤、鍋具

瓦斯爐與烤箱

各類茶包與即溶黑咖啡

洗衣機是滾筒式，包含烘衣的功能，要自備洗衣粉或洗衣精，我們這次是在台灣購買洗衣球，方便在海外旅遊的時候攜帶。


臥室

臥室大小適中，床鋪的軟硬度偏軟一點點，不過還算是好睡，也由於不是在鬧區，晚上的安靜度也蠻不錯的。不過面對雅拉河的那一面可能會比較吵，因為正對面有火車鐵路，我們雖然是背面，但也還是聽得到一點點聲音。

房間內也有一個電視

保險箱、燙衣服用具與額外的枕頭、毛毯

浴室

浴室的部分大小適中，沒有什麼特別不好與特別好的地方，不過淋浴只有花灑，不像一般台灣飯店至少都還會有蓮蓬頭，但水量充足水壓很大，熱水溫度也沒問題。


飯店備品


整體入住的體驗還算不錯，不過有些扣分的地方：

  • 走廊上與客廳的隔音很差，感覺牆壁完全沒隔音效果
  • housekeeping 很偷懶，他不會幫你換毛巾，反而是把放在地放的毛巾折一折掛回去，因為我們有發現為什麼掛好新的毛巾有頭髮，有一次剛好他來整理的時候才發現他直接掛回去，才馬上叫他換。且窗台上有一層灰層，感覺他們打掃不是很確實，都在偷懶。

意外入住有送小禮物

如果想找有廚房、有洗衣設施的，在墨爾本這間 Clarion Suites Gateway 相對已經算平價了，如果入住時間包含假日，平均下來一晚也是要不便宜的六千元，雖然飯店比較舊一點，但是維持的還不錯，只有對於 housekeeping 不是很滿意。

title.$t: Australia Independent Travel | Melbourne City Accommodation | Clarion Suites Gateway | A Well-Equipped Apartment Hotel in a Great Location

content.$t:
When choosing accommodation in Melbourne this time, our basic requirements were: staying in the same room for all six nights to avoid the hassle of moving luggage, having a washing machine in the room or a laundry room in the hotel, and a location with convenient transport. After searching around, we found that Melbourne accommodation meeting these requirements isn't exactly cheap... In the end we settled on Clarion Suites Gateway, a four-star apartment hotel that feels a little dated but has decent reviews and a good location.

📜  Information

  • Length of stay: six nights (including the weekend)
  • Room type: One-Bedroom Suite (no breakfast)
  • Price: NT$35,421
  • Payment: credit cards accepted
  • Address: 1 William St, Melbourne VIC 3000
  • Phone: +61392968888
  • Booking site：https://www.booking.com/hotel/au/clarion-suites-gateway.zh-tw.html?aid=8003516

📍 Location

Clarion Suites Gateway isn't in the busiest shopping district of the Melbourne CBD; it sits in the lower-left part of the CBD, between Southern Cross Station and Flinders Street Railway Station. That makes it very convenient both for getting to and from the airport (Southern Cross Station) and for heading out to the suburbs (Flinders Street Station) — you can simply walk to both major transport hubs.

On foot

Coming from the airport into the city you'll get off at Southern Cross Station, and from there it's only about a 10-minute walk (800 metres) to Clarion Suites Gateway.

I'd suggest that after leaving Southern Cross Station you walk straight down to Flinders St and then follow Flinders St — that route is flat and easy with luggage. If you follow Google's shortest route, part of the way goes up and down and isn't easy to walk. (We took that route at first... only later did we realise the lower route was easier.)

The easier walking route

Tram

Since trams within the Melbourne CBD are free (inside the Free Tram Zone), you could also consider taking a tram to the hotel. However, there's no single line that takes you from Southern Cross Station straight to Clarion Suites Gateway — you'd need to change once, plus haul your luggage on and off, so the total time is probably about the same. Weigh it up; walking may well be easier!

Driving

The hotel also has a car park. Unlike Taiwan, where hotel parking is usually free, many Australian hotels charge separately for parking. At Clarion Suites Gateway parking costs AU$30 per day (about NT$600). If you need it, check the details on the hotel's official site: https://www.clarionsuitesgateway.com.au/hotel-information/car-parking/

🏢 Hotel Environment

There are a few steps at the entrance (with a wheelchair ramp beside them)

The reception desk right inside the door

Walking in, you can immediately sense the hotel's age, but overall the environment is clean and bright, and the ground-floor lobby is quite spacious. Since we arrived on a weekday and there probably weren't many guests, check-in went smoothly. Besides the room rate, the hotel also takes a deposit, refunded after check-out once they've confirmed there are no issues.


The in-house restaurant at Clarion Suites Gateway is on the ground floor and is called William Bar & Cafe, but it has been temporarily closed since the pandemic, so stays no longer include breakfast.

The plain, simple lift lobby

The hotel doesn't have many facilities. There's an indoor swimming pool, but we didn't use it so we didn't take photos — here's a shot from the official website instead:

Photo from: https://www.clarionsuitesgateway.com.au/gallery/

🛏  The Room

The room gets good natural light

Living room and kitchen

The living room and open kitchen just inside the door

This time we booked a One-Bedroom Suite without a view. The room is very spacious: besides the separate bedroom, the living area is combined with an open kitchen that has a large countertop — handy both for cooking and for putting things down!

A corner of the living room has a small desk and a not-very-large TV

A roomy kitchen space

The kitchen is very well equipped: gas stove, medium-sized double-door fridge, microwave, oven, toaster, kettle and more, plus a full range of plates, bowls and cookware. It's perfect for guests who want to cook for themselves — just buy oil and seasonings at the supermarket and you can cook right in your room!

All kinds of plates, bowls and cookware

Gas stove and oven

A selection of tea bags and instant black coffee

The washing machine is a front-loader with a drying function. You need to bring your own laundry powder or liquid — we bought laundry pods in Taiwan, which are easy to carry when travelling overseas.


Bedroom

The bedroom is a reasonable size and the mattress is on the slightly soft side, but still comfortable to sleep on. As we weren't in the busy district, it was pleasantly quiet at night too. That said, the side facing the Yarra River may be noisier since the railway lines are right opposite; our room faced the back, but we could still hear a little noise.

There's a TV in the bedroom too

Safe, ironing gear, plus extra pillows and blankets

Bathroom

The bathroom is a decent size with nothing especially good or bad about it, though the shower is a fixed rain head only — unlike most Taiwanese hotels, which at least also have a handheld shower head. Still, the water flow and pressure are strong and the hot water is fine.


Bathroom amenities


Overall the stay was pretty good, though a few things lost points:

  • Sound insulation from the corridor and the living room is poor — it feels like the walls have no soundproofing at all.
  • Housekeeping is lazy: they don't replace your towels; instead they fold the towels you left on the floor and hang them back up. We noticed because a freshly "hung" towel had a hair on it, and one time we happened to be there while they were servicing the room and saw them hang it straight back — we asked them to change it on the spot. There was also a layer of dust on the windowsill, so their cleaning clearly isn't thorough; they're just cutting corners.

A surprise little welcome gift

If you're looking for a place in Melbourne with a kitchen and laundry facilities, Clarion Suites Gateway is relatively affordable. If your stay includes a weekend, the average still works out to a not-so-cheap NT$6,000 or so per night. The hotel is a bit older but well maintained; the only thing we weren't happy with was the housekeeping.

title.$t: 澳洲自由行 | 墨爾本郊區行程 | 菲利普島一日遊 Phillip Island | 彩虹小屋 | 月光保護區野生動物園 | 企鵝歸巢 | Go West Tours

content.$t:
Penguin Parade (企鵝遊行)，又稱為企鵝歸巢，是墨爾本最著名的旅遊行程，任何來墨爾本的旅行團也都會安排這個行程。其實以前小時候曾經有來過，不過那時候年紀還小，其實不太記得實際狀況了，這次有機會來到墨爾本，就選擇了再來看一次企鵝歸巢。

要觀看企鵝歸巢，要到菲利普島上的 Penguin Parade Visitor Centre，從墨爾本開車過來單趟約要兩小時的車程，通常大家會選擇自駕，順路玩玩沿路的景點，不過由於企鵝歸巢觀看完的時間應該會將近10點，再開回墨爾本市區就會蠻晚的了，可以考慮入住在附近，或是和我們一樣直接參加一日遊囉！

Penguin Parade Visitor Centre

  • 地址：1019 Ventnor Rd, Summerlands VIC 3922
  • 營業時間：16:00–22:00

🗺 菲利普島一日遊

我們參加的 Tour 一樣是從 KKday 上預訂 Go West Tour 的行程，訂購方式蠻簡單的，購買行程後，就會收到 Go West Tour 寄來的確認信了，接下來有什麼需要聯絡的都可以直接用 email 跟他們聯絡就可以囉。不過基本上出發前都不太需要額外聯絡了，只要在指定時間到達指定的集合地點就可以了。

菲利普島觀看企鵝歸巢的行程有蠻多種不同的組合，由於企鵝們是晚間才會回來，所以通常下午會搭配著附近不同的景點，來組合成一個一日遊的行程。

我們這次選擇的是這個組合：

  • 彩虹小屋 Brighton Bathing Boxes
  • 月光保護區野生動物園 Moonlit Sanctuary Wildlife Park
  • 諾比司中心 Phillip Island Nobbies Centre
  • 企鵝歸巢 Penguin Parade

🌈 彩虹小屋 Brighton Bathing Boxes

離開墨爾本市區莫約半小時的車程後，我們第一個景點來到的是，大家俗稱「彩虹小屋」的 Brighton Bathing Boxes。其實這個景點在出發前查詢的時候，看照片好像蠻美而且蠻好拍，所以有在考慮是該直接跟團，還是應該自己找一天搭車過來有比較多的時間。不過，實際來了之後發現這個景點應該也不會待太久，還好最後還是跟團了 🤣

Brighton Bathing Boxes

  • 地址：Esplanade, Brighton VIC 3186
  • 交通：從墨爾本市區搭乘火車抵達 Middle Brighton Station，再步行前往海灘

Brighton Bathing Boxes 最初建於 1860 年，主要用途是出租給當地人當作儲藏室或是更衣間，每間小屋都有著不同的彩繪與圖案，漸漸的這裡也成為一個知名的觀光景點。現今這些小屋據導遊所說，只要是居住在這區 or 這一洲 (有點忘了)的居民，是可以購買且現在是有在販售的，不過價格不低就是了。

我們抵達的這天天氣非常的好，所以沙灘上的人潮也是非常的多，很多人都在沙灘上曬太陽做日光浴，或是在海裡玩水。

也因為是的度假的好天氣，才有機會看到有幾間小屋的主人有來，是有打開在使用的。小屋裡面很簡陋，因為沒水沒電，基本上可能只能當作更衣，或是來海邊玩的休息室，真的是要常來海邊玩而且是有錢人可能才會想買小屋的所有權吧。

Brighton Bathing Boxes 內部

🦘 月光保護區野生動物園 Moonlit Sanctuary Wildlife Park

月光保護區野生動物園於 1998 年起開始建立，2001 年開始對外營業，這裡有著澳洲本土在保護區中發現的動物群，並致力於恢復受到威脅的澳洲動物。雖然園區並不是很大，不過開放式的園區除了可以看到澳洲本土的無尾熊、袋熊之外，還可以在袋鼠區購買食物餵食袋鼠喔！

Moonlit Sanctuary Wildlife Conservation Park

  • 地址：550 Tyabb-Tooradin Rd, Pearcedale VIC 3912
  • 營業時間：09:30–16:00
  • 官方網站：https://moonlitsanctuary.com.au/

票價

感覺剛睡醒在恍神的無尾熊

從彩虹小屋過來的車程大約要將近一小時，在這裡停留的時間也是約一小時，有蠻充裕的時間可以看看動物與餵食袋鼠。不過因為抵達的時候是中午時段，再加上當天天氣實在是蠻熱且蠻曬的，袋鼠們都在睡覺或是懶洋洋的...

有點壯的袋鼠

在裡面來來回回繞了一圈，發現買的袋鼠飼料根本沒有袋鼠想吃... ，加上天氣實在很熱，在快要放棄的時候，袋鼠們開始有慢慢出來吃遊客的食物了，不知道是不是現在才是吃飯時間？購買的袋鼠飼料一盒 3 澳元，裡面是乾糧與玉米粒的混合，有發現袋鼠們都不太喜歡吃玉米粒，還會特別挑掉 🤣


袋鼠：天氣很熱

不同品種的小袋鼠

🦭 諾比司中心 Phillip Island Nobbies Centre

離開月光野生動物園之後，接著就會再經過一小時的車程，抵達菲利普島了！菲利普島是維多利亞州的第二大島，與澳洲本土透過陸橋連接，因為是神仙企鵝主要的棲息地，因此又被稱為企鵝島，也是我們這次 Tour 最主要的目的地。

在出發前往吃晚餐與觀看企鵝歸巢之前，來到菲利普島會先抵達 Nobbies Ocean Discovery Centre，又被稱為海豹岩海洋生物中心。這裡可以遠眺海豹岩，據說可以看到許多海豹在岩石上，也有 tour 是專門會出海去看海豹。

海豹岩蠻遠的，要實際看到海豹也是真的有點難...

這裡風蠻大的，除了風景遼闊優美之外，更有趣的是可以在木棧道下、或是旁邊的小洞中，找到神仙企鵝的身影。

發現躲在木棧道底下的企鵝

躲在洞穴與木棧道的小企鵝

🐧 企鵝歸巢 Penguin Parade

由於不能攝影，照片取自官網：https://www.penguins.org.au/attractions/penguin-parade/

最後一站就是來到這個 Tour 的最重點，觀看神仙企鵝歸巢了。抵達後車子會停在 Penguin Parade Visitor Centre 的停車場，經過 Penguin Parade Visitor Centre 沿著步道，就可以抵達觀看企鵝歸巢的海邊。


不是很便宜的票價

昨日企鵝數量、上岸時間與今日預測時間


雖然遊客中心內有預測時間，但不知道企鵝們實際何時會上岸，通常在天還沒暗的時候，大家就會陸續到位置上坐著等待了。


小企鵝們會在天色暗下來之後，才會成群結隊上岸，回到牠們的巢穴中。在大家等待的同時，會有工作人員先來跟大家做介紹，並且告知當小企鵝出現後就不能再拍攝照片了。



大概要等到天色全暗之後，才會開始出現一批一批的小企鵝上岸，數量很多也很有趣。另外，也可以留點時間給原先走過來的步道，因為當企鵝上岸後，他們都會在步道旁邊走來走去與發出叫聲，可以看得更清楚喔！

整個 Tour 結束回到墨爾本市區的時候已經快要 12 點了，還好 Tour 會把你放到指定的飯店附近，加上墨爾本市區的治安不算太差，所以還算是蠻安全的。不過我們回程下大雨，天色又很暗，自駕不熟悉路線可能會有點危險，如果沒有打算要在菲利普島住上一晚，那或許可以考慮看看直接跟一日遊的行程，會比較輕鬆舒適。

如果來到墨爾本，別錯過這個經典的小企鵝歸巢的景點，畢竟這是在其他地方很難見到的景色！

title.$t: Australia Independent Travel | Melbourne Day Trips | Phillip Island Day Tour | Brighton Bathing Boxes | Moonlit Sanctuary Wildlife Park | Penguin Parade | Go West Tours

content.$t:
The Penguin Parade, also known as the penguins' return to their burrows, is Melbourne's most famous tour, and just about every tour group coming to Melbourne includes it in the itinerary. I actually visited once as a child, but I was so young back then that I don't really remember what it was like. Now that I had the chance to come to Melbourne again, I decided to see the Penguin Parade one more time.

To watch the Penguin Parade, you need to go to the Penguin Parade Visitor Centre on Phillip Island. It's about a two-hour drive one way from Melbourne. Most people choose to self-drive so they can stop at attractions along the way, but since the penguin viewing doesn't finish until close to 10 pm, driving back to central Melbourne makes for a very late night. You might consider staying nearby, or just joining a day tour like we did!

Penguin Parade Visitor Centre

  • Address: 1019 Ventnor Rd, Summerlands VIC 3922
  • Opening hours: 16:00–22:00

🗺 Phillip Island Day Tour

The tour we joined was, again, booked through KKday — a Go West Tour itinerary. Booking is quite simple: after purchasing, you'll receive a confirmation email from Go West Tour, and from then on you can contact them directly by email for anything you need. Generally, though, no extra contact is needed before departure — just show up at the designated meeting point at the designated time.

There are many different combinations of tours for seeing the Penguin Parade on Phillip Island. Since the penguins only come back in the evening, the afternoon is usually paired with various nearby attractions to make up a full day trip.

This is the combination we chose:

  • Brighton Bathing Boxes
  • Moonlit Sanctuary Wildlife Park
  • Phillip Island Nobbies Centre
  • Penguin Parade

🌈 Brighton Bathing Boxes

About half an hour's drive from central Melbourne, our first stop was the Brighton Bathing Boxes, popularly known in Chinese as the "rainbow huts." When I was researching before the trip, the photos looked so pretty and photogenic that I wondered whether I should join a tour or come out here on my own to have more time. But after actually visiting, I realized you don't really need to stay long — luckily we went with the tour in the end 🤣

Brighton Bathing Boxes

  • Address: Esplanade, Brighton VIC 3186
  • Getting there: Take the train from central Melbourne to Middle Brighton Station, then walk to the beach

The Brighton Bathing Boxes were first built in 1860, mainly rented out to locals as storage sheds or changing rooms. Each box has its own painted design and pattern, and over time the spot has become a well-known tourist attraction. According to our guide, these boxes can be purchased today by residents of this area — or this state (I can't quite remember which) — and some are currently on the market, though the prices are far from cheap.

The weather was fantastic the day we visited, so the beach was packed with people sunbathing on the sand or playing in the water.

And because it was such perfect holiday weather, we got to see a few boxes with their owners present and the doors open. The interiors are very basic — no water, no electricity — so they can really only serve as changing rooms or rest spots for a beach day. You'd probably have to be both a frequent beachgoer and quite wealthy to want to buy one.

Inside a Brighton Bathing Box

🦘 Moonlit Sanctuary Wildlife Park

Moonlit Sanctuary Wildlife Park was established in 1998 and opened to the public in 2001. It's home to native Australian animals found within the sanctuary and is dedicated to the recovery of threatened Australian species. Although the park isn't very large, its open layout lets you see native koalas and wombats, and you can even buy food in the kangaroo area to feed the kangaroos!

Moonlit Sanctuary Wildlife Conservation Park

  • Address: 550 Tyabb-Tooradin Rd, Pearcedale VIC 3912
  • Opening hours: 09:30–16:00
  • Official website: https://moonlitsanctuary.com.au/

Ticket prices

A koala that looks like it just woke up and is still dazed

It's nearly an hour's drive from the Brighton Bathing Boxes, and we stayed here for about an hour — plenty of time to look at the animals and feed the kangaroos. However, since we arrived around midday and the weather was really hot and sunny, the kangaroos were all sleeping or lazing about...

A rather buff kangaroo

After walking back and forth around the park, we found that not a single kangaroo was interested in the feed we'd bought... and with the heat, we were about to give up when the kangaroos slowly started coming out to eat visitors' food. Maybe that was finally mealtime? A box of kangaroo feed costs AUD 3 and contains a mix of dry pellets and corn kernels — we noticed the kangaroos don't really like the corn and even pick it out 🤣


Kangaroo: it's so hot out here

A wallaby of a different species

🦭 Phillip Island Nobbies Centre

After leaving Moonlit Sanctuary, another hour's drive brings you to Phillip Island! Phillip Island is Victoria's second-largest island, connected to the mainland by a bridge. Because it's the main habitat of the little (fairy) penguins, it's also known as Penguin Island, and it was the main destination of our tour.

Before heading off for dinner and the Penguin Parade, our first stop on Phillip Island was the Nobbies Ocean Discovery Centre, also known as the Seal Rocks marine life centre. From here you can look out toward Seal Rocks, where many seals are said to gather on the rocks; there are also tours that go out to sea specifically to see the seals.

Seal Rocks is quite far away, so actually spotting seals is genuinely difficult...

It's very windy here, and besides the sweeping, beautiful scenery, the more interesting part is that you can spot little penguins under the boardwalk or in the small burrows alongside it.

A penguin we spotted hiding under the boardwalk

Little penguins tucked into burrows and under the boardwalk

🐧 Penguin Parade

Since photography isn't allowed, this photo is from the official website: https://www.penguins.org.au/attractions/penguin-parade/

The last stop is the highlight of the whole tour: watching the little penguins return home. On arrival, the bus parks in the Penguin Parade Visitor Centre car park; you pass through the visitor centre and follow the boardwalk down to the beach where you watch the parade.


Not exactly cheap ticket prices

Yesterday's penguin count, arrival time, and today's predicted time


Although the visitor centre posts a predicted time, no one knows exactly when the penguins will come ashore, so people usually start taking their seats and waiting while it's still light out.


The little penguins only come ashore in groups after dark, heading back to their burrows. While everyone waits, a staff member gives an introductory talk and reminds visitors that once the penguins appear, photography is no longer permitted.



It's only once it's completely dark that groups of little penguins start coming ashore, one batch after another — there are a lot of them and it's great fun. Also, leave some time for the boardwalk you walked in on, because once the penguins are ashore they waddle back and forth beside it and call out, so you can see them even more clearly!

By the time the whole tour finished and we got back to central Melbourne, it was nearly midnight. Fortunately the tour drops you off near your designated hotel, and central Melbourne is reasonably safe, so it felt fine. That said, it poured with rain on the way back and it was very dark — self-driving could be a bit dangerous if you don't know the roads. If you're not planning to stay a night on Phillip Island, joining a day tour might be the easier, more comfortable option.

If you're visiting Melbourne, don't miss this classic little penguin parade — it's a sight you'd be hard-pressed to see anywhere else!

title.$t: 澳洲自由行 | 墨爾本郊區行程 | 大洋路一日遊 The Great Ocean Road | 十二使徒岩和奧特威國家公園 | Go West Tours

content.$t:
十二使徒岩 (The Twelve Apostles)

大洋路 (The Great Ocean Road)，是位於墨爾本近郊、澳洲西南部的一條沿海公路，全長約243公里，起點為 Torquay，終點為 Allansford。作為澳洲最著名的自然旅遊景點之一，這條公路不僅是到墨爾本必訪的景點之一，更是眾多旅客前來澳洲必去的地方。

🗺 大洋路怎麼玩

大洋路門牌 (Memorial Arch at Eastern View)

大洋路包含許多景點，像是最有名的十二使徒岩 (The Twelve Apostles)、阿德湖峽 (Loch Ard Gorge) 或是倫敦拱橋 (London Arch) 等等，由於路程很長，基本上靠大眾運輸是不可能的，通常旅行方式最方便會是自駕，或是和我們一樣參加當地的旅行團。

如果只有一天的時候可以給大洋路的行程，可以直接考慮參加旅行團的一日遊，如果兩天以上，就可以考慮租車來深度遊覽大洋路囉！

大洋路景點：大洋路 Google Map 路線規劃

  • 貝爾斯海灘 (Bells Beach)
  • 大洋路門牌 (Memorial Arch at Eastern View)
  • 洛恩鎮 (Lorne)
  • 阿波羅灣 (Apollo Bay)
  • 十二使徒岩 (The Twelve Apostles)
  • 阿德湖峽 (Loch Ard Gorge)
  • 倫敦拱橋 (London Arch)

🚌 訂購當地旅行團

這次我們這趟澳洲行並沒有打算自駕，所以大洋路的行程也是選擇了參加旅行團的方式，我們選擇的是從 KKday 上訂購的英文團，會幫你代訂  Go West Tours 的行程。

訂購方式蠻簡單的，購買行程後，就會收到 Go West Tour 寄來的確認信了，接下來有什麼需要聯絡的都可以直接用 email 跟他們聯絡就可以囉。不過基本上出發前都不太需要額外聯絡了，只要在指定時間到達指定的集合地點就可以了。

Go West Tour 寄來的確認信，會有集合時間地點

🗺 出發大洋路 - Torquay

從七點開始， Tour 的巴士就會從市區開始陸續接人上車，距離我們住宿最近的是 7:50 在 Rendezouvs Hotel 這站上車，幾乎已經是離開市區前的最後一站了，一上車就發現約20人座的小巴，幾乎已經是坐滿的狀況。車子都還蠻準時來的，所以千萬不要遲到，司機兼導遊都會有一個名冊，只要確認姓名就可以上車了。

坐滿滿的小巴

在出發前有看到行程寫有 Morning Tea and Cake，還以為是會先去間餐廳給我們吃早餐。經過一個半小時的車程離開市區後，我們第一站來到了 Torquay Surf Beach 旁邊的停車場小公園，導遊就拿出了三壺熱水跟幾種不同口味的茶包和蛋糕，讓大家在出發前先吃吃小東西稍作休息 🤣

這裡位於大洋路的起點 Torquay，是個衝浪聖地的海灘，不過我們來的這天早上的天氣其實不是很好，有些一陣一陣的飄雨，海風非常非常的大，吹起來十分寒冷，所以也只有零星幾個衝浪客有來這個海灘。


🗺 大洋路門牌 Memorial Arch at Eastern View

大洋路門牌 (Memorial Arch at Eastern View)

大約再過了 30 分鐘車程，就會抵達 Memorial Arch at Eastern View，這裡有著象徵大洋路起點的大洋路門牌，也被稱為大洋路拱門，旁邊也有一個紀念碑，紀念建造大洋路的人們。不過這景點就真的是下車拍張照就結束了，附近也沒有什麼其他東西。

🌳 Koala Sleeping Tree

野生無尾熊！

接著在午餐之前，先來到離大洋路門牌 45 分鐘車程的一個小休息站 Kafe Koala，這裡有一條路可以看到野生的無尾熊，不過由於是野生的，停留時間大概也只有半小時左右，所以導遊事先也有說不保證一定看得到。不過幸運的是，我們有找到兩隻野生的無尾熊，雖然因為都在樹上只能遠遠的看到而已，但體驗蠻有趣的。(不過要看清楚還是在動物園最清楚)

🏝 阿波羅灣 Apollo Bay

阿波羅灣是在大洋路上的一個海岸小鎮，1845 年的時候由於猛烈颱風襲擊，一艘名為阿波羅號的帆船因為在這裡的平靜水域躲避颱風襲擊，此灣才因而得名。這裡也是大部分旅遊團，或是自駕的遊客會來休息，或是享用午餐的地點。這裡也有許多住宿，如果是規劃二日遊，或是三日遊的旅客，也可以選擇在這裡住上一晚。

阿波羅灣有許多餐廳，也有超市，算是在大洋路上一個重要的休息與補給站，但是由於我們跟團的停留時間也只有 45 分鐘，光吃午餐就其實蠻趕的，如果選擇餐廳可能會來不及，所以選擇導遊推薦的一家澳洲傳統肉派來當午餐。

Apollo Bay Bakery
  • 125 Great Ocean Rd, Apollo Bay VIC 3233

Apollo Bay Bakery

🌲 Maits Rest Rainforest Walk

在澳洲，有著不少的雨林生態，而在大洋路上， Great Otway National Park 內也有著一個可以穿越原始雨林的步道 - Maits Rest Rainforest Walk。這個景點離阿波羅灣大約只有15分鐘的車程，導遊會帶著我們進入步道，沿途介紹雨林的生態與植物，除了路好走之外，全長也只有 800 公尺，是一個蠻輕鬆放鬆的行程。

我們的司機兼導遊，是一位退休的郵差

雨林內除了步道的部分之外，其他都保持的很原始，有很多巨大的樹、蕨類，也有許多鳥類，而且也是個完全沒有任何手機收訊的地方 🤣。最後在離開前，還會帶著大家一起閉起眼睛，深深呼吸，放大感官，仔細感受在雨林的感覺。

🏞️ 十二使徒岩 (The Twelve Apostles)

接下來就是這次大洋路一日遊的重點了，十二使徒岩！

位於坎貝爾港國家公園內的海岸邊，有著一系列自然形成的石灰岩的組合，這些石頭被稱為「母豬和小豬」，不過後來它們的名字被改成更加吸引人的十二使徒岩，目前存有八塊。

這些石頭形成於海浪的侵蝕作用。在過去的1000到2000萬年中，來自南冰洋的風暴和大風不斷的腐蝕相對鬆軟的石灰岩懸崖，並在其上形成了許多洞穴。這些洞穴不斷變大，以致發展成拱門，並最終倒塌。

Tour 的車會停在遊客中心讓大家下車，只要沿著步道走幾分鐘就可以到海邊，看到這些壯麗的景色囉。還可以選擇自費搭乘直升機從空中俯瞰整個十二使徒岩，體驗不一樣的壯麗，不過如果跟團的話，選擇自費搭乘直升機就沒有時間步行到海邊看這景色了。

在來澳洲之前查詢景點的時候，看到十二使徒岩的照片似乎覺得沒有到很震撼，也看到網路上有人說台灣的花東還比較漂亮，不過實際到訪後，還是有被這裡遼闊與壯麗的景色驚艷到！

再往前一點點約車程 2 分鐘的距離，可以抵達另一個點 - Gibson Steps， 這是沿著山壁建立的樓梯，樓梯很窄又蠻陡的，行走要特別小心。走下來之後可以抵達沙灘，可以從沙灘的角度來看十二使徒岩，也有著讓你置身於電影外星球場景般壯麗的景色。


🏞️ 阿德湖峽 (Loch Ard Gorge)

我們這個一日遊旅行團的最後一個景點，就是位於十二使徒岩附近2公里的阿德湖峽 Loch Ard Gorge，這裡命名是因為以前有一艘名為「阿德湖號」（Loch Ard）的英國移民船在此處觸礁遇難，為了紀念這些遇難者，這個地方被命名為「Loch Ard Gorge」。

這裡是被巨大的石灰岩包圍的沙灘，海水會從狹窄的入口進入，感覺很像一個秘境，拍照起來也很美。這裡是 Tour 的最後一站，導遊也會找大家在這裡一起拍張大合照，做今天大洋路一日遊最後的 Ending。

十分美麗的 Loch Ard Gorge


結束了最後一站阿德湖峽之後，時間也差不多到了晚間六點，接下來就是一路200多公里的路程回到墨爾本市區，中間會停一站讓我們簡單快速地吃一點晚餐，大約 9:30 之後會回到市區。

回程路上遇到的野生袋鼠群

大洋路是個來到墨爾本必訪的景點之一，但如果和我們一樣只留給大洋路一天，且不想要太累的自駕的話，跟團是一個不錯的選擇，直接濃縮最精華的幾的景點在一天內走完。

content.$t:
The Twelve Apostles

The Great Ocean Road is a coastal highway in southwestern Australia, just outside Melbourne. It runs for about 243 kilometres, starting at Torquay and ending at Allansford. As one of Australia's most famous natural attractions, it is not only a must-see when visiting Melbourne, but also a place countless travellers make a point of visiting when they come to Australia.

🗺 How to Travel the Great Ocean Road

Great Ocean Road sign (Memorial Arch at Eastern View)

The Great Ocean Road takes in many attractions, such as the famous Twelve Apostles, Loch Ard Gorge and London Arch. Because the route is so long, getting around by public transport is basically impossible; the most convenient options are usually self-driving or, like us, joining a local tour.

If you only have one day to spare for the Great Ocean Road, a one-day group tour is worth considering. If you have two days or more, renting a car lets you explore the Great Ocean Road in depth!

Great Ocean Road attractions: Great Ocean Road Google Maps route plan

  • Bells Beach
  • Memorial Arch at Eastern View
  • Lorne
  • Apollo Bay
  • The Twelve Apostles
  • Loch Ard Gorge
  • London Arch

🚌 Booking a Local Tour

We weren't planning to drive ourselves on this Australia trip, so for the Great Ocean Road we also went with a group tour. We chose an English-language tour booked through KKday, which arranges the tour for you with  Go West Tours.

Booking is quite simple: after purchasing the tour you'll receive a confirmation email from Go West Tours, and from then on you can contact them directly by email for anything you need. That said, you generally don't need to get in touch before departure — just show up at the designated meeting point at the designated time.

The confirmation email from Go West Tours, with the meeting time and place

🗺 Setting Off on the Great Ocean Road - Torquay

From 7am the tour bus starts picking people up around the city one stop at a time. The stop closest to our accommodation was the 7:50 pickup at the Rendezvous Hotel, which is almost the last stop before leaving the city. As soon as we boarded we found the roughly 20-seat minibus was already nearly full. The bus arrives quite punctually, so don't be late — the driver-guide has a name list, and once your name is confirmed you can hop on.

The packed minibus

Before setting off I'd seen "Morning Tea and Cake" listed on the itinerary and assumed we'd be taken to a restaurant for breakfast. After an hour and a half of driving out of the city, our first stop was a small car-park park next to Torquay Surf Beach, where the guide pulled out three thermoses of hot water along with a selection of tea bags and cakes, so everyone could have a little something and take a short break before continuing 🤣

This is Torquay, the start of the Great Ocean Road and a surfing mecca. The weather that morning wasn't great, though — there were intermittent showers and the sea breeze was extremely strong and bitterly cold, so only a handful of surfers were out on the beach.


🗺 Memorial Arch at Eastern View

Great Ocean Road sign (Memorial Arch at Eastern View)

About another 30 minutes' drive brings you to the Memorial Arch at Eastern View, home to the sign marking the start of the Great Ocean Road, also known as the Great Ocean Road arch. Next to it stands a memorial honouring the people who built the road.That said, this stop really is just hop off, take a photo and you're done — there isn't much else nearby.

🌳 Koala Sleeping Tree

A wild koala!

Next, before lunch, we stopped at a small rest stop 45 minutes' drive from the Memorial Arch, Kafe Koala, where there's a trail along which you can spot wild koalas. Since they're wild — and we only stayed about half an hour — the guide told us in advance there was no guarantee we'd see any. Luckily we spotted two wild koalas; they were up in the trees so we could only see them from a distance, but it was a fun experience. (For a proper close-up look, though, the zoo is still best.)

🏝 Apollo Bay

Apollo Bay is a small coastal town on the Great Ocean Road. In 1845, during a fierce storm, a schooner named the Apollo sheltered in these calm waters — and that's how the bay got its name. It's also where most tour groups and self-driving travellers stop to rest or have lunch. There's plenty of accommodation here too, so if you're planning a two- or three-day trip, you could stay a night here.

Apollo Bay has plenty of restaurants as well as a supermarket, making it an important rest and resupply point on the Great Ocean Road. But our tour only stopped for 45 minutes, so even just having lunch felt rushed — a sit-down restaurant would have taken too long, so we went with a traditional Australian meat pie recommended by our guide.

Apollo Bay Bakery
  • 125 Great Ocean Rd, Apollo Bay VIC 3233

Apollo Bay Bakery

🌲 Maits Rest Rainforest Walk

Australia has plenty of rainforest ecosystems, and on the Great Ocean Road, within Great Otway National Park, there's a walk that takes you through old-growth rainforest — the Maits Rest Rainforest Walk. It's only about a 15-minute drive from Apollo Bay. Our guide led us along the trail, explaining the rainforest ecology and plants along the way. The path is easy and only 800 metres long, making it a relaxed, refreshing part of the itinerary.

Our driver-guide, a retired postman

Apart from the walkway itself, the rainforest is kept completely pristine, with huge trees, ferns and lots of birdlife — and absolutely no phone reception 🤣. Before leaving, the guide had us all close our eyes, breathe deeply, open up our senses and really take in the feeling of the rainforest.

🏞️ The Twelve Apostles

Next comes the highlight of this Great Ocean Road day trip: the Twelve Apostles!

Along the coast within Port Campbell National Park stands a series of naturally formed limestone stacks. They were once called the "Sow and Piglets", but the name was later changed to the more appealing "Twelve Apostles". Eight of them remain today.

The stacks were formed by wave erosion. Over the past 10 to 20 million years, storms and gales from the Southern Ocean gradually eroded the relatively soft limestone cliffs, carving out numerous caves. These caves kept growing until they became arches, which eventually collapsed.

The tour bus drops everyone off at the visitor centre, and it's just a few minutes' walk along the path to the coast to take in these magnificent views. You can also pay extra to take a helicopter flight for an aerial view of the whole Twelve Apostles — a very different kind of grandeur — but if you're on a group tour, choosing the helicopter means you won't have time to walk out to the coastal viewpoints.

When I was researching attractions before coming to Australia, photos of the Twelve Apostles didn't look all that impressive, and I'd even seen people online say Taiwan's east coast is prettier. But after visiting in person, I was genuinely blown away by how vast and magnificent the scenery is!

Just a couple of minutes further down the road is another spot — Gibson Steps, a staircase built into the cliff face. The steps are narrow and fairly steep, so take extra care. At the bottom you reach the beach, where you can view the Twelve Apostles from sand level amid scenery so magnificent it feels like an alien planet from a movie.


🏞️ Loch Ard Gorge

The final stop on our day tour was Loch Ard Gorge, about 2 kilometres from the Twelve Apostles. It's named after the Loch Ard, a British immigrant ship that struck the reef and was wrecked here; the site was named "Loch Ard Gorge" in memory of those who lost their lives.

It's a beach enclosed by towering limestone walls, with the sea flowing in through a narrow entrance — it feels like a hidden paradise, and photographs beautifully. This was the tour's last stop, and the guide gathered everyone for a group photo to round off the Great Ocean Road day trip.

The stunning Loch Ard Gorge


After finishing at Loch Ard Gorge it was around 6pm, and from there it was a 200-plus kilometre drive back to central Melbourne, with one stop along the way for a quick, simple dinner. We got back to the city after about 9:30pm.

A mob of wild kangaroos we spotted on the way back

The Great Ocean Road is one of the must-visit attractions when you come to Melbourne. But if, like us, you only have one day for it and don't want the exhaustion of driving yourself, joining a tour is a great option — it condenses the very best highlights into a single day.

title.$t: 澳洲自由行 | 墨爾本郊區行程 | 普芬比利鐵路 Puffing Billy Railway | 復古煤炭蒸汽火車 | 交通資訊與如何買票

content.$t:
Puffing Billy Railway 最經典的拍攝點

墨爾本除了市中心之外，其實蠻多郊區的景點很有趣，有時間的話很值得一訪，除了需要開車或參加 Tour 的大洋路或是菲利浦島企鵝歸巢之外，有幾個景點是比較容易自己從市中心搭車過來的，這個普芬比利鐵路 Puffing Billy Railway 就是其中之一。

  • 地址：1 Old Monbulk Rd, Belgrave VIC 3160
  • 營業時間：09:00–17:00
  • 聯絡電話：+61397570700
  • 官方網站：http://www.puffingbilly.com.au/

🚃 地點交通資訊

從市區到 Puffing Billy Railway 的交通方式其實很簡單，除了自駕前往之外，只要一班火車(藍線往 Belgrave 方向)直達「Belgrave」站，出站後步行三分鐘就會到入口囉！

但是，我們再出發澳洲前查詢交通的時候，不幸的發現這段鐵路中間會有一段在維修，所以沒辦法直接利用火車直達這麼簡單，必須使用火車轉乘公車的方式才能抵達，路程時間也從本來火車直達的 1 小時，變成要 1.5 小時...

硬生生多了半小時的車程...

從 Flinders Street Railway Station 準備上車囉！

需要購買一張 myki card 來使用
再換公車...要搭一小時的公車
抵達 693 號公車的最後一站 Belgrave，回程上車在一樣地點對面搭車

🎫 入口與購票

售票與換票處

網路上查到之前別人的心得，似乎都是可以到現場再買票，這樣也比較好抓時間來搭配蒸氣火車班次，不過這次我們在網路上先購票的時候有看到網站上特別標注的訊息：

All our visitors are required to pre-book their tickets online. Please select your preferred experience below to begin.

到現場領票後問售票人員，他們也說現在開始都一定要網路上先購票，到現場再領實體票卷才可以囉！

從路口要先經過這段才會到購票處

網路購票：https://puffingbilly.com.au/buy-tickets/

也可以到 KKday 或是 Klook 上購買票卷喔，但價格差不多的話官網買還是最好囉！

這次我們在 Klook 上購票體驗不是很好，購買其他行程船票的時候，購買好付錢後隔天跟我們說沒票了，要取消訂單，如果可以購買都付款了不是應該是有足夠的票嗎？差點害我們行程泡湯... 光是這點就極度不推薦 Klook 了

  網路購票


網路購票的話也是不會太困難，他有分幾個不同起始站與終點站的來回票組合，直接看好你要搭到哪裡，然後選好時間，刷卡後就會拿到電子憑證囉。


Belgrave 站出發時間 (夏季與冬季時間稍有不同)：
  • 10:00
  • 11:15
  • 12:35 (假日限定)
我們本來想買 10:00 出發的，可惜前一兩天晚上才買票，只買得到 11:15 的票了，而且到了現場售票人員也說現在平日沒有 12:35 這班車了，不確定是不是因為疫情的關係。



至於要搭到哪一站，大家都是推薦到 Lakeside 就可以囉！而且光是到 Lakeside 就已經單程要一小時了，再往後的景色其實都長得一樣，而且時間就會變得很趕，如果從頭搭到尾 (底站Gembrook) 全程要將近兩小時的車程。


🚂 復古煤炭蒸汽火車


普芬比利鐵路 Puffing Billy Railway 有著超過百年的歷史，是目前維多利亞州內僅存保留完整且可以使用的火車軌道，除了現今的觀光價值之外，也有著極高的歷史價值。

進入車站前會先經過販賣區


真的使用煤炭作為動力的火車頭


車廂內很簡單，是開放式的車廂，記得去程要乘坐靠近月台這一側，這樣在經過 Puffing Billy Railway Trestle Bridge 的時候，才能夠拍出經典的景色喔！

另外建議如果坐在後半段的車廂，拍照起來也才會比較好看，不過這次領票的時候就有劃位分配車廂了，不確定是不是能跟他說想要後面一點的車廂。


車廂內提供了乘坐在窗台上的方式，但聽說之前在 2018 年有發生過意外，因此一度禁止乘坐在窗台上。不過這次去已經恢復開放囉 (2023年)，可以讓遊客乘坐在窗台上，體驗早期搭蒸氣火車的感覺，出發前車站員工還會到每節車廂簡單介紹要怎麼乘坐。


沿途經過的自然風光

比較特別的是，Puffing Billy Railway 這裡的員工有一大半都是志工，每一站都會有老爺爺站長在出發的時候做搖鈴的動作。



   Lakeside



Lakeside 是自由行旅客最多人下車的地點，這裡其實是在 Emerald Lake Park 內，裏面有一個小湖，附近有一些咖啡廳與草地，不少人會選擇在這裡午餐。


網路上蠻多心得都說 Lakeside 很美，在這裡野餐很棒，不過自己是覺得實際的景色好像還好...? 湖實際蠻小的，跟台大醉月湖差不多大，而且附近也沒有什麼太多東西，野生的鳥類與水鳥倒是有非常多。

一坐下來野餐馬上各種鳥類就會靠近

我們是參照網路上建議，也是買了點東西在這裡野餐，不過對於野餐如果沒太大興趣的，Lakeside 遊客中心裡面有間餐廳，可以直接在那裡用餐就可以囉～

Lakeside 遊客中心

Lakeside 火車站與遊客中心之間的走道


Puffing Billy Railway 最經典的拍攝點

這次普芬比利鐵路 Puffing Billy Railway 一日遊的體驗其實是蠻有趣的，除了可以搭乘復古的煤炭蒸汽火車之外，乘坐在窗台上的方式也是第一次，沿途經過的樹林與草原雖然沒有很特別驚艷，但路過所有的汽車或是路人都會很熱情的揮手，也算是一段可以讓你放鬆心靈舒適有趣的旅程。

不過由於我們是的時候是 3 月初，天氣還是偏涼，如果沒有穿外套在火車上風吹起來還是非常的冷喔。另外就是由於是真的在燒煤炭，身上都會有細碎的煤炭，最可怕的是當他飛進你眼睛的那一刻，實在是非常的痛，而且會痛到張不開 😅 ，這點之後有去這行程的要自己小心囉！

特別時刻火車頭會變成湯瑪士小火車...

title.$t: Australia Independent Travel | Melbourne Day Trip | Puffing Billy Railway | Vintage Coal-Fired Steam Train | Transport Info & How to Buy Tickets

content.$t:
The most classic photo spot on the Puffing Billy Railway

Beyond the city centre, Melbourne actually has quite a few interesting attractions out in the suburbs that are well worth a visit if you have time. Apart from the Great Ocean Road or the Phillip Island penguin parade, which require driving or joining a tour, there are several spots you can easily reach on your own by public transport from the city — and the Puffing Billy Railway is one of them.

  • Address: 1 Old Monbulk Rd, Belgrave VIC 3160
  • Opening hours: 09:00–17:00
  • Phone: +61397570700
  • Official website: http://www.puffingbilly.com.au/

🚃 Getting There

Getting from the city to the Puffing Billy Railway is actually very simple. Apart from driving yourself, you just take a single train (the blue line towards Belgrave) straight to "Belgrave" station, and it's a three-minute walk from the station to the entrance!

However, when we were checking transport options before setting off for Australia, we unfortunately discovered that part of this rail line was under maintenance, so we couldn't simply take the train the whole way — we had to transfer from train to bus to get there, and the journey time went from the usual 1 hour by direct train to 1.5 hours...

An extra half hour of travel time, just like that...

About to board at Flinders Street Railway Station!

You'll need to buy a myki card to use the system
Then transfer to a bus... a one-hour bus ride
Arriving at Belgrave, the final stop of bus route 693; for the return trip you catch the bus across the road from the same spot

🎫 Entrance and Tickets

Ticket office and ticket collection point

From other people's write-ups online, it seemed you could just buy tickets on the spot, which also makes it easier to plan around the steam train departure times. But this time, when we were booking online, we noticed a message specially highlighted on the website:

All our visitors are required to pre-book their tickets online. Please select your preferred experience below to begin.

When we collected our tickets on site, we asked the ticket staff and they confirmed that from now on you must book online first and then pick up the physical tickets at the station!

From the intersection you walk along this stretch before reaching the ticket office

Online booking: https://puffingbilly.com.au/buy-tickets/

You can also buy tickets on KKday or Klook, but if the prices are similar, booking through the official website is still the best option!

Our experience buying on Klook this time wasn't great: when we booked ferry tickets for another part of our trip, we paid and then the next day they told us there were no tickets left and the order had to be cancelled. If you're able to book and pay, shouldn't that mean there are enough tickets? It almost ruined our itinerary... For that reason alone, I really can't recommend Klook.

  Booking Online


Booking online isn't difficult either. There are several return-ticket combinations with different departure and destination stations — just decide how far you want to ride, pick your time, pay by card, and you'll receive an e-voucher.


Departure times from Belgrave station (summer and winter times differ slightly):
  • 10:00
  • 11:15
  • 12:35 (weekends and holidays only)
We originally wanted the 10:00 departure, but since we only booked a night or two beforehand, all we could get were 11:15 tickets. On site, the ticket staff also said the 12:35 service no longer runs on weekdays — not sure whether that's because of the pandemic.



As for how far to ride, everyone recommends Lakeside! Even getting to Lakeside already takes an hour one way, and the scenery beyond that looks much the same, plus your schedule gets very rushed. Riding the whole line to the end (the terminus, Gembrook) takes nearly two hours.


🚂 The Vintage Coal-Fired Steam Train


The Puffing Billy Railway has over a century of history and is the only fully preserved, still-operating railway line of its kind in Victoria. Besides its value as a tourist attraction today, it also carries enormous historical significance.

You pass through the shop area before entering the station


A locomotive genuinely powered by coal


The carriages are very simple and open-sided. Remember to sit on the platform side on the outbound trip — that way you'll be able to capture the classic view as the train crosses the Puffing Billy Railway Trestle Bridge!

I'd also suggest sitting in one of the rear carriages, as the photos come out better. That said, this time the carriage was assigned when we collected our tickets, so I'm not sure whether you can request a carriage further back.


The carriages let you sit on the window ledges, though apparently there was an accident back in 2018 that led to this being banned for a time. On our visit (2023) it had been reopened, so visitors can sit on the window ledges and experience what riding a steam train was like in the old days. Before departure, station staff come around to each carriage to briefly explain how to sit safely.


Natural scenery along the way

One special thing about the Puffing Billy Railway is that more than half of the staff here are volunteers, and at every station an elderly stationmaster rings a bell as the train departs.



   Lakeside



Lakeside is where most independent travellers get off. It's actually inside Emerald Lake Park, which has a small lake, plus some cafés and lawns nearby — many people choose to have lunch here.


Plenty of write-ups online say Lakeside is beautiful and a great picnic spot, but personally I found the scenery just okay...? The lake is actually quite small — about the size of Drunken Moon Lake at NTU — and there isn't much else around. There are, however, a huge number of wild birds and waterbirds.

The moment you sit down to picnic, all sorts of birds come over

Following the advice online, we also bought some food and had a picnic here. But if picnics aren't really your thing, there's a restaurant inside the Lakeside visitor centre where you can just eat instead~

Lakeside visitor centre

The walkway between Lakeside station and the visitor centre


The most classic photo spot on the Puffing Billy Railway

This day trip on the Puffing Billy Railway was genuinely fun. Besides riding a vintage coal-fired steam train, it was our first time sitting on the window ledge of a train. The woods and meadows along the way weren't especially breathtaking, but every car and passer-by we passed waved at us enthusiastically, making it a relaxing, comfortable and enjoyable journey.

That said, we went in early March when the weather was still on the cool side, and without a jacket the wind on the train is really cold. Also, since they're genuinely burning coal, you'll end up with fine coal specks on you — and the scariest moment is when one flies into your eye. It hurts so much you can't even open your eye 😅. Anyone doing this trip in future, be careful!

On special occasions the locomotive is turned into Thomas the Tank Engine...

title.$t: 澳洲自由行 | 墨爾本市區美食篇 | 人氣早午餐與咖啡廳 | 咖啡之都 | The Hardware Societe | Higher Ground

content.$t:
這次到了咖啡之都墨爾本，因為行程沒有排得太緊湊，除了每天都可以找一間咖啡廳來喝咖啡之外，還挑了兩間在網路上知名的早午餐餐廳來試試看。
 

   🥯 The Hardware Société

The Hardware Societe - Katherine Place

The Hardware Societe 是一家位於墨爾本市中心的鄉村時尚風格法式餐廳，提供咖啡、甜點或是餐點，其中又以早午餐和咖啡最為聞名，在墨爾本除了本店「Hardware Street」之外，還有另一家分店「Katherine Place」，現在也在巴黎與巴賽隆納都有分店。

這次我們是去離住宿地點底較近的分店「Katherine Place」，網路上介紹常常都會大排長龍，但不知道是否因為我們是平日早上，且又是去分店，完全沒有遇到需要排隊的狀況，店內大約1/4坐滿而已。

  • 地址：10 Katherine Pl, Melbourne VIC 3000
  • 網站：http://hardwaresociete.com/
  • 菜單：https://www.hardwaresociete.com/melbourne
  • 電話：+61396212100



餐廳內走的是鄉村時尚風格，空間明亮，一進去店員就會帶你到座位上，然後給你菜單後直接先問你有沒有要先點咖啡，一開始有點不習慣因為我連菜單都還沒看😅，但似乎是這裡的習慣？

這次我們品嘗了 Baked Eggs (烤蛋) 和 Benedict (丹尼狄克)，還點了兩杯咖啡。一般主餐類價格約在20到30澳幣之間，咖啡約為5到8澳幣之間。總共消費63澳幣，以澳洲物價來看算是中等價位。

Benedict (丹尼狄克)

BENEDICT *

confit garlic beef brisket, Pedro Ximénez sticky onions, orange hollandaise, crispy shallots

漢堡內夾了班尼迪克蛋，配上底下的牛肉與微酸的醬汁，整體來說蠻好吃的，而且牛肉份量給很多，最後還差點吃不完。

The Hardware Societe 的菜單上有一道叫做 BENEDICT 的早午餐，其中夾了班尼迪克蛋的漢堡，搭配上 confit garlic beef brisket (蒜味慢煮牛胸肉) ，再加上微酸的橙子荷蘭醬，味道整體來說蠻好吃的，而且牛肉的份量十分大，差點吃不完。如果喜歡吃漢堡，或者想要嚐試一種不同的班尼迪克蛋，那The Hardware Societe 的 BENEDICT 可以來試試看。

備註：

  • Confit garlic beef brisket："Confit garlic beef brisket" 是一種經過慢慢煮熟的牛胸肉，並混合了煮軟的大蒜，使牛肉呈現出濃郁的大蒜香味。這道料理通常需要花費幾個小時慢慢燉煮以達到最佳的口感和風味，可以被用來做各種不同的菜餚。
  • Pedro Ximénez sticky onions：Pedro Ximénez是一種西班牙產的酒，而sticky onions指的是經過慢慢燉煮的洋蔥，通常會加入糖或是醋等材料增添風味，讓洋蔥變得黏稠甜美。在這道菜中，Pedro Ximénez 被加入洋蔥中一同慢煮，製成一種微甜的醬汁。

Baked Eggs (烤蛋)

BAKED EGGS * 

UN (V) — tomato and thyme tartare, semi‐dried tomatoes, basil pistou, stracciatella, smoked almonds DEUX — chorizo, potato, piquillo peppers, queso manchego, almonds, aioli

這道菜是網路上蠻多人推薦的必吃烤蛋，有兩種口味可以選擇：

  • UN (V) — 使用切碎番茄和百里香混合而成的醬料，半乾番茄，九層塔醬汁，燻杏仁和stracciatella（一種類似義大利酪梨的軟質奶酪）
  • DEUX— 融合了西班牙香腸、土豆、皮克喬辣椒、奶酪、杏仁和 aioli (一種類似於蒜泥和蛋黃醬)。

用小鐵鍋裝的烤蛋，會搭配烤得酥脆的麵包來食用，這口感與口味真的蠻不錯，只是他的價格已經從網路上 2019 年的 20 澳幣變成 25 澳幣就是了😅




   🥞 Higher Ground

在網路上搜尋墨爾本咖啡廳或是墨爾本早午餐，Higher Ground 大概都一定會出現在結果裡面，是一家網路上蠻推薦的知名餐廳。它的外觀是紅磚的舊建築，是由廢棄發電廠改建而成，裡面則是高挑的工業風，整體空間很寬敞，就算全部客滿也不會有太擁擠的感覺。

這次會來也是因為 Higher Ground 就位於 Southern Cross 車站對面，最後一天要到搭乘機場巴士之前剛好來這裡吃早午餐。其實前一天週日早上的時候，我們就有走過來想要吃吃看，但沒想到大排長龍，隔天最算是週一早上，人也還是滿的，等了一下下才入座，可見 Higher Ground 在墨爾本的熱門程度。

  • 地址：650 Little Bourke St, Melbourne VIC 3000
  • 網站：https://highergroundmelbourne.com.au/
  • 菜單：https://highergroundmelbourne.com.au/menu/
  • 電話：+61388996219


比較不起眼的入口處

Blueberry & Ricotta Hotcake

blueberry hotcake with maple, seeds & grains, cream, seasonal berries, flowers v

餐點的選擇一樣是先看了網路上推薦什麼，發現蠻多人推薦一個比較特別的 Hotcake 熱蛋糕，就選擇試試看了。他有點像是烤的外酥內軟的鬆餅(蛋糕？)，淋上楓糖漿之後，外面撒上各類穀物與水果，最後有一大球奶油，整體外觀蠻色彩繽紛，口感也不錯。

其中比較驚豔的是這麼大塊的鬆餅可以烤的外酥內軟，相當的不錯且很好吃，只是這一盤一人吃會蠻膩的，建議還是要點其他食物來分食。

這一盤不配咖啡可能會吃不下去


開放到許多蒼蠅都可以隨意進出的麵包櫃

值得一提的是，我們剛好坐在這個開放式麵包餐點櫃旁邊，有發現這個麵包櫃開放到許多蒼蠅都可以隨意進出，麵包上都有不少的蒼蠅....然後當有人點麵包或是小蛋糕的時候，店員就會來這裡直接拿，所以來到 Higher Ground 不太建議點這些麵包蛋糕，除非腸胃很強壯。



來到咖啡之都墨爾本的時候，如果有時間不妨找找當地的店，坐下來喝杯咖啡，或是悠閒的吃個早午餐，體驗一下當地人的生活步調吧！
