title.$t: Yilan Accommodation | HOTEL PIN Jiaoxi | Room Review | Facilities | A Design-Savvy Hot Spring Hotel

content.$t:
On this trip to Yilan we decided to spend a night in Jiaoxi. While searching online I came across this fairly new hotel that looked like good value for money, so here's a write-up of our stay.

📜  Information 

  • Stay date: 2020-11-01 (double room, one Sunday night)
  • Room type: Pin Spring Double Room (breakfast for two included)
  • Price: $ 3,640
  • Payment: credit cards accepted
  • Address: No. 2, Lane 21, Jiankang 2nd St., Jiaoxi Township, Yilan County
  • Phone: +88639889090
  • Official website: https://jiaoxi.hotel-pin.com/tw/index.php
  • Booking site: https://www.booking.com/hotel/tw/pin-wen-lu.xt.html?aid=8003516

HOTEL PIN is the LDC Hotels & Resorts group's first lifestyle-hotel brand, having opened only in July 2019. It's a new hotel built around green and eco-friendly concepts, and its logo is designed after the Taiwan Blue Magpie, Taiwan's most iconic national-treasure bird. If you're not familiar with the LDC group, you may have heard of some of its upscale properties, such as Palais de Chine and The Lalu Sun Moon Lake.

The hotel logo, designed after the Taiwan Blue Magpie


📍 Location

HOTEL PIN Jiaoxi sits near Jiaoxi Hot Spring Park, just a ten-minute walk from Jiaoxi Train Station. Almost everything in the surrounding area is either an upscale or a newly built hotel.

There's plenty of parking, with several lots (I recall seeing P1 through P7), so you don't need to worry about finding a space. That said, they're all outdoor spaces, so if it rains you'll have to walk a stretch outside with an umbrella to reach your room or the lobby.




For most of the lots you can just park and go; only for lot P3 do you need to get a token from the front desk before you drive off, otherwise you won't be able to exit!

The parking token required for lot P3

🏢 Hotel Grounds

HOTEL PIN is split into two buildings, Building 1 and Building 2, with no sky bridge between them, so you have to step outside. Besides guest rooms, Building 1 mainly houses the reception lobby and restaurant, while Building 2 has the recreation area, including the pool, spa, game room and so on.


The reception desk in Building 1

A bright, spacious reception area

Building 2, across the P2 parking lot

The lobby of Building 2 — our stay happened to fall on Halloween


🛏 The Room

This time we stayed in a double room on the top floor (7F) of Building 2. Quite a few online reviews say the rooms are small, but personally I found the space just right — two people don't feel cramped at all, and you can even open two large suitcases fully on the floor.


On the entrance side there's a full-length mirror, a dressing light and an integrated clothes rack, which is handy for getting ready before heading out — and it looks pretty stylish too (?)


The entire room was designed by a Taiwanese design firm; the white steel frame overhead symbolizes a greenhouse, aiming to give guests a sense of "nature and letting go." We don't like beds that are too soft, and HOTEL PIN's beds lean firm, so the firmness suited us nicely.


At the far end by the window is the bathroom and hot spring area, with a hot spring tub and a shower zone.


Jiaoxi's hot springs are sodium bicarbonate springs — clear, odorless water with a pH of around 7. The tub is a good size and you can even take in the view out the window, though our room looked out onto the parking lot and the building opposite, so we basically kept the curtains closed.


The shower area next to the hot spring tub

Basic toiletries

The vanity with a large mirror

One slightly odd thing, though: the bathroom and toilet are separated into wet and dry areas, with the toilet located right by the entrance, a fair distance from the bathroom. Whether that's convenient depends on your habits.

A small toilet right by the entrance


Because HOTEL PIN emphasizes being green and eco-friendly, no single-use amenities are provided (slippers, toothbrushes, bottled water). If you need slippers you can ask for them at the front desk. As for water, the room provides a glass carafe and a kettle, and guests fill up at the elevator lobby themselves!


Right outside the elevator on every floor there's a sparkling water machine dispensing chilled water, room-temperature water and sparkling water. If you want hot water, you fill the kettle yourself and boil it.


Chilled water, room-temperature water and sparkling water on tap


🛴 Other Facilities

Building 2 also has some recreational facilities and a swimming pool. We skipped the pool, but did wander over to the game area in the evening. There's a playroom suitable for little kids, plus basketball arcade machines, a PS4, a Switch and more for everyone — though you need to reserve in advance to play the PS4 or Switch.

A children's playroom, great if you're travelling with kids




🍽 Breakfast

Lastly, a word about breakfast. It's served at the restaurant on the ground floor of Building 1 — the bright, high-ceilinged space to the right of the front desk. The selection is quite generous: congee, salads and bread, as well as Taiwanese options like danzai noodles and savory soy milk. It's definitely a breakfast that will fill you up.








Overall the stay was a pleasant one, and the room was nice and quiet — we didn't hear much noise from poor soundproofing at night.

If I had to nitpick, it rained during our stay, so it would have been better if the parking lots and the passage between Buildings 1 and 2 had some cover.

All in all, though, based on this experience I'd still recommend this hotel.

title.$t: 台北景點 | 銀河洞 | 銀河洞越嶺步道 | 有仙氣的拍照景點 | IG 網美景點

content.$t:
銀河洞位於銀河洞越嶺步道內，是位於新北市新店山區的一個景點，1914年的時候這裏依洞而興建呂洞賓廟，1958年時重新改建後，一度成為台北近郊著名的景點之一，但隨著時間演變，又逐漸沒落。傳說瀑布上方的岩石，有呂洞賓留下的腳印，與景美仙跡岩上的腳印，恰巧一左一右。

近幾年因為在 instagram 上成為打卡熱門景點，才越來越多人知道這個地方。從步道口走到銀河洞瀑布這裡大約半小時內就可以抵達，一路上都是石階，也不會到太難行走。從小住在新店住了這麼久，也是近幾年成為網美打卡景點後才知道有這個地方，最近趁有時間來這裡走走。

  • 地址：231新北市新店區銀河路68號



🚃 交通資訊

要到銀河洞步道口，還是開車或是騎車最方便囉，也有公車可以抵達附近。

🚗 汽機車

因為步道口位於一個轉角處，基本上不太可能停車，只能停機車，所以開車的人可以在前面的『福德祠』就先停車，再走過去步道口。不過這區可停車的範圍也不是太大，如果假日去可以能會沒有車位。

P.S 福德祠這裏有新規劃的乾淨廁所




🚌 大眾交通工具


如果搭乘公車，可以搭新店客運綠12線【坪林－捷運新店站】至銀河洞站，下車之後再走進來，路程大概是微微上坡的 1.3 km， 應該路程不會到太難走。




在步道路口有一個導覽圖，導覽圖上可以看到步道其實是還有連結到貓空的，我們實際走不到的時候也有遇到一位阿姨，他說他從貓空那邊走過來比較好走(?)，導覽圖上面是寫要 1.5 小時，有興趣的人可以試試看這條路線。

從這條小路進去就是步道的起點了！




一路上的步道大概都是這種石階，我覺得不會到太難走，但也不是很好走，尤其下雨天或是下雨過後石階可能會變得很滑，建議還是天氣好的時候來比較安全。

沿路就是一路上坡，石階旁也都有扶手

但不知道是不是季節的原因，扶手上全部都是毛毛蟲🐛🐛🐛，一路從路口到銀河洞瀑布的扶手都是，如果有來的人要注意一下，小心不要直接手就放上扶手了。

等看到旁邊扶手變成紅色的，就知道目的地快到了！



莫約20分鐘的爬樓梯行程後，就可以抵達今天的重點，銀河洞瀑布 & 沿山壁建造的小廟囉！







最多人拍照打卡的就是這個平台了，角度抓得好可以拍出不錯的照片。


沿著樓梯往上走，可以進入沿著山壁建造的呂洞賓廟，已經有百年的歷史，由於沿著山壁又緊連瀑布，廟裡面的空氣蠻潮濕。

這裡也有幾扇八角形的窗戶，可以遠眺山區的風景



穿過呂洞賓廟，可以繼續往上走，在這裡就會到銀河洞瀑布的後方，好天氣的時候瀑布搭配陽光的景色十分優美。


如果沿著這個樓梯再繼續走，就是往貓空方向了，全長大約 1.5 小時可以抵達步道的另一端出口，這次開車來如果走過去就還要再走回來...搭乘大眾運輸來的人可以考慮看看這條路線。

巧遇一隻在瀑布旁睡很熟的黑狗


好天氣的時候不妨來銀河洞步道走走吧！不但可以運動，也可以體會一下脫離世俗的美景。

title.$t: Taipei Attractions | Yinhe Cave | Yinhe Cave Cross-Ridge Trail | An Ethereal Photo Spot | Instagram-Worthy Destination

content.$t:
Yinhe Cave (Galaxy Cave) lies along the Yinhe Cave Cross-Ridge Trail, an attraction in the mountains of Xindian District, New Taipei City. In 1914 a temple dedicated to Lü Dongbin was built beside the cave, and after being rebuilt in 1958 it became one of the best-known scenic spots on the outskirts of Taipei — though it gradually faded from popularity over time. Legend has it that the rock above the waterfall bears a footprint left by Lü Dongbin, which happens to pair up as a left and right with the footprint on Xianjiyan (Immortal's Footprint Rock) in Jingmei.

In recent years it has become a hot check-in spot on Instagram, which is why more and more people have come to know about this place. It takes less than half an hour to walk from the trailhead to the Yinhe Cave Waterfall; the whole way is stone steps, and it isn't too difficult a walk. Even though I've lived in Xindian since I was little, I only learned about this place after it became an Instagram hotspot in recent years, so I recently took the chance to come and have a look.

  • Address: No. 68, Yinhe Rd., Xindian District, New Taipei City 231



🚃 Getting There

To reach the Yinhe Cave trailhead, driving or riding a scooter is still the most convenient option, though there are also buses that stop nearby.

🚗 By Car or Scooter

Because the trailhead sits at a bend in the road, parking a car there is basically impossible — only scooters can park. So drivers can park earlier at the "Fude Temple" and then walk over to the trailhead. That said, the parking area there isn't very big either, so on weekends you may not find a space.

P.S. There are newly built, clean restrooms at the Fude Temple.




🚌 Public Transport


If you take the bus, hop on the Xindian Bus Green 12 line [Pinglin – MRT Xindian Station] and get off at Yinhe Cave stop, then walk in from there. It's about 1.3 km of gentle uphill, so the walk shouldn't be too difficult.




There's a trail map at the trailhead, and on it you can see that the trail actually connects all the way to Maokong. While we were walking we ran into a lady who said coming over from the Maokong side is easier (?). The map says it takes about 1.5 hours, so if you're interested you could give that route a try.

Head in along this small path and you're at the start of the trail!




The trail is basically stone steps like these the whole way. I don't think it's too hard, but it's not exactly easy either — especially on rainy days or after rain, when the steps can get very slippery. I'd recommend coming in good weather to be safe.

It's uphill the whole way, with handrails alongside the stone steps

But maybe because of the season, the handrails were absolutely covered in caterpillars 🐛🐛🐛 — all the way from the trailhead to the Yinhe Cave Waterfall. If you're visiting, watch out and be careful not to just plonk your hand down on the railing.

Once you see the handrail turn red, you know you're almost at your destination!



After roughly 20 minutes of climbing stairs, you arrive at today's highlight: the Yinhe Cave Waterfall & the little temple built into the cliff face!







This platform is where most people take their check-in photos — get the angle right and you can capture some really nice shots.


Follow the stairs up and you can enter the Lü Dongbin Temple built against the cliff face. It already has a century of history, and because it clings to the rock right next to the waterfall, the air inside the temple is quite damp.

There are also several octagonal windows here with distant views over the mountains



Passing through the Lü Dongbin Temple, you can keep heading up and end up behind the Yinhe Cave Waterfall — on a fine day the waterfall paired with the sunlight makes for a truly beautiful sight.


If you keep going up these stairs, you'll be heading toward Maokong; it takes about 1.5 hours in total to reach the other end of the trail. Since we came by car this time, walking over would have meant walking all the way back... but those arriving by public transport might want to consider this route.

We happened upon a black dog sleeping soundly beside the waterfall


Next time the weather's good, why not come take a stroll on the Yinhe Cave Trail! You get some exercise, and you also get to experience scenery that feels a world away from the everyday.

title.$t: 台南住宿 | 台南晶英酒店 Silks Place Tainan | 客房介紹 | 設施介紹 | 飯店 bar - 水晶廊

content.$t:
由於今年公司的旅遊補助還沒使用，想說要用好用滿，就在台南選了一間高檔的旅館來住住。如果不是公司出錢，平常自己來玩可能捨不得著這麼貴的 😂，順手紀錄一下這次的入住經驗。

📜 資訊

  • 入住日期：2020-02-08 (雙床房週六一晚)
  • 入住房型：12 坪海東客房 (含雙人早餐)
  • 入住價格：$ 6,120
  • 付款方式：可刷卡
  • 飯店地址：700台南市中西區和意路1號
  • 聯絡電話：06 213 6290
  • 官方網站：https://tainan.silksplace.com/tw/index.html
  • 訂房網站：https://www.booking.com/hotel/tw/tai-nan-jing-ying-jiu-dian.xt.html?aid=8003516


台南晶英酒店，是晶華集團旗下的新飯店，開幕時間不算太久，所以整體飯店都還很新穎。

地點位置

台南晶英酒店鄰近新光三越與小西門商圈，離台南火車站大約十分鐘車程，步行半小時，地點就在藍曬圖旁邊，如果用走的可以到許多城市古蹟景點，也可以到許多小吃的地方，地點上可以說是非常方便。



飯店外面有露天的免費停車格，也有室內可以停，地下停車場 B5~B7 是專屬於台南晶英使用，最後在 check-in 的時候給櫃台登記車號，到隔日中午12:30之前都可以自由進出停車場。

機車的話也可以停到地下停車場停車，需要然後先付款($20)拿發票，最後退房的時候根據發票飯店會再退款給你。(P.S. 機車的話入住一個晚上總共可以停六次)


 旅館環境

由於現在正值武漢肺炎疫情時刻，飯店處處都有酒精消毒，也有人員在量體溫。

一開門進入飯店一樓，可以看到很氣派的大廳。

很氣派的大廳



從大廳繼續往後走，會有一區特色交誼廳，整個就很古色古香，感覺很適合在這裡喝上一杯茶。


在剛剛大廳一進來的左手邊，也會有一區休息區。

大廳旁的休息區



往前一點就是飯店的櫃檯，一去櫃檯 check-in 的時候，旁邊馬上就會遞上迎賓飲料 - 冬瓜茶。

溫的，不會太甜，喝起來蠻爽口。



check-in 完成後，就可以直接往旁邊的電梯上樓囉！




 房間環境


我們的房間在五樓，電梯一出來也有一塊很寬廣的小空地，旁邊得窗戶可以直接看得到四樓的泳池。




房內有很大的空間，除了加大的雙人床之外，靠窗邊還有很大的躺椅。
桌上還放著迎賓水果，而且用台灣造型的盤子裝的，蠻有特色。



一打開電視，還發現會客製化有你的名字在歡迎的字幕上



電視也有 HDMI / VGA 可以連接，最方便的是，內建了 Apple play 跟 Chromecast，只要連上房間的 wifi，掃描電視的 QRCode 就可以連接，直接用來放手機的 Netflix 或是 Spotify 音樂了！


房內的備品有一台膠囊咖啡機，並且附上兩顆膠囊可以使用


房間的 mini bar 所有飲料也都是免費，沒想到還有附上一罐台啤


床跟枕頭睡起來很舒服，但床頭邊只有一個插座，如果兩個人同時都要充電就不能放在床頭邊了，這點稍微會有些不太方便。




 浴室


浴室的空間也是很大，有著乾濕分離，也有著一個蠻大的浴缸。


淋浴的空間也不算小



沐浴用備品使用的是集華集團旗下的SPA品牌"沐蘭"


除了基本的牙刷牙膏等等之外，還附了兩片面膜可以使用



🛴 其他設施

飯店四樓是主要設施所在的地方，有游泳池，健身房，還有一個戶外的 bar (水晶廊)。



基本上我是沒有去使用，只去了 bar 點幾杯酒喝喝看而已



關於早餐的部分，有分中式早餐跟西式早餐，我是去吃中式的早餐，只有小小這一區

中式早餐用餐地點


西式早餐用餐地點

西式的會比較大，部分中式有的菜色其實西式也會有，所以不知道要去哪的話，不妨先進去繞一圈看看菜色再決定。

(可以跟前台人員說想先看看菜色)

 ---

整體住起來，其實沒有什麼好挑惕的，唯一考量的點可能就是有點點貴 😂

如果想要有不錯體驗舒服住一晚，而且又有預算的話，蠻推薦可以去住住看。

title.$t: Tainan Accommodation | Silks Place Tainan | Room Review | Facilities | Hotel Bar – Crystal Corridor

content.$t:
Since I still hadn't used this year's company travel subsidy, I figured I might as well make the most of it and pick a high-end hotel in Tainan. If the company weren't paying, I probably wouldn't be willing to splurge this much on my own trips 😂. Here's a quick record of the stay.

📜 Information

  • Stay date: 2020-02-08 (twin room, one Saturday night)
  • Room type: 12-ping Haidong Room (breakfast for two included)
  • Price: $ 6,120
  • Payment: Credit cards accepted
  • Address: No. 1, Heyi Rd., West Central District, Tainan 700
  • Phone: 06 213 6290
  • Official website: https://tainan.silksplace.com/tw/index.html
  • Booking site:https://www.booking.com/hotel/tw/tai-nan-jing-ying-jiu-dian.xt.html?aid=8003516


Silks Place Tainan is a newer hotel under the Regent (Silks) Group. It hasn't been open all that long, so the whole property still feels fresh and modern.

Location

Silks Place Tainan sits close to the Shin Kong Mitsukoshi and Xiaoximen shopping districts, about a ten-minute drive (or half-hour walk) from Tainan Railway Station, and right next to the Blueprint Culture & Creative Park. On foot you can reach many of the city's historic sites as well as plenty of street-food spots, so the location is extremely convenient.



There are free open-air parking spaces outside the hotel, plus indoor parking. Basement levels B5–B7 are reserved exclusively for Silks Place Tainan guests. Just register your license plate at the front desk during check-in and you can come and go freely from the car park until 12:30 p.m. the next day.

Scooters can also park in the basement. You pay first ($20) and keep the receipt; at check-out the hotel refunds you based on the receipt. (P.S. For scooters, you get a total of six entries per one-night stay.)


 Hotel Environment

As this was during the COVID-19 (Wuhan pneumonia) outbreak, there was hand sanitizer everywhere in the hotel and staff taking temperatures.

Step through the doors onto the first floor and you're greeted by a very grand lobby.

The grand lobby



Keep walking past the lobby and you'll find a distinctive lounge area with a lovely classical feel — it seems like the perfect spot to sit down with a cup of tea.


On the left as you enter the lobby there's another seating area.

The seating area beside the lobby



A little further ahead is the front desk. The moment you go up to check in, someone hands you a welcome drink — winter melon tea.

It's served warm, not too sweet, and very refreshing.



Once check-in is done, just head to the elevators next to the desk and go up!




 The Room


Our room was on the fifth floor. Stepping out of the elevator there's a wide open area, and the window beside it looks straight down onto the fourth-floor pool.




The room is very spacious — besides the oversized double beds, there's a large chaise longue by the window.
A welcome fruit plate sits on the table, served on a Taiwan-shaped dish, which is a nice touch.



Turn on the TV and you'll find a personalized welcome message with your name on it



The TV has HDMI / VGA inputs, and best of all it has built-in AirPlay and Chromecast — just connect to the room's Wi-Fi, scan the QR code on the TV, and you can stream Netflix or Spotify straight from your phone!


The room amenities include a capsule coffee machine, with two capsules provided


Everything in the room's mini bar is free too — I didn't expect them to even throw in a can of Taiwan Beer


The bed and pillows were very comfortable, but there's only one power outlet at the bedside — if two people both want to charge overnight, one of you can't keep your phone by the bed, which is slightly inconvenient.




 Bathroom


The bathroom is also very roomy, with separated wet and dry areas and a fairly large bathtub.


The shower area isn't small either



The bath amenities are from "Wellspring" (Mu Lan), the spa brand under the Silks Group


Besides the basics like toothbrushes and toothpaste, they also provide two facial masks



🛴 Other Facilities

The fourth floor is where the main facilities are: a swimming pool, a gym, and an outdoor bar (the Crystal Corridor).



I didn't really use any of them — I only went to the bar to try a few drinks



As for breakfast, there's a Chinese-style option and a Western-style option. I went for the Chinese breakfast, which is just this small area

The Chinese breakfast dining area


The Western breakfast dining area

The Western venue is bigger, and it actually serves some of the same dishes as the Chinese one. So if you can't decide, it's worth walking through first to look at the spread before choosing.

(You can tell the front-of-house staff you'd like to take a look at the food first)

 ---

Overall there really wasn't much to complain about; the only thing to consider is that it's a little on the pricey side 😂

If you want a great experience and a comfortable night's stay and the budget allows, I'd definitely recommend giving it a try.

title.$t: 檳城自助旅行 | 檳城酒吧篇 | Bar Surfing in Penang | Manchu Bar 满族酒吧 | Beso Rosado by ChinChin

content.$t:
這次來檳城短短四個晚上

除了飯店附設的酒吧外

找了兩天晚上各跑了一間 bar

體驗一下當地的特色酒吧

---

由於調酒口味是很主觀的

同一種調酒的味道並不一定適合每一個人

這裡只講自己的喜好與心得

作客觀的心得分享

🍸 Manchu Bar 滿族酒吧


📜 資訊

  • 地址：38 & 40, Jalan Pintal Tali, George Town, 10100 George Town, Pulau Pinang, 馬來西亞
  • 營業時間：19:00 ~ 03:00
  • 聯絡電話：+60 12-500 7588
  • 官方網站：https://www.facebook.com/manchupenang/


📍 環境與地點


位於喬治城的市中心

整間有著濃濃的中國古代風

也算是個小小的 speakeasy

因為大門進去一開始是找不到入口的

後來才發現要掀開布幕

推開後面的暗門才可以進去


我們約 8:30 的時候到

店內幾乎只有兩三桌客人而已

正常也很少人會這麼早開始喝酒 😅


也因為這樣才能好好地拍拍環境


整個就是濃厚的中國古代風

環境裝潢非常有特色


還有一個舞台

是給駐唱歌手表演用的


廁所也有特別設計



📜 酒單






🍸 調酒

Elixir Of Youth 仙丹 (RM 45)


一開始上來搭配乾冰

視覺上的體驗還不錯

這杯是用琴酒為基底

搭配 Campari 與花草類的一杯調酒

口感的話我覺得很符合他的命名

"仙丹"

實在是只有 Campari 的苦味...

原料裡面的花香味都沒出來

我感覺我好像是在喝一大壺的中藥


由於蝶豆花的關係

所以酒的顏色是淡淡的紫藍色


打開裝酒的容器

可以看到用料很實在

加了很多很多 😅

但因為沒有濾掉

倒出來的時候會一直喝到這些花草

口感上我也不是很喜歡一直吃到這些花草

所以這杯基本上我自己是蠻不喜歡的

Spring Ripple 格格的春天 (RM 58)



這杯格格的春天

也是琴酒為基底

使用了柚子，中國茶來搭配小黃瓜

一開始送上來的時候喝有一點太甜

要等待融冰一陣子後

降低甜度就蠻順口

尤其柚子跟小黃瓜的味道很搭

有種很清新的味道

Applemon 蘋果啦 (RM 38)



這杯是蘭姆為基底

口味算是個中規中矩的蘋果風味調酒

但一開始送上來的時候

上面插的肉桂棒是在燃燒的

燒的肉桂棒香氣

有讓整體風味加分不少

---

等到我們要離開的時候

已經都坐滿了


滿滿的都是人


也有駐唱歌手的表演


整體環境由於裝潢的特色

體驗是蠻特別的

但可惜調酒沒有完全都點到很合自己口味的


另外因為室內沒有禁菸

很多人在抽煙

空氣變很不好

而且我們入座後發現桌子也沒擦乾淨

上面還留有食物

這兩點倒是有大扣分

---

🍸 Reso Rosada by ChinChin



📜 資訊

  • 地址：86, Lebuh Bishop, George Town, 10200 George Town, Pulau Pinang, 馬來西亞
  • 營業時間：12:00 ~ 00:00
  • 聯絡電話：+60 4-263 6868
  • 官方網站：https://www.facebook.com/besodosadobychinchin/

📍 環境與地點


這間當初在找的時候

看起來是一間網美拍照名店

然後他們除了調酒外

餐點也是很有名的

在網路上查到照片的時候

bar 外面有一小塊區域

這塊有著浴缸專為網美拍照的裝潢

看起來很有特色

但實際到了之後竟然變成這樣



整個風格大改變

覺得好像之前的比較好看...


這次選擇了在吧台的位置

想要在這裡看看酒調製的過程


📜 酒單






🍸 調酒

Purple Rain, Purple Rain (RM 54)


這杯是用蝶豆花 infused 的琴酒為基底

搭配薰衣草，伯爵茶做的花草系調酒

帶有微微甜味跟花草香

整體平衡很不錯

是有讓我驚豔到的一杯

唯一缺憾就是這個杯子讓我聞不到香氣

Beso Beso (RM 35)


這杯本來要做 mocktail

但他可能忘記了還是變成一般調酒

這杯是用茶 infused vodka

搭配覆盆子果泥

與一些香草，玫瑰花做的調酒

酸酸甜甜，有覆盆子香氣

蠻順口

如果 infused 的茶香有出來

這杯層次應該會更厲害

Marikoriko (RM 36)



這杯用了 Spiced Rum

搭配百香果跟鳳梨

做成水果風味的 mojito 概念

喝起來大概是個水果風味 mojito

整體還不錯

基本上自己試過一些水果搭配 mojito

調出來的都不會太差

Tropic Panda (RM 34)


這杯走的是 Tiki 風

也是用了 Spiced Rum 跟百香果果泥

最後使用他們自製的 Ginger Beer

帶有蠻重的薑味

我覺得是個有趣的味道

但是喜不喜歡要看人

---

整體來說

我給這間的評價是不錯的



在吧台上看他們的調製過程

也有覺得是認真在調酒的

如果有去檳城

要找間酒吧喝酒

Beso Rosado by ChinChin 可以試試看

content.$t:
We only had four short nights in Penang

Besides the bar attached to our hotel

we picked two evenings and hit one bar each night

to experience some of the local specialty bars

---

Since cocktail taste is very subjective

the same cocktail won't necessarily suit everyone

here I'm only talking about my own preferences and impressions

sharing them as objectively as I can

🍸 Manchu Bar


📜 Information

  • Address: 38 & 40, Jalan Pintal Tali, George Town, 10100 George Town, Pulau Pinang, Malaysia
  • Opening hours: 19:00 ~ 03:00
  • Phone: +60 12-500 7588
  • Official website: https://www.facebook.com/manchupenang/


📍 Atmosphere & Location


Located in the heart of George Town

the whole place has a strong ancient-China vibe

and it also counts as a little speakeasy

because when you first walk through the front door you can't find the entrance

only later did we realize you have to lift the curtain

and push open the hidden door behind it to get in


We arrived around 8:30

and there were only two or three tables of guests inside

which makes sense—few people start drinking this early 😅


Which also meant we could take our time photographing the space


It's all heavy classical Chinese styling

the decor is really distinctive


There's also a stage

used by the resident singers for their performances


Even the restroom has a special design



📜 Drinks Menu






🍸 Cocktails

Elixir Of Youth (RM 45)


It arrives with dry ice

so the visual presentation is pretty good

This one is gin-based

paired with Campari and botanicals

As for the taste, I think it really lives up to its name

"Elixir"

because honestly all you get is Campari's bitterness...

none of the floral notes from the ingredients came through

It felt like I was drinking a big pot of Chinese herbal medicine


Thanks to the butterfly pea flower

the drink has a pale purple-blue color


Open up the vessel it comes in

and you can see they're generous with the ingredients

they packed in a whole lot 😅

But since it isn't strained

you keep getting bits of the herbs and flowers when you pour it out

and I really don't enjoy constantly chewing on those botanicals

so personally I wasn't a fan of this drink at all

Spring Ripple (RM 58)



This Spring Ripple

is also gin-based

using pomelo and Chinese tea paired with cucumber

When it first arrived it tasted a little too sweet

but after letting the ice melt for a while

the sweetness dropped and it went down easily

the pomelo and cucumber in particular go well together

giving it a very fresh, clean flavor

Applemon (RM 38)



This one is rum-based

a solid, by-the-book apple-flavored cocktail

But when it was first brought over

the cinnamon stick on top was lit and burning

and the aroma of the smoldering cinnamon

added quite a lot to the overall flavor

---

By the time we were leaving

every seat was taken


Packed with people


There was a resident singer performing too


Thanks to the distinctive decor

the overall experience is quite unique

but it's a shame none of the cocktails we ordered fully matched my taste


Also, because smoking is allowed indoors

lots of people were smoking

and the air got pretty bad

plus after we sat down we found the table hadn't been wiped clean

there was still food left on it

those two points were big minus marks

---

🍸 Reso Rosada by ChinChin



📜 Information

  • Address: 86, Lebuh Bishop, George Town, 10200 George Town, Pulau Pinang, Malaysia
  • Opening hours: 12:00 ~ 00:00
  • Phone: +60 4-263 6868
  • Official website: https://www.facebook.com/besodosadobychinchin/

📍 Atmosphere & Location


When I was researching this place

it looked like a famous Instagram photo spot

and besides cocktails

their food is also well known

In the photos I found online

there was a small area outside the bar

decorated with a bathtub specifically for Instagram photos

which looked really distinctive

But when we actually got there, it had turned into this



The whole style has completely changed

and I feel like the old look was nicer...


This time we chose seats at the bar counter

so we could watch the drinks being made


📜 Drinks Menu






🍸 Cocktails

Purple Rain, Purple Rain (RM 54)


This one is based on butterfly pea flower–infused gin

paired with lavender and Earl Grey tea for a floral, botanical cocktail

It has a slight sweetness and floral aroma

and the overall balance is very good

this was the drink that impressed me

The only downside is that the glass made it hard to smell the aroma

Beso Beso (RM 35)


This was supposed to be made as a mocktail

but the bartender may have forgotten and it came as a regular cocktail

It uses tea-infused vodka

with raspberry purée

plus some herbs and rose petals

Sweet and tart with a raspberry aroma

very easy to drink

If the infused tea notes had come through

this drink would have had even more complexity

Marikoriko (RM 36)



This one uses spiced rum

with passion fruit and pineapple

built on the concept of a fruit-flavored mojito

and it tastes pretty much like a fruity mojito

Overall it's quite good

basically, from the fruit-mojito combinations I've tried myself

none of them ever turn out badly

Tropic Panda (RM 34)


This one goes for a tiki style

also using spiced rum and passion fruit purée

finished with their house-made ginger beer

It has a fairly strong ginger kick

which I found an interesting flavor

though whether you like it depends on the person

---

Overall

I'd rate this place highly



Watching them mix the drinks from the bar counter

you can tell they take their craft seriously

If you're in Penang

and looking for a bar for a drink

Beso Rosado by ChinChin is worth a try

---

content.$t:
Tree Monkey

是位在熱帶香料園旁邊的一間泰式餐廳

因為我們逛完熱帶香料園差不多就中午了

決定先在這裡吃完午餐

再前往下一個目的地


📜 資訊

  • 地址：Lot 595 Mkm 2, Lone Crag Villa, Jalan Tanjung Bungah, 11100, Pulau Pinang, 馬來西亞
  • 營業時間：10:30 ~ 22:30
  • 聯絡電話：+60 4-881 3493
  • 官方網站：http://www.treemonkey.com.my/

取名為 Tree Monkey

是因為附近樹上有許多的 Dusky Leaf Monkey

Dusky Leaf Monkey 鬱烏葉猴

又稱眼鏡猴 (之前 The Habitat Penang Hill 的導覽人員這樣稱)

通常是不會打擾人類

也不會主動來搶人類食物

---

🍽 環境與地點


餐廳設計的很有熱帶風


又分為戶外區跟室內用餐區



室內區並不是完全室內

也是半開放式的

還跟一顆大樹融為一體


還有一個小小的工作吧台


我們當時比較早來

到我們用餐一半的時候

整間餐廳已經幾乎快客滿的狀態

看得出來他的生意不錯

如果想要海景的座位

菜單

title.$t: Penang Independent Travel | Penang Restaurants | Tree Monkey | With a Detailed Menu

content.$t:
Tree Monkey

is a Thai restaurant located right next to the Tropical Spice Garden

Since it was almost noon by the time we finished touring the Tropical Spice Garden

we decided to have lunch here first

before heading to our next destination


📜 Information

  • Address: Lot 595 Mkm 2, Lone Crag Villa, Jalan Tanjung Bungah, 11100, Pulau Pinang, Malaysia
  • Opening hours: 10:30 ~ 22:30
  • Phone: +60 4-881 3493
  • Official website: http://www.treemonkey.com.my/

It's named Tree Monkey

because there are many Dusky Leaf Monkeys in the surrounding trees

Dusky Leaf Monkey (dusky langur)

also called the "spectacled monkey" (that's what the guide at The Habitat Penang Hill called them)

They generally don't bother humans

and won't come snatch food from people

---

🍽 Setting & Location


The restaurant has a very tropical design


and is divided into an outdoor area and an indoor dining area



The indoor area isn't fully enclosed

it's semi-open

and even built around a big tree


There's also a small service bar


We arrived fairly early

but by the time we were halfway through our meal

the whole restaurant was nearly full

so you can tell business is good here

If you want a sea-view table

you'll probably need to book in advance

---

🍽 The Food

Menu

Tree Monkey mainly serves Thai cuisine












The prices are actually quite reasonable

Pineapple Fried Rice MYR 22.80


Phad Thai MYR 24.80


Massaman Samosa & Monkey Bag


Drinks




The flavors are decent

If you're visiting the Tropical Spice Garden

it's worth stopping by for a meal

but it's probably not worth making a special trip just for this

---

As we were leaving

we really did spot a few monkeys right by the entrance

content.$t:
熱帶香料園 Tropical Spice Garden

是在出發前在網路上看到

感覺蠻有趣的一個行程

距離我們住的 ParkRoyal 也很近

搭乘 Grap 一台車只要5馬幣


📜 資訊

  • 地址：Lot 595 Mukim, 2, Jalan Teluk Bahang, Teluk Bahang, 11050 George Town, Pulau Pinang, 馬來西亞
  • 營業時間：09:00 ~ 18:00
  • 聯絡電話：+60 4-881 1797
  • 官方網站：https://tropicalspicegarden.com/



熱帶香料園位於檳島的北部往西一點點

在知名旅遊網站的檳城景點排名名列前茅



除了可以觀看各種香料的植物長相

還可以體驗原始的熱帶雨林風情

更可以預約香料烹調課程

結束後一旁還有香料餐廳 Tree Monkey

聽起來很美好

所以我們就實際來一趟看看是不是真的如此


🌿 熱帶香料園園區

一進入大門

就會先到買票處跟櫃台



票價其實相較其他地方不便宜

成人 + 語音導覽要 31 馬幣


本來我們是想要預約真人的導覽

可是這時段剛好沒有

要的話還要等一個多小時

* Tour Times: 9am, 11am and 1.30pm

所以後來就選擇用語音導覽了

---

買好票之後

會先噴天然防蟲液

然後過來這個櫃檯

一個人領一台語音導覽


之後就自己拿著導覽機進入園區了！


一開始進入園區的地方

還真像個熱帶雨林

而且蚊蟲有夠多...


園區內到處都有小小數字立牌

讓你聽相對應的導覽用


但老實說

沒有真人導覽還是有點差別


園區裡面還有架設鞦韆

讓遊客可以愜意地在這裡休息或是拍照

---

除了香料外

還有一區劇毒植物區

裡面很寫實地告訴你

各種劇毒植物會影響人的身體哪一部分


接著到了香料區


這裡種植的是各種香料植物

還有講述香料歷史的導覽

跟香料本人


在麻辣鍋很常見的花椒




但由於我們沒有預定烹飪教室

所以逛完園區就結束了

算是一個充滿知識性的園區

如果有住附近可以順道來逛逛

如果住很遠要特地過來

建議可以預約真人導覽 & 烹飪課程

或許會更有趣

title.$t: Penang Independent Travel | Nature Guide | Tropical Spice Garden

content.$t:
Tropical Spice Garden 

I came across it online before the trip

and it looked like a pretty interesting thing to do

It's also very close to the ParkRoyal where we stayed

A Grab ride costs just 5 MYR per car


📜 Information

  • Address: Lot 595 Mukim, 2, Jalan Teluk Bahang, Teluk Bahang, 11050 George Town, Pulau Pinang, Malaysia
  • Opening hours: 09:00 ~ 18:00
  • Phone: +60 4-881 1797
  • Official website: https://tropicalspicegarden.com/



The Tropical Spice Garden sits in the north of Penang Island, slightly to the west

and it ranks near the top of Penang attractions on the well-known travel websites



Besides seeing what all kinds of spice plants actually look like

you can also experience the atmosphere of a primeval tropical rainforest

and you can even book a spice cooking class

Afterwards, there's the spice restaurant Tree Monkey right next door

It all sounds lovely

so we went to see for ourselves whether it really lives up to it


🌿 Inside the Tropical Spice Garden

As soon as you walk through the main gate

you arrive at the ticket counter and reception



The admission price is actually not cheap compared with other places

An adult ticket with audio guide costs 31 MYR


We had originally wanted to book a live guided tour

but there just wasn't one at that time slot

and we would have had to wait over an hour for the next one

* Tour Times: 9am, 11am and 1.30pm

So in the end we went with the audio guide

---

After buying the tickets

you first get sprayed with natural insect repellent

then head over to this counter

where each person picks up an audio guide device


Then you head into the garden on your own with the audio guide in hand!


The area right at the entrance to the garden

really does feel like a tropical rainforest

And there are so many mosquitoes and bugs...


There are small numbered signs all over the garden

so you can listen to the matching audio commentary


But to be honest

it's still not quite the same without a live guide


There are also swings set up in the garden

so visitors can relax here or take photos

---

Besides the spices

there's also a section for highly poisonous plants

which tells you very graphically

which part of the human body each toxic plant affects


Next we came to the spice section


This is where all kinds of spice plants are grown

along with commentary on the history of spices

and the spices themselves in person


Sichuan pepper, which you often see in spicy hotpot




But since we hadn't booked the cooking class

our visit ended once we'd walked the whole garden

It's a garden full of interesting knowledge

If you're staying nearby, it's worth dropping by

If you're staying far away and making a special trip

I'd suggest booking a live guided tour & a cooking class

That would probably be more fun

title.$t: 檳城自助旅行 | 歷史文化篇 | 姓氏橋 | 喬治城壁畫 | 檳城極樂寺

content.$t:
檳城除了室內的歷史文化景點之外

還有一些戶外的歷史文化景點

最有名的就是喬治城壁畫

這篇主要會介紹

  • 姓氏橋
  • 喬治城壁畫
  • 檳城極樂寺

---

🌉 姓氏橋

姓氏橋在檳城是一個很特別的景象

他不是指某一座橋

而是很多條不同姓氏橋的統稱

是喬治市重要的文化古蹟之一

它充分表現了喬治市海上居民的生活特色

原本共有9座姓氏橋

2座被拆除後，現今只剩下7座

節錄一下維基百科上的介紹：
  • 姓王橋 ( Ong Jetty )
  • 姓林橋 ( Lim Jetty ) 
  • 姓周橋 ( Chew Jetty ) 
    • 姓周橋是姓氏橋當中規模最大的一座橋，橋上約有75戶人家。
  • 姓陳橋 ( Tan Jetty ) 
    • 姓陳橋是姓氏橋里最長的一座橋，長長的橋延伸至海中央。
  • 姓李橋 ( Lee Jetty ) 
    • 姓李橋的木橋板塊，並沒有如其他姓氏橋般是豎直搭起，而是橫直的，為其中一大特色。 
  • 雜姓橋 ( Mixed Surname Jetty ) 
    • 由來自不同姓氏，沒有自己屬於的那一條橋的居民，聚集在一起組成了雜姓橋。
  • 姓楊橋 (Yeoh Jetty)
  • 姓郭橋(已拆除) 
  • 平安橋(已拆除)

姓氏橋大概都是聚集在這區

某些橋可能 Google Map 上找不到

要實際去走走可能才會找到

根據我們包車的司機所說

姓氏橋出現的原因是因為

當時如果蓋房子在陸地上需要繳稅給政府

因此大家就把房子蓋在海上

這樣就不用繳稅了

姓周橋 ( Chew Jetty ) 



第一站我們先去了最大的姓周橋

雖然說橋上大多還是當地居民住家

但走進去就感覺到濃濃的觀光景點味


而且非常非常多人

沿路上除了住家外

還有一些賣紀念品的小商店

或是一些餐廳 or 賣甜點的店


走到最底是一座廟

可以在這裡稍作休息停留


姓陳橋 ( Tan Jetty )



離開了充滿商業氣息的姓周橋

到了隔壁的姓陳橋

轉眼間變得很寧靜

這裡沒有商店

真的是當地人的住家


姓陳橋最大的賣點

就是這個網美拍照景點了


一路延伸到海中央的木橋

前端連接了一座小小的寺廟

有種寧靜的美

但其實走這條橋有點可怕

木橋很窄

大概兩個人並排寬度而已

如果不小心就是直接下去海了

來這裡拍照之餘要注意腳下

姓楊橋 (Yeoh Jetty)




姓楊橋也是很寧靜的一條橋

尾端也有一個延伸到海中的木橋

寬度比姓陳橋還要寬一點


---

🏚 喬治城壁畫

在檳城喬治城各地

都可以看到非常有特色的壁畫

原因是因為當地政府在2012年的時候

舉辦了一個「喬治市魔境企劃」活動

由藝術家 Ernest Zacharevic 在喬治城各地

創作「Mirrors Georgetown（喬治市魔鏡）」系列壁畫

其中最熱門常常會出現在明信片中的是
  • 姐弟共騎腳踏車
  • 兄妹蕩鞦韆
  • 追風少年
  • 爬牆小孩

漸漸的

越來越多的壁畫出現

成為現在檳城喬治城的一個特色景觀

---

由於壁畫實在太多

在沒有方便交通工具的情況下

我們只去找了幾的比較有名的壁畫

Mural - Kids on bicycle




這個壁畫大概是最多人來拍照的點了

這趟旅程總共路過三次

不論早上或是晚上都有人在排隊著要拍照


它位於熱鬧的 Lebuh Armenian 路上

沿著這條路走走

一路上還有許多特色小店可以逛



如果沒時間只能去一個壁畫

就選擇這個吧！

Mural - Children behind window bar




同樣位於 Lebuh Armenian 路上

再快到姓氏橋的地方

就會看到這個壁畫了

Mural - Brother & Sister on a Swing



位於 Lebuh Armenian 隔壁街的巷子裡

也是著名的壁畫之一

我們是晚上去這個壁畫

發現完全沒人

而且一盞燈都沒有

當下看著這個壁畫其實有一點點恐怖(?)

他旁邊還有另一個壁畫


Street Art - "Boy on Motorbike"





也是在 Lebuh Armenian 隔壁街

著名壁畫 "Boy on Motorbike" 就在這裡


旁邊也還有另一個有特色的壁畫

---

不妨在喬治城市區隨意走走



探索一下每個角落的壁畫


也會發現有不少野貓在路上


---

📿 檳城極樂寺



檳城極樂寺

建於1891年並於1904年全面竣工

為東南亞規模最大與建築最宏偉的華人佛寺

每逢春節晚間 7:30 後 (一月)

極樂寺會舉辦一年一度的新春燈會


我們這次來剛好有遇上一年一度的點燈祈福

整個極樂寺就變成一個浮誇

又很華麗的寺廟


寺廟下面有一個停車場

在這種人多的時候基本上很難開車上山去



從停車場可以選擇搭纜車還是走路上去寺廟

纜車短短的一小段單程就要8馬幣

非常的貴

所以後來我們決定用走的

不會很難走

大約10分鐘多也就可以到寺廟入口了


不過人實在太多

我們也沒有全部走完

只走一小段看一下全景就離開了



從山上還可以看到



在春節期間晚上要去極樂寺看點燈的話

十之八九一定會遇到塞車

要有花很多時間的心理準備

content.$t:
Besides its indoor historical and cultural attractions, Penang

also has plenty of outdoor historical and cultural sights

and the most famous of all are the George Town murals

This post mainly covers

  • The Clan Jetties
  • George Town murals
  • Kek Lok Si Temple, Penang

---

🌉 The Clan Jetties

The Clan Jetties are a very unique sight in Penang

The name doesn't refer to a single jetty

but is a collective term for several jetties named after different family surnames

They are one of George Town's most important cultural heritage sites

and vividly showcase the lifestyle of George Town's waterborne residents

There were originally 9 clan jetties

Two have been demolished, so only 7 remain today

Here's an excerpt from Wikipedia:
  • Ong Jetty
  • Lim Jetty 
  • Chew Jetty 
    • Chew Jetty is the largest of the clan jetties, with around 75 households living on it.
  • Tan Jetty 
    • Tan Jetty is the longest of the clan jetties, with a long walkway stretching out into the sea.
  • Lee Jetty 
    • The wooden planks of Lee Jetty are laid crosswise rather than lengthwise as on the other jetties — one of its distinctive features. 
  • Mixed Surname Jetty 
    • Residents of various surnames who didn't have a jetty of their own gathered together to form the Mixed Surname Jetty.
  • Yeoh Jetty
  • Koay Jetty (demolished) 
  • Peng Aun Jetty (demolished)

The clan jetties are all clustered in this area

Some of them may not show up on Google Maps

so you might only find them by walking around in person

According to our chartered-car driver

the reason the clan jetties came about was that

back then, building a house on land meant paying taxes to the government

so people built their houses over the water instead

and that way they didn't have to pay tax

Chew Jetty 



Our first stop was the largest one, Chew Jetty

Although most of the houses on the jetty are still local residences

walking in, it definitely feels like a tourist attraction


And there are a huge number of people

Along the way, besides the homes

there are also little shops selling souvenirs

as well as restaurants and dessert shops


At the very end there's a temple

where you can stop and take a short rest


Tan Jetty



Leaving the very commercial Chew Jetty

and heading to Tan Jetty next door

everything suddenly becomes very peaceful

There are no shops here

it's genuinely just local homes


Tan Jetty's biggest draw

is this Instagram-worthy photo spot


A wooden walkway stretching all the way out into the sea

with a tiny temple at its far end

There's a serene kind of beauty to it

But walking out along this jetty is actually a bit scary

The wooden walkway is very narrow

roughly only wide enough for two people side by side

and one wrong step and you'd go straight into the sea

So while taking photos here, watch your footing

Yeoh Jetty




Yeoh Jetty is also a very quiet one

and at its end there's likewise a wooden walkway extending into the sea

a little wider than the one at Tan Jetty


---

🏚 George Town Murals

All around George Town in Penang

you can spot highly distinctive murals

This is because in 2012 the local government

launched a project called "Mirrors George Town"

in which artist Ernest Zacharevic created

the "Mirrors George Town" mural series all over the city

The most popular ones, which often appear on postcards, are
  • Kids on Bicycle
  • Brother & Sister on a Swing
  • Boy on Motorbike
  • Children Behind Window Bar (Boy Climbing the Wall)

Gradually

more and more murals appeared

and they've become a signature sight of George Town, Penang today

---

Since there are simply too many murals

and we didn't have convenient transport

we only sought out a few of the more famous ones

Mural - Kids on bicycle




This mural is probably the most photographed spot of all

We passed by it three times on this trip

and morning or evening, there was always a queue of people waiting to take photos


It's located on the bustling Lebuh Armenian

Take a stroll along this street

and you'll find plenty of charming little shops to browse along the way



If you only have time for one mural

go with this one!

Mural - Children behind window bar




Also on Lebuh Armenian

near the end of the street heading towards the clan jetties

you'll come across this mural

Mural - Brother & Sister on a Swing



Tucked in a lane on the street next to Lebuh Armenian

this is another one of the famous murals

We visited this mural at night

and found there was absolutely no one around

and not a single light either

Standing there looking at the mural was actually a little creepy (?)

There's another mural right next to it


Street Art - "Boy on Motorbike"





Also on the street next to Lebuh Armenian

you'll find the famous "Boy on Motorbike" mural


There's yet another distinctive mural right beside it

---

Why not just wander around downtown George Town



and discover the murals hiding in every corner


You'll also notice quite a few stray cats on the streets


---

📿 Kek Lok Si Temple, Penang



Kek Lok Si Temple in Penang

was founded in 1891 and fully completed in 1904

It is the largest and most magnificent Chinese Buddhist temple in Southeast Asia

Every Lunar New Year, after 7:30 pm (in January)

Kek Lok Si holds its annual Chinese New Year light festival


Our visit happened to coincide with the annual lantern-lighting blessing festival

and the entire temple was transformed into an extravagant

and dazzlingly ornate spectacle


There's a car park below the temple

When it's this crowded, it's basically impossible to drive up the hill



From the car park you can either take the cable car or walk up to the temple

The cable car covers only a very short stretch yet costs RM8 one way

which is really expensive

so in the end we decided to walk

It's not a difficult walk

and in a little over 10 minutes you'll reach the temple entrance


But there were simply too many people

so we didn't walk the whole way through

We just went a short distance, took in the panorama, and left



From up on the hill you can also see this view



If you're heading to Kek Lok Si at night during Chinese New Year to see the lights

nine times out of ten you'll hit traffic jams

so be mentally prepared to spend a lot of time

title.$t: 檳城自助旅行 | 歷史文化篇 | 張弼士故居 |藍屋 | 亞洲瘋狂富豪電影拍攝地 | 娘惹博物館

content.$t:
張弼士故居

又名藍屋

是在出發前上網查詢檳城必去的景點中

一定會出現的其中一項

這裡不僅是擁有歷史文化的景點

也是之前“瘋狂亞洲富豪”電影的取景地

中庭就是最後女主角 Rachel

和男友媽媽打麻將的那一幕場景

📜 資訊

  • 地址：14, Leith St, Georgetown, 10200 George Town, Penang, 馬來西亞
  • 票價：成人 17 馬幣
  • 開放時間：
    • 11:00 ~ 12:00
    • 14:00 ~ 15:00
    • 15:30 ~ 16:30
  • 官方網站：https://www.cheongfatttzemansion.com/


在來這個景點之前

相信很多人跟我一樣不知道張弼士是誰

張弼士是當時的馬來西亞華僑領袖

由於很會經商

曾經種植葡萄，成為張裕葡萄酒創始人

創辦張裕安堂藥行、廣州亞通機器織布廠

也在新加坡、馬來西亞兩地相繼創建了8所華文學校

在當時清朝國庫年收入才8000萬兩的時候

資產高達8000萬兩白銀

號稱「南洋首富」

---

🏡 內部環境

由於張弼士故居是不開放大家自由參觀的

必須要在有導覽的固定時間才可以進入

如果想自由參觀

看起來只有住在他的旅館才有機會

導覽的時間是
  • 11:00 ~ 12:00
  • 14:00 ~ 15:00
  • 15:30 ~ 16:30
這三個是英文導覽

如果要中文導覽必須事先預約

而且是要 15 人以上的團體才可以

---

我們剛好趕上下午兩點這場

在門口小亭子買好票之後

就會需要在大廳等到導覽開始


每一批參加的人數看起來是沒上限

超級多人


等時間差不多

就會開始跟著他一步一步

走進張弼士的歷史故事中

導覽的內容其實很豐富

歷史緣由，奇聞軼事

當時的時空背景

還有這間屋子歷經的總總故事

都很清楚生動的介紹

不妨跟著導覽人員的腳步

細細的品味張弼士的一生

---

也因為太認真在聽導覽

導致後來發現我幾乎沒照什麼照片

另一方面也是人實在很多

怎麼照都是人



經過大廳之後

會到一個中庭

有一個露天的天井

導覽人員說這裡充滿了風水的設計



雨天的時候

雨會留在這個小小的中庭

象徵著聚財


中庭對面有一個開放式的小廳

這裡就是“瘋狂亞洲富豪”電影最後打麻將的那一幕背景

也是居住在這裡的住客吃早餐的地方





另外一區

這裡是不開放給一般參觀遊客進入的地方

是住宿客專用的區域

一般遊客只能在門口看看裡面的景


感覺裡面也很美很漂亮

但因為沒有住在這

也沒有機會進去一探究竟








如果有來檳城

張弼士故居必定是個要來的景點

除了建築物有歷史風味之外

導覽的故事也非常有價值一聽

---



離開張弼士故居後

我們就驅車前往另一個也在附近的景點

娘惹博物館

📜 資訊

  • 地址：29, Church St, Georgetown, 10200 George Town, Penang, 馬來西亞
  • 票價：成人 20 馬幣
  • 開放時間：09:30 ~ 17:00
  • 官方網站：http://www.pinangperanakanmansion.com.my/

峇峇娘惹

是在馬來西亞一直聽到的一個詞

從大量華人到達南洋開始

華人與馬來人的混血

男的就叫峇峇

女的就叫娘惹

而這間位娘惹博物館（Pinang Peranakan Mansion）

主要是紀念檳城娘惹遺產的博物館

地點在喬治一棟綠色豪宅內

該豪宅曾是19世紀中國大亨鄭景貴的住所和辦公室

---

🏡 內部環境


剛踏進去的時候

覺得跟張弼士故居的建築風格好像

大概就是外觀一個是藍色的

一個是綠色的 😅


這裡的票價比張弼士故居更貴

一樣是有導覽的

但沒有一定要跟著導覽

隨時都可以進出


這裡是典型的19世紀峇峇娘惹民宅

室內是混合中式、維多利亞式和荷蘭式風格

非常的華麗


中間也蠻大的

跟著導覽走會到很多房間


導覽的內容是關於峇峇娘惹文化

會介紹很多當時當地人的生活

衣服穿著，建築故事等等

且中英文導覽都有


到處都是很氣派的中式建築感覺



在後面的祠堂

屋頂上還有很多的蝙蝠

但這時候正值武漢肺炎疫情起來的時候

看到這些蝙蝠反而覺得有點可怕

content.$t:
Cheong Fatt Tze Mansion

Also known as the Blue Mansion

When you search online before your trip for the must-visit spots in Penang

this is one that always comes up

Not only is it a site full of history and culture

it was also a filming location for the movie "Crazy Rich Asians"

The courtyard is where the heroine Rachel

plays mahjong with her boyfriend's mother in the final scene

📜 Information

  • Address: 14, Leith St, Georgetown, 10200 George Town, Penang, Malaysia
  • Ticket price: RM 17 for adults
  • Opening hours:
    • 11:00 ~ 12:00
    • 14:00 ~ 15:00
    • 15:30 ~ 16:30
  • Official website: https://www.cheongfatttzemansion.com/


Before coming to this attraction

I believe many people, like me, had no idea who Cheong Fatt Tze was

Cheong Fatt Tze was a leader of the overseas Chinese community in Malaysia at the time

A brilliant businessman

he once grew grapes and became the founder of Changyu Wine

He founded the Zhangyu'an Tang pharmacy and the Yatung mechanical weaving mill in Guangzhou

and also established 8 Chinese-language schools in Singapore and Malaysia

At a time when the Qing dynasty's annual treasury income was only 80 million taels

his assets amounted to 80 million taels of silver

earning him the title "the richest man in the South Seas"

---

🏡 Inside the Mansion

Since the Cheong Fatt Tze Mansion isn't open for free wandering

you can only enter at the fixed guided-tour times

If you want to explore freely

it seems the only way is to stay at the hotel here

The tour times are
  • 11:00 ~ 12:00
  • 14:00 ~ 15:00
  • 15:30 ~ 16:30
These three are English-language tours

If you want a Chinese-language tour you must book in advance

and it's only available for groups of 15 or more

---

We happened to make it in time for the 2 p.m. tour

After buying tickets at the little booth by the entrance

you wait in the main hall until the tour begins


There seems to be no limit on the number of people per tour group

So many people


Once it's about time

you follow the guide step by step

into the story of Cheong Fatt Tze's life

The tour content is actually very rich

Historical background, curious anecdotes

the context of the era

and all the stories this house has been through

all explained clearly and vividly

It's well worth following the guide's footsteps

and savoring the life of Cheong Fatt Tze

---

Because I was listening to the tour so intently

I later realized I had barely taken any photos

The other reason was that there were just so many people

every shot was full of crowds



After passing through the main hall

you reach a central courtyard

with an open-air light well

The guide said this space is full of feng shui design



On rainy days

the rain collects in this small courtyard

symbolizing the gathering of wealth


Across the courtyard there's a small open hall

This is the backdrop for the final mahjong scene in "Crazy Rich Asians"

and also where guests staying here have breakfast





Another section

This is an area not open to ordinary visitors

It's reserved for hotel guests

Regular visitors can only peek in from the doorway


It looks really beautiful inside

but since we weren't staying here

we never got the chance to go in and look around








If you come to Penang

the Cheong Fatt Tze Mansion is definitely a must-visit

Beyond the historic charm of the architecture

the stories told on the tour are truly worth hearing

---



After leaving the Cheong Fatt Tze Mansion

we drove to another attraction nearby

the Pinang Peranakan Mansion (Nyonya Museum)

📜 Information

  • Address: 29, Church St, Georgetown, 10200 George Town, Penang, Malaysia
  • Ticket price: RM 20 for adults
  • Opening hours: 09:30 ~ 17:00
  • Official website: http://www.pinangperanakanmansion.com.my/

Baba-Nyonya

is a term you hear constantly in Malaysia

Ever since large numbers of Chinese arrived in the South Seas

descendants of mixed Chinese and Malay heritage emerged

The men are called Baba

and the women are called Nyonya

This Pinang Peranakan Mansion

is a museum dedicated to Penang's Peranakan heritage

housed in a green mansion in George Town

The mansion was once the residence and office of the 19th-century Chinese tycoon Chung Keng Quee

---

🏡 Inside the Mansion


The moment we stepped inside

it felt very similar in architectural style to the Cheong Fatt Tze Mansion

The main difference is that one is blue on the outside

and the other is green 😅


Tickets here are more expensive than at the Cheong Fatt Tze Mansion

Guided tours are also available

but you don't have to join a tour

you can come and go as you please


This is a typical 19th-century Baba-Nyonya residence

The interior blends Chinese, Victorian and Dutch styles

It's extremely opulent


The central area is quite large too

Following the tour takes you through many rooms


The tour focuses on Baba-Nyonya culture

covering a lot about how local people lived back then

their clothing, the story of the building, and more

and both Chinese and English tours are offered


Everywhere you look there's grand, imposing Chinese-style architecture



In the ancestral hall at the back

there are lots of bats up on the roof

But this was right when the COVID-19 outbreak was ramping up

so seeing these bats felt a little unnerving

title.$t: 檳城自助旅行 | 檳城餐廳篇 | 92 Armenian 打銅仔 | 燕窩專賣店 | 燕窩蛋塔

content.$t:
在出發檳城之前，查詢檳城美食的時候看到蠻多推薦這間以燕窩甜點聞名的「 92 Armenian 打銅仔」，他的評價在 Google map 上也高達 4.2，也是個網路上的人氣甜點店，因此這次我們就排了一天下午茶時段，打算來當點心吃吃看。



📜 資訊

  • 地址：92, Lebuh Armenian, George Town, 10200 George Town, Pulau Pinang, 馬來西亞
  • 營業時間：11:00 ~ 21:00
  • 聯絡電話：+60 4-226 2206
  • 官方Facebook：https://www.facebook.com/92armenian

🍽 環境與地點


92 Armenian 打銅仔位於熱鬧的 Armenian Street 上，位在檳城熱鬧的區域，往前走一點點是著名的壁畫，離最大的姓氏橋 - 姓周橋也不遠。



打銅仔主打各種甜點搭配燕窩，店內空間有兩層樓但不是很大，所以熱門時段常常都會客滿。我們抵達的時候樓下呈現爆滿狀態，且還有很多人在等位置，可想而知這間店的熱門程度。

人實在太多，環境的照片都不是很好看



不過由於我們有事先打電話來訂位，被安排到樓上的座位區，室內裝潢都古色古香，很像來到古時候吃茶點的感覺。



🍽 菜單與餐點



店內主打各種甜點搭配燕窩，除了甜點也有幾道湯品，號稱他們使用的燕窩是上等燕窩。不過看起來是有反應在價格上，因為並不是太便宜，一個蛋塔要 9 馬幣，大概折合 70 元台幣

燕窩蛋塔 (RM9 / pc) 

這就是店內最主打的產品，燕窩蛋塔



上面放了滿滿一層燕窩，吃起來口感很滑順，但很可惜的是，自己覺得下面的蛋塔很不怎麼樣...跟一般麵包店買的便宜但塔口感差不了多少，或許是厲害在燕窩的部分吧(?)

燕窩椰子凍 (RM 26) 


口感蠻特殊的，外觀也有特色，是一整顆椰子，像是淡淡椰子味的稀釋果凍

燕窩芒果蛋糕 (RM 26) 

就是個蛋糕林上一點燕窩 (很貴)


---

由於口味是很主觀的，燕窩的部分我不常吃，不知道這是好還是不好，其他點心吃起來很普通，是不會到不好吃，其中蛋塔真的是有夠普通。

配上這個價格，一顆 70 元的麵包店蛋塔，我是不會二訪了，檳城肯定還有更多經濟實惠又好吃的小吃，給要來遊玩的旅客參考看看。

title.$t: Penang Independent Travel | Penang Restaurants | 92 Armenian | Bird's Nest Specialty Shop | Bird's Nest Egg Tarts

content.$t:
Before setting off for Penang, while researching local food, I came across plenty of recommendations for "92 Armenian," a shop famous for its bird's nest desserts. It scores as high as 4.2 on Google Maps and is a hugely popular dessert spot online, so this time we set aside an afternoon tea slot to try it out as a snack.



📜 Information

  • Address: 92, Lebuh Armenian, George Town, 10200 George Town, Pulau Pinang, Malaysia
  • Opening hours: 11:00 ~ 21:00
  • Phone: +60 4-226 2206
  • Official Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/92armenian

🍽 Setting and Location


92 Armenian sits on the bustling Armenian Street, right in one of Penang's liveliest areas. Walk a little further and you'll reach the famous street murals, and it's not far from the largest of the clan jetties, Chew Jetty.



92 Armenian specializes in all kinds of desserts paired with bird's nest. The shop has two floors but isn't very big, so it's often full during peak hours. When we arrived the ground floor was packed and plenty of people were waiting for a table — you can imagine just how popular this place is.

There were simply too many people, so none of the interior photos turned out well



Luckily we had called ahead to book, so we were seated in the upstairs area. The interior decor is charmingly old-fashioned — it feels like taking tea in a bygone era.



🍽 Menu and Dishes



The shop's specialty is a range of desserts paired with bird's nest; besides desserts there are also a few soups, and they claim to use top-grade bird's nest. That seems to be reflected in the prices, because they aren't exactly cheap — a single egg tart costs RM9, roughly NT$70.

Bird's Nest Egg Tart (RM9 / pc) 

This is the shop's signature item, the bird's nest egg tart



It's topped with a generous layer of bird's nest, which is wonderfully silky. Unfortunately, I personally found the tart underneath rather unimpressive... not much better than a cheap tart from an ordinary bakery. Perhaps the real skill lies in the bird's nest (?)

Bird's Nest Coconut Jelly (RM 26) 


The texture is quite unusual and the presentation is distinctive too — served in a whole coconut, it's like a diluted jelly with a faint coconut flavor

Bird's Nest Mango Cake (RM 26) 

Basically a cake with a little bird's nest on top (very pricey)


---

Taste is highly subjective, and since I don't eat bird's nest often I can't say whether theirs is good or not. The other desserts were pretty ordinary — not bad, just unremarkable — and the egg tart in particular was really nothing special.

Given the price — a NT$70 bakery-grade egg tart — I wouldn't come back a second time. Penang surely has plenty more affordable and delicious snacks; just something for fellow travelers to consider.

content.$t:
這次的檳城自由行

由於也算是家族過年聚會

所以決定要找一間比較高檔(貴)的餐廳

來當作過年聚餐的餐廳

📜 資訊

  • 地址：Stewart Ln, Georgetown, 10200 George Town, Penang, 馬來西亞
  • 營業時間：18:00 ~ 22:00
  • 聯絡電話：+60 4-264 2333
  • 官方網站：http://kebaya.com.my/
  • Facebook：https://www.facebook.com/KebayaDiningRoom/


這間 Kebaya Dining Room

在 TripAdvisor 有著 4.5 分的高分

Google map 上的評價也有 4.4

號稱是檳城第一的特色創新娘惹菜餐廳

---

什麼是娘惹菜呢？

娘惹菜是流行於東南亞新加坡，馬來西亞，等地的美食

起源來自於早期定居於檳城，馬六甲，新加坡的中國移民

娘惹菜口味濃重

使用多種來自馬來料理多用的香料

並喜好使用華人傳統的食材

配以多種馬來料理中的配料

與香料加以長時間的燉煮

Kebaya 的娘惹菜被評論為創新式的娘惹菜

---

🍽 環境與地點



Kebaya Dining Room

位於融合英國殖民色彩的七間老厝飯店內



餐廳的裝潢非常有特色

仿佛走進時光隧道

到了英國殖民時期的檳城


不管是地磚，牆壁，裝潢擺設

桌子椅子，甚至餐具都很有當時的風味

好像電影裡的場景一般


連小小的櫃檯都金碧輝煌


在餐廳的一角

有一間附設的酒吧 Bababar


這個附設的 bar 在網路上沒看到任何介紹或是評論

蠻好奇他的酒如何

旁邊還有看起來很像裝調酒的茶杯


特別拍了一下酒單


價格跟檳城酒吧差不多

只有經典調酒

可惜這次沒機會來上一杯


---

這次我們有事先訂位

餐廳幫我們準備的是一整個長桌


由於當天是農曆春節期間

餐廳告知無法單點

只能點他們的春節菜單

但其實我們後來有看到其他小桌的客人

點不一樣的菜

有懷疑是不是餐廳在呼隆我們

這是當天的菜單

十道菜(每道兩份) + 每人一樣甜點

這樣一個人大約是 1000 元台幣


連餐盤都很有特色

餐巾我記得很香


後來甜點的部分

有讓我們可以多點選項

這是甜點的部分菜單



🍽 餐點

如前所述

我們是十道菜(每道兩份) + 每人一樣甜點

份量不算太少

所以我們十個大人 + 一個小孩

這樣下來還是吃得飽的

開胃菜


Cold Smoked Red Snapper Yee Sang


Roll Your Own Popiah
 


主菜

Fresh Acar Fish


Plum Glazed Duck


Organic Roast Pork


Kebaya Tamarind Beef


Grilled Chicken Kapitan


Thai Soft Shell Crab Salad


Sambal Goreng


 Wing Bean Kerabu




甜點



招牌藍花湯圓



---

吃完後趁著還有時間

到餐廳後面的中庭去看看


這裡是七間老厝住宿的客房區

所以不能到上面去

但從中庭看這裡的景色

很美也很有特色



---

小結論


口味這種東西

我覺得很主觀

我也不是美食評論家

自己覺得味道不錯

但沒有驚艷

這個價格&口味

在檳城是真的有點貴了

不過甜點的部分是覺得蠻不錯

招牌藍花湯圓，搭配椰子風味的甜湯

真的蠻不錯的口味

至於值不值得去一吃

就由大家自己評斷了

title.$t: Penang Independent Travel | Penang Restaurants | Kebaya Dining Room | Nyonya Cuisine | Seven Terraces

content.$t:
On this independent trip to Penang

since it doubled as a family Lunar New Year gathering

we decided to look for a somewhat upscale (read: pricey) restaurant

to host our New Year dinner

📜 Information

  • Address: Stewart Ln, Georgetown, 10200 George Town, Penang, Malaysia
  • Opening hours: 18:00 ~ 22:00
  • Phone: +60 4-264 2333
  • Official website: http://kebaya.com.my/
  • Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/KebayaDiningRoom/


This Kebaya Dining Room

holds a high score of 4.5 on TripAdvisor

and 4.4 on Google Maps

It's billed as Penang's number one innovative, distinctive Nyonya cuisine restaurant

---

So what exactly is Nyonya cuisine?

Nyonya food is popular across Southeast Asia in Singapore, Malaysia and beyond

It originated with the early Chinese immigrants who settled in Penang, Malacca and Singapore

Nyonya dishes have bold, rich flavors

using a wide range of spices common in Malay cooking

while favoring traditional Chinese ingredients

paired with various Malay condiments

and slow-simmered for a long time with spices

Kebaya's Nyonya food is described as innovative-style Nyonya cuisine

---

🍽 Setting & Location



Kebaya Dining Room

sits inside the Seven Terraces hotel, a property infused with British colonial character



The decor is full of character

It feels like stepping into a time tunnel

back to Penang in the British colonial era


From the floor tiles and walls to the furnishings

the tables, chairs and even the tableware all carry the flavor of that period

just like a movie set


Even the little front desk is dazzlingly ornate


In one corner of the restaurant

there's an attached bar called Bababar


I couldn't find a single write-up or review of this attached bar online

so I was quite curious about its drinks

Next to it there were teacups that looked like they're used for cocktails


I made a point of snapping the drinks list


Prices are on par with other Penang bars

Only classic cocktails are offered

Sadly there was no chance to have one this time


---

We booked in advance this time

and the restaurant set up a whole long table for us


Since it was during the Lunar New Year period

the restaurant told us à la carte wasn't available

and we could only order their Lunar New Year menu

But we later saw guests at other smaller tables

ordering different dishes

which made us suspect the restaurant was pulling one over on us

This was the menu that day

Ten dishes (two portions each) + one dessert per person

That worked out to roughly NT$1,000 per person


Even the plates are distinctive

and I remember the napkins smelled lovely


For dessert

they did let us choose from more options

Here's part of the dessert menu



🍽 The Food

As mentioned above

we had ten dishes (two portions each) + one dessert per person

The portions weren't small

so with ten adults + one child

we still ended up full

Appetizers


Cold Smoked Red Snapper Yee Sang


Roll Your Own Popiah
 


Main Courses

Fresh Acar Fish


Plum Glazed Duck


Organic Roast Pork


Kebaya Tamarind Beef


Grilled Chicken Kapitan


Thai Soft Shell Crab Salad


Sambal Goreng


 Wing Bean Kerabu




Dessert



The signature blue pea flower glutinous rice balls



---

After the meal, while we still had time

we went to take a look at the courtyard behind the restaurant


This is the guest room area of Seven Terraces

so you can't go upstairs

but the view from the courtyard

is beautiful and full of character



---

Final Thoughts


Taste is a very subjective thing

in my opinion

and I'm no food critic

Personally I thought the food was good

but not amazing

For this price & flavor

it really is a bit expensive by Penang standards

That said, I thought the dessert was quite good

The signature blue pea flower rice balls, served in a coconut-flavored sweet soup

tasted really lovely

As for whether it's worth a visit

I'll leave that for you to judge

content.$t:
升旗山

又名檳榔山

由於過去英國高官的別墅大多數在這裡

山下的士兵利用旗語傳遞重要訊息

升旗山因而得名

這裡是當地居民和遊客的避暑勝地

也是來檳城完必去的景點之一


📜 資訊


  • 地址：Bukit Bendera 11500 Bukit Bendera 檳城 馬來西亞
  • 營業時間：06:30 ~ 23:00
  • 纜車票價：
    • 成人：來回 30 MYR
    • 小孩(4~12歲)：來回 15 MYR
  • 官方網站：http://www.penanghill.gov.my/index.php/en/



因為聽說從中午左右開始

就會有爆炸的人潮

為了想避開人潮

我們一大早就到了山腳下的纜車站



今天有包車

所以我們是搭著包車來的


一進來可以先看到售票處

因為是一大早

所以幾乎沒什麼人在排隊


票價在這裡

可以選擇要不要購買快速通道

來回票價會從 30 MYR 變成 80 MYR


如果有帶行李來

這裡也有收費的寄物櫃


只要買好票之後就可以直接進去囉


🚠 升旗山纜車

從售票處左手邊的入口進去



進去會先經過一個走道

介紹升旗山的歷史

一方面應該也是給人太多的時候

排出來緩衝用的


到裡面後會再等著上山

如果這時候你有買快速通關

就可以直接跳過這些人潮了


我們大約等 20 分鐘上下

就成功進去搭纜車上山囉！


纜車是地面纜車

跟之前在布達佩斯 & Hallstatt 是同一種


但是不得不說

這個纜車是我搭過開最快的纜車

從山下到山上

會明顯感覺氣壓改變那種

(影片是縮時)



到了山上後

可以看到遼闊的景色


也可以遠眺連接檳島跟馬來西亞本島的大橋


往上走一點可以到一個小廣場

這裡有著當年最早使用的纜車


纜車建於1922年

當年是為了方便英國人上山度假而建

---

山上主要是一些景觀餐廳

還有一些特殊的博物館

地震體驗館，相機博物館，貓頭鷹博物館...



但是假如只是去看這些博物館

其實就沒有什麼好介紹的了

升旗山上真正更有價值的

是要進去 The Habitat Penang Hill 森林步道


🌲 The Habitat Penang Hill 森林步道


  • 地址：Jalan Stesen, Bukit Bendera Air Itam, 11500 Penang, Pulau Pinang, 馬來西亞
  • 營業時間：09:00 ~ 19:00
  • 聯絡電話：+60 4-827 2677
  • 官方網站：https://thehabitat.my/




The Habitat Penang Hill

是位於升旗山的自然保護區

擁有 1.3 億年的歷史

由於他是跟升旗山纜車分開

必須還要另外購票

有很多種不同的 package

所以有需要的人可以直接進去看看哪種票卷適合

https://thehabitat.my/buytickets.html




從入口進去後

會先到售票處



聽導覽人員說

售票處是由以前的馬廄所改建



買完票後

會從售票處的入口進入


我們因為人數眾多

所以我們是直接跟官方聯絡

除了票卷外有一起購買導覽

由一個導覽人員跟著我們走全程

全程大約 1~2 小時

過程中可以聽到很多熱帶動植物的知識

還有這裡的歷史故事

蠻值得也蠻推薦的



一路上的路也不會很難走

適合各種年齡層的人

漫步懸帶橋天空步道（Langur Way Canopy Walk ）





走在雨林當中

除了空氣好之外

也非常寧靜

只有蟲鳴鳥叫聲

Tree Top Walk (樹頂天空步道)


 山上比起平地涼爽很多

加上這天天氣非常的好

在天空步道這裡可以看到很美的風景




最後結束後會到一家紀念品店

在這裡可以搭接駁車

回到本來纜車站的廣場




再從山頂的纜車站下山

我們下山的時間大概是中午

發現人潮真的爆炸多



所以建議要上去升旗山

一大早真的會是比較好的選擇

content.$t:
Penang Hill

also known as Bukit Bendera (Flagstaff Hill)

Because most of the British officials' villas were once located here

soldiers at the foot of the hill used flag signals to relay important messages

which is how the hill got its Chinese name

It's a summer retreat for both locals and visitors

and one of the must-see attractions when you come to Penang


📜 Information


  • Address: Bukit Bendera 11500 Bukit Bendera, Penang, Malaysia
  • Opening hours: 06:30 ~ 23:00
  • Funicular fares:
    • Adults: 30 MYR round trip
    • Children (ages 4~12): 15 MYR round trip
  • Official website: http://www.penanghill.gov.my/index.php/en/



We'd heard that from around noon onwards

the crowds get absolutely enormous

so to avoid them

we arrived at the funicular station at the foot of the hill first thing in the morning



We had a private car for the day

so that's how we got here


Right as you walk in you'll see the ticket office

Since it was so early in the morning

there was hardly anyone queuing


Here are the fares

You can choose whether or not to buy the fast lane pass

which takes the round-trip fare from 30 MYR up to 80 MYR


If you've brought luggage with you

there are also paid lockers here


Once you've bought your tickets you can head straight in


🚠 The Penang Hill Funicular

Enter through the entrance to the left of the ticket office



Once inside you first pass through a corridor

introducing the history of Penang Hill

which probably also doubles as buffer space

for queuing when there are too many people


After that you wait again to ride up the hill

If you bought the fast lane pass

you can skip all these crowds


We waited about 20 minutes or so

and then successfully boarded the funicular up the hill!


It's a ground funicular railway

the same type as the ones we rode in Budapest & Hallstatt


But I have to say

this is the fastest funicular I've ever ridden

Going from the bottom to the top

you can clearly feel the air pressure change

(the video is a time-lapse)



Once at the top

you're treated to sweeping views


You can also look out to the bridge linking Penang Island with the Malaysian mainland


Walk up a little further and you reach a small plaza

where the earliest funicular car is on display


The funicular was built in 1922

originally to make it easier for the British to come up here on holiday

---

At the top there are mainly a few scenic restaurants

plus some quirky museums

an earthquake simulator, a camera museum, an owl museum...



But if all you do is visit those museums

there's really not much to write home about

What's truly worthwhile on Penang Hill

is going into The Habitat Penang Hill rainforest trail


🌲 The Habitat Penang Hill Rainforest Trail


  • Address: Jalan Stesen, Bukit Bendera Air Itam, 11500 Penang, Pulau Pinang, Malaysia
  • Opening hours: 09:00 ~ 19:00
  • Phone: +60 4-827 2677
  • Official website: https://thehabitat.my/




The Habitat Penang Hill

is a nature reserve on Penang Hill

with a history going back 130 million years

Since it's separate from the Penang Hill funicular

you have to buy a separate ticket

There are many different packages

so if you're interested, take a look and see which ticket suits you

https://thehabitat.my/buytickets.html




After going through the entrance

you first come to the ticket office



According to our guide

the ticket office was converted from the old stables



After buying tickets

you enter through the doorway at the ticket office


Since there were a lot of us

we contacted the official team directly

and booked a guided tour along with our tickets

so a guide accompanied us the whole way

The whole walk takes about 1~2 hours

Along the way you learn a lot about tropical flora and fauna

as well as the history of the place

Well worth it and highly recommended



The path isn't difficult at all

suitable for people of all ages

Langur Way Canopy Walk





Walking through the rainforest

besides the fresh air

it's also incredibly peaceful

with nothing but insects chirping and birds singing

Tree Top Walk


 It's much cooler up here than down at sea level

and the weather was fantastic that day

so from the canopy walk we got beautiful views




At the end of the trail you arrive at a souvenir shop

where you can catch the shuttle bus

back to the plaza by the funicular station




Then head back down from the hilltop funicular station

We went back down around noon

and the crowds were absolutely insane



So if you're planning to go up Penang Hill

going first thing in the morning really is the better choice

title.$t: 檳城自助旅行 | 檳城住宿篇 | 絕對不推薦 | ParkRoyal Penang Resort | 飯店環境 | 房間介紹 | 度假村餐廳 Gustoso & Cinnamon Asian Kitchen

content.$t:
在找檳城住宿的時候，目標想找一個可以好好度假，就算不出去也可以放鬆休息的飯店。在網路上比價了幾間，後來選了這間 ParkRoyal Penang Resort。

先說結論

這間絕對不推薦，到檳城玩千萬別選這間飯店


飯店設施還有乾淨程度沒話說

但員工人員管理有著很大的問題


這段放到介紹完環境再來提，先客觀介紹一下整體的環境還有設施。


📜 資訊

  • 入住日期：2020-01-26 ~ 2020-01-30 (雙床房四晚)
  • 入住房型：高級客房 (含早餐)
  • 入住價格：MYR1,603.80 ($11,614, 不包含稅金與服務費)
  • 付款方式：可刷卡
  • 飯店地址：PARKROYAL Penang Resort Batu Ferringhi Beach, 11100 Batu Ferringhi, Pulau Pinang, 馬來西亞
  • 聯絡電話：+60 4-886 2288
  • 官方網站：https://www.panpacific.com/en/hotels-and-resorts/pr-penang.html
  • 訂房網站：https://www.booking.com/hotel/my/parkroyalpenang.zh-tw.html?aid=8003516


ParkRoyal 是一間連鎖酒店，這間是在檳城以度假村形式的五星級飯店。


地點位置&交通

到檳城遊玩，主要的幾點幾乎都在檳島上。ParkRoyal 位於檳島的北方偏西，而國際機場在東南方，剛好是個最遠的對角線位置。



從機場要到飯店有幾種方法：
  • 搭公車直達 (Bus 102)
  • 搭機場巴士到市區，再換公車或是計程車
  • 直接搭計程車或是 Grab
由於我們這次是家族旅遊，所以這段交通是包車，但光是包車直達也要超過一小時，距離是蠻遠的。

如果人數不多推薦可以使用 Grab，這裡 Grab 車資很便宜，我們在沒有包車的時候都是使用 Grab，從飯店到市區的地點，大約 50min 車程，車費只要台幣 160 左右。

---

ParkRoyal  這區位於 Batu Feringghi Night Market，整條路上有許多的小攤販，賣很多小玩意跟衣服，並且許多度假村飯店都在這裡，整理周遭環境蠻熱鬧，也有不少餐廳和一些酒吧在這一區，適合晚上出去走一走逛逛。


 旅館環境


一進入飯店，映入眼簾的是很有南洋度假風、並且氣派的挑高接待大廳，大廳直直看過去就是沙灘與海。
要辦理 check-in 都會在這裡的櫃檯


會有人先引導我們到後面的休息區

一開始進入大廳後，會有服務人員引導到休息區，以及會附上迎賓飲料(芒果汁)，等待他們確認好資料才會請我們到櫃檯辦理 check-in。辦理的速度不是很快，因此其實等了有點久，不知道是不是東南亞的 style，員工有點悠哉(?)的感覺。

[大廳休息區]


這裡是早晚都開放，除了當作 check-in 前的休息區，晚上也是大家會來這裡喝一杯，聽聽現場 live show 的地方。這裡的空間蠻大的，而且沙發也還蠻好坐，晚上適合在這裡點一杯酒好好放鬆。



除了一些免費的小點可以拿之外，旁邊還放了一車酒，可惜是要收費的。

[戶外空間]


穿過大廳，會看到一個很南洋度假風的戶外區，以及必備的游泳池。



一定要有的海邊小屋酒吧


還有一整片的沙灘！


Spa 小屋

不過整個區域並不是很大，大概就是敘述的這幾塊，比較適合像歐美人一樣，來這裡躺在躺椅上曬太陽。這裏還有一個面海的鞦韆，可以在這裡靜靜的享受這片寧靜。


夜晚的游泳池會打燈，很有氣氛

房間入口位於櫃檯左方

每一層樓電梯廳都還有一個很大的沙發，但乾淨度有點差，有看到上面有一些食物碎屑。



 房間環境


我們這次總共入住六間雙人房，但是沒有面海景的經濟房型，景色就是外面的夜市，但隔音安靜度蠻不錯，晚上睡覺幾乎沒有聽到什麼噪音。


房內設施基本該有的都有，一開始房間有六瓶水，後來每天也補 2~4 瓶，不用擔心水會不夠，在炎熱的東南亞天氣，時常需要補充水分。



minibar 的飲料餅乾全部都是要收費的


Evian 的水想當然也是錢的


也有基本的咖啡跟茶包

[浴室]

浴室空間也不小，不過只有簡單的淋浴設施




備品也是飯店自己的品牌


🍽 飯店餐廳，早餐與酒吧

Parkloyal 除了早餐之外，還有兩間餐廳，與兩間 bar，在這裡待的五天，每一間我們都去過了。

[早餐]


菜色選擇不算真的很多，有熟食也有冷食，也有基本的麵包優格，該有的都有，口味的話也不會太差。


座位區蠻大的，不過要 8:00 前來比較少人

也有現煮的蛋料理可以選擇

沙拉區

熟食區

還有一區兒童區，備有兒童餐具與比較低的桌子，這點倒是蠻貼心的，可以讓小朋友自己來取用食物。




飲料區，每天的新鮮果汁會不太一樣

[餐廳]

Parkloyal 有兩間餐廳
  • Gustoso
  • Asian Kitchen


Gustoso

這間餐廳有室內與室外，我們這次選擇的是戶外在海灘上的 Gustoso by the beach

Gustoso by the beach


其實這間餐廳，我們還在台灣的時候就先訂了，但到了發現他們竟然沒登記...

很傻眼，好在他馬上有安排出座位，而且座位的景色其實很不賴，可以邊看著夕陽邊吃著晚餐


這是菜單，主要是以燉飯跟義大利麵為主


我們事先也沒有做功課，就直接叫他推薦，然後隨便亂點了一些。味道其實不差，有些還蠻好吃的，而且價格又不貴，適合在飯店住好幾天的遊客某一餐可以試試看。




點了一杯邁泰，但就也很普通像果汁，沒啥記憶點



雖然可能有些蚊蟲，不過這裡的風景倒是很美，在這裡用夕陽配著晚餐蠻浪漫的



Asian Kitchen



這間地點其實就是早餐的餐廳，不過就不怎麼推薦了，食物普普通通，再加上遇到白目的員工 (留到最後再講)，照片也不照了。

---

贈送的蝦餅


海南雞飯

這擺盤還有它的質感，還以為是在外面路邊的小店...


[Bar]

Parkloyal 有兩間 bar
  • Javana Lounge
  • Sunset Bar

先說結論

如果想喝好的調酒

 還是不要浪費錢了

這裡點點啤酒就好了



Javana Lounge


這間是下午開始營業，提供也飯店住戶的酒吧，點了兩杯經典的調酒。比較有趣的是，本來想點杯 Sidecar，但調酒的人卻反問我說原料有什麼，然後開始拿出手機 google...



雖然當下聽到想說不妙了，是不要浪費錢直接走人，但還是想想都來了就試試看。

由於口味這種東西是很主觀的

 這裡只講講個人心得與以前喝到的比較口感

--

 柯夢波丹 Cosmopolitan


這杯酒味很重，檸檬跟柑橘味沒有出來，只有現成蔓越莓汁的死甜

長島冰茶 Long Island Ice Tea



這杯是沒有柳橙汁的原始版本，又因為可樂量比較少，導致整體酒感偏重，而且龍舌蘭的味道很突出，少了長島冰茶清涼順口的口感，不過比起上一杯好一些。

--

Sunset Bar



其實就是剛剛外面那間戶外的小屋，在這裡點了杯新加坡司令

新加坡司令 (Singapore Sling)



跟想像中的味道不一樣，少了鳳梨汁改成櫻桃汁，口感是蠻清爽的，算是杯沒有點到雷，但也不是很驚豔的一杯。最驚豔的是，他竟然沒 shake 直接拿去攪拌機攪拌...

--

結論是，喝喝啤酒其實就好了



---

❌ 人員管理問題

最後就是最重要的部分，擺在最後是希望，能先客觀地看完整體環境與服務，最後再來看看我們所遇到的問題。

飯店人員刷錯卡的時候硬凹

一開始 check-in 的時候，因為我們有多間房間，所以分開刷卡。但後來我們發現金額刷錯，飯店人員發現刷錯卡的時候，第一時間不是跟我們道歉，而是馬上推給我們，說是我們講錯。

Check-in 時間 Delay

我們四點多快要五點抵達，已經過了3點 check-in 時間，但是當下房間竟然還沒準備好，要我們繼續在沙發區等待。

訂位訂假的 & 態度很差

2020/01/29日晚間，我們在 Asian Kitchen Restaurant 使用晚餐，由於我們人數很多，也算是過年家族聚餐，想要一大桌的桌型。前一天晚上親自先去預定10人以上大桌，當下人員都確定好，也看他好像有寫在本子上，結果當天去發現他們根本沒有登記，接待的人員是另一個人，然後態度強硬問我們昨天是誰幫我們預定...???



所以預定要先錄影，還要問工作人員名字嗎？？？

並且堅持不給我們併桌，因為說他整理會困難不好收，後來叫他們經理出來才解決，不知道原來附近桌子併在一起難度有這麼高。

再來一位女性點餐人員聽錯，後來上錯菜，一樣還堅持是我們講錯，一句道歉都沒有直接擺臭臉，真的是很優質的服務呢

退房問題

最後一天退房的時候，說我們有一間房間沒有付錢，也是不去查證一直堅持是我們的問題，不太懂管理上倒底出了什麼問題？



平心而論呢，飯店員工大部分是友善的，但還是第一次在同一間旅館，遇到這麼多員工的問題，壞了旅遊興致。

所以 ParkRoyal Penang Resort  是絕對不推薦

大家去檳城玩，千萬別選這間飯店

title.$t: Penang Independent Travel | Penang Accommodation | Absolutely NOT Recommended | ParkRoyal Penang Resort | Hotel Grounds | Room Review | Resort Restaurants Gustoso & Cinnamon Asian Kitchen

content.$t:
When looking for a place to stay in Penang, our goal was to find a hotel where we could truly unwind — somewhere relaxing even if we never left the property. After comparing prices for several hotels online, we settled on ParkRoyal Penang Resort.

Let me start with the conclusion

This hotel is absolutely NOT recommended. Whatever you do, don't pick this one for your Penang trip


The facilities and cleanliness are beyond reproach

But there are serious problems with staff management


I'll come back to that after introducing the property. First, an objective look at the overall environment and facilities.


📜 Information

  • Stay dates: 2020-01-26 ~ 2020-01-30 (twin room, four nights)
  • Room type: Deluxe Room (breakfast included)
  • Price: MYR1,603.80 (NT$11,614, excluding taxes and service charge)
  • Payment: Credit cards accepted
  • Address: PARKROYAL Penang Resort Batu Ferringhi Beach, 11100 Batu Ferringhi, Pulau Pinang, Malaysia
  • Phone: +60 4-886 2288
  • Official website:https://www.panpacific.com/en/hotels-and-resorts/pr-penang.html
  • Booking site:https://www.booking.com/hotel/my/parkroyalpenang.zh-tw.html?aid=8003516


ParkRoyal is a hotel chain, and this Penang property is a five-star resort-style hotel.


Location & Transport

When traveling in Penang, nearly all the main sights are on Penang Island. ParkRoyal sits in the north-northwest of the island, while the international airport is in the southeast — pretty much the farthest diagonal point away.



There are a few ways to get from the airport to the hotel:
  • Direct public bus (Bus 102)
  • Airport bus into the city, then transfer to a bus or taxi
  • Take a taxi or Grab directly
Since this was a family trip, we chartered a van for this leg — but even going direct it took over an hour. It really is quite far.

If you're a small group, I'd recommend Grab. Fares here are very cheap. Whenever we weren't using the chartered van, we took Grab; from the hotel into town is about a 50-minute drive and costs only around NT$160.

---

ParkRoyal is located in the Batu Ferringhi Night Market area. The whole street is lined with small vendors selling all kinds of trinkets and clothing, and many resort hotels are located here too. The surrounding area is quite lively, with plenty of restaurants and bars — great for an evening stroll.


 The Hotel


The moment you step inside, you're greeted by a grand, high-ceilinged lobby with a distinctly tropical resort feel — and looking straight through it, you see the beach and the sea.
Check-in is handled at this counter


Someone first guides you to the lounge area at the back

After entering the lobby, a staff member leads you to the lounge area and serves a welcome drink (mango juice); only once they've confirmed your details do they invite you to the counter to check in. The process wasn't very fast, so we ended up waiting quite a while. Maybe it's just the Southeast Asian style — the staff seemed rather laid-back (?).

[Lobby Lounge]


This area is open morning and night. Besides serving as a waiting area before check-in, it's also where people come for a drink in the evening and listen to the live show. The space is quite large and the sofas are comfortable — a nice place to order a drink and relax at night.



Besides some complimentary snacks, there's also a drinks trolley beside it — though sadly that one costs extra.

[Outdoor Areas]


Walk through the lobby and you'll find a very tropical outdoor area, complete with the obligatory swimming pool.



The must-have beachside hut bar


And a whole stretch of beach!


Spa hut

That said, the whole area isn't very large — pretty much just what I've described. It's better suited to the Western style of lounging on a deck chair soaking up the sun. There's also a sea-facing swing where you can quietly enjoy the tranquility.


The pool is lit up at night — lovely atmosphere

The entrance to the guest rooms is to the left of the counter

Every elevator lobby has a big sofa, but cleanliness was a bit lacking — I spotted food crumbs on them.



 The Room


We booked six double rooms in total, but these were the economy rooms without sea views — the outlook is the night market. Still, the soundproofing was quite good and we barely heard any noise at night.


The room has all the basics. There were six bottles of water to start with, and they restocked 2–4 bottles daily, so no worries about running out — in the hot Southeast Asian climate you need to hydrate constantly.



Everything in the minibar — drinks and snacks — costs extra


The Evian water is, of course, also chargeable


Basic coffee and tea bags are provided too

[Bathroom]

The bathroom is a decent size, though it only has a simple shower




The amenities are the hotel's own brand


🍽 Hotel Restaurants, Breakfast and Bars

Aside from breakfast, ParkRoyal has two restaurants and two bars — and over our five days here we visited every one of them.

[Breakfast]


The selection isn't huge, but there's both hot and cold food, plus the standard breads and yogurt — everything you'd expect, and the taste isn't bad either.


The seating area is quite large, but come before 8:00 to avoid the crowds

There's also a made-to-order egg station

Salad station

Hot food station

There's also a kids' corner with children's tableware and lower tables — a thoughtful touch that lets little ones serve themselves.




Drinks station — the fresh juices vary from day to day

[Restaurants]

ParkRoyal has two restaurants
  • Gustoso
  • Asian Kitchen


Gustoso

This restaurant has both indoor and outdoor seating; we chose the outdoor beachfront option, Gustoso by the beach

Gustoso by the beach


We had actually reserved this restaurant back in Taiwan, but on arrival we found they hadn't recorded it at all...

Pretty dumbfounding. Thankfully they seated us right away, and the view from the table was actually great — dinner with the sunset.


Here's the menu — mainly risotto and pasta


We hadn't done any research beforehand, so we just asked for recommendations and ordered a few things at random. The food wasn't bad at all — some dishes were quite tasty — and the prices are reasonable, making it a good option for one meal if you're staying several days at the hotel.




I ordered a Mai Tai, but it was very ordinary — tasted like juice, nothing memorable



There may be a few bugs around, but the scenery here is beautiful — dinner paired with the sunset is quite romantic



Asian Kitchen



This is actually in the same space as the breakfast restaurant, but I wouldn't recommend it. The food was mediocre, and on top of that we ran into some obnoxious staff (more on that at the end), so I didn't take many photos.

---

Complimentary prawn crackers


Hainanese chicken rice

Judging by the plating and overall quality, you'd think it came from a roadside stall outside...


[Bars]

ParkRoyal has two bars
  • Javana Lounge
  • Sunset Bar

Conclusion first

If you want a good cocktail

 don't waste your money

Just stick to beer here



Javana Lounge


This bar opens in the afternoon and serves hotel guests. We ordered two classic cocktails. The funny part: I wanted to order a Sidecar, but the bartender asked me what ingredients go in it, then pulled out his phone to Google it...



At that moment I sensed trouble and thought about walking away rather than wasting money, but figured since we were already there we might as well try.

Since taste is highly subjective

 I'll just share my personal impressions compared with versions I've had before

--

 Cosmopolitan


Very boozy, with no lemon or citrus notes coming through — just the cloying sweetness of bottled cranberry juice

Long Island Iced Tea



This was the original version without orange juice, and because there was less cola the alcohol came through heavily, with a very prominent tequila note. It lacked the refreshing, easy-drinking quality of a Long Island Iced Tea — though still a bit better than the previous drink.

--

Sunset Bar



This is that outdoor hut I mentioned earlier; here I ordered a Singapore Sling

Singapore Sling



Not what I expected — pineapple juice was swapped out for cherry juice. It was fairly refreshing, so not a dud, but not impressive either. The most astonishing part: instead of shaking it, they threw it straight into a blender...

--

The conclusion: just stick with beer



---

❌ Staff Management Problems

Now for the most important part. I saved it for last so you could first get an objective view of the property and its services before hearing about the problems we ran into.

Staff charged the wrong card — then argued about it

At check-in, because we had multiple rooms, we paid separately. Later we discovered the amounts had been charged incorrectly. When the staff realized they'd charged the wrong card, their first reaction wasn't to apologize but to immediately push the blame onto us, claiming we'd said it wrong.

Delayed check-in

We arrived just before five o'clock, well past the 3pm check-in time, yet the rooms still weren't ready and we were told to keep waiting in the sofa area.

Fake reservations & terrible attitude

On the evening of 2020/01/29, we had dinner at the Asian Kitchen Restaurant. As we were a large group having a Lunar New Year family meal, we wanted one big table. The night before I went in person to reserve a large table for 10+ people; the staff member confirmed everything and appeared to write it in a notebook. But when we showed up, they had no record of it at all. A different staff member received us and demanded to know, in a very confrontational tone, who exactly had taken our reservation the day before...???



So do we need to film ourselves making a reservation and ask for the staff member's name???

They also flatly refused to push tables together, saying it would be hard to tidy up afterwards. It was only resolved after we asked for their manager. I had no idea pushing a few adjacent tables together was such a formidable task.

Then a female server misheard our order and brought the wrong dish — and again insisted we were the ones who'd said it wrong, without a single apology, just a sour face. Truly premium service.

Check-out problems

On our final day at check-out, they claimed one of our rooms hadn't been paid for — and again, instead of verifying, they simply insisted it was our fault. I really don't understand what's going wrong with their management.



To be fair, most of the hotel staff were friendly, but this was the first time I'd encountered so many staff problems at a single hotel, and it soured the trip.

So ParkRoyal Penang Resort is absolutely NOT recommended

If you're traveling to Penang, please don't pick this hotel
