content.$t:
這是我們這次北九州行的最後一個晚上，吃過了一蘭，也吃了一直想再吃一次的豬排，在沒有特定目標的情況下，索性就直接上網隨便找找大家還有推薦吃什麼，很多人都推薦一定要吃雞肉鍋料理，不過因為最有名的一間離我們的飯店有點距離，在不想走太遠的情況下，找到了另一間離我們旅館很近的とりまぶし 水炊鍋，這間店在 tabelog 上也有 3.58 的高分 (https://tabelog.com/fukuoka/A4001/A400102/40040160/)。



とりまぶし 水炊鍋就是水炊雞肉鍋，其中有名的就是使用了福岡的 “地雞”，其實也就是我們常說的土雞或是放山雞。聽說這也是可以代表福岡的料理之一，水炊雞肉鍋不加其他的調味料，直接使用好的地雞製作成的水炊鍋，擁有最甘甜的地雞風味。


📜 資訊

  • 店家地址：〒810-0801 福岡県福岡市博多区中洲５丁目３−18 Tm-16ビル1F
  • 營業時間：11:00 ~ 23:00
  • 聯絡電話：+815034644885
  • 付款方式：接受信用卡
  • 官方網站：https://fb3m600.gorp.jp/



🍽 餐廳環境

這間店地點位於中州川端2號出口，出站之後看到一蘭拉麵總店，從旁邊的巷子進去約1分鐘就會到了。



我們來的時候大約是晚間八點，時間已經比較晚了，可是一樓全滿，二樓也坐滿一半，而且幾乎看起來都是當地的日本人，很像剛下班過來這裡吃晚餐+喝一杯。通常蠻受當地人會去的店，口味也是蠻不錯。

很像居酒屋的小店


整間店的空間不大，一樓只有大約十個吧檯座位與半開放式的廚房。

我們被安排在二樓靠窗的位置，桌上放有各式的調味料，一共有7種的調味粉，鹽、一味、山椒、七味、黑胡椒、胡麻、柚子辣椒。


可以試試看用不同的調味粉來搭配


柚子醋


🍽 菜單











菜單有著基本的單點，也有各式的飲料跟酒類，另外除了各種的鍋類定食外，とりまぶし 還有許多看起來很豪華的套餐(價格當然也比較豪華)，一個人是 ¥2,700 ~ ¥5,000 不等。



Menu 上還有教你要如何分成四次來品嘗蒲燒雞肉蓋飯，也就是所謂的地雞四吃



🍽 餐點

蒲燒雞肉蓋飯御膳 ¥1,260

博多雞肉火鍋御膳 ¥1,760

為了想嚐到著名的水炊鍋，以及看起來很好吃的蒲燒雞肉蓋飯地雞四吃，但又不想點太多吃不完，所以就各點一個蒲燒雞肉蓋飯御膳＆博多雞肉火鍋御膳。

博多雞肉火鍋御膳


鼎鼎大名的水炊鍋，使用了福岡的 “地雞”，因為他不加其他的調味料，直接使用好的地雞製作成的水炊鍋，所以擁有最甘甜的地雞風味。實際吃起來，湯的地雞香氣是有的，也因為沒有額外的調味料，所以喝起來是最純粹的原味，但我個人覺得味道有點淡，太沒有調味以至於有點像是清淡的雞湯。不過雞肉的部分處理得很嫩很多汁，不會像很多雞湯煮久了雞肉都柴柴的。



蒲燒雞肉蓋飯御膳


蒲燒雞肉蓋飯，就是 Menu 上寫有四種吃法的餐點，光看到就覺得好像很厲害了，所以當然要點一份來試試，一上桌看到這雞肉金黃酥脆的樣子就先加分了。實際上吃起來雞肉烤的很好吃，而且也充滿香氣。


除了原味的第一吃外，第二吃就是加上你喜愛的調味料，可以七種都試試看，或是自己組合搭配一下，可以讓雞肉蓋飯變更好吃。



第三吃就是加上旁邊附上的半熟蛋，混合到飯中搭配著雞肉來吃，這我覺得是四吃中最好吃的一種。


第四吃，把御膳附的一小杯雞湯倒入飯中，變成雞湯泡飯。但其實我自己不太喜歡湯泡飯的吃法，這樣搭配個人口味覺得還好，就不推薦了，有興趣的人可以自己試試看。




梅酒蘇打


整體吃完，整間店是還算不錯的，可以體驗看看不太會踩到雷，如果有在附近可以來試試看福岡有名的水炊鍋。看了很多文章都說這間店需要預訂，如果是用餐時間要來吃保險起見還是先預訂喔！

title.$t: Northern Kyushu Trip | Fukuoka Food | Torimabushi Mizutaki Hot Pot | Free-Range Chicken Specialty Restaurant | Delicious Chicken Four Ways

content.$t:
This was the last night of our Northern Kyushu trip. We'd already had Ichiran, and we'd also had the tonkatsu I'd been wanting to eat again. With no particular plan in mind, we simply hopped online to see what else people recommended. Many suggested that chicken hot pot was a must-try, but since the most famous restaurant was a bit far from our hotel and we didn't feel like walking too much, we found another spot very close to our hotel: Torimabushi mizutaki hot pot. This restaurant also scores a high 3.58 on Tabelog (https://tabelog.com/fukuoka/A4001/A400102/40040160/).



Torimabushi mizutaki is a chicken water-boiled hot pot, and what makes it famous is the use of Fukuoka "jidori" — essentially what we call free-range or native chicken. It's said to be one of the dishes that best represents Fukuoka. Mizutaki chicken hot pot uses no other seasonings; it's made purely from quality free-range chicken, giving it the sweetest, most natural chicken flavor.


📜 Information

  • Address: 1F Tm-16 Building, 5-3-18 Nakasu, Hakata-ku, Fukuoka City, Fukuoka Prefecture 810-0801
  • Opening hours: 11:00 ~ 23:00
  • Phone: +815034644885
  • Payment: Credit cards accepted
  • Official website：https://fb3m600.gorp.jp/



🍽 The Restaurant

The restaurant is located near Exit 2 of Nakasu-Kawabata Station. After exiting, you'll see the Ichiran Ramen head store; head into the alley beside it and you'll arrive in about a minute.



We arrived around 8pm, fairly late already, yet the first floor was completely full and the second floor was half full — and almost everyone looked like local Japanese, as if they'd just gotten off work and come here for dinner and a drink. Restaurants popular with locals usually taste pretty good.

A small place that feels much like an izakaya


The restaurant isn't big — the ground floor has only about ten counter seats and a semi-open kitchen.

We were seated by the window on the second floor. The table was set with all sorts of seasonings — seven seasoning powders in all: salt, ichimi (chili powder), sansho pepper, shichimi, black pepper, sesame, and yuzu kosho.


Try pairing your food with different seasoning powders


Ponzu (yuzu vinegar)


🍽 Menu











The menu has basic à la carte items plus all kinds of drinks and alcohol. Besides the various hot pot set meals, Torimabushi also offers many luxurious-looking course menus (with equally luxurious prices), ranging from ¥2,700 to ¥5,000 per person.



The menu even teaches you how to enjoy the kabayaki chicken rice bowl in four stages — the so-called "chicken four ways"



🍽 The Food

Kabayaki Chicken Rice Bowl Set ¥1,260

Hakata Chicken Hot Pot Set ¥1,760

Wanting to try both the famous mizutaki hot pot and the delicious-looking kabayaki chicken rice bowl "four ways," but not wanting to order more than we could finish, we each ordered one: the Kabayaki Chicken Rice Bowl Set and the Hakata Chicken Hot Pot Set.

Hakata Chicken Hot Pot Set


The renowned mizutaki hot pot uses Fukuoka "jidori" free-range chicken. Since no other seasonings are added and it's made purely from quality free-range chicken, it has the sweetest, most natural chicken flavor. Tasting it for real, the soup does carry the aroma of free-range chicken, and with no extra seasoning it's the purest original flavor — but personally I found it a bit bland, so unseasoned that it felt like a light chicken soup. That said, the chicken itself was cooked beautifully tender and juicy, not dry and stringy like the chicken in many long-simmered soups.



Kabayaki Chicken Rice Bowl Set


The kabayaki chicken rice bowl is the dish with the four eating methods listed on the menu. Just reading about it made it sound impressive, so of course we had to order one. The moment it arrived, the golden, crispy-looking chicken already earned points. The chicken was genuinely delicious, beautifully grilled and full of aroma.


After the first round enjoyed plain, the second round is with your favorite seasoning — you can try all seven or mix and match your own combination to make the chicken rice bowl even tastier.



The third round is adding the soft-boiled egg served on the side, mixing it into the rice and eating it with the chicken — I thought this was the tastiest of the four.


For the fourth round, pour the small cup of chicken broth that comes with the set over the rice to make chicken soup ochazuke. Personally I'm not a big fan of soup-over-rice, so this combination was just so-so for me and I wouldn't recommend it — but if you're curious, give it a try.




Plum wine soda


Overall, the restaurant was pretty good — a safe bet worth experiencing. If you're in the area, come try Fukuoka's famous mizutaki hot pot. I've read many articles saying this place requires reservations, so if you're coming during peak dining hours, it's safest to book ahead!

title.$t: 北九州自由行 | 福岡美食篇 | Ivorish 福岡本店 | 法式吐司專賣 | 好吃的法式吐司推薦

content.$t:
從福岡起家的這間 Ivorish，一直是網路上很推薦的一家店，常常只要直接 google 搜尋『福岡 甜點』，出來的結果除了Quil Fait Bon 之外，第二間大概就是 Ivorish 了！

被號稱福岡必吃之一的Ivorish，主打用法式吐司的各種甜食與鹹食。這次北九州行的最後一天中午，就選擇了這間店來當作早午餐，我們去的是『Ivorish 福岡本店』。其實前一陣子 Ivorish 也在台灣也有了分店，分店位置位在台中三井MITSUI OUTLET PARK內。

📜 資訊

  • 店家地址：〒810-0041 福岡県福岡市中央区大名２丁目１−1番地44号
  • 營業時間：10:00 ~ 21:00
  • 聯絡電話：+81927912295
  • 付款方式：接受信用卡
  • 官方網站：https://ivorish.com/
  • 線上預約：https://www.hotpepper.jp/strJ001071516/yoyaku/request/?vos=othpporgzzzzx00000001

---

🍽 餐廳地點
很好認的外觀

Ivorish 福岡本店的地點位於天神站與赤阪站中間，比較好記的地點是在一蘭拉麵後面的巷子裡，可以從天神地下街「西6」出口往岩田屋方向出來，看到一蘭拉麵後，從右邊巷子進去就可以看到Ivorish 福岡本店了喔！

實際怎麼走，可以參考一蘭拉麵這篇怎麼到一蘭拉麵的位置圖喔！
北九州自由行 | 福岡美食篇 | 福岡天神限定款一蘭拉麵 | 方盒子一蘭拉麵 | Ichiran Ramen

---

🍽 店內環境


由於一開始就打算把他當早午餐來吃，所以沒有吃早餐就直接過來了，抵達的時候是早上 11 點左右，店內幾乎還沒什麼客人也不用等待。



Ivorish 福岡本店分為上下兩層，一樓是一個開放廚房的設計，以 L 型的座位圍繞著隔著透明玻璃的開放式廚房，可以直接看到食物的製作，有種坐在吧台看調酒師調酒的感覺，感覺體驗應該蠻不錯，不過不知道是不是店內還很空，所以一進餐聽就直接被帶位到二樓的座位區了。







二樓的座位區雖然不是很大，但是空間設計的蠻舒適，我們被安排在靠牆的座位區。牆上的擺設雖然簡單，可是有種讓人舒服溫馨的設計感。

這面牆感覺很適合網美拍照

濕紙巾的包裝竟然是純手工一個一個畫上去！



---

🍽 菜單

鹹食



甜食




飲品


---

🍽 食物

由於是想當早午餐，但又想試試他的甜食，最後決定點一份鹹食與一份甜食，這樣不但可以試試他的鹹食又可以吃到甜點。

Eggs Benedict (¥ 1,400)



底下是法式吐司的班尼迪克蛋，班尼迪克蛋配上法式吐司與鹹鹹的生火腿，這樣搭配其實蠻好吃的。旁邊搭配的沙拉，讓口感吃起來不會過於鹹膩，整體吃起來還算不錯。

Rare Cheese (Regular ¥ 1,700)


另外一盤點的是甜點，酥脆的法式吐司加上鮮奶油與新鮮草莓，還有一球冰淇淋可以來搭配。最印象深刻的是底下的法式吐司，很酥脆，吃的時候跟想像中預期的口感很不一樣，尤其搭配冰淇淋吃的時候，整個配起來吃真的滿不錯，是一道印象深刻下次會想再吃一次的甜點！


由於我們是在午餐時間，所以隨餐都有附贈一杯簡單的飲品，只點了簡單的美式與茶。

---


整體吃起來的體驗是蠻不錯的，不過也只有吃了其中的兩個品項，其他餐點如何就有待下次造訪或是大家實際去吃吃看分享經驗了，有興趣到了福岡可以試試看 Ivorish，或是直接去台中分店試試看，可以當下午茶或是早午餐都還蠻適合的。

title.$t: Northern Kyushu Independent Travel | Fukuoka Food | Ivorish Fukuoka Main Store | French Toast Specialty Shop | Delicious French Toast Recommendation

content.$t:
Ivorish, which got its start in Fukuoka, has always been a highly recommended shop online. Very often, if you simply google "Fukuoka desserts," the results will include Quil Fait Bon and, in second place, most likely Ivorish!

Hailed as one of Fukuoka's must-eat spots, Ivorish specializes in all kinds of sweet and savory dishes made with French toast. On the last day of this Northern Kyushu trip, we picked this shop for brunch at midday — we went to the "Ivorish Fukuoka Main Store." Actually, a while back Ivorish also opened a branch in Taiwan, located inside the MITSUI OUTLET PARK in Taichung.

📜 Information

  • Address: 〒810-0041 2-1-1-44 Daimyo, Chuo-ku, Fukuoka City, Fukuoka Prefecture
  • Opening hours: 10:00 ~ 21:00
  • Phone: +81927912295
  • Payment: Credit cards accepted
  • Official website：https://ivorish.com/
  • Online reservations：https://www.hotpepper.jp/strJ001071516/yoyaku/request/?vos=othpporgzzzzx00000001

---

🍽 Restaurant Location
An easy-to-spot storefront

The Ivorish Fukuoka Main Store is located between Tenjin Station and Akasaka Station. An easier way to remember it is that it's in the alley behind Ichiran Ramen. You can come out of the Tenjin Underground Mall's "West 6" exit toward Iwataya, and once you see Ichiran Ramen, head into the alley on the right and you'll find the Ivorish Fukuoka Main Store!

For exact directions, you can refer to the location map in my Ichiran Ramen post on how to get to Ichiran Ramen!
Northern Kyushu Independent Travel | Fukuoka Food | Fukuoka Tenjin Limited-Edition Ichiran Ramen | Square Box Ichiran Ramen | Ichiran Ramen

---

🍽 The Interior


Since we'd planned from the start to have this as brunch, we skipped breakfast and came straight over. We arrived around 11 a.m., and there were hardly any customers yet, so there was no wait.



The Ivorish Fukuoka Main Store has two floors. The first floor features an open-kitchen design, with L-shaped seating wrapping around the glass-fronted open kitchen, so you can watch the food being made — a bit like sitting at a bar watching the bartender mix drinks. It seems like a pretty nice experience, though perhaps because the shop was still fairly empty, we were led straight up to the second-floor seating area as soon as we walked in.







The second-floor seating area isn't very large, but the space is designed to be quite comfortable. We were seated in the area against the wall. The wall decor is simple, yet it has a warm, cozy design sense to it.

This wall looks perfect for Instagram photos

The wet wipe packaging is actually hand-drawn, one by one!



---

🍽 Menu

Savory



Sweets




Drinks


---

🍽 The Food

Since we wanted it to be brunch but also wanted to try the sweets, we finally decided to order one savory dish and one sweet dish — that way we could sample the savory side and still get dessert.

Eggs Benedict (¥ 1,400)



Underneath is French toast, topped with eggs Benedict. The eggs Benedict paired with French toast and salty prosciutto actually tastes quite good. The salad on the side keeps it from feeling too salty or heavy. Overall it was pretty decent.

Rare Cheese (Regular ¥ 1,700)


The other plate we ordered was the dessert: crispy French toast topped with whipped cream and fresh strawberries, plus a scoop of ice cream to go with it. What impressed me most was the French toast at the bottom — very crispy, with a texture quite different from what I'd expected. Especially when eaten together with the ice cream, the combination is really quite good. It's a memorable dessert that I'd want to have again next time!


Since we were there during lunch hours, each meal came with a simple complimentary drink; we just ordered a plain americano and a tea.

---


Overall the dining experience was pretty good, though we only tried two items. How the rest of the menu is will have to wait until my next visit, or for others to actually go try it and share their experiences. If you're interested, give Ivorish a try when you're in Fukuoka, or just head to the Taichung branch — it works well for either afternoon tea or brunch.

title.$t: 北九州自由行 | 福岡市區景點篇 | 天神地下街 | 大濠公園 | 博多運河城 | 交通一日卷

content.$t:
福岡，是距離台灣最近的日本大都市之一，兩小時多的飛機時間，讓福岡也成為台灣人常常去的日本城市。

福岡市是位於日本九州北部、福岡縣西部的都市，是九州最大都市與政治、經濟、交通中心。福岡市臨博多灣，古稱博多，是前往東亞大陸的玄關，自中世紀就形成了商人的自治城市。市區內有眾多人文觀光景點，像是福岡城就是日本100名城之一。福岡市氣候溫暖，年平均氣溫約17℃，也是日本各大城市中氣溫最高的城市之一。

關於福岡的景點，這次總共分成幾個區域來介紹：

  • 中洲川端區
  • 天神區
  • 中央區

中洲川端區

這區廣義來說，是位於祗園到天神之前中間的這一區塊，包含了有名的櫛田神社 、購物美食的博多運河城，更有著在地人生活中心的川端通商店街，另外也包含了一塊福岡市的風化區。是一個融合歷史與現代，非常熱鬧的區域。

櫛田神社

  • 地址：〒812-0026 福岡県福岡市博多区上川端町１−41
  • 開放時間：04:00 ~ 22:00
  • 參觀費用：免費
  • 官方網站：https://www.hakatayamakasa.com/61866.html

位於川端通商店街尾端的櫛田神社歷史十分悠久，自古就作為博多的氏神和總鎮守而聚集當地人的信仰，並在7月舉辦博多祇園山笠，在10月舉辦博多供日等大型活動。在市中心的櫛田神社，也是外地遊客來到福岡市，一定會去參觀的神社景點之一。

博多祇園山笠祭典時候的「飾山笠」

博多祇園山笠，是在櫛田神社的祇園大祭上，博多的人們為祈求封印夏季疾病而舉行的奉納神事。有興趣的人可以延伸閱讀來看看參考資料：https://ohmatsuri.com/zh/articles/fukuoka-hakata-gion-yamakasa

櫛田神社內的稻荷神社


櫛田神社側面入口


博多運河城

有一條人工運河穿過的運河城
  • 地址：〒812-0018 福岡県福岡市博多区住吉１丁目２
  • 營業時間：10:00 ~ 21:00
  • 官方網站：https://canalcity.co.jp/


博多運河城，是在福岡市中心的購物和娛樂中心，也是每個人來到福岡市區必逛的大型商場。商場中間有一條運河，也是運河城的名稱由來。這裡是一間複合式商場，凡舉電影院、劇場、遊樂場、 展場、 購物之外，也有很多美食，除了有方形碗「一蘭拉麵」也有一個來自九州各地拉麵的「拉麵競技場」。不過實際逛下來我自己會覺得天神區可能更好逛一些，大家可以實地兩的地方都去逛逛看。

樓層指南：https://canalcity.co.jp/files/floormap_zh-tw.pdf

博多運河城內的水舞表演

博多運河城內有許多國際品牌

博多運河城離博多車站步行只要十分鐘多，如果是從櫛田神社過來，還可以走空橋直接通到博多運河城喔！從櫛田神社側邊的出口出來，有一個隱藏版的天橋可以直接通到博多運河城，從這棟建築物裡面就有個手扶梯，直接就可以上天橋了。


川端通商店街


  • 地址：〒812-0026 福岡県福岡市博多区上川端町１０
  • 營業時間：視各商家而定
  • 官方網站：http://www.hakata.or.jp/

作為市民生活中心的川端通商店街，中洲川端地鐵站與博多運河城之間，全長400公尺，是個發展超過百年歷史的商店街。結合了各式各樣的餐飲、服飾、雜貨等等的商店，如同日本各個大大小小城市都有的商店街一般，是當地居民生活的一部分。特別的是，在這裡不光只是一條商店街，更是每年博多的「博多祇園山笠祭」的重要地點之一！

商家店舖介紹：(如果圖片失效，請直接到川端通商店街的官網)


面對中洲川端地鐵站的入口




一蘭 本社總本店

  • 地址：〒810-0801 福岡県福岡市博多区中洲５丁目３−2
  • 營業時間：09:00 ~ 02:00
  • 消費方式：只收現金
  • 官方網站：https://ichiran.com/shop/kyushu/sohonten/

在台灣也很有名氣的一蘭拉麵，他的總本店就位於福岡的中洲川端唷！一蘭拉麵來自九州福岡，總本店當然也在福岡市區，就位在地鐵中洲川端出口附近。雖然一蘭發麵只佔了一樓與二樓兩層，但是整棟大樓全都裝上了一蘭拉麵的燈籠，看起來十分氣派。

比較特別的是，總本店特地結合了福岡屋台的飲食文化，在一樓『一蘭屋台』是一般的座位席，二樓才是大家熟悉一格一格的位置。在一整棟的紅燈籠中，仔細看看，會發現只有唯一一個的白色燈籠唷！

只有一個的白燈籠


---

天神區

新天町商店街


  • 地址：〒810-0001 福岡県福岡市中央区天神２丁目９
  • 營業時間：視各商家而定
  • 官方網站：http://www.shintencho.or.jp/


新天町商店街是位於天神站附近，有歷史的商店街，有服飾、藥妝、餐廳等等店舖。不過個人是覺得不是很好逛，如果有到天神地下街，可以順道過來看看計時台地標就好了。



計時台地標

在入口處有這個很大的報時音樂鐘，每當整點時會啟動，像是歐洲的一些城市都有的計時鐘一樣，不同節日的時候也會有著不同的裝飾。

天神地下街

  • 地址：機場線『天神站』到七隈線『天神南站』之間的地下街
  • 營業時間：10:00 ~ 20:00 (餐廳到 21:00)
  • 官方網站：https://www.tenchika.com/

說到福岡的逛街地點，想必最常被推薦、也最常出現在 google 搜尋結果的應該就是『天神地下街』了，天神區也是九州最大的商圈，這裡百貨林立，各個百貨的地下跟天神地下街也接在一起，複雜的程度跟台北車站地下有得比，第一次來的人要不迷路也難！


天神地下街全長約 600 公尺，有著許多流行服飾店、餐廳、雜貨等超過150家店面，空間設計美寬廣且漂亮。

附上店舖地圖：
https://www.tenchika.com/tenchika-map/



天神地下街除了逛街之外，也可以欣賞他的不同設計。在連接PARCO百貨的接口處，有一個天神かっぱの泉，到了年節的時候還會有燈光秀。





另外一個特色是天神地下街的廁所，每一區的廁所都有不同主題，而且設計得非常有質感，在天神地下街逛逛的時候，也可以到廁所逛逛(?)

           



---

中央區

大濠公園

  • 地址：〒810-0051 福岡県福岡市中央区大濠公園１
  • 營業時間：24 hr
  • 官方網站：https://www.ohorikouen.jp/

大濠公園位於中央區，佔地39.8公頃，是當地人休憩遊玩的地點。公園裡其實有很多東西，有日本庭園、美術館、兒童遊戲區、划船設施等等，櫻花季的時候更是賞花重點地區之一。


連接在一起的舞鶴公園有著滿滿的櫻花樹

福岡城遺跡


福岡城別名舞鶴城、石城，現在是日本國家指定史跡，遺址位於大濠公園旁的舞鶴公園，有來大濠公園的話記得順道過來逛逛喔！

title.$t: North Kyushu Independent Travel | Fukuoka City Attractions | Tenjin Underground Mall | Ohori Park | Canal City Hakata | One-Day Transit Pass

content.$t:
Fukuoka is one of the Japanese metropolises closest to Taiwan. With a flight time of just over two hours, it has become a Japanese city that Taiwanese travelers visit again and again.

Fukuoka City lies in northern Kyushu, in the western part of Fukuoka Prefecture. It is Kyushu's largest city and its political, economic and transport hub. Facing Hakata Bay, the city was anciently known as Hakata and served as the gateway to the East Asian continent; as early as the medieval period it developed into a self-governing merchant town. The city is full of cultural and historical sights — Fukuoka Castle, for instance, is one of Japan's 100 Fine Castles. Fukuoka enjoys a mild climate with an average annual temperature of about 17°C, making it one of the warmest of Japan's major cities.

For this guide, Fukuoka's attractions are divided into several districts:

  • Nakasu-Kawabata area
  • Tenjin area
  • Chuo Ward

Nakasu-Kawabata Area

Broadly speaking, this area lies between Gion and Tenjin. It includes the famous Kushida Shrine, Canal City Hakata for shopping and dining, and the Kawabata Shopping Arcade at the heart of local life — plus one of Fukuoka's red-light districts. It's a lively area where history and modernity blend together.

Kushida Shrine

  • Address: 〒812-0026 1-41 Kamikawabata-machi, Hakata-ku, Fukuoka City, Fukuoka Prefecture
  • Opening hours: 04:00 ~ 22:00
  • Admission: Free
  • Official website: https://www.hakatayamakasa.com/61866.html

Standing at the far end of the Kawabata Shopping Arcade, Kushida Shrine has a very long history. Since ancient times it has been worshipped as Hakata's guardian deity and chief protector, drawing the devotion of locals. It hosts the Hakata Gion Yamakasa festival in July and the Hakata Okunchi festival in October. Located right in the city center, Kushida Shrine is one of the shrines visitors to Fukuoka simply must see.

A "Kazari Yamakasa" float from the Hakata Gion Yamakasa festival

The Hakata Gion Yamakasa is a votive ritual held at Kushida Shrine's grand Gion festival, in which the people of Hakata pray to ward off summer illnesses. If you're interested, here's some further reading: https://ohmatsuri.com/zh/articles/fukuoka-hakata-gion-yamakasa

The Inari Shrine within Kushida Shrine


The side entrance to Kushida Shrine


Canal City Hakata

Canal City, with an artificial canal running right through it
  • Address: 〒812-0018 1-2 Sumiyoshi, Hakata-ku, Fukuoka City, Fukuoka Prefecture
  • Opening hours: 10:00 ~ 21:00
  • Official website: https://canalcity.co.jp/


Canal City Hakata is a shopping and entertainment complex in the heart of Fukuoka, and a large mall that everyone visiting the city ends up browsing. A canal runs through the middle of the complex — the source of its name. It's a mixed-use mall with a cinema, theater, arcade, exhibition space and shopping, plus plenty of food: not only the square-bowl "Ichiran Ramen" but also a "Ramen Stadium" gathering ramen from all over Kyushu. That said, after walking around I personally felt Tenjin might be the better shopping district — so do check out both places for yourself.

Floor guide: https://canalcity.co.jp/files/floormap_zh-tw.pdf

The fountain show inside Canal City Hakata

Canal City Hakata is home to many international brands

Canal City Hakata is just over ten minutes' walk from Hakata Station, and if you're coming from Kushida Shrine you can take a skywalk straight there! Exit from the side of Kushida Shrine and you'll find a hidden pedestrian bridge that leads directly to Canal City — there's an escalator inside the building that takes you right up onto the bridge.


Kawabata Shopping Arcade


  • Address: 〒812-0026 10 Kamikawabata-machi, Hakata-ku, Fukuoka City, Fukuoka Prefecture
  • Opening hours: Varies by shop
  • Official website: http://www.hakata.or.jp/

The Kawabata Shopping Arcade, a hub of daily life for residents, stretches 400 meters between Nakasu-Kawabata subway station and Canal City Hakata, and has more than a century of history. It brings together all kinds of restaurants, clothing shops, general goods stores and more — just like the shopping arcades found in cities large and small across Japan, it's part of everyday local life. What makes it special is that it isn't just a shopping street: it's also one of the key venues for Hakata's annual "Hakata Gion Yamakasa Festival"!

Shop directory: (if the image doesn't load, please go straight to the Kawabata Shopping Arcade official site)


The entrance facing Nakasu-Kawabata subway station




Ichiran Head Office Main Store

  • Address: 〒810-0801 5-3-2 Nakasu, Hakata-ku, Fukuoka City, Fukuoka Prefecture
  • Opening hours: 09:00 ~ 02:00
  • Payment: Cash only
  • Official website: https://ichiran.com/shop/kyushu/sohonten/

Ichiran Ramen, famous in Taiwan too, has its head main store right here in Nakasu-Kawabata, Fukuoka! Ichiran originated in Fukuoka, Kyushu, so naturally its flagship is in downtown Fukuoka, near the exit of Nakasu-Kawabata subway station. Although Ichiran only occupies the first and second floors, the entire building is hung with Ichiran lanterns, making it look very impressive.

What's unusual is that the main store deliberately incorporates Fukuoka's yatai (street food stall) culture: the first floor, "Ichiran Yatai," has ordinary seating, while the second floor has the individual booth seats everyone knows. And if you look carefully at all those red lanterns, you'll spot the one and only white lantern!

The one and only white lantern


---

Tenjin Area

Shintencho Shopping Arcade


  • Address: 〒810-0001 2-9 Tenjin, Chuo-ku, Fukuoka City, Fukuoka Prefecture
  • Opening hours: Varies by shop
  • Official website: http://www.shintencho.or.jp/


The Shintencho Shopping Arcade is a historic arcade near Tenjin Station, with clothing stores, drugstores, restaurants and more. Personally, though, I didn't find it that great for browsing — if you're already at the Tenjin Underground Mall, you might just swing by to see the landmark clock tower.



The landmark clock tower

At the entrance stands this large musical chiming clock, which starts up on the hour, much like the clocks found in some European cities. It's also decorated differently for various holidays and festivals.

Tenjin Underground Mall

  • Address: The underground mall running between "Tenjin Station" on the Airport Line and "Tenjin-Minami Station" on the Nanakuma Line
  • Opening hours: 10:00 ~ 20:00 (restaurants until 21:00)
  • Official website: https://www.tenchika.com/

When it comes to shopping in Fukuoka, the most recommended spot — and the one that shows up most often in Google search results — has to be the "Tenjin Underground Mall." Tenjin is also Kyushu's largest shopping district, packed with department stores whose basement levels all connect to the underground mall. It's about as complex as the underground beneath Taipei Main Station, so it's hard not to get lost on your first visit!


The Tenjin Underground Mall runs for about 600 meters and holds more than 150 shops — fashion boutiques, restaurants, general goods stores and more — in a spacious, beautifully designed setting.

Here's the shop map:
https://www.tenchika.com/tenchika-map/



Besides shopping, the Tenjin Underground Mall is worth visiting just to appreciate its varied design. At the junction connecting to the PARCO department store there's the Tenjin Kappa no Izumi (Kappa Fountain), which even hosts light shows during the holiday season.





Another distinctive feature is the restrooms in the Tenjin Underground Mall: each section has its own theme, and they're all designed with real style. While you're browsing the mall, you can go browse the restrooms too (?)

           



---

Chuo Ward

Ohori Park

  • Address: 〒810-0051 1 Ohorikoen, Chuo-ku, Fukuoka City, Fukuoka Prefecture
  • Opening hours: 24 hr
  • Official website: https://www.ohorikouen.jp/

Ohori Park sits in Chuo Ward and covers 39.8 hectares, serving as a place for locals to relax and unwind. There's actually plenty to see here: a Japanese garden, an art museum, a children's play area, boat rentals and more — and during cherry blossom season it's one of the top hanami spots.


The adjoining Maizuru Park is packed with cherry trees

Fukuoka Castle Ruins


Fukuoka Castle, also known as Maizuru Castle or Seki Castle, is today a nationally designated historic site of Japan. The ruins lie in Maizuru Park right next to Ohori Park, so if you're visiting Ohori Park, be sure to stop by!

title.$t: 北九州自由行 | 福岡美食篇 | 黒かつ亭 | 福岡阪急樓上 | 好吃的鹿兒島炸豬排

content.$t:
黑豚，在鹿兒島算是最有名的美食，黒かつ亭主打產地直送的薩摩黑豚，且價格也不會到太貴。這間炸豬排店，其實是一年前在東京車站地下街偶然吃到的，當時因為想要吃的店大排長龍，索性隨便找一間在旁邊的店進去吃，結果吃到的時候真的可以說是第一次吃到這麼好吃的豬排。

這次來福岡發現黒かつ亭在這裡也有分店，查到福岡也有分店後，就在行程裡面不管怎樣也要擠出一個晚上去吃，想來試試看當時驚奇的美味，是不是只是當下太餓了而已 😂



黒かつ亭在日本總共有四間店，tabelog 四間店平均分數大概是 3.5 (黒かつ亭@ tabelog)，這分數的水準在 tabelog 已算是蠻不錯的。Google map 上的分數在兩間鹿兒島的分店都有4分以上的高分，剛好我吃過的福岡與東京店分數都比較慘烈，大概 3.5 左右。


📜 資訊

  • 店家地址：〒812-0012 Fukuoka, Hakata Ward, Hakataekichuogai, 1−1番1号 くうてん 9Ｆ
  • 營業時間：11:00 ~ 20:00
  • 聯絡電話：+81 92-260-1177
  • 付款方式：接受信用卡
  • 官方網站：http://www.kurokatutei.net/



這次我們去的 JR 博多阪急店，就位在 JR 博多站樓上的阪急百貨 9F 美食廣場裡面。抵達 9F 的時候，其他店家都沒人在排隊，就只有 黒かつ亭 外頭坐了兩三組客人在等，意外的熱門。

一進來就會先附上茶水還有小菜


大約等15分鐘多就輪到我們了，店內空間不算太大，有許多四人桌，也有像吧檯式面向外面的座位。





定食的價位在日本來說不會算太貴，大概 1500 ~ 2000 日幣之間，我們各點了一個 黑豬排亭套餐 & 上等里肌肉排套餐。

份量不算太少的定食


味道還蠻不錯的豬肉味增湯

定食有附一碗味增湯，這碗味增湯裡面有很多料，不光是豬肉，還有許多的蘿蔔，紅蘿蔔和洋蔥，而且熬煮的調味蠻不錯，上一次在東京店吃到就蠻驚豔的了。

中規中矩的高麗菜絲



可以保溫的小飯鍋


比較特別的是，定食的飯是用一個小鍋子裝的，有一定程度的保溫效果，等你要吃的時候再打開去挖飯，可以吃到熱熱的飯，印象中在東京店吃到的時候是用普通的碗。

黑豬排亭套餐

上等里肌肉排套餐


炸豬排的部分一樣很好吃，不過忘記在東京店吃到的是哪一個部位，那時候吃到的比較入口即化很驚艷，這次的兩個部位有部分瘦肉，外皮很酥脆，豬排的肉汁也還保留在裡面，整體比例吃起來還是很不錯！

未來有機會到福岡，想吃豬排的話，不妨來試試看這間黒かつ亭吧

title.$t: Northern Kyushu Trip | Fukuoka Food | Kurokatsutei | Above Hankyu Fukuoka | Delicious Kagoshima Tonkatsu

content.$t:
Kurobuta (black pork) is probably Kagoshima's most famous delicacy, and Kurokatsutei (黒かつ亭) specializes in Satsuma black pork shipped directly from the source — at prices that aren't too steep either. I actually stumbled upon this tonkatsu restaurant a year ago in the underground mall at Tokyo Station: the place I originally wanted to eat at had a huge line, so I just picked a shop next door at random, and it turned out to be the best tonkatsu I'd ever tasted.

On this trip to Fukuoka I discovered that Kurokatsutei has a branch here too, and once I found out, I was determined to squeeze one evening into the itinerary no matter what — just to see whether that amazing flavor was real, or whether I was simply starving that day 😂



Kurokatsutei has four locations in Japan, with an average Tabelog score of about 3.5 across them (Kurokatsutei @ Tabelog), which is actually a pretty good rating by Tabelog standards. On Google Maps, both Kagoshima branches score above 4, while the Fukuoka and Tokyo branches I happened to visit fare worse, at around 3.5.


📜 Information

  • Address: 〒812-0012 Fukuoka, Hakata Ward, Hakataekichuogai, 1−1番1号 Kuten (くうてん) 9F
  • Opening hours: 11:00 ~ 20:00
  • Phone: +81 92-260-1177
  • Payment: Credit cards accepted
  • Official website：http://www.kurokatutei.net/



The branch we visited, JR Hakata Hankyu, is located in the food court on the 9th floor of the Hankyu department store above JR Hakata Station. When we arrived on the 9th floor, no other restaurant had a line — only Kurokatsutei had two or three groups waiting outside. Unexpectedly popular.

Tea and a small appetizer are served as soon as you sit down


After waiting a little over 15 minutes it was our turn. The interior isn't very large, with plenty of four-person tables plus counter-style seats facing outward.





The set meals aren't too expensive by Japanese standards, roughly 1,500 ~ 2,000 yen. We each ordered one: the Kurokatsutei Set & the Premium Loin Cutlet Set.

A set meal with a decent portion size


The pork miso soup was really tasty

The set comes with a bowl of miso soup packed with ingredients — not just pork, but plenty of daikon, carrot and onion, and it's seasoned and simmered beautifully. I was already impressed by it at the Tokyo branch last time.

Standard shredded cabbage



A small rice pot that keeps the rice warm


One nice touch: the rice in the set comes in a small pot that keeps it warm, so you open it and scoop out hot rice whenever you're ready to eat. As I recall, at the Tokyo branch it was served in an ordinary bowl.

Kurokatsutei Set

Premium Loin Cutlet Set


The tonkatsu itself was just as delicious, though I can't remember which cut I had at the Tokyo branch — that one practically melted in the mouth and blew me away. The two cuts this time had some leaner meat; the coating was very crisp and the pork still held its juices, so overall the balance was still excellent!

If you're in Fukuoka in the future and feel like tonkatsu, do give Kurokatsutei a try.

title.$t: 北九州自由行 | 福岡住宿篇 |  The Lively Hakata Fukuoka | 地點方便，新穎且價格便宜的住宿 | Happy Hour 啤酒&水果紅酒喝到飽

content.$t:
📜 資訊

  • 入住日期：2019-12-08 ~ 2019-12-09 (雙人房一晚)，2019-12-10 ~ 2019-12-12 (雙人房兩晚)
  • 入住房型：標準雙人房 (不含早餐)
  • 入住價格：¥ 6,480 (雙人房一晚)，¥ 12,150 (雙人房兩晚)
  • 付款方式：可刷卡
  • 旅館地址：〒810-0801 福岡県福岡市博多区中洲５丁目２−18
  • 聯絡電話：+81 92-262-2009
  • 官方網站：https://www.the-lively.com/
  • 訂房網站：https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/the-lively-hakata-fukuoka.zh-tw.html?aid=8003516

這次會在福岡待三個晚上，這間 The Lively Hakata Fukuoka 是在 2019-07-27 才新開幕的旅店，The Lively 是連鎖旅店，目前在東京，大阪，還有福岡各有一間，三間都是走時尚設計的風格，福岡這間 The Lively Hakata Fukuoka 應該是最新開幕的。

會注意到他是因為他的價格，相較其他福岡的住宿實在很便宜，而且不管是在 booking.com 或是 google map 的評分都很高。看了一下評論也沒有什麼太大的問題，再加上又是新開的飯店，設備應該都很新，所以最後就選擇這間來當作福岡三個晚上的住宿！




P.S 通常在看評分的時候，我都習慣會再去看一下評分最低的幾個留言，看看實際上是什麼狀況，因為有的時候會因為一點小事情就給了負評，用來當作另一個評斷的指標，通常都也還蠻準的，大家可以參考看看～

---

📝 整體評價

先給個關於這間住宿的整體評價：

✔ 優點

  • 地點方便，就在中洲川地鐵站2號出口
  • 價格便宜，一晚日幣六千多
  • 設備新穎，2019年下半年才開幕的新旅館
  • 裝潢很有設計感
  • 櫃檯英文溝通流暢

❌ 缺點

  • 房間很小，無法打開兩個行李箱
  • 浴室也很小，且排水很慢，洗澡的時候浴缸會積水
  • 中央空調無法選擇冷氣或是暖氣，只能選擇風量
  • 隔音不太好
  • 垃圾桶設計不太好用
  • 房內衛生紙給的有點少
---

📍地點位置&交通

旅館地點就在中洲川地鐵站2號出口出來轉角，出來走不到一分鐘就到了，但這個出口沒有電梯，如果帶著大行李，建議還是選擇有電梯的出口再走過來(4號)。

這裡就是地鐵出口，會從這裡的樓梯上來

出來後只要直接從這個巷口左轉進去，馬上就可以看到 The Lively Hakata Fukuoka 了，附近也有多間便利商店跟藥妝店，地點非常的方便。

出口出來另一個方向，就是一蘭拉麵的總店，晚上想吃個宵夜也很方便！

往前走左轉進巷子裡


光看入口大廳就覺得蠻有設計感

中洲川端是福岡著名的風化區場所，不過因為 The Lively Hakata Fukuoka 的地點是在風化區的另一側，所以從地鐵出來並不會經過那一區。

---

🏢 旅館環境


一進大廳先看到的就是這個吧台和他挑高的大廳，跟以往在日本住的商務旅館感覺差很多，有總到了高級飯店或是 bar 的感覺，體驗是蠻新穎的。

挑高的大廳與吧台

大廳四周有很多很舒服的休息空間，再加上我們抵達的時候剛好遇上旅館的 Happy Hour (每天的 5:30 ~ 6:30)，有提供啤酒與水果紅酒喝到飽！

每日下午 5:30 ~ 6:30 的 Happy Hour

許多人就在大廳聽著音樂，享用著旅館提供的免費酒水


由於這時間也是 check-in 熱門時段，我們剛好在等待 check-in 的時候，剛好可以享用到 Happy Hour 的服務。

Check-in 櫃檯小小的在門邊，只有兩個服務窗口，所以人多的時候會等比較久。不過接待的人員一個是外國員工，另一個是可以英文溝通的日本員工，所以整體辦理的過程是很順暢的，不會有什麼溝通不良的狀況。


一旁還有飯店的大廳，也是住宿客吃早餐的場所。


不過我們這次住宿並沒有搭配早餐，所以無法介紹他的早餐如何。

---

🛏 房間環境


房間內空間不大，基本上床就佔了大部分空間了，如果兩個行李箱是無法完全打開的。不過雖然床是一般大小不算大，但是床鋪軟硬適中，睡起來是舒適的。


床旁邊有個有設計感的櫃子，冰箱＆其餘東西都在櫃子裡面。不過垃圾桶設計不太好用，而且垃圾桶也很小，實在用起來不是很舒適。房內衛生紙給的也蠻少，很容易就會用完了。

基本的水，咖啡，快煮壺都有

抽屜打開有浴衣和基本的吹風機＆拖鞋

房內走道也是很小


浴室也是非常非常的小 😂

如同一般的日本商務旅館一樣，房內空間以及廁所都會非常的小，不過該有的備品都會有。但這裡有個缺點，就是浴缸中的排水很慢，只要洗澡的時候浴缸都會積水，要等一陣子才能順利排掉，不知道是真的有堵塞還是設計不良。



備品是 The Lively 自己的品牌

基本的衛浴備品也都有

實際住起來，除了床鋪好睡之外，倒是有幾個缺點。

中央空調無法選擇冷氣或是暖氣，看起來是中央控制的，所以每間房間裡面只能選擇風量，有的時候其實會太熱，只能關起來開窗通風，這點就不是非常方便。另外就是房間的隔音不太好，有一天半夜的時候，可以聽到隔壁間的打呼聲。😅

---

樓梯間的裝飾

考量到價位，地點，還有舒適度，這間旅館還是推薦的，畢竟福岡的住宿其實真的不是很便宜，能在地鐵旁邊又是這種價位，CP 值算不錯的。

content.$t:
📜 Information

  • Dates of stay: 2019-12-08 ~ 2019-12-09 (double room, one night), 2019-12-10 ~ 2019-12-12 (double room, two nights)
  • Room type: Standard double room (without breakfast)
  • Price: ¥ 6,480 (double room, one night), ¥ 12,150 (double room, two nights)
  • Payment: Credit cards accepted
  • Address: 〒810-0801 5-2-18 Nakasu, Hakata-ku, Fukuoka City, Fukuoka Prefecture
  • Phone: +81 92-262-2009
  • Official website: https://www.the-lively.com/
  • Booking site: https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/the-lively-hakata-fukuoka.zh-tw.html?aid=8003516

We stayed three nights in Fukuoka this time, and The Lively Hakata Fukuoka is a hotel that only opened on 2019-07-27. The Lively is a hotel chain with one property each in Tokyo, Osaka and Fukuoka; all three go for a stylish designer look, and the Fukuoka one, The Lively Hakata Fukuoka, should be the newest of them.

What first caught my eye was the price — really cheap compared with other places to stay in Fukuoka — and it scores highly both on booking.com and Google Maps. I read through the reviews and there weren't any major issues, plus being a newly opened hotel the facilities should all be new, so in the end I picked it for our three nights in Fukuoka!




P.S. When I check ratings, I always make a point of also reading the lowest-rated comments to see what's actually going on, because sometimes people leave a bad review over something trivial. I use it as another benchmark and it's usually pretty accurate — give it a try!

---

📝 Overall Review

Here's my overall verdict on this hotel:

✔ Pros

  • Convenient location, right at Exit 2 of Nakasu-Kawabata subway station
  • Cheap — just over ¥6,000 a night
  • Brand-new facilities; the hotel only opened in the second half of 2019
  • Stylish, design-conscious interiors
  • Front desk communicates smoothly in English

❌ Cons

  • Very small rooms — you can't open two suitcases at once
  • The bathroom is also tiny, and drainage is slow, so the tub fills with water while you shower
  • Central air conditioning: you can't choose heating or cooling, only fan strength
  • Poor soundproofing
  • The trash can design isn't very practical
  • Not much tissue paper provided in the room
---

📍Location & Transport

The hotel sits right around the corner from Exit 2 of Nakasu-Kawabata subway station — less than a minute's walk. But this exit has no elevator, so if you have large luggage I'd suggest using the exit with an elevator (Exit 4) and walking over from there.

This is the subway exit — you come up these stairs

Once outside, just turn left into this alley and you'll see The Lively Hakata Fukuoka right away. There are also several convenience stores and drugstores nearby, so the location is extremely handy.

In the other direction from the exit is the head store of Ichiran Ramen — very convenient if you fancy a late-night snack!

Walk ahead and turn left into the alley


Even the entrance lobby already looks nicely designed

Nakasu-Kawabata is Fukuoka's famous red-light district, but since The Lively Hakata Fukuoka is on the other side of it, you won't walk through that area coming from the subway.

---

🏢 Hotel Environment


The first thing you see on entering is this bar counter and the high-ceilinged lobby — a very different feel from the business hotels I've stayed at in Japan before, more like a upscale hotel or a bar. It's quite a fresh experience.

The high-ceilinged lobby and bar counter

There are plenty of comfortable seating areas around the lobby, and we happened to arrive right during the hotel's Happy Hour (5:30 ~ 6:30 daily), with free-flow beer and fruit wine!

Happy Hour daily from 5:30 to 6:30 pm

Lots of people relaxing in the lobby with music and the hotel's complimentary drinks


Since this is also peak check-in time, we got to enjoy the Happy Hour service while waiting to check in.

The check-in counter is small and tucked by the door, with only two service windows, so when it's busy the wait can be long. That said, one of the staff was a foreign employee and the other a Japanese employee who could speak English, so the whole process went smoothly with no communication problems.


Next to it is the hotel's dining area, which is also where guests have breakfast.


We didn't include breakfast in our booking this time, though, so I can't say how the breakfast is.

---

🛏 The Room


The room isn't big — the bed basically takes up most of the space, and you can't fully open two suitcases. The bed itself is a normal size, not large, but it's just the right firmness and comfortable to sleep on.


Beside the bed there's a stylish cabinet holding the fridge and everything else. The trash can, though, is poorly designed and very small, which isn't great in practice. There's also very little tissue paper in the room, so it runs out quickly.

The basics — water, coffee and a kettle — are all there

Open the drawer and you'll find a yukata plus the usual hairdryer and slippers

The walkway inside the room is very narrow too


The bathroom is also extremely tiny 😂

Just like typical Japanese business hotels, the room and bathroom are very small, but all the essentials are provided. One drawback here, though: the bathtub drains very slowly, so water pools in the tub whenever you shower and takes a while to drain away. I'm not sure whether it's actually clogged or just badly designed.



The toiletries are The Lively's own brand

All the basic bath amenities are provided too

In actual use, apart from the comfortable bed, there were a few downsides.

The central air conditioning doesn't let you choose heating or cooling — it seems to be centrally controlled, so in each room you can only adjust the fan speed. Sometimes it got too hot and we could only turn it off and open the window for ventilation, which isn't very convenient. The other issue is the poor soundproofing: one night I could hear snoring from the room next door. 😅

---

Decor in the stairwell

Taking price, location and comfort into account, I'd still recommend this hotel. Accommodation in Fukuoka really isn't cheap, so getting this price right next to the subway makes it pretty good value.

  • 聯絡電話：+81 977-85-2515

在日本美食網站 tabelog 上的分數有 3.03 分

https://tabelog.com/tw/oita/A4402/A440201/44001628/


---

🍽 環境與地點



燒肉萬養軒位於由布院車站出來，直直的那條路上，步行只需要 10 分鐘以內。我們當天晚上借了民宿的腳踏車，沿著這條路直直騎去餐廳。

過了六點後的由布院，大部分遊客離開後其實很寧靜，除了部分餐廳之外，一般的商店都已經沒有營業了。


燒肉萬養軒位於轉角處，他有一個大大的招牌所以不至於會找不到。



打開門會發現很神奇的風格，像是印地安(?)的圖騰柱，要爬樓梯到二樓才會到餐廳。



餐廳內空間不大，大概只有 5~6 張桌子，店內環境有點復古懷舊感，看起來是由一家人一起經營。


🍽 餐點

菜單

菜單有分幾種，吃到飽，套餐跟單點，如果特別跟老闆說的話，他會拿給你"手寫"的中文菜單給你。



吃到飽其實不貴，但吃到飽可以吃的就沒有和牛了，中文菜單上的 "牛腰肉" & "上等肋排肉" 這兩個才是黑毛和牛，日文菜單上才有標示。所以最後我們就決定單點，吃吃想吃的就好了。

---


電視前面有一個很居家感的生菜吃到飽


每桌旁的調味料區


地雞 (¥ 800)

燒肉的烤盤是用這種烤爐，油也是用一壞牛肉的油脂給你刷 (右邊那塊)。


黑毛和牛上等肋排肉 (¥ 1,300)


黑毛和牛牛腰肉 (¥ 1,500)

這塊其實還算大塊，油花分布也蠻均勻，看起來還蠻不錯的。另外，桌子旁有剪刀可以剪。


生啤酒 (¥ 600)






我們陸續還有點一些其他的餐點，最後這餐總共兩個人花費 ¥ 5,830。





和牛的等級雖然可能沒有到頂級，但以這種價位，CP 值已經很不錯了。

餐後還有應該是自己手工做的甜點

吃到一半老闆經過也會來跟你閒聊，走的時候老闆娘還送我們橘子 (??)

是一間價位不高，蠻溫馨的小餐館，可惜沒有禁菸。我們快吃完的時候後來進來的客人，就直接在抽菸，室內通風不是很好所以本來就會充滿油煙味，再多煙味是真的有點可怕。這大概是個人認為一大不能接受的點，不過以餐點 CP 來說是蠻不錯的。

title.$t: Northern Kyushu Independent Travel | Yufuin Food | Yakiniku Manyoken | A Cozy Family Restaurant | Great-Value Kuroge Wagyu Yakiniku | Menu

content.$t:
We stayed one night in Yufuin, and since we hadn't booked dinner at our guesthouse, we had to go find something good to eat. Before the trip I'd already looked it up and found a yakiniku restaurant recommended by quite a few people, offering great-value wagyu, so we decided to have dinner there during our night in Yufuin — Yakiniku Manyoken.

📜 Information

  • Address: 〒879-5102 3048-10 Kawakami, Yufuin-cho, Yufu City, Oita Prefecture
  • Opening hours: 18:00 ~ 21:00
  • Phone: +81 977-85-2515

It has a score of 3.03 on the Japanese food site tabelog

https://tabelog.com/tw/oita/A4402/A440201/44001628/


---

🍽 Atmosphere & Location



Yakiniku Manyoken sits on the road that runs straight out from Yufuin Station — under 10 minutes on foot. That evening we borrowed bicycles from our guesthouse and rode straight down this road to the restaurant.

After 6 p.m., once most of the tourists have left, Yufuin is actually very quiet; apart from a few restaurants, the ordinary shops are all closed.


Yakiniku Manyoken is on a corner, and it has a big sign so you won't miss it.



Open the door and you'll find a rather curious style — something like Native American (?) totem poles. You have to go up the stairs to the second floor to reach the restaurant.



The dining room isn't big — only about 5 or 6 tables — and the interior has a retro, nostalgic feel. It looks like the place is run by one family.


🍽 The Food

Menu

The menu is split into a few options: all-you-can-eat, set meals, and à la carte. If you specifically ask the owner, he'll bring you a "handwritten" Chinese menu.



The all-you-can-eat option isn't expensive, but it doesn't include wagyu. On the Chinese menu, only the "beef loin" and "premium short rib" are Kuroge Wagyu — that's only marked on the Japanese menu. So in the end we decided to order à la carte and just eat what we wanted.

---


A very homey all-you-can-eat salad corner in front of the TV


The condiment area beside each table


Jidori Free-Range Chicken (¥ 800)

The yakiniku is grilled on this kind of grill, and for oil they give you a chunk of beef fat to brush over it (the piece on the right).


Kuroge Wagyu Premium Short Rib (¥ 1,300)


Kuroge Wagyu Beef Loin (¥ 1,500)

This piece was actually fairly large, with nicely even marbling — it looked pretty good. There are also scissors beside the table for cutting it.


Draft Beer (¥ 600)






We went on to order a few other dishes, and in the end the meal came to ¥ 5,830 for two people.





The wagyu may not be top grade, but at this price the value is really quite good.

After the meal there was dessert, which seemed to be homemade

Halfway through the meal the owner came by for a chat, and as we left the owner's wife even gave us some mandarin oranges (??)

It's a warm little restaurant with reasonable prices; the only pity is that smoking is allowed. Just as we were finishing, customers who came in later lit up right there. The indoor ventilation isn't great, so the place is already full of grill smoke — adding cigarette smoke on top was honestly a bit awful. That's the one thing I personally couldn't accept, though in terms of value for money the food is really quite good.

title.$t: 北九州自由行 | 由布院住宿篇 |  Yufuin Lamp no Yado | 湯布院燈之宿旅館 | 有貓咪的溫泉旅館

content.$t:
由布院，也是日本著名的一個溫泉區，由於鄰近的活火山由布岳的緣故，擁有非常豐沛的溫泉水量。到了由布院一定就要住個溫泉旅館，一開始在找的時候，會發現靠近景點的區域住宿都不會太便宜，尤其在金鱗湖旁的旅館。後來隨意找結果看到這間貓咪溫泉旅館，雖然網路上的網誌介紹心得不多，但總體評價都蠻高的：
  • Booking.com 上 9.2 分 (滿分10)
  • Google map 上 4.5 分 (滿分5)
最後就決定住這間 Yufuin Lamp no Yado


📜 資訊

  • 入住日期：2019-12-09 ~ 2019-12-10 (雙人房一晚)
  • 入住房型：雙床間- 位於新樓 (不含早餐)
  • 入住價格：¥13,500
  • 付款方式：可刷卡
  • 旅館地址：〒879-5102 大分県由布市湯布院町川上3639-1
  • 聯絡電話：+81 977-76-8611
  • 官方網站：https://www.yufuinlampnoyado.com/
  • 訂房網站：https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/he-modannawen-quan-lu-guan-tang-bu-yuan-ranpusu.zh-tw.html?aid=8003516


地點位置&交通

Yufuin Lamp no Yado 位於由布院車站上方，步行大約10分鐘的路程

(Google map 預測的時間通常都用很快的腳程去算...)



從車站出來到第一條路左轉


沿途會經過一間 7-11 跟一個小上坡


最後在路口看到 Lawson 就代表要到了

旅館門口有招牌，還有插很多旗子，所以還蠻好認的



 旅館環境


這間旅館是在 2018 年 5月才開業，打造了一個像是日式庭園的風格，主樓是擁有超過 175 年歷史的老房子改建而成，擁有很有特色的茅草屋頂，搭配日式屋瓦和木頭牆，很有日式風味的建築。



旅館主人之一剛好經過門口

主樓

主樓的兩隻貓咪玩偶，常常會發現它變成貓咪的床...

主樓其實就是接待大廳 & 公共空間，Check-in 或是寄放行李都會在這裡，裡面還有一間溫泉跟部分的客房。



公共區域這裡有免費的飲料，以及一人一顆的溫泉蛋



還有一個設備完善的廚房讓房客自由使用，這裡也是貓咪主要的休息區

直接壓在玩偶臉上睡...

戶外庭園




戶外庭園有著濃濃日式風，維護＆整理得蠻好得，這時候也還有些楓葉，讓庭園增添不少大自然的顏色，白天天氣好的時候坐在外面還蠻舒適的。

這裡是吸煙區

日式庭園中有一小塊足湯區，可以讓住客隨時來這裡泡腳。除了旅館清潔時間之外，24小時都是開放的，我們退房後還繼續留在這裡跟貓玩，所以有看到他每天都有把足湯的水放掉，清理環境。

有注意到有一位足湯管理員嗎？


這裡還可以免費借腳踏車，我們當天有借腳踏車騎去吃晚餐。不過大概只有六台而已，要借的話要趁早，像我們隔天一早想去金鱗湖的時候就都被借完了，只好走過去...


溫泉

溫泉當然也是旅館的一大重點了，Yufuin Lamp no Yado 總共有四間溫泉，三間是室內，一間露天溫泉。溫泉是除了打掃時間外 24 小時開放，而且是不需要與別的住客共用的，我們這次使用了一次庭園的湯屋&別館的露天湯屋。

庭園的湯屋


這兩間是在庭園的兩間室內溫泉，只要看到牌子是沒人使用的，就可以直接進去，然後把牌子換成使用中。裡面也可以鎖門，可以自己享受整個溫泉空間。


這兩間湯屋有一個小小換衣服的空間，這裡有暖氣，所以不至於到太冷，但要記得自己拿房間的吹風機過來。


湯屋裡面長這樣，由於是在隔天打掃的時候拍的，水已經放掉不少了，但也可以看出來他們確實每天有換水打掃。

別館的露天湯屋


這間是別館的露天湯屋，空間就比較大了，裡面設備比較完善，有洗手台&備品都有準備



進去溫泉池之前一樣要先在外面洗乾淨



這就是能真正體驗戶外溫度的露天湯屋了，我們是傍晚的時候過來，這時候由布院氣溫應該差不多個位數溫度，很冷但是溫泉真的很舒服。


 房間環境






我們的房間位於別館，房內的空間其實很大，該有的設備也都有，電視，冰箱，加濕空氣清靜器，旁邊還有一個小茶几，可以讓你在這裡吃吃東西用。




桌上也放了很多東西，除了一些資訊外，還會寫了張小卡片給你


也有基本的熱水壺，鏡子等等


房內看得出來也有蠻多用心的設計，在一些角落也放了不少的裝飾品


房間內也還有附一人一雙外出的木屐造型拖鞋，讓你去泡溫泉的時候方便使用


浴室


房間裡也還是有自己的衛浴設備，如果不想去泡溫泉還是可以在這裡洗澡



備品是使用日本的 ORANGE ROSE 品牌，但我們也都沒使用房內的衛浴，湯屋裡面也有沐浴用品可以使用。



房間裡得吹風機就是一般旅館使用的簡單款，如果去庭院的湯屋要使用，要記得自己帶過去


🐈 旅館主人


當初會選擇這間旅館，一大主因也是看到別人評論說有貓咪很親人



旅館有四隻貓咪
  • TAMA
  • BITA
  • Poo
  • RAN

TAMA


TAMA 是 Poo & RAN 的媽媽，很穩重高雅

BITA


不確定這隻是不是貓爸爸 (?) 當有住客在餐廳吃飯的時候，他會坐在桌上盯著看，給人很有壓力 😂

Poo



這隻應該是最活潑親人的貓了，印象中他大概也才一歲左右，也只有他平常會一直到處晃來晃去，當找不到其他的貓的時候，大概只有他最容易找到了。

RAN


一開始不太理人的 RAN，也是常常會在院子發現他


---

整體住起來蠻舒適，雖然我們待在房間的時間不多，大多數時間都在大廳玩貓，但房間的床很舒適，空間也很大不會有壓迫感。另外，旅館員工很親切，Check-in的時候還帶著我們走偏旅館各個地方仔細介紹，隔天退房還會免費幫你拍立可拍做紀念。

整體體驗是很不錯的，再加上很親人的貓咪，整體對我們而言是有大加分，如果有來由布院要找住宿，喜歡貓咪的話不妨來試試看這間  Yufuin Lamp no Yado。




---

title.$t: Northern Kyushu Trip | Yufuin Accommodation | Yufuin Lamp no Yado | A Hot Spring Ryokan with Cats

content.$t:
Yufuin is one of Japan's famous hot spring areas. Thanks to the nearby active volcano Mount Yufu, it enjoys an extremely abundant supply of hot spring water. When you come to Yufuin, staying at a hot spring ryokan is a must. When we first started looking, we found that accommodation near the main attractions isn't cheap at all, especially the inns beside Lake Kinrin. Later, while browsing around, we came across this cat hot spring ryokan. Although there aren't many blog reviews about it online, the overall ratings are quite high:
  • 9.2 out of 10 on Booking.com
  • 4.5 out of 5 on Google Maps
In the end we decided to stay at Yufuin Lamp no Yado


📜 Information

  • Stay dates:2019-12-09 ~ 2019-12-10 (one night, double room)
  • Room type:Twin room - located in the new wing (breakfast not included)
  • Price:¥13,500
  • Payment:Credit cards accepted
  • Address:〒879-5102 3639-1 Kawakami, Yufuin-cho, Yufu City, Oita Prefecture
  • Phone:+81 977-76-8611
  • Official website:https://www.yufuinlampnoyado.com/
  • Booking site:https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/he-modannawen-quan-lu-guan-tang-bu-yuan-ranpusu.zh-tw.html?aid=8003516


Location & Getting There

Yufuin Lamp no Yado is located above Yufuin Station, about a 10-minute walk away

(Google Maps' estimated times are usually calculated with a pretty brisk walking pace...)



Come out of the station and turn left at the first road


Along the way you'll pass a 7-Eleven and a small uphill slope


When you finally see the Lawson at the intersection, you're almost there

There's a sign at the ryokan entrance, plus lots of flags planted outside, so it's quite easy to spot



 The Ryokan Grounds


This ryokan only opened in May 2018, built in the style of a Japanese garden. The main building is a converted old house with over 175 years of history, featuring a distinctive thatched roof paired with Japanese roof tiles and wooden walls — a building full of Japanese character.



One of the ryokan's owners happened to walk past the entrance

Main Building

The two cat plush toys in the main building — you'll often find they've become a cat's bed...

The main building is essentially the reception lobby & common area. Check-in and luggage storage all happen here, and there's also a hot spring bath and some of the guest rooms inside.



In the common area there are free drinks, plus one hot spring egg per person



There's also a fully equipped kitchen guests can use freely — and this is the cats' main resting spot too

Sleeping face-down right on top of the plush toy...

Outdoor Garden




The outdoor garden has a strong Japanese feel and is very well maintained and tidy. At this time of year there were still some maple leaves, adding plenty of natural color to the garden. On a nice day, sitting outside is really pleasant.

This is the smoking area

There's a small footbath area in the Japanese garden where guests can soak their feet anytime. Apart from cleaning hours, it's open 24 hours. We stayed on here playing with the cats even after checking out, so we saw that they drain the footbath water every day and clean the area.

Did you notice there's a footbath supervisor on duty?


You can also borrow bicycles here for free. We borrowed bikes that day and rode out for dinner. But there are only about six of them, so if you want one, go early — the next morning when we wanted to head to Lake Kinrin they were all taken, so we had to walk...


Hot Springs

The hot springs are of course a major highlight of the ryokan. Yufuin Lamp no Yado has four baths in total — three indoor and one open-air. Apart from cleaning hours the baths are open 24 hours, and you don't have to share them with other guests. This time we used the garden bath house once and the open-air bath house in the annex once.

The Garden Bath House


These are the two indoor baths in the garden. As long as the sign shows nobody is using it, you can just go straight in and then flip the sign to "in use." You can lock the door from inside, so you get the whole bath to yourself.


These two bath houses have a small changing area with heating, so it doesn't get too cold — but remember to bring the hair dryer from your room.


This is what the bath house looks like inside. Since this was taken during cleaning the next day, quite a lot of the water had already been drained — but it also shows they really do change the water and clean every day.

The Annex Open-Air Bath House


This is the open-air bath house in the annex. The space is much bigger and better equipped, with a washbasin and amenities all provided



As always, wash yourself thoroughly outside before entering the bath



This is the open-air bath where you really feel the outdoor temperature. We came in the early evening, when Yufuin's temperature was probably in the single digits — freezing cold, but the hot spring felt absolutely wonderful.


 The Room






Our room was in the annex. It was actually very spacious and had all the essentials — TV, fridge, humidifying air purifier — plus a small tea table on the side where you can sit and have a snack.




There's plenty on the table too — besides various information, they also write you a little card


There's also a basic kettle, mirror and so on


You can tell a lot of thought went into the room design, with plenty of decorative touches tucked into the corners


Each guest also gets a pair of geta-style slippers for going outside, handy for when you head to the hot spring


Bathroom


The room still has its own bathroom, so if you don't feel like going to the hot spring you can shower here



The amenities are from the Japanese brand ORANGE ROSE, though we didn't use the in-room bathroom at all — the bath houses also have bath products available.



The hair dryer in the room is the simple type you find in most hotels; if you want to use it at the garden bath house, remember to take it with you


🐈 The Real Owners


A big reason we chose this ryokan in the first place was reading other reviews saying the cats here are really friendly



The ryokan has four cats
  • TAMA
  • BITA
  • Poo
  • RAN

TAMA


TAMA is the mother of Poo & RAN — very composed and elegant

BITA


Not sure if this one is the cat dad (?) When guests are eating in the dining area, he'll sit on the table and stare at you — quite a lot of pressure 😂

Poo



This one must be the liveliest and friendliest cat. As I recall he was only about a year old, and he's the only one who's constantly wandering around. When you can't find any of the other cats, he's usually the easiest one to track down.

RAN


RAN doesn't pay much attention to people at first, and you'll often spot him out in the garden


---

Overall the stay was very comfortable. Although we didn't spend much time in the room — most of it was spent in the lobby playing with the cats — the bed was very comfortable and the space was generous with no cramped feeling. The staff were also very friendly: at check-in they walked us all around the ryokan and explained everything in detail, and when we checked out the next day they took a free Polaroid photo for us as a keepsake.

The overall experience was really good, and with such friendly cats on top of that, it was a big bonus for us. If you're looking for a place to stay in Yufuin and you love cats, why not give  Yufuin Lamp no Yado a try.

title.$t: 北九州自由行 |  由布院景點篇 | 湯布院 | 湯之坪街道 | 抹茶專門店 télato | B-Speak | Milch | 湯布院花卉村 | 金鱗湖

content.$t:
說到九州的溫泉勝地，除了別府，熊本之外，由布院(湯布院)絕對榜上有名，甚至可能還是第一個想到的溫泉度假勝地，也是遊客來九州自由行最喜歡的景點之一。

2005年的時候，湯布院町與挾間町、庄內町合併為由布市，所以現在一般來說，由布院或是湯布院兩個名稱都有人使用。

🚊 交通



要到由布院觀光，怎麼能錯過九州的觀光列車 - 由布院之森 Yufuin no Mori

請參考：

北九州自由行 | 由布院交通篇 | 北九州觀光列車 | 由布院之森（ゆふいんの森）Yufuin no Mori


📍 景點


由布院其實不大，主要的景點就是湯之坪街道與金鱗湖

由布院車站


從由布院之森抵達由布院車站後，一下車在月台上會先看到一個奇特的景象，不愧是溫泉之鄉，月台上竟然有足湯！


不過這個足湯不是免費的，泡一次成人的話需要 ¥200


如果不想泡足湯，一出站外也有手湯可以稍微暖暖手


一走出由布院車站，可以看到這片開闊的景象，天氣好的時候可以遠眺由布岳


湯之坪街道


湯之坪街道是由布院溫泉區的中心地段，也是由布院著名觀光景點，沿著車站出來的路直直走，就可以到湯之坪街道了。


在這個岔路往右邊那條小路，進去就是湯之坪街道囉！





湯之坪街道有很多特色小店，主要介紹幾間覺得比較特別的店
  • 抹茶專門店 télato
  • B-Speak 蛋糕卷
  • 金賞可樂餅
  • Snoopy 茶屋
  • Milch
  • 湯布院花卉村
---

抹茶專門店 télato

  • 地址：〒879-5102 大分県由布市湯布院町川上2939-4
  • 營業時間：10:30 ~ 16:30
  • 聯絡電話：+81 120-372-539
由布院

這間抹茶專門店 télato 位在由布院車站，出來的那條路直直走沒多久，在進入湯之坪街道之前就會看到了。如果喜歡抹茶的人千萬別錯過，必吃的就是他的抹茶冰淇淋。


其實我們在查景點的時候，並沒有特別查到這間店，而是剛好在前往湯之坪街道的途中，偶然發現了這個小廣告牌，才發現了這間店而進去試試看。(廣告很重要？)


店內空間不大，只有一個員工(老闆？)，牆上有著抹茶冰淇淋的 Menu。

不論是幾倍的抹茶冰淇淋價格都是500日圓，最推薦的是 3 倍抹茶與 5 倍抹茶。旁邊還有一日限定三個使用茶道家御用抹茶，一個足足要六倍價格要價 3,000 日圓，但實在買不下手，不知道是不是真的有很厲害就是了。




不同口味的抹茶與培茶冰淇淋


我們選擇了 3 倍抹茶

三倍抹茶有著剛剛好的抹茶口感，入口的抹茶甜味與香氣都很剛好，不會過於死甜或是很苦，推薦如果不排斥或是喜歡抹茶的人，經過不妨來試試看這間低調的抹茶專賣店。


B-Speak

  • 地址：〒879-5102 大分県由布市湯布院町川上3040-2
  • 營業時間：10:00 ~ 17:00
  • 聯絡電話：+81 977-28-2166
  • 官方網站：http://www.b-speak.net/

到了要進入湯之坪街道的路口轉角處，可以看到非常知名的 B-Speak 蛋糕捲。據說這也是由布院必吃的點心之一，通常都要一開店早上十點就來買，才有機會買得到小份量的蛋糕捲。

我們抵達的時候已經下午了，店門口直接就掛著已售完，就很可惜這次沒吃到。不過由布院之森車上也有販售 B-Speak 的蛋糕捲，如果沒買到的人可以在車上再購買。

金賞可樂餅

  • 地址：1079-番地の８ 湯布院町川上 由布市 大分県 879-5102
  • 營業時間：09:00 ~ 17:30
  • 聯絡電話：+81 977-28-8691

這間 湯布院 金賞コロッケ (金賞可樂餅) 有兩間分店，本店位於湯布院花卉村正門口旁，如果走湯之坪街道進來，最先遇到的應該會是二號店。




一個可樂餅的價格大約都在 200 日圓上下，網路上很推薦的都是豐後牛和牛可樂餅



但吃起來老實說，覺得還好。網路上推薦的都過譽了，和牛是碎肉拌在馬鈴薯裡面，所以就沒有什麼牛肉香氣，感覺是個很普通的可樂餅。不過口感因人而異，大家有興趣路過還是可以去吃吃看。

Snoopy 茶屋


這間 Snoopy 茶屋，也是在由布院常常會有人推薦的景點之一，而且號稱是全球第一家充滿日式風味的 Snoopy 茶屋。但是時間關係&沒有太大興趣所以我們就沒進去了，如果是 Snoopy 的愛好者可以去看看。

由布院 Milch


  • 地址：〒879-5102 大分県由布市湯布院町川上３０１５−1
  • 營業時間：09:30 ~ 17:30
  • 聯絡電話：+81 977-28-2800
  • 官方網站：http://milch-japan.co.jp/


Milch 在湯之坪街道與由布院車站各有一間店，主打的是獲得金賞的「 半熟起司蛋糕 」，一個是150元日幣。







台灣現在也吃得到了，在北車微風就有一間店，但是臺灣買當然會比較貴一個要 60 元台幣。

在蛋糕內層是半熟的起司，底層是鹹鹹的碎餅乾，整體香氣很夠，又不會太甜太膩，尤其要在現場買現場吃，蠻推薦有路過可以買一個來吃吃看。


另外在車站那間店也吃了他們的冰淇淋，香草口味的有很香的香草籽，也算是蠻好吃的冰淇淋。

湯布院花卉村


湯布院花卉村我覺得是一個很奇妙的景點，網路上很多評論都很推，說是很美的歐風小鎮，超殺底片等等。老實說如果你不是要去拍網美照，而是想體驗溫泉鄉逛商店街的種風情，那這個景點完全不會吸引人，而且我也不覺得能拍出什麼厲害的網美照...

主要是模仿英國科茨沃爾德地區的村莊，想要營造出一種這樣的感覺？


裡面有模仿阿爾卑斯山少女的場景，這到底要幹嘛 😅


還真的養了山羊，導致環境蠻臭...


園區也很小，裡面養了很多動物，有松鼠，烏龜，綠頭鴨等等。還有一些特色的屋子裡面都是小商店，簡單說就是自己覺得這景點，不會是什麼由布院必去景點。不過因為免門票，有經過也是可以順便進去晃晃。

金鱗湖

  • 地址：〒879-5102 大分県由布市湯布院町川上
  • 官方網站：http://www.city.yufu.oita.jp/kankou/kankou/kinrinko/

金鱗湖是位於由布院溫泉旁的一個水池，由於位於由布岳山麓，因此也有「岳下之池」、「岳下池」，名稱由來是因為在1884年儒家學者毛利空桑，在此見到夕陽照射反射出像魚鱗的金色光影而命名。這裡在早晨池面常出現晨霧，成為代表由布院溫泉的景觀之一。

從湯布院花卉村走到底，可以看到不少指標告訴你怎麼到金鱗湖。

但我覺得對保險的還是跟著 Google map 走 😅


看到這個在地上的指標，就代表金鱗湖到了



先別急著到湖邊，湖旁的一景沒有什麼遊客，如果楓葉有開也是蠻漂亮。



金鱗湖不大，就是個寧靜的小湖，大概跟台大的醉月湖差不多大吧，傍晚夕陽反射的話有機會看到金光閃閃的湖面。

金鱗湖朝霧

但是比較特殊的景色要看他的朝霧，因為金鱗湖池底有溫泉水與地下水湧出，湧入的水溫約為攝氏30度，湖面水溫則約在攝氏17度至23度之間，因為較高的水溫讓早晨時湖面容易產生霧氣，泛著霧氣的湖面就成為金麟湖的著名景觀。


為了看朝霧，隔天一大早就走路走過來，快到的時候其實看到路邊的小水溝都已經充滿霧氣了，當下早上的溫度是個位數溫度，才有機會看到這樣的景色。

充滿仙氣的金鱗湖


充滿仙氣的金鱗湖

但氣溫太低實在霧太大 😂，應該再晚一點點等氣溫升高一點，霧氣少一點應該會更漂亮！

---


一到晚上遊客走了之後，由布院就會寧靜下來，可以在這裡體會寧靜溫泉鄉的慢活步調。雖然景點實在不多，但還是推薦有時間的話，可以安排在這裡的住宿，不會這麼趕，又可以慢慢的走各個景點。

content.$t:
When it comes to hot spring destinations in Kyushu, aside from Beppu and Kumamoto, Yufuin (Yufuin/Yufuin Onsen) is definitely on the list — it might even be the first hot spring resort that comes to mind, and it's one of the most popular spots for independent travelers in Kyushu.

In 2005, the town of Yufuin merged with the towns of Hasama and Shonai to form Yufu City, so nowadays both names "Yufuin" and "Yufuin (Yunohira reading)" are commonly used.

🚊 Getting There



For sightseeing in Yufuin, how could you miss Kyushu's sightseeing train — Yufuin no Mori

Please refer to:

Northern Kyushu Independent Travel | Yufuin Transport | Kyushu Sightseeing Train | Yufuin no Mori (ゆふいんの森)


📍 Attractions


Yufuin isn't very big; the main attractions are Yunotsubo Street and Lake Kinrin

Yufuin Station


After arriving at Yufuin Station on the Yufuin no Mori, the moment you step off you'll see something unusual on the platform — living up to its name as a hot spring town, there's actually a footbath on the platform!


The footbath isn't free, though — one soak costs ¥200 for adults


If you don't want to soak your feet, there's also a hand bath just outside the station to warm your hands


Step out of Yufuin Station and you're greeted by this wide-open view — on clear days you can gaze out at Mt. Yufu


Yunotsubo Street


Yunotsubo Street is the heart of the Yufuin hot spring district and Yufuin's most famous attraction. Just walk straight along the road leading out from the station and you'll reach Yunotsubo Street.


At this fork, take the small road on the right — go in and you're on Yunotsubo Street!





Yunotsubo Street has plenty of distinctive little shops; here are a few I found especially interesting
  • Matcha Specialty Shop télato
  • B-Speak Roll Cake
  • Kinsho Croquette
  • Snoopy Chaya
  • Milch
  • Yufuin Floral Village
---

Matcha Specialty Shop télato

  • Address: 〒879-5102 2939-4 Kawakami, Yufuin-cho, Yufu City, Oita Prefecture
  • Hours: 10:30 ~ 16:30
  • Phone: +81 120-372-539
Yufuin

This matcha specialty shop, télato, sits along the road leading straight out from Yufuin Station — you'll spot it not long before you enter Yunotsubo Street. If you love matcha, don't miss it; the must-try is their matcha ice cream.


Actually, when researching attractions we never came across this shop. We just happened to spot this little advertising board on the way to Yunotsubo Street, discovered the shop, and went in to give it a try. (Advertising matters, huh?)


The shop is small, with just one staff member (the owner?), and the matcha ice cream menu is on the wall.

No matter the matcha strength, the ice cream is ¥500. The most recommended are the 3x and 5x matcha. There's also a limited three-per-day option using matcha favored by tea ceremony masters — a full six times the price at ¥3,000. I just couldn't bring myself to buy it, so I have no idea whether it's really that amazing.




Different flavors of matcha and roasted tea (hojicha) ice cream


We went with the 3x matcha

The 3x matcha had just the right matcha texture — the sweetness and aroma on the palate were perfectly balanced, neither cloyingly sweet nor overly bitter. If you don't mind matcha, or love it, this understated matcha specialty shop is worth a stop as you pass by.


B-Speak

  • Address: 〒879-5102 3040-2 Kawakami, Yufuin-cho, Yufu City, Oita Prefecture
  • Hours: 10:00 ~ 17:00
  • Phone: +81 977-28-2166
  • Official website: http://www.b-speak.net/

Right at the corner where you turn into Yunotsubo Street, you'll see the very famous B-Speak roll cake. It's said to be one of Yufuin's must-eat treats — you usually have to come right at opening at 10 a.m. to have any chance of getting the smaller-size roll cake.

By the time we arrived it was already afternoon, and a "sold out" sign was hanging at the door, so sadly we missed out this time. That said, B-Speak roll cakes are also sold onboard the Yufuin no Mori, so if you miss out you can buy one on the train.

Kinsho Croquette

  • Address: 1079-8 Kawakami, Yufuin-cho, Yufu City, Oita Prefecture 879-5102
  • Hours: 09:00 ~ 17:30
  • Phone: +81 977-28-8691

Yufuin Kinsho Korokke (Kinsho Croquette) has two branches; the main shop is right beside the front entrance of Yufuin Floral Village, and if you come in via Yunotsubo Street, the first one you'll run into is probably Shop No. 2.




A croquette costs around ¥200 each; the one most recommended online is the Bungo beef wagyu croquette



Honestly though, it was just okay. The online praise is overhyped — the wagyu is minced and mixed into the potato, so there's no real beefy aroma; it felt like a pretty ordinary croquette. Taste is subjective, though, so if you're curious and passing by, give it a try.

Snoopy Chaya


This Snoopy Chaya is another spot people often recommend in Yufuin, billed as the world's first Japanese-style Snoopy teahouse. But between time constraints and a lack of strong interest, we didn't go in. If you're a Snoopy fan, it's worth a look.

Yufuin Milch


  • Address: 〒879-5102 3015-1 Kawakami, Yufuin-cho, Yufu City, Oita Prefecture
  • Hours: 09:30 ~ 17:30
  • Phone: +81 977-28-2800
  • Official website: http://milch-japan.co.jp/


Milch has one shop on Yunotsubo Street and another at Yufuin Station. Its signature is the award-winning "half-baked cheesecake," priced at ¥150 each.







You can try it in Taiwan now too — there's a shop at Breeze Taipei Station, though of course it's pricier there at NT$60 each.

Inside the cake is half-set cheese, with a salty crumbled-biscuit base; the overall aroma is rich without being too sweet or heavy. It's especially good bought and eaten fresh on the spot — definitely worth grabbing one if you pass by.


We also tried their ice cream at the station shop; the vanilla had lots of fragrant vanilla seeds and was pretty tasty too.

Yufuin Floral Village


I find Yufuin Floral Village a rather curious attraction. Lots of online reviews rave about it, calling it a beautiful European-style village, a total photo-op magnet, and so on. Honestly, if you're not there to shoot Instagram photos but rather to soak up the atmosphere of strolling a hot spring town's shopping street, this place holds zero appeal — and I don't think you can even get that great a photo here...

It's mainly modeled on villages in England's Cotswolds region, trying to conjure up that kind of feeling, I suppose?


There's even a scene mimicking Heidi, Girl of the Alps — what exactly is that for? 😅


They really do keep goats, which makes the place rather smelly...


The grounds are tiny and home to lots of animals — squirrels, tortoises, mallard ducks and more. There are also some quaint little houses that are all small shops. In short, I personally don't think this counts as a must-visit Yufuin attraction. But since admission is free, you may as well pop in for a wander if you're passing by.

Lake Kinrin

  • Address: 〒879-5102 Kawakami, Yufuin-cho, Yufu City, Oita Prefecture
  • Official website: http://www.city.yufu.oita.jp/kankou/kankou/kinrinko/

Lake Kinrin is a pond next to Yufuin Onsen. Because it lies at the foot of Mt. Yufu, it's also known as "the pond below the peak." The name comes from 1884, when the Confucian scholar Mori Kuso saw the setting sun reflecting off the water in golden, fish-scale-like shimmers and named it accordingly. Morning mist often rises from the water here at dawn, making it one of the signature sights of Yufuin Onsen.

Walk to the far end of Yufuin Floral Village and you'll see plenty of signs pointing the way to Lake Kinrin.

But I think the safer bet is still to follow Google Maps 😅


When you see this marker on the ground, you've reached Lake Kinrin



Don't rush straight to the lakeside — the scenery beside the lake sees few tourists, and if the maples are turning it's quite lovely.



Lake Kinrin isn't big — just a quiet little lake, roughly the size of NTU's Zuiyue Lake. At dusk, with the sun reflecting off it, you might catch the water shimmering gold.

Morning Mist at Lake Kinrin

The most distinctive sight, though, is the morning mist. Hot spring water and groundwater well up from the bottom of Lake Kinrin at around 30°C, while the lake surface sits at about 17–23°C. The warmer inflow makes mist form easily over the water in the early morning, and that mist-shrouded surface has become Lake Kinrin's famous scene.


To see the morning mist, we walked over first thing the next morning. As we got close, even the roadside gutters were already full of mist — the temperature that morning was in the single digits, which is what gives you a chance to see a scene like this.

Lake Kinrin, wreathed in an ethereal haze


Lake Kinrin, wreathed in an ethereal haze

But it was so cold that the mist was honestly too thick 😂 — we probably should have come a little later, once the temperature rose and the mist thinned; it would have looked even prettier!

---


Once night falls and the day-trippers leave, Yufuin grows peaceful, and you can savor the slow pace of a quiet hot spring town. There really aren't that many attractions, but if you have the time I'd still recommend arranging a night's stay here — you won't feel so rushed, and you can take your time exploring each spot.

title.$t: Northern Kyushu Independent Travel | Yufuin Transport | Northern Kyushu Sightseeing Train | Yufuin no Mori (ゆふいんの森)

content.$t:
When visiting Yufuin, besides the local attractions,

one of the biggest highlights is the sightseeing train!

This time we of course had to ride the famous sightseeing train,

the limited express "Yufuin no Mori"

📜 Information

Official website: Limited Express "Yufuin no Mori"

Tickets and Reservations

For ticket purchasing, please see the other post

This post mainly introduces the train's interior and onboard facilities

Further reading: Northern Kyushu Independent Travel | JR Pass Ticketing & Reservation | Yufuin no Mori Booking Guide | Ticket Pickup at Hakata Station


Timetable

The Yufuin no Mori runs from Hakata Station, passing through Yufuin,

and finally arriving at Beppu

Official timetable: Timetable 2020-03-14 ~ 2021-02-28

If the dates have passed, the timetable link may no longer work

In that case, just check the latest version on the official website

But the train times don't change much anyway


"Yufu" is the ordinary limited express Yufu, which has non-reserved seating

"Yufuin no Mori" is the actual Yufuin no Mori train!


There are two round-trip Yufuin no Mori services each day

Also, there is only one service a day from Hakata to Beppu

If you're coming from Beppu,

you may want to check the departure times when planning your itinerary


🚊 The Yufuin no Mori Train

The carriage configuration differs slightly depending on the service number

This time we happened to take No. 3 on the way there and No. 2 on the way back

Among the carriages,

the one most people consider the prettiest is car No. 4


It's a carriage designed around a forest concept

The whole car uses a lot of wooden elements

and the floors are all wood


This time we couldn't book the very front of car No. 1

but car No. 4 was still completely empty

so we chose seats in the very last row

Right behind us was the driver's cab at the other end


Although the view faces backwards,

the scenery is still great

If you can't book the front, consider the rear!



Salon Area


This salon area is exclusive to Yufuin no Mori No. 3 & No. 4

On the return trip on No. 2 we didn't see this area


You can buy some light snacks

or a Yufuin train bento

and then enjoy them in the salon area with the scenery outside the window


Onboard Shop


This is the menu of items sold onboard

The shops on the two different train types also look a bit different

The shop on Yufuin no Mori No. 3 & No. 4

The shop on Yufuin no Mori No. 1, 2, 5 and 6


Besides selling goods,

they also give out one commemorative boarding certificate per person



The bento sold onboard is the Michelin one-star Northern Kyushu bento

It's also the ekiben that everyone says you must try



Unfortunately, this bento wasn't quite to my taste

If you're interested, do give these ekiben a try yourself

---

The overall onboard experience is great everywhere

Even the vestibules between carriages are elegantly designed


Shortly after boarding, the train attendant comes on the PA with an introduction

but unfortunately it's only in Japanese

so we really had no idea what she was talking about


If you're making a trip to Yufuin,

why not experience

the resort-style Yufuin no Mori train!

content.$t:
門司港要吃什麼？網路上一查，燒咖哩絕對是門司港必吃！

不過門司港的燒咖哩店實在太多，到底要吃哪一間呢？可以參考日本美食網站 tabelog 的評分來決定，我們挑了一間在門司港車站附近評分最高的，也是網路推薦名店的 - BEAR FRUITS

📜 資訊

  • 地址：〒801-0841 福岡県北九州市門司区西海岸１丁目４−7 門司港センタービル 1F
  • 營業時間：11:00 ~ 21:30 (週五週六開到 22:30)
  • 聯絡電話：+81 93-321-3729
  • 官方網站：http://bearfruits.jp/

燒咖哩其實就是焗烤咖哩，把咖哩飯加上起司進去焗烤，屬於熱量應該很高的食物 😂

🍽 環境與地點


BEAR FRUITS 位於門司港車站走出來，左手邊的馬路對面。由於是間名店，我們這天去的時間又是週日，只要是用餐時間附近，幾乎隨時都有人在排隊



當客滿狀態的時候，記得要自己來前面填寫這張候位單，填寫姓名&人數，店內人員會依照這個單子來依序叫號，但因為他寫日文我們一開始並不知道，是看到有人過去寫才知道。


店門口還放著大大的廣告跟菜單

上戶彩大推薦

“地球毀滅前最後一刻想吃的食物”


我們大概等了15分鐘

很快就進去店內了


店內空間不大

印象中大概十桌上下

尖峰時刻的話應該是真的要等一陣子


🍽 菜單與餐點



主要菜色當然就是燒咖哩了

口味很單純

只有原味或是加牛肉這兩種而已

可以搭配 A, B, C, D, S 五中不同的套餐

另外還有其他的餐點

像是一般的咖哩飯，蛋包飯或是義大利麵

牛肉燒咖哩 (¥ 1050)


另外點了門司港啤酒

但這味道還好

沒有像生啤那樣清爽

個人沒有特別愛

而且又少又不便宜

門司港啤酒 (¥ 650)


---

焗烤咖哩裡面

除了牛肉塊

還加了一些像是青椒、洋蔥絲

搭配起司


還有一顆半熟的雞蛋


配上上層的辣粉

口味算是比較重口味的


附餐還有一小碗的沙拉


---

我覺得口味還算不錯

不過算是可猜想到的味道(?)

但自己覺得由於味道偏重口味

吃到後來會有一點膩

來門司港沒吃過可以吃吃看

試試看著名的門司港名物！

title.$t: Kitakyushu Trip | Mojiko Food | Bear Fruits Baked Curry | Mojiko Specialty | Must-Eat in Mojiko

content.$t:
What should you eat in Mojiko? Search online and you'll find that baked curry is absolutely the must-eat dish in Mojiko!

But there are so many baked curry restaurants in Mojiko — which one should you choose? You can use the ratings on the Japanese food site tabelog to decide. We picked the highest-rated one near Mojiko Station, which is also a famous spot recommended online — BEAR FRUITS

📜 Information

  • Address: 〒801-0841 Moji Port Center Building 1F, 1-4-7 Nishikaigan, Moji-ku, Kitakyushu, Fukuoka
  • Opening hours: 11:00 ~ 21:30 (until 22:30 on Fridays and Saturdays)
  • Phone: +81 93-321-3729
  • Official website: http://bearfruits.jp/

Baked curry is basically curry rice topped with cheese and baked in the oven — definitely a high-calorie dish 😂

🍽 Atmosphere & Location


BEAR FRUITS is located across the street on your left as you walk out of Mojiko Station. Since it's such a famous restaurant and we went on a Sunday, there was almost always a queue whenever it was anywhere near mealtime



When the restaurant is full, remember to go up front and fill in this waiting list yourself with your name and party size. The staff call parties in order based on this list — but since it's written in Japanese, we didn't realize it at first and only figured it out after seeing someone else go over and write their name down.


There's also a big ad and menu displayed at the entrance

Highly recommended by Aya Ueto

"The food I'd want to eat in the last moments before the world ends"


We waited about 15 minutes

and were seated inside pretty quickly


The interior isn't very big

As I recall, around ten tables or so

So at peak hours you really do have to wait a while


🍽 Menu & Dishes



The main dish is of course the baked curry

The flavors are quite simple

Just two options: original, or with beef

You can pair it with five different set menus: A, B, C, D and S

There are other dishes too

such as regular curry rice, omurice, and pasta

Beef Baked Curry (¥ 1050)


We also ordered a Mojiko beer

but the taste was just so-so

Not as refreshing as draft beer

Personally I wasn't a big fan

Plus the serving is small and it isn't cheap

Mojiko Beer (¥ 650)


---

Inside the baked curry

besides the chunks of beef

there were also green peppers and sliced onions

all topped with cheese


Plus a soft-cooked egg


Together with the chili powder sprinkled on top

the flavor is on the strong, rich side


The set also comes with a small bowl of salad


---

I thought the taste was pretty good

though it was more or less what you'd expect (?)

But since the flavor is fairly heavy

it does get a bit cloying toward the end

If you've never tried it, it's worth a go when you're in Mojiko

Give this famous Mojiko specialty a try!

---

title.$t: 北九州自由行 | 福岡美食篇 | 福岡天神限定款一蘭拉麵 | 方盒子一蘭拉麵 | Ichiran Ramen

content.$t:
一蘭拉麵，一直是去日本玩大家推薦要吃的連鎖拉麵店之一，想必大家一定不陌生。自從台北在信義區商圈也開了兩間分店後，要吃到就更加容易了，不需要特地飛一趟日本才能吃到一蘭拉麵！不過台北的分店還是假日都要排很久，至今我也都還沒在台灣吃到過一蘭拉麵 😂。

不過，在一蘭拉麵的發源地 - 九州福岡，就有著兩種充滿特色的限定款一蘭拉麵，主要的特色在於用來承裝一蘭拉麵的碗，有著「方盒子」與「五角型」兩種特色的拉麵碗：
  • 方盒子「釜醬汁豚骨湯拉麵」- 博多運河城博多店、天神西通店
  • 五角型「合格拉麵」- 太宰府參道店
這次我們去的福岡天神西通店，就是有限定版的方盒子一蘭拉麵 。


📜 資訊

  • 店家地址：〒810-0041 福岡県福岡市中央区大名２丁目１−57
  • 營業時間：11:00 ~ 22:00
  • 聯絡電話：+81 92-713-6631
  • 官方網站：https://ichiran.com/shop/kyushu/tenjin-nishidori/


---

🍽 餐廳地點

一蘭拉麵位於熱鬧的天神區


由於天神地下街實在像個迷宮一樣，所以如果不想迷路可以走平面的道路，跟著 google map 走就很容易了。福岡天神西通店在大型百貨公司岩田屋本店的後方，應該很明顯就可以看到一蘭拉麵大大的 logo。

如果想走天神地下街的話，從「西6」出口之後的連接通道，往岩田屋的方向走，也是可以直接從岩田屋出來，一樣可以找到天神西通店。

「西6」出口之後的連接通道

這條走到底就會接到岩田屋本店了


🍽 店內環境

我們抵達的時間大約是當地時間晚上 7:15，也還算是用餐的尖峰時刻，不過排隊的隊伍並沒有很長，稍微等待一下排一下下隊，15分鐘後就換我們入座了。比起在台北的一蘭拉麵，假日用餐時間動輒就要排一小時相比實在是快太多了。


在等候的時候，先自助點餐換取票卷

有很清楚的各國語言使用說明

旁邊也還有一個即時空位顯示燈號


內部是一貫的一蘭拉麵風格，有著一個一個的K書中心獨立座位，每一個座位前面都還有簾子，減少你吃面被外界干擾的機會，讓你可以用心專注在你眼前的這碗拉麵。




座位旁有著各種加點的菜單＆價格，還有告訴你怎麼點餐的說明書。





相信大家都很熟悉了，自己畫好客製化的口味後，放在桌上按下服務鈴，簾子後面就會有工作人員來收單了。

至於口味我們在出發前有調查一下網路上大家都推薦怎麼吃最好吃，大部分都說要選湯最濃，麵最硬，醬汁還要三倍，然後最後還要加上很多的特製辣粉！這樣的客製化的確的香氣很夠，而且特製辣粉又很夠味。不過這樣實在是又辣又鹹.... 湯喝完可能就要去洗腎了，大家還斟酌使用。😂

🍽 方盒子一蘭拉麵


很快的一蘭拉麵馬上就送上來了！這猶如棺材的外觀這看起來很有質感的黑色方盒，感覺湯的份量好像比一般的湯碗還要多了不少。


由於以往吃的經驗，他的麵份量不算太多，所以就也先加點了一份麵。


口味的話就如同印象中的一蘭拉麵一樣，連鎖的店面品質控管的蠻一致，沒什麼不同的。

最有特色的應該就是這個黑色的方盒子了吧！如果有來福岡，不如來吃吃用不同碗承裝的一蘭拉麵，雖然口味不會有不一樣，但是就是個新奇感可以試試看。😂

題外話，這次也有買了一蘭拉麵的泡麵回去試試看，一包大概就要台幣快一100元的泡麵實在很貴，不過煮出來的湯頭算是蠻接近在店內喝到的湯了(當然還是有差距，不過方向很接近了)，但這 CP 值不是特別推薦就是 😏

title.$t: Northern Kyushu Trip | Fukuoka Food | Tenjin-Exclusive Ichiran Ramen | Ichiran's Square Box Ramen | Ichiran Ramen

content.$t:
Ichiran Ramen has always been one of the ramen chains everyone recommends when travelling to Japan, so it surely needs no introduction. Ever since two branches opened in Taipei's Xinyi shopping district, it has become even easier to get a bowl — no need to fly all the way to Japan just for Ichiran! That said, the Taipei branches still have long queues on weekends, and to this day I still haven't managed to eat Ichiran in Taiwan 😂.

However, in Ichiran's birthplace — Fukuoka, Kyushu — there are two distinctive limited-edition versions of Ichiran Ramen. The main difference lies in the bowl the ramen is served in: there is a "square box" style and a "pentagon" style:
  • Square box "Kama-dare Tonkotsu Ramen"- Canal City Hakata branch, Tenjin Nishidori branch
  • Pentagon "Pass-the-Exam Ramen"- Dazaifu Sando branch
The one we visited this time, the Fukuoka Tenjin Nishidori branch, serves the limited-edition square box Ichiran Ramen.


📜 Information

  • Address: 〒810-0041 2-1-57 Daimyo, Chuo-ku, Fukuoka City, Fukuoka Prefecture
  • Opening hours: 11:00 ~ 22:00
  • Phone: +81 92-713-6631
  • Official website: https://ichiran.com/shop/kyushu/tenjin-nishidori/


---

🍽 Restaurant Location

Ichiran Ramen is located in the bustling Tenjin district


Since the Tenjin underground mall really is like a maze, if you don't want to get lost you can walk at street level — just follow Google Maps and it's easy. The Fukuoka Tenjin Nishidori branch is behind the big Iwataya department store's main building, and you should easily spot the huge Ichiran logo.

If you'd rather go through the Tenjin underground mall, take the connecting passage after Exit "West 6" and head toward Iwataya; you can come out directly at Iwataya and still find the Tenjin Nishidori branch.

The connecting passage after Exit "West 6"

Follow this passage to the end and you'll reach the Iwataya main store


🍽 Inside the Restaurant

We arrived at around 7:15 p.m. local time, still fairly peak dining hours, but the queue wasn't very long. After a short wait of about 15 minutes it was our turn to be seated. Compared with Ichiran in Taipei, where you easily wait an hour at weekend meal times, this was way faster.


While waiting, order at the self-service machine to get your meal ticket

There are clear instructions in several languages

Next to it there's also a real-time display showing available seats


The interior is classic Ichiran: individual booths like study-hall carrels, each with a curtain in front to minimise outside distractions so you can focus entirely on the bowl of ramen in front of you.




Beside the seat there's a menu of add-ons with prices, plus instructions telling you how to order.





I'm sure everyone is familiar with the drill: fill in your customised preferences on the order sheet, put it on the counter and press the service bell, and a staff member behind the curtain will come to collect it.

As for the flavour settings, before the trip we looked up what people online recommend as the tastiest combination. Most say to pick the richest broth, the firmest noodles, triple sauce, and then add lots of the special chilli powder at the end! This combination certainly is very aromatic, and the special chilli powder packs a punch. But it really turns out both spicy and salty.... you might need dialysis after finishing the soup, so use your judgement. 😂

🍽 The Square Box Ichiran Ramen


The ramen arrived very quickly! This coffin-like container This classy-looking black square box seems to hold quite a bit more soup than a regular ramen bowl.


From past experience the noodle portion isn't very big, so we ordered an extra serving of noodles up front.


Taste-wise it's exactly the Ichiran you remember — the chain's quality control is very consistent, no real difference.

The most distinctive thing is probably that black square box! If you're in Fukuoka, why not try Ichiran served in a different vessel — the flavour won't differ, but the novelty makes it worth a shot. 😂

On a side note, we also bought some Ichiran instant ramen to take home and try. At nearly NT$100 a pack it's really expensive instant noodles, but the broth once cooked is fairly close to what you drink in-store (there's still a gap, of course, but it's heading in the right direction). Still, the value for money isn't something I'd particularly recommend 😏

title.$t: 北九州自由行 | 下關市區景點篇 | 門司港往下關交通 | 唐戶市場 | 日清議和紀念館 | 赤間神宮

content.$t:
下關是位於日本山口縣的城市，自古以來一直作為“日本的門戶”而繁榮發展，是本州最西端的都市，也是一座充滿文化、歷史和大自然美景的城市。最知名的漁獲是河魨和鮟鱇魚，這兩種都是全日本捕獲量最高的地方。

這裡也是馬關條約簽訂的歷史地點，通常來門司港遊玩都會搭配下關一起。在我們完成早上的門司港漫步後，午餐後就準備出發到下關去走走。

先來張相對位置圖：

門司港 & 下關景點相對位置
---

⛴ 門司港往下關交通

從門司港去下關有幾種方法

  • 自駕
  • 火車(山陽本線)
  • 搭渡輪 (約5min)
  • 步行海底隧道 (約40min)

由於搭火車離景點都不是很方便，海底隧道的路口又不是在門司港車站這裡，這次就放棄用走的，直接來回都搭渡輪。

從門司港車站往海邊走，馬上就可以看到搭船到下關的地方。


船票單程大人一個人是400日圓



不過這裡同時還有去嚴流島的船，不要買錯票＆上錯船喔。嚴流島是關門海峽中的一個無人島

因宮本武藏和佐佐木小次郎在此決鬥而有名。但看了一下別人去過的介紹，島上除了一尊決鬥的雕像之外，就沒有東西了….所以我們是沒有太大興趣特地繞過去。

上船的時候要注意搭船的方向


這台就是這裡聯絡的渡輪


渡輪有分室內跟室外，但因為天氣也是蠻冷的，加上5分鐘就到了而且其實沒有什麼景可以看可以直接舒服坐在室內就好了，五分鐘過後就會到下關囉！

---

⚓ 卡蒙碼頭

  • 地址：〒750-0005 山口県下関市唐戸町６−1
  • 營業時間：09:00 ~ 22:00


碼頭旁有個小小的複合商場，大部分都是餐廳。

---

🐟 唐戶市場

  • 地址：〒750-0005 山口県下関市唐戸町５−50
  • 營業時間：
    • 05:00 ~ 15:00 (週一～週六)
    • 08:00 ~ 15:00 (週日)
  • 官方網站：http://www.karatoichiba.com/

唐戶市場是位於日本山口縣下關市唐戶地區的地方批發市場，也是下關市著名的旅遊觀光景點。1909年開始政府許可在此的路邊販賣野菜，直到 1933年政府將野菜市場與唐戶魚市場，整合為「下關市唐戶魚菜市場」，也成為現在唐戶市場的前身。


沿著海邊繼續走，很快就會看到唐戶市場，唐戶市場有著各種新鮮魚貨海鮮，又被稱為"關門的廚房“與“河豚天堂”，在這裏可以買到很多新鮮的魚貨，魚販會在這裡卸貨之後直接販售。

一進去就看到一隻很大的河豚像

一樓外圍是一些商店賣一些乾貨


二樓有一些很平價的海鮮餐廳，一樓內部平日是一個販售漁獲的普通漁市場。但最值得體驗的是在週五至週日的活きいき馬関街飲食イベント，就是所謂的假日壽司屋台，有很多海鮮小吃攤，販售的各種壽司與海鮮炸物。


壽司屋台



在一樓買完食物後，可以到二樓的座位區來食用。由於已經吃過午餐，我們就只買了個炸河豚&炸海膽來試試看味道。至於哪一攤比較好吃，就由大家自己去品嚐試試看了！


很多人也會買了食物後，在唐戶市場外的海邊，一邊欣賞關門海峽美景，一邊享受美食。


---

 日清議和紀念館

  • 地址：〒750-0003 山口県下関市阿弥陀寺町４−3
  • 營業時間：09:00 ~ 17:00
  • 參觀費用：免費
  • 官方網站：http://www.shimohaku.jp/page0106.html


小時候歷史課都會讀到，大清帝國與日本進行了甲午戰爭，最後清廷戰敗被迫議和，與日本簽訂了割讓台灣的《馬關條約》，結束了甲午戰爭。而清廷代表李鴻章和日方代表伊藤博文，他們簽訂《馬關條約》的地點就在這裡 –「春帆樓」。

而旁邊的「日清議和紀念館」，就是用來紀念這段歷史。原來簽訂馬關條約的地方是在春帆樓二樓，但春帆樓因地震重建，而將所有文物移至旁邊的紀念館。紀念館中現今重現當時談判會議上的場景，並展示當時談判雙方使用的相關文書資料。


這張位置就是當年李鴻章坐的位置


---

 赤間神宮

  • 地址：〒750-0003 山口県下関市阿弥陀寺町４−1
  • 營業時間：每日
  • 官方網站：http://www.tiki.ne.jp/~akama-jingu/



外型像龍宮城的赤間神宮，是下關必去的景點之一，位於日清議和紀念館隔壁，離連絡船碼頭只有15分鐘的路程。

水天門


最特別的是赤間神宮的水天門，外型就像日本童話中的龍宮城，其實背後是有歷史故事的。

赤間神宮是為了祭祀年幼安德天皇所建的，在平氏和源氏發生的大規模內亂中，安德天皇由兩位尼抱著投水自盡。據說，外型像龍宮城的水天門，是因為安德天皇投水前，外祖母告訴他「浪濤底下也有都城」。也有一說是兩位尼誦著一首詩歌，意思是「海底深處也會有宮殿」。因此後人將神宮設計有如龍宮，象徵供奉在海底的神體

殿旁還有一個石碑，奉鎮著三種神器之一八咫鏡，據說安德天皇投水時將三種神器也都一同帶走，之後源氏只找回了八尺瓊勾玉及八咫鏡，草薙劍則未曾尋獲，而傳說中八咫鏡就被供奉在這裡。


和一般神社一樣，這裡可以綁著抽到著壞運氣的籤


從這條小路進去可以到無耳芳一堂跟祭祀平家的七盛塚。無耳芳一怪談有興趣的人可以直接去wiki看：延伸閱讀：無耳芳一怪談



---
